101.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
101.t: jo jo peevai so tirapataavai ||
101.e: Whoever drinks this in, is satisfied.

101.g: ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
101.t: amar hovai jo naam ras paavai ||
101.e: Whoever obtains the Sublime Essence of the Naam becomes immortal.

101.g: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
101.t: naam nidhaan tiseh paraapat jis sabadh guroo man vooThaa jeeau ||2||
101.e: The Treasure of the Naam is obtained by one whose mind is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

101.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
101.t: jin har ras paiaa so tirapat aghaanaa ||
101.e: One who obtains the Sublime Essence of the Lord is satisfied and fulfilled.

101.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਨਾਹਿ ਡੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
101.t: jin har saadh paiaa so naeh ddulaanaa ||
101.e: One who obtains this Flavor of the Lord does not waver.

101.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
101.t: tiseh paraapat har har naamaa jis masatak bhaageeThaa jeeau ||3||
101.e: One who has this destiny written on his forehead obtains the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

101.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
101.t: har ikas hath aaiaa varasaane bahutere ||
101.e: The Lord has come into the hands of the One, the Guru, who has blessed so many with good fortune.

101.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
101.t: tis lag mukat bhe ghanere ||
101.e: Attached to Him, a great many have been liberated.

101.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੨॥
101.t: naam nidhaanaa gurmukh paieeaai kahu naanak viralee ddeeThaa jeeau ||4||15||22||
101.e: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam; says Nanak, those who see the Lord are very rare. ||4||15||22||

101.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
101.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
101.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

101.g: ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
101.t: nidh sidh ridh har har har merai ||
101.e: My Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the nine treasures, the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, wealth and prosperity.

101.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥
101.t: janam padhaarath gahir ga(n)bheerai ||
101.e: He is the Deep and Profound Treasure of Life.

101.g: ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
101.t: laakh koT khuseeaa ra(n)g raavai jo gur laagaa paiee jeeau ||1||
101.e: Hundreds of thousands, even millions of pleasures and delights are enjoyed by one who falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

101.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
101.t: dharasan pekhat bhe puneetaa ||
101.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all are sanctified,

101.g: ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
101.t: sagal udhaare bhaiee meetaa ||
101.e: and all family and friends are saved.

101.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
101.t: agam agochar suaamee apunaa gur kirapaa te sach dhiaaiee jeeau ||2||
101.e: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Inaccessible and Unfathomable True Lord. ||2||

101.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਉਪਾਏ ॥ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
101.t: jaa kau khojeh sarab upaae || vaddabhaagee dharasan ko viralaa paae ||
101.e: The One, the Guru, who is sought by all-only a few, by great good fortune, receive His Darshan.

101.g: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਥਾਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
101.t: uooch apaar agochar thaanaa oh mahal guroo dhekhaiee jeeau ||3||
101.e: His Place is lofty, infinite and unfathomable; the Guru has shown me that palace. ||3||

101.g: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
101.t: gahir ga(n)bheer a(n)mirat naam teraa ||
101.e: Your Ambrosial Name is deep and profound.

101.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਰਾ ॥
101.t: mukat bhiaa jis ridhai vaseraa ||
101.e: That person is liberated, in whose heart You dwell.

101.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੩॥
101.t: gur ba(n)dhan tin ke sagale kaaTe jan naanak sahaj samaiee jeeau ||4||16||23||
101.e: The Guru cuts away all his bonds; O Servant Nanak, he is absorbed in the poise of intuitive peace. ||4||16||23||

101.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
101.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
101.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

101.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
101.t: prabh kirapaa te har har dhiaavau ||
101.e: By God's Grace, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.

101.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
101.t: prabhoo dhiaa te ma(n)gal gaavau ||
101.e: By God's Kindness, I sing the songs of joy.

101.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਗਲ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
101.t: uooThat baiThat sovat jaagat har dhiaaieeaai sagal avaradhaa jeeau ||1||
101.e: While standing and sitting, while sleeping and while awake, meditate on the Lord, all your life. ||1||

101.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਆ ॥
101.t: naam aaukhadh mo kau saadhoo dheeaa ||
101.e: The Holy Saint has given me the Medicine of the Naam.

101.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
101.t: kilabikh kaaTe niramal theeaa ||
101.e: My sins have been cut out, and I have become pure.

101.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਸਭ ਪੀਰਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਦਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
101.t: anadh bhiaa nikasee sabh peeraa sagal binaase dharadhaa jeeau ||2||
101.e: I am filled with bliss, and all my pains have been taken away. All my suffering has been dispelled. ||2||

101.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
101.t: jis kaa a(n)g kare meraa piaaraa || so mukataa saagar sa(n)saaraa ||
101.e: One who has my Beloved on his side, is liberated from the world-ocean.

101.g: ਸਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
101.t: sat kare jin guroo pachhaataa so kaahe kau ddaradhaa jeeau ||3||
101.e: One who recognizes the Guru practices Truth; why should he be afraid? ||3||

101.g: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਉ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਏ ॥
101.t: jab te saadhoo sa(n)gat paae || gur bheTat hau giee balaae ||
101.e: Since I found the Company of the Holy and met the Guru, the demon of pride has departed.

101.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਢਾਕਿ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੜਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੨੪॥
101.t: saas saas har gaavai naanak satigur ddaak leeaa meraa paRadhaa jeeau ||4||17||24||
101.e: With each and every breath, Nanak sings the Lord's Praises. The True Guru has covered my sins. ||4||17||24||

101.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
101.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
101.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

101.g: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
101.t: ot pot sevak sa(n)g raataa ||
101.e: Through and through, the Lord is intermingled with His servant.

101.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
101.t: prabh pratipaale sevak sukhadhaataa ||
101.e: God, the Giver of Peace, cherishes His servant.

101.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
101.t: paanee pakhaa peesau sevak kai Thaakur hee kaa aahar jeeau ||1||
101.e: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the grain for the servant of my Lord and Master. ||1||

101.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
101.t: kaaT silak prabh sevaa laiaa ||
101.e: God has cut the noose from around my neck; He has placed me in His Service.

101.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
101.t: hukam saahib kaa sevak man bhaiaa ||
101.e: The Lord and Master's Command is pleasing to the mind of His servant.

101.g: ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
101.t: soiee kamaavai jo saahib bhaavai sevak a(n)tar baahar maahar jeeau ||2||
101.e: He does that which pleases his Lord and Master. Inwardly and outwardly, the servant knows his Lord. ||2||

101.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
101.t: too(n) dhaanaa Thaakur sabh bidh jaaneh ||
101.e: You are the All-knowing Lord and Master; You know all ways and means.

102.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ॥
102.t: Thaakur ke sevak har ra(n)g maaneh ||
102.e: The servant of the Lord and Master enjoys the Love and Affection of the Lord.

102.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
102.t: jo kichh Thaakur kaa so sevak kaa sevak Thaakur hee sa(n)g jaahar jeeau ||3||
102.e: That which belongs to the Lord and Master, belongs to His servant. The servant becomes distinguished in association with his Lord and Master. ||3||

102.g: ਅਪੁਨੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਜੋ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
102.t: apunai Thaakur jo pahiraiaa || bahur na lekhaa puchh bulaiaa ||
102.e: He, whom the Lord and Master dresses in the robes of honor, is not called to answer for his account any longer.

102.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰਾ ਗਉਹਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੫॥
102.t: tis sevak kai naanak kurabaanee so gahir gabheeraa gauhar jeeau ||4||18||25||
102.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to that servant. He is the pearl of the deep and unfathomable Ocean of God. ||4||18||25||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

102.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
102.t: sabh kichh ghar meh baahar naahee ||
102.e: Everything is within the home of the self; there is nothing beyond.
One who searches outside is deluded by doubt.

102.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
102.t: gur parasaadhee jinee a(n)tar paiaa so a(n)tar baahar suhelaa jeeau ||1||
102.e: By Guru's Grace, one who has found the Lord within is happy, inwardly and outwardly. ||1||
Slowly, gently, drop by drop, the stream of nectar trickles down within.
The mind drinks it in, hearing and reflecting on the Word of the Shabad.

102.g: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
102.t: anadh binodh kare dhin raatee sadhaa sadhaa har kelaa jeeau ||2||
102.e: It enjoys bliss and ecstasy day and night, and plays with the Lord forever and ever. ||2||
I have now been united with the Lord after having been separated and cut off from Him for so many lifetimes;
by the Grace of the Holy Saint, the dried-up branches have blossomed forth again in their greenery.

102.g: ਸੁਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਏ ਮੇਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
102.t: sumat paae naam dhiaae gurmukh hoe melaa jeeau ||3||
102.e: I have obtained this sublime understanding, and I meditate on the Naam; as Gurmukh, I have met the Lord. ||3||
As the waves of water merge again with the water,
so does my light merge again into the Light.

102.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਟੇ ਕਿਵਾੜਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਜਉਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੬॥
102.t: kahu naanak bhram kaTe kivaaRaa bahuR na hoieeaai jaulaa jeeau ||4||19||26||
102.e: Says Nanak, the veil of illusion has been cut away, and I shall not go out wandering any more. ||4||19||26||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
I am a sacrifice to those who have heard of You.
I am a sacrifice to those whose tongues speak of You.

102.g: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
102.t: vaar vaar jaiee tis viTahu jo man tan tudh aaraadhe jeeau ||1||
102.e: Again and again, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on You with mind and body. ||1||

102.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
102.t: tis charan pakhaalee jo terai maarag chaalai ||
102.e: I wash the feet of those who walk upon Your Path.
With my eyes, I long to behold those kind people.

102.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
102.t: man dhevaa tis apune saajan jin gur mil so prabh laadhe jeeau ||2||
102.e: I offer my mind to those friends, who have met the Guru and found God. ||2||
Very fortunate are those who know You.
In the midst of all, they remain detached and balanced in Nirvaanaa.

102.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਤ ਉਨਿ ਸਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
102.t: saadh kai sa(n)g un bhaujal tariaa sagal dhoot un saadhe jeeau ||3||
102.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and conquer all their evil passions. ||3||

102.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
102.t: tin kee saran pariaa man meraa ||
102.e: My mind has entered their Sanctuary.
I have renounced my pride in my own strength, and the darkness of emotional attachment.

102.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੭॥
102.t: naam dhaan dheejai naanak kau tis prabh agam agaadhe jeeau ||4||20||27||
102.e: Please bless Nanak with the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable God. ||4||20||27||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
You are the tree; Your branches have blossomed forth.
From the very small and subtle, You have become huge and manifest.

102.g: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
102.t: too(n) jalanidh too(n) fen budhabudhaa tudh bin avar na bhaaleeaai jeeau ||1||
102.e: You are the Ocean of Water, and You are the foam and the bubbles on its surface. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||1||
You are the thread, and You are also the beads.
You are the knot, and You are the primary bead of the maalaa.

102.g: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਦਿਖਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
102.t: aadh madh a(n)t prabh soiee avar na koi dhikhaaleeaai jeeau ||2||
102.e: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, there is God. I cannot see any other except You, Lord. ||2||
You transcend all qualities, and You possess the supreme qualities. You are the Giver of peace.
You are detached in Nirvaanaa, and You are the Enjoyer, imbued with love.

102.g: ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
102.t: apane karatab aape jaaneh aape tudh samaaleeaai jeeau ||3||
102.e: You Yourself know Your Own Ways; You dwell upon Yourself. ||3||
You are the Master, and then again, You are the servant.
O God, You Yourself are the Manifest and the Unmanifest.

102.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੮॥
102.t: naanak dhaas sadhaa gun gaavai ik bhoree nadhar nihaaleeaai jeeau ||4||21||28||
102.e: Slave Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises forever. Please, just for a moment, bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||21||28||

103.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
103.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
103.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

103.g: ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
103.t: safal su baanee jit naam vakhaanee ||
103.e: Blessed are those words, by which the Naam is chanted.

103.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
103.t: gur parasaadh kinai viralai jaanee ||
103.e: Rare are those who know this, by Guru's Grace.

103.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
103.t: dha(n)nu su velaa jit har gaavat sunanaa aae te paravaanaa jeeau ||1||
103.e: Blessed is that time when one sings and hears the Lord's Name. Blessed and approved is the coming of such a one. ||1||

103.g: ਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
103.t: se netr paravaan jinee dharasan pekhaa ||
103.e: Those eyes which behold the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan are approved and accepted.

103.g: ਸੇ ਕਰ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
103.t: se kar bhale jinee har jas lekhaa ||
103.e: Those hands which write the Praises of the Lord are good.

103.g: ਸੇ ਚਰਣ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
103.t: se charan suhaave jo har maarag chale hau bal tin sa(n)g pachhaanaa jeeau ||2||
103.e: Those feet which walk in the Lord's Way are beautiful. I am a sacrifice to that Congregation in which the Lord is recognized. ||2||

103.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
103.t: sun saajan mere meet piaare ||
103.e: Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:

103.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥
103.t: saadhasa(n)g khin maeh udhaare ||
103.e: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved in an instant.

103.g: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
103.t: kilavikh kaaT hoaa man niramal miT ge aavan jaanaa jeeau ||3||
103.e: Your sins will be cut out; your mind will be immaculate and pure. Your comings and goings shall cease. ||3||

103.g: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
103.t: dhui kar joR ik binau kareejai ||
103.e: With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer:

103.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਪਥਰੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
103.t: kar kirapaa ddubadhaa pathar leejai ||
103.e: please bless me with Your Mercy, and save this sinking stone.

103.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੯॥
103.t: naanak kau prabh bhe kirapaalaa prabh naanak man bhaanaa jeeau ||4||22||29||
103.e: God has become merciful to Nanak; God is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||4||22||29||

103.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
103.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
103.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

103.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
103.t: a(n)mirat baanee har har teree ||
103.e: The Word of Your Bani, Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar.

103.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
103.t: sun sun hovai param gat meree ||
103.e: Hearing it again and again, I am elevated to the supreme heights.

103.g: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
103.t: jalan bujhee seetal hoi manooaa satigur kaa dharasan paae jeeau ||1||
103.e: The burning within me has been extinguished, and my mind has been cooled and soothed, by the Blessed Vision of the True Guru. ||1||

103.g: ਸੂਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
103.t: sookh bhiaa dhukh dhoor paraanaa ||
103.e: Happiness is obtained, and sorrow runs far away,

103.g: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
103.t: sa(n)t rasan har naam vakhaanaa ||
103.e: when the Saints chant the Lord's Name.

103.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
103.t: jal thal neer bhare sar subhar birathaa koi na jaae jeeau ||2||
103.e: The sea, the dry land, and the lakes are filled with the Water of the Lord's Name; no place is left empty. ||2||

103.g: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
103.t: dhiaa dhaaree tin sirajanahaare ||
103.e: The Creator has showered His Kindness;

103.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਗਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
103.t: jeea ja(n)t sagale pratipaare ||
103.e: He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.

103.g: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
103.t: miharavaan kirapaal dhiaalaa sagale tirapat aghaae jeeau ||3||
103.e: He is Merciful, Kind and Compassionate. All are satisfied and fulfilled through Him. ||3||

103.g: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
103.t: van tiran tirabhavan keeton hariaa ||
103.e: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds are rendered green.

103.g: ਕਰਣਹਾਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
103.t: karanahaar khin bheetar kariaa ||
103.e: The Doer of all did this in an instant.

103.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੩੦॥
103.t: gurmukh naanak tisai araadhe man kee aas pujaae jeeau ||4||23||30||
103.e: As Gurmukh, Nanak meditates on the One who fulfills the desires of the mind. ||4||23||30||

103.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
103.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
103.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

103.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
103.t: too(n) meraa pitaa too(n)hai meraa maataa ||
103.e: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

103.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
103.t: too(n) meraa ba(n)dhap too(n) meraa bhraataa ||
103.e: You are my Relative, and You are my Brother.

103.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
103.t: too(n) meraa raakhaa sabhanee thaiee taa bhau kehaa kaaRaa jeeau ||1||
103.e: You are my Protector everywhere; why should I feel any fear or anxiety? ||1||

103.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
103.t: tumaree kirapaa te tudh pachhaanaa ||
103.e: By Your Grace, I recognize You.

103.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
103.t: too(n) meree oT too(n)hai meraa maanaa ||
103.e: You are my Shelter, and You are my Honor.

103.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
103.t: tujh bin dhoojaa avar na koiee sabh teraa khel akhaaRaa jeeau ||2||
103.e: Without You, there is no other; the entire Universe is the Arena of Your Play. ||2||

103.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
103.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh tudh upaae ||
103.e: You have created all beings and creatures.

103.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
103.t: jit jit bhaanaa tit tit laae ||
103.e: As it pleases You, You assign tasks to one and all.

103.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਸਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
103.t: sabh kichh keetaa teraa hovai naahee kichh asaaRaa jeeau ||3||
103.e: All things are Your Doing; we can do nothing ourselves. ||3||

103.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
103.t: naam dhiaai mahaa sukh paiaa ||
103.e: Meditating on the Naam, I have found great peace.

103.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥
103.t: har gun gai meraa man seetalaiaa ||
103.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my mind is cooled and soothed.

103.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤਾ ਬਿਖਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੧॥
103.t: gur poorai vajee vaadhaiee naanak jitaa bikhaaRaa jeeau ||4||24||31||
103.e: Through the Perfect Guru, congratulations are pouring in-Nanak is victorious on the arduous battlefield of life! ||4||24||31||

103.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
103.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
103.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

103.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
103.t: jeea praan prabh maneh adhaaraa ||
103.e: God is the Breath of Life of my soul, the Support of my mind.

103.g: ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
103.t: bhagat jeeveh gun gai apaaraa ||
103.e: His devotees live by singing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

103.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
103.t: gun nidhaan a(n)mrit har naamaa har dhiaai dhiaai sukh paiaa jeeau ||1||
103.e: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Meditating, meditating on the Lord's Name, I have found peace. ||1||

103.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ॥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
103.t: manasaa dhaar jo ghar te aavai || saadhasa(n)g janam maran miTaavai ||
103.e: One whose heart's desires lead him from his own home to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall be rid of the cycle of birth and death.

104.g: ਆਸ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੇਟਤ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
104.t: aas manorath pooran hovai bheTat gur dharasaiaa jeeau ||2||
104.e: His hopes and desires are fulfilled, when he gains the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

104.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
104.t: agam agochar kichh mit nahee jaanee ||
104.e: The limits of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord cannot be known.
The seekers, the Siddhas, those beings of miraculous spiritual powers, and the spiritual teachers, all meditate on Him.

104.g: ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
104.t: khudhee miTee chookaa bholaavaa gur man hee meh pragaTaiaa jeeau ||3||
104.e: Thus, their egos are erased, and their doubts are dispelled. The Guru has enlightened their minds. ||3||

104.g: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥
104.t: anadh ma(n)gal kaliaan nidhaanaa || sookh sahaj har naam vakhaanaa ||
104.e: I chant the Name of the Lord, the Treasure of bliss, joy, salvation, intuitive peace and poise.

104.g: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੫॥੩੨॥
104.t: hoi kirapaal suaamee apanaa naau naanak ghar meh aaiaa jeeau ||4||25||32||
104.e: When my Lord and Master blessed me with His Mercy, O Nanak, then His Name entered the home of my mind. ||4||25||32||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
Hearing of You, I live.
You are my Beloved, my Lord and Master, Utterly Great.

104.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
104.t: tumare karatab tum hee jaanahu tumaree oT guopaalaa jeeau ||1||
104.e: You alone know Your Ways; I grasp Your Support, Lord of the World. ||1||
Singing Your Glorious Praises, my mind is rejuvenated.
Hearing Your Sermon, all filth is removed.

104.g: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
104.t: bheTat sa(n)g saadh sa(n)tan kai sadhaa japau dhiaalaa jeeau ||2||
104.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate forever on the Merciful Lord. ||2||
I dwell on my God with each and every breath.

104.g: ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
104.t: eeh mat gur prasaadh man dhaarau ||
104.e: This understanding has been implanted within my mind, by Guru's Grace.

104.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
104.t: tumaree kirapaa te hoi pragaasaa sarab miaa pratipaalaa jeeau ||3||
104.e: By Your Grace, the Divine Light has dawned. The Merciful Lord cherishes everyone. ||3||
True, True, True is that God.
Forever, forever and ever, He Himself is.

104.g: ਚਲਿਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੩॥
104.t: chalit tumaare pragaT piaare dhekh naanak bhe nihaalaa jeeau ||4||26||33||
104.e: Your Playful Ways are revealed, O my Beloved. Beholding them, Nanak is enraptured. ||4||26||33||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
By His Command, the rain begins to fall.
The Saints and friends have met to chant the Naam.

104.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
104.t: seetal saa(n)t sahaj sukh paiaa Thaadd paiee prabh aape jeeau ||1||
104.e: Serene tranquility and peaceful ease have come; God Himself has brought a deep and profound peace. ||1||
God has produced everything in great abundance.
Granting His Grace, God has satisfied all.

104.g: ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
104.t: dhaat karahu mere dhaataaraa jeea ja(n)t sabh dhraape jeeau ||2||
104.e: Bless us with Your Gifts, O my Great Giver. All beings and creatures are satisfied. ||2||
True is the Master, and True is His Name.
By Guru's Grace, I meditate forever on Him.

104.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੋਹਾ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
104.t: janam maran bhai kaaTe mohaa binase sog sa(n)taape jeeau ||3||
104.e: The fear of birth and death has been dispelled; emotional attachment, sorrow and suffering have been erased. ||3||
With each and every breath, Nanak praises the Lord.
Meditating in remembrance on the Name, all bonds are cut away.

104.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਕਰੀ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਪੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੪॥
104.t: pooran aas karee khin bheetar har har har gun jaape jeeau ||4||27||34||
104.e: One's hopes are fulfilled in an instant, chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||27||34||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
Come, dear friends, Saints and companions:
let us join together and sing the Glorious Praises of the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

104.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
104.t: gaavat sunat sabhe hee mukate so dhiaaieeaai jin ham ke'ee jeeau ||1||
104.e: Those who sing and hear these praises are liberated, so let us meditate on the One who created us. ||1||
The sins of countless incarnations depart,
and we receive the fruits of the mind's desires.

104.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਭਸੁ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
104.t: simar saahib so sach suaamee rijak sabhas kau dhe'ee jeeau ||2||
104.e: So meditate on that Lord, our True Lord and Master, who gives sustenance to all. ||2||
Chanting the Naam, all pleasures are obtained.

104.g: ਸਭੁ ਭਉ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
104.t: sabh bhau binasai har har dhiaaieeaai ||
104.e: All fears are erased, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

104.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਥੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
104.t: jin seviaa so paaragiraamee kaaraj sagale the'ee jeeau ||3||
104.e: One who serves the Lord swims across to the other side, and all his affairs are resolved. ||3||
I have come to Your Sanctuary;
if it pleases You, unite me with You.

105.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੫॥
105.t: kar kirapaa prabh bhagatee laavahu sach naanak a(n)mrit pe'ee jeeau ||4||28||35||
105.e: Shower Your Mercy upon me, God; let me be committed to devotional worship. Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of Truth. ||4||28||35||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth, has become Merciful;
the rain is falling everywhere.

105.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
105.t: dheen dhiaal sadhaa kirapaalaa Thaadd paiee karataare jeeau ||1||
105.e: He is Merciful to the meek, always Kind and Gentle; the Creator has brought cooling relief. ||1||
He cherishes all His beings and creatures,
as the mother cares for her children.

105.g: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਆਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
105.t: dhukh bha(n)jan sukh saagar suaamee dhet sagal aahaare jeeau ||2||
105.e: The Destroyer of pain, the Ocean of Peace, the Lord and Master gives sustenance to all. ||2||
The Merciful Lord is totally pervading and permeating the water and the land.
I am forever devoted, a sacrifice to Him.

105.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ਜਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
105.t: rain dhinas tis sadhaa dhiaaiee j khin meh sagal udhaare jeeau ||3||
105.e: Night and day, I always meditate on Him; in an instant, He saves all. ||3||
God Himself protects all;
He drives out all sorrow and suffering.

105.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੬॥
105.t: naam japat man tan hareeaaval prabh naanak nadhar nihaare jeeau ||4||29||36||
105.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are rejuvenated. O Nanak, God has bestowed His Glance of Grace. ||4||29||36||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
Where the Naam, the Name of God the Beloved is chanted
those barren places become mansions of gold.

105.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਇਦਾ ਸੇਈ ਨਗਰ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
105.t: jithai naam na japeeaai mere goidhaa seiee nagar ujaaRee jeeau ||1||
105.e: Where the Naam, the Name of my Lord of the Universe is not chanted-those towns are like the barren wilderness. ||1||
One who meditates as he eats dry bread,
sees the Blessed Lord inwardly and outwardly.

105.g: ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਸੂ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
105.t: khai khai kare badhafailee jaan visoo kee vaaRee jeeau ||2||
105.e: Know this well, that one who eats and eats while practicing evil, is like a field of poisonous plants. ||2||
One who does not feel love for the Saints,
misbehaves in the company of the wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics;

105.g: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਖੋਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੜ ਅਪੁਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
105.t: dhulabh dheh khoiee agiaanee jaR apunee aap upaaRee jeeau ||3||
105.e: he wastes this human body, so difficult to obtain. In his ignorance, he tears up his own roots. ||3||
I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek,
Ocean of Peace, my Guru, Sustainer of the world.

105.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮ ਅਸਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੩੭॥
105.t: kar kirapaa naanak gun gaavai raakhahu saram asaaRee jeeau ||4||30||37||
105.e: Shower Your Mercy upon Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; please, preserve my honor. ||4||30||37||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
I cherish in my heart the Feet of my Lord and Master.
All my troubles and sufferings have run away.

105.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
105.t: saa(n)t sookh sahaj dhun upajee saadhoo sa(n)g nivaasaa jeeau ||1||
105.e: The music of intuitive peace, poise and tranquility wells up within; I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
The bonds of love with the Lord are never broken.
The Lord is totally permeating and pervading inside and out.

105.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
105.t: simar simar simar gun gaavaa kaaTee jam kee faasaa jeeau ||2||
105.e: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, singing His Glorious Praises, the noose of death is cut away. ||2||
The Ambrosial Nectar, the Unstruck Melody of Gurbani rains down continually;
deep within my mind and body, peace and tranquility have come.

105.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
105.t: tirapat aghai rahe jan tere satigur keeaa dhilaasaa jeeau ||3||
105.e: Your humble servants remain satisfied and fulfilled, and the True Guru blesses them with encouragement and comfort. ||3||

105.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
105.t: jis kaa saa tis te fal paiaa ||
105.e: We are His, and from Him, we receive our rewards.
Showering His Mercy upon us, God has united us with Him.

105.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੩੮॥
105.t: aavan jaan rahe vaddabhaagee naanak pooran aasaa jeeau ||4||31||38||
105.e: Our comings and goings have ended, and through great good fortune, O Nanak, our hopes are fulfilled. ||4||31||38||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
The rain has fallen; I have found the Transcendent Lord God.
All beings and creatures dwell in peace.

105.g: ਗਇਆ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
105.t: giaa kales bhiaa sukh saachaa har har naam samaalee jeeau ||1||
105.e: Suffering has been dispelled, and true happiness has dawned, as we meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

105.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
105.t: jis ke se tin hee pratipaare ||
105.e: The One, to whom we belong, cherishes and nurtures us.
The Supreme Lord God has become our Protector.

105.g: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
105.t: sunee bena(n)tee Thaakur merai pooran hoiee ghaalee jeeau ||2||
105.e: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer; my efforts have been rewarded. ||2||

106.e: He is the Giver of all souls.
By Guru's Grace, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.

106.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਮਹੀਅਲ ਸਭਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਣੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
106.t: jal thal maheeal sabh tirapataane saadhoo charan pakhaalee jeeau ||3||
106.e: The beings in the water, on the land and in the sky are all satisfied; I wash the Feet of the Holy. ||3||
He is the Fulfiller of the desires of the mind.
Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.

106.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੩੯॥
106.t: naanak dhaan keeaa dhukh bha(n)jan rate ra(n)g rasaalee jeeau ||4||32||39||
106.e: O Nanak, the Destroyer of pain has given this Gift; I am imbued with the Love of the Delightful Lord. ||4||32||39||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

106.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਭੀ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
106.t: man tan teraa dhan bhee teraa ||
106.e: Mind and body are Yours; all wealth is Yours.
You are my God, my Lord and Master.

106.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
106.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh raas tumaaree teraa jor gopaalaa jeeau ||1||
106.e: Body and soul and all riches are Yours. Yours is the Power, O Lord of the World. ||1||
Forever and ever, You are the Giver of Peace.
I bow down and fall at Your Feet.

106.g: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
106.t: kaar kamaavaa je tudh bhaavaa jaa too(n) dheh dhiaalaa jeeau ||2||
106.e: I act as it pleases You, as You cause me to act, Kind and Compassionate Dear Lord. ||2||

106.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਲਹਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
106.t: prabh tum te lahanaa too(n) meraa gahanaa ||
106.e: O God, from You I receive; You are my decoration.

106.g: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥
106.t: jo too(n) dheh soiee sukh sahanaa ||
106.e: Whatever You give me, brings me happiness.

106.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਰਖਹਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
106.t: jithai rakheh baiku(n)Th tithaiee too(n) sabhanaa ke pratipaalaa jeeau ||3||
106.e: Wherever You keep me, is heaven. You are the Cherisher of all. ||3||
Meditating, meditating in remembrance, Nanak has found peace.
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises.

106.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੪੦॥
106.t: sagal manorath pooran hoe kadhe na hoi dhukhaalaa jeeau ||4||33||40||
106.e: All my hopes and desires are fulfilled; I shall never again suffer sorrow. ||4||33||40||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
The Supreme Lord God has unleashed the rain clouds.

106.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
106.t: jal thal maheeal dheh dhis varasaiaa ||
106.e: Over the sea and over the land-over all the earth's surface, in all directions, He has brought the rain.

106.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੁਝੀ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
106.t: saa(n)t bhiee bujhee sabh tirasanaa anadh bhiaa sabh Thaiee jeeau ||1||
106.e: Peace has come, and the thirst of all has been quenched; there is joy and ecstasy everywhere. ||1||
He is the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of pain.
He gives and forgives all beings.

106.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪਇ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਨਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
106.t: apane keete no aap pratipaale pi pairee tiseh manaiee jeeau ||2||
106.e: He Himself nurtures and cherishes His Creation. I fall at His Feet and surrender to Him. ||2||

106.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
106.t: jaa kee saran piaa gat paieeaai ||
106.e: Seeking His Sanctuary, salvation is obtained.
With each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord's Name.

106.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
106.t: tis bin hor na dhoojaa Thaakur sabh tisai keeaa jaiee jeeau ||3||
106.e: Without Him, there is no other Lord and Master. All places belong to Him. ||3||
Yours is the Honor, God, and Yours is the Power.
You are the True Lord and Master, the Ocean of Excellence.

106.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੧॥
106.t: naanak dhaas kahai bena(n)tee aaTh pahar tudh dhiaaiee jeeau ||4||34||41||
106.e: Servant Nanak utters this prayer: may I meditate on You twenty-four hours a day. ||4||34||41||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
All happiness comes, when God is pleased.

106.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
106.t: gur poore ke charan man vuThe ||
106.e: The Feet of the Perfect Guru dwell in my mind.

106.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗੀ ਲਿਵ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਰਸੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
106.t: sahaj samaadh lagee liv a(n)tar so ras soiee jaanai jeeau ||1||
106.e: I am intuitively absorbed in the state of Samaadhi deep within. God alone knows this sweet pleasure. ||1||
My Lord and Master is Inaccessible and Unfathomable.
Deep within each and every heart, He dwells near and close at hand.

106.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
106.t: sadhaa alipat jeeaa kaa dhaataa ko viralaa aap pachhaanai jeeau ||2||
106.e: He is always detached; He is the Giver of souls. How rare is that person who understands his own self. ||2||
This is the sign of union with God:
in the mind, the Command of the True Lord is recognized.

106.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਖਸਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
106.t: sahaj sa(n)tokh sadhaa tirapataase anadh khasam kai bhaanai jeeau ||3||
106.e: Intuitive peace and poise, contentment, enduring satisfaction and bliss come through the Pleasure of the Master's Will. ||3||
God, the Great Giver, has given me His Hand.
He has erased all the sickness of birth and death.

106.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੪੨॥
106.t: naanak dhaas ke'ee prabh apune har keeratan ra(n)g maane jeeau ||4||35||42||
106.e: O Nanak, those whom God has made His slaves, rejoice in the pleasure of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||35||42||

107.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
The Life of the World, the Sustainer of the Earth, has showered His Mercy;

107.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
107.t: gur ke charan vase man maahee ||
107.e: the Guru's Feet have come to dwell within my mind.

107.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
107.t: a(n)geekaar keeaa tin karatai dhukh kaa dderaa ddaahiaa jeeau ||1||
107.e: The Creator has made me His Own. He has destroyed the city of sorrow. ||1||
The True One abides within my mind and body;
no place seems difficult to me now.

107.g: ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਮਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣ ਹੋਏ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
107.t: dhoot dhusaman sabh sajan hoe eko suaamee aahiaa jeeau ||2||
107.e: All the evil-doers and enemies have now become my friends. I long only for my Lord and Master. ||2||

107.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੈ ॥
107.t: jo kichh kare su aape aapai ||
107.e: Whatever He does, He does all by Himself.
No one can know His Ways.

107.g: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
107.t: aapaniaa sa(n)taa no aap sahaiee prabh bharam bhulaavaa laahiaa jeeau ||3||
107.e: He Himself is the Helper and Support of His Saints. God has cast out my doubts and delusions. ||3||
His Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servants.
Twenty-four hours a day, they deal in the Name of the Lord.

107.g: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੬॥੪੩॥
107.t: sahaj ana(n)dh gaaveh gun govi(n)dh prabh naanak sarab samaahiaa jeeau ||4||36||43||
107.e: In peace and pleasure, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. O Nanak, God is permeating everywhere. ||4||36||43||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

107.g: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
107.t: so sach ma(n)dhar jit sach dhiaaieeaai ||
107.e: True is that temple, within which one meditates on the True Lord.

107.g: ਸੋ ਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
107.t: so ridhaa suhelaa jit har gun gaieeaai ||
107.e: Blessed is that heart, within which the Lord's Glorious Praises are sung.

107.g: ਸਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
107.t: saa dharat suhaavee jit vaseh har jan sache naam viTahu kurabaano jeeau ||1||
107.e: Beautiful is that land, where the Lord's humble servants dwell. I am a sacrifice to the True Name. ||1||
The extent of the True Lord's Greatness cannot be known.
His Creative Power and His Bounties cannot be described.

107.g: ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
107.t: dhiaai dhiaai jeeveh jan tere sach sabadh man maano jeeau ||2||
107.e: Your humble servants live by meditating, meditating on You. Their minds treasure the True Word of the Shabad. ||2||
The Praises of the True One are obtained by great good fortune.
By Guru's Grace, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

107.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
107.t: ra(n)g rate terai tudh bhaaveh sach naam neesaano jeeau ||3||
107.e: Those who are imbued with Your Love are pleasing to You. The True Name is their Banner and Insignia. ||3||
No one knows the limits of the True Lord.
In all places and interspaces, the True One is pervading.

107.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੋ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੪੪॥
107.t: naanak sach dhiaaieeaai sadh hee a(n)tarajaamee jaano jeeau ||4||37||44||
107.e: O Nanak, meditate forever on the True One, the Searcher of hearts, the Knower of all. ||4||37||44||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
Beautiful is the night, and beautiful is the day,
when one joins the Society of the Saints and chants the Ambrosial Naam.

107.g: ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਲ ਵੰਞਹਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
107.t: ghaRee moorat simarat pal va(n)n(j)h jeevan safal tithaiee jeeau ||1||
107.e: If you remember the Lord in meditation for a moment, even for an instant, then your life will become fruitful and prosperous. ||1||
Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all sinful mistakes are erased.
Inwardly and outwardly, the Lord God is always with us.

107.g: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਭਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
107.t: bhai bhau bharam khoiaa gur poorai dhekhaa sabhanee jaiee jeeau ||2||
107.e: Fear, dread and doubt have been dispelled by the Perfect Guru; now, I see God everywhere. ||2||
God is All-powerful, Vast, Lofty and Infinite.
The Naam is overflowing with the nine treasures.

107.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
107.t: aadh a(n)t madh prabh soiee dhoojaa lavai na laiee jeeau ||3||
107.e: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, there is God. Nothing else even comes close to Him. ||3||
Take pity on me, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.
I am a beggar, begging for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

107.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੮॥੪੫॥
107.t: dheh dhaan naanak jan maagai sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaiee jeeau ||4||38||45||
107.e: Servant Nanak begs for this gift: let me meditate on the Lord, forever and ever. ||4||38||45||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
You are here, and You are hereafter.
All beings and creatures were created by You.

107.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
107.t: tudh bin avar na koiee karate mai dhar oT tumaaree jeeau ||1||
107.e: Without You, there is no other, O Creator. You are my Support and my Protection. ||1||
The tongue lives by chanting and meditating on the Lord's Name.
The Supreme Lord God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

107.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
107.t: jin seviaa tin hee sukh paiaa so janam na jooaai haaree jeeau ||2||
107.e: Those who serve the Lord find peace; they do not lose their lives in the gamble. ||2||

107.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
107.t: naam avakhadh jin jan terai paiaa ||
107.e: Your humble servant, who obtains the Medicine of the Naam,

108.e: is rid of the illnesses of countless lifetimes and incarnations.

108.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਏਹਾ ਹੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
108.t: har keeratan gaavahu dhin raatee safal ehaa hai kaaree jeeau ||3||
108.e: So sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night. This is the most fruitful occupation. ||3||
Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He has adorned His slave.
Deep within each and every heart, the Supreme Lord is humbly worshipped.

108.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੪੬॥
108.t: eikas vin hor dhoojaa naahee baabaa naanak ieh mat saaree jeeau ||4||39||46||
108.e: Without the One, there is no other at all. O Baba Nanak, this is the most excellent wisdom. ||4||39||46||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord.
I sacrifice everything for Him.

108.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
108.t: aaTh pahar govi(n)dh gun gaieeaai bisar na koiee saasaa jeeau ||1||
108.e: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. Do not forget Him, for even one breath. ||1||
He is a companion, a friend, and a beloved of mine,
who reflects upon the Lord's Name, in the Company of the Holy.

108.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੀਜੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
108.t: saadhoo sa(n)g tareejai saagar kaTeeaai jam kee faasaa jeeau ||2||
108.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, cross over the world-ocean, and the noose of death shall be cut away. ||2||
The four cardinal blessings are obtained by serving the Lord.
The Elysian Tree, the source of all blessings, is meditation on the Unseen and Unknowable Lord.

108.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
108.t: kaam karodh kilabikh gur kaaTe pooran hoiee aasaa jeeau ||3||
108.e: The Guru has cut out the sinful mistakes of sexual desire and anger, and my hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

108.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗ ਭਏ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
108.t: pooran bhaag bhe jis praanee || saadhasa(n)g mile saara(n)gapaanee ||
108.e: That mortal who is blessed by perfect destiny meets the Lord, the Sustainer of the Universe, in the Company of the Holy.

108.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੪੭॥
108.t: naanak naam vasiaa jis a(n)tar paravaan girasat udhaasaa jeeau ||4||40||47||
108.e: O Nanak, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the mind, one is approved and accepted, whether he is a house-holder or a renunciate. ||4||40||47||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, my heart is filled with peace.
By His Grace, His devotees become famous and acclaimed.

108.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਆਲਸ ਰੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
108.t: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil har har japiaa binase aalas rogaa jeeau ||1||
108.e: Joining the Society of the Saints, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the disease of laziness has disappeared. ||1||

108.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
108.t: jaa kai gireh nav nidh har bhaiee ||
108.e: O Siblings of Destiny, the nine treasures are found in the Home of the Lord;
He comes to meet those who deserve it by their past actions.

108.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
108.t: giaan dhiaan pooran paramesur prabh sabhanaa galaa jogaa jeeau ||2||
108.e: The Perfect Transcendent Lord is spiritual wisdom and meditation. God is All-powerful to do all things. ||2||
In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes.
He Himself is the One, and He Himself is the Many.

108.g: ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਡਿਠੇ ਲਹਨਿ ਵਿਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
108.t: lep nahee jagajeevan dhaate dharasan ddiThe lahan vijogaa jeeau ||3||
108.e: Filth does not stick to the Giver, the Life of the World. Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, the pain of separation departs. ||3||
Holding on to the hem of His Robe, the entire Universe is saved.
He Himself causes His Name to be chanted.

108.g: ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੧॥੪੮॥
108.t: gur bohith paiaa kirapaa te naanak dhur sa(n)jogaa jeeau ||4||41||48||
108.e: The Boat of the Guru is found by His Grace; O Nanak, such blessed destiny is pre-ordained. ||4||41||48||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
People do whatever the Lord inspires them to do.
Wherever He keeps us is a good place.

108.g: ਸੋਈ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸੋ ਪਤਿਵੰਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
108.t: soiee siaanaa so pativa(n)taa hukam lagai jis meeThaa jeeau ||1||
108.e: That person is clever and honorable, unto whom the Hukam of the Lord's Command seems sweet. ||1||
Everything is strung upon the One String of the Lord.

108.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
108.t: jis lai le so charanee laagai ||
108.e: Those whom the Lord attaches, are attached to His Feet.

108.g: ਊਂਧ ਕਵਲੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
108.t: uoo(n)dh kaval jis hoi pragaasaa tin sarab nira(n)jan ddeeThaa jeeau ||2||
108.e: Those, whose inverted lotus of the crown chakra is illuminated, see the Immaculate Lord everywhere. ||2||
Only You Yourself know Your Glory.
You Yourself recognize Your Own Self.

108.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਪੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
108.t: hau balihaaree sa(n)tan tere jin kaam karodh lobh peeThaa jeeau ||3||
108.e: I am a sacrifice to Your Saints, who have crushed their sexual desire, anger and greed. ||3||
You have no hatred or vengeance; Your Saints are immaculate and pure.
Seeing them, all sins depart.

108.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਧੀਠਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪੨॥੪੯॥
108.t: naanak naam dhiaai dhiaai jeevai binasiaa bhram bhau dheeThaa jeeau ||4||42||49||
108.e: Nanak lives by meditating, meditating on the Naam. His stubborn doubt and fear have departed. ||4||42||49||

109.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:
One who asks for a false gift,

109.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਰਤੇ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
109.t: tis kau marate ghaRee na laagai ||
109.e: shall not take even an instant to die.

109.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
109.t: paarabraham jo sadh hee sevai so gur mil nihachal kahanaa ||1||
109.e: But one who continually serves the Supreme Lord God and meets the Guru, is said to be immortal. ||1||

109.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
109.t: prem bhagat jis kai man laagee ||
109.e: One whose mind is dedicated to loving devotional worship
sings His Glorious Praises night and day, and remains forever awake and aware.

109.g: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਲੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੨॥
109.t: baeh pakaR tis suaamee melai jis kai masatak lahanaa ||2||
109.e: Taking him by the hand, the Lord and Master merges into Himself that person, upon whose forehead such destiny is written. ||2||
His Lotus Feet dwell in the minds of His devotees.
Without the Transcendent Lord, all are plundered.

109.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
109.t: sa(n)t janaa(n) kee dhooR nit baa(n)chheh naam sache kaa gahanaa ||3||
109.e: I long for the dust of the feet of His humble servants. The Name of the True Lord is my decoration. ||3||
Standing up and sitting down, I sing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, I obtain my Eternal Husband Lord.

109.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੦॥
109.t: naanak kau prabh hoi dhiaalaa teraa keetaa sahanaa ||4||43||50||
109.e: God has become merciful to Nanak. I cheerfully accept Your Will. ||4||43||50||

109.t: raag maajh asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
109.e: Raag Maajh, Ashtpadheeyaa: First Mehla, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
By His Command, all are attuned to the Word of the Shabad,
and all are called to the Mansion of His Presence, the True Court of the Lord.

109.g: ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
109.t: sache dheen dhiaal mere saahibaa sache man pateeaavaniaa ||1||
109.e: O my True Lord and Master, Merciful to the meek, my mind is pleased and appeased by the Truth. ||1||

109.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
109.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sabadh suhaavaniaa ||
109.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

109.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
109.t: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa gurmatee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
109.e: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of Peace. Through the Guru's Teachings, it dwells in the mind. ||1||Pause||

109.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
109.t: naa ko meraa hau kis keraa ||
109.e: No one is mine, and I am no one else's.
The True Lord and Master of the three worlds is mine.

109.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
109.t: haumai kar kar jai ghaneree kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
109.e: Acting in egotism, so very many have died. After making mistakes, they later repent and regret. ||2||

109.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
109.t: hukam pachhaanai su har gun vakhaanai ||
109.e: Those who recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are glorified with the Naam.

109.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਸਚੈ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
109.t: sabhanaa kaa dhar lekhaa sachai chhooTas naam suhaavaniaa ||3||
109.e: Everyone's account is kept in the True Court, and through the Beauty of the Naam, they are saved. ||3||
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded; they find no place of rest.
Bound and gagged at Death's Door, they are brutally beaten.

109.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
109.t: bin naavai ko sa(n)g na saathee mukate naam dhiaavaniaa ||4||
109.e: Without the Name, there are no companions or friends. Liberation comes only by meditating on the Naam. ||4||
The false shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth.
Bound by duality, they come and go in reincarnation.

109.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
109.t: likhiaa lekh na meTai koiee gurmukh mukat karaavaniaa ||5||
109.e: No one can erase pre-recorded destiny; the Gurmukhs are liberated. ||5||
In this world of her parents' house, the young bride did not know her Husband.
Through falsehood, she has been separated from Him, and she cries out in misery.

109.g: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਿ ਬਖਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
109.t: avagan muThee mahal na paae avagan gun bakhasaavaniaa ||6||
109.e: Defrauded by demerits, she does not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. But through virtuous actions, her demerits are forgiven. ||6||
She, who knows her Beloved in her parents' house,
as Gurmukh, comes to understand the essence of reality; she contemplates her Lord.

109.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
109.t: aavan jaanaa Thaak rahaae sachai naam samaavaniaa ||7||
109.e: Her comings and goings cease, and she is absorbed in the True Name. ||7||
The Gurmukhs understand and describe the Indescribable.
True is our Lord and Master; He loves the Truth.

109.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
109.t: naanak sach kahai bena(n)tee sach milai gun gaavaniaa ||8||1||
109.e: Nanak offers this true prayer: singing His Glorious Praises, I merge with the True One. ||8||1||
Maajh, Third Mehla, First House:
By His Mercy, we meet the True Guru.

110.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
110.t: sevaa surat sabadh chit laae ||
110.e: Center your awareness on seva-selfless service-and focus your consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

110.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
110.t: haumai maar sadhaa sukh paiaa maiaa moh chukaavaniaa ||1||
110.e: Subduing your ego, you shall find a lasting peace, and your emotional attachment to Maya will be dispelled. ||1||

110.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
110.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree satigur kai balihaaraniaa ||
110.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, I am totally devoted to the True Guru.

110.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਜੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
110.t: gurmatee paragaas hoaa jee anadhin har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
110.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Divine Light has dawned; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

110.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੋਜੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
110.t: tan man khoje taa naau paae ||
110.e: Search your body and mind, and find the Name.

110.g: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
110.t: dhaavat raakhai Thaak rahaae ||
110.e: Restrain your wandering mind, and keep it in check.

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
110.t: gur kee baanee anadhin gaavai sahaje bhagat karaavaniaa ||2||
110.e: Night and day, sing the Songs of the Guru's Bani; worship the Lord with intuitive devotion. ||2||

110.g: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਸੰਖਾ ॥
110.t: eis kaiaa a(n)dhar vasat asa(n)khaa ||
110.e: Within this body are countless objects.

110.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵੇਖਾ ॥
110.t: gurmukh saach milai taa vekhaa ||
110.e: The Gurmukh attains Truth, and comes to see them.

110.g: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਦਸਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
110.t: nau dharavaaje dhasavai mukataa anahadh sabadh vajaavaniaa ||3||
110.e: Beyond the nine gates, the Tenth Gate is found, and liberation is obtained. The Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates. ||3||

110.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
110.t: sachaa saahib sachee naiee ||
110.e: True is the Master, and True is His Name.

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
110.t: gur parasaadhee ma(n)n vasaiee ||
110.e: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell within the mind.

110.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
110.t: anadhin sadhaa rahai ra(n)g raataa dhar sachai sojhee paavaniaa ||4||
110.e: Night and day, remain attuned to the Lord's Love forever, and you shall obtain understanding in the True Court. ||4||

110.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
110.t: paap pu(n)n kee saar na jaanee ||
110.e: Those who do not understand the nature of sin and virtue

110.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
110.t: dhoojai laagee bharam bhulaanee ||
110.e: are attached to duality; they wander around deluded.

110.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
110.t: agiaanee a(n)dhaa mag na jaanai fir fir aavan jaavaniaa ||5||
110.e: The ignorant and blind people do not know the way; they come and go in reincarnation over and over again. ||5||

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
110.t: gur sevaa te sadhaa sukh paiaa ||
110.e: Serving the Guru, I have found eternal peace;

110.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
110.t: haumai meraa Thaak rahaiaa ||
110.e: my ego has been silenced and subdued.

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
110.t: gur saakhee miTiaa a(n)dhiaaraa bajar kapaaT khulaavaniaa ||6||
110.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness has been dispelled, and the heavy doors have been opened. ||6||

110.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
110.t: haumai maar ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
110.e: Subduing my ego, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind.

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
110.t: gur charanee sadhaa chit laiaa ||
110.e: I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet forever.

110.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
110.t: gur kirapaa te man tan niramal niramal naam dhiaavaniaa ||7||
110.e: By Guru's Grace, my mind and body are immaculate and pure; I meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

110.g: ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਧੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
110.t: jeevan maranaa sabh tudhai taiee ||
110.e: From birth to death, everything is for You.

110.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
110.t: jis bakhase tis dhe vaddiaaiee ||
110.e: You bestow greatness upon those whom You have forgiven.

110.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
110.t: naanak naam dhiaai sadhaa too(n) ja(n)man maran savaaraniaa ||8||1||2||
110.e: O Nanak, meditating forever on the Naam, you shall be blessed in both birth and death. ||8||1||2||

110.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
110.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
110.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

110.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
110.t: meraa prabh niramal agam apaaraa ||
110.e: My God is Immaculate, Inaccessible and Infinite.

110.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
110.t: bin takaRee tolai sa(n)saaraa ||
110.e: Without a scale, He weighs the universe.

110.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
110.t: gurmukh hovai soiee boojhai gun keh gunee samaavaniaa ||1||
110.e: One who becomes Gurmukh, understands. Chanting His Glorious Praises, he is absorbed into the Lord of Virtue. ||1||

110.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
110.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
110.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the Name of the Lord.

110.g: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
110.t: jo sach laage se anadhin jaage dhar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
110.e: Those who are committed to Truth remain awake and aware night and day. They are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

110.g: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੈ ਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
110.t: aap sunai tai aape vekhai ||
110.e: He Himself hears, and He Himself sees.

110.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
110.t: jis no nadhar kare soiee jan lekhai ||
110.e: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, become acceptable.

110.g: ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
110.t: aape lai le so laagai gurmukh sach kamaavaniaa ||2||
110.e: They are attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches; as Gurmukh, they live the Truth. ||2||

110.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਸੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
110.t: jis aap bhulaae su kithai hath paae ||
110.e: Those whom the Lord Himself misleads-whose hand can they take?

110.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
110.t: poorab likhiaa su meTanaa na jaae ||
110.e: That which is pre-ordained, cannot be erased.

110.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
110.t: jin satigur miliaa se vaddabhaagee poorai karam milaavaniaa ||3||
110.e: Those who meet the True Guru are very fortunate and blessed; through perfect karma, He is met. ||3||

110.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਧਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਤੀ ॥
110.t: peieeaRai dhan anadhin sutee ||
110.e: The young bride is fast asleep in her parents' home, night and day.

110.g: ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਤੀ ॥
110.t: ka(n)t visaaree avagan mutee ||
110.e: She has forgotten her Husband Lord; because of her faults and demerits, she is abandoned.

110.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
110.t: anadhin sadhaa firai bilalaadhee bin pir needh na paavaniaa ||4||
110.e: She wanders around continually, crying out, night and day. Without her Husband Lord, she cannot get any sleep. ||4||

110.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
110.t: peieeaRai sukhadhaataa jaataa ||
110.e: In this world of her parents' home, she may come to know the Giver of peace,

110.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
110.t: haumai maar gur sabadh pachhaataa ||
110.e: if she subdues her ego, and recognizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

110.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
110.t: sej suhaavee sadhaa pir raave sach seegaar banaavaniaa ||5||
110.e: Her bed is beautiful; she ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord forever. She is adorned with the Decorations of Truth. ||5||

111.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
111.t: lakh chauraaseeh jeea upaae ||
111.e: He created the 8.4 million species of beings.

111.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
111.t: jis no nadhar kare tis guroo milaae ||
111.e: Those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, come to meet the Guru.

111.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
111.t: kilabikh kaaT sadhaa jan niramal dhar sachai naam suhaavaniaa ||6||
111.e: Shedding their sins, His servants are forever pure; at the True Court, they are beautified by the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

111.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਦੀਐ ॥
111.t: lekhaa maagai taa kin dheeaai ||
111.e: When they are called to settle their accounts, who will answer then?

111.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਦੂਐ ਤੀਐ ॥
111.t: sukh naahee fun dhooaai teeaai ||
111.e: There shall be no peace then, from counting out by twos and threes.

111.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
111.t: aape bakhas le prabh saachaa aape bakhas milaavaniaa ||7||
111.e: The True Lord God Himself forgives, and having forgiven, He unites them with Himself. ||7||

111.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
111.t: aap kare tai aap karaae ||
111.e: He Himself does, and He Himself causes all to be done.

111.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
111.t: poore gur kai sabadh milaae ||
111.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, He is met.

111.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
111.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee aape mel milaavaniaa ||8||2||3||
111.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. He Himself unites in His Union. ||8||2||3||

111.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
111.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
111.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

111.g: ਇਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਛੰਨਾ ॥
111.t: eiko aap firai parachha(n)naa ||
111.e: The One Lord Himself moves about imperceptibly.

111.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
111.t: gurmukh vekhaa taa ih man bhi(n)naa ||
111.e: As Gurmukh, I see Him, and then this mind is pleased and uplifted.

111.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
111.t: tirasanaa taj sahaj sukh paiaa eko ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
111.e: Renouncing desire, I have found intuitive peace and poise; I have enshrined the One within my mind. ||1||

111.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
111.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree ikas siau chit laavaniaa ||
111.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the One.

111.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
111.t: gurmatee man ikat ghar aaiaa sachai ra(n)g ra(n)gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
111.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, my mind has come to its only home; it is imbued with the True Color of the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

111.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਤੈਂ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
111.t: eih jag bhoolaa tai(n) aap bhulaiaa ||
111.e: This world is deluded; You Yourself have deluded it.

111.g: ਇਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
111.t: eik visaar dhoojai lobhaiaa ||
111.e: Forgetting the One, it has become engrossed in duality.

111.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
111.t: anadhin sadhaa firai bhram bhoolaa bin naavai dhukh paavaniaa ||2||
111.e: Night and day, it wanders around endlessly, deluded by doubt; without the Name, it suffers in pain. ||2||

111.g: ਜੋ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
111.t: jo ra(n)g raate karam bidhaate ||
111.e: Those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord, the Architect of Destiny

111.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
111.t: gur sevaa te jug chaare jaate ||
111.e: by serving the Guru, they are known throughout the four ages.

111.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
111.t: jis no aap dhei vaddiaaiee har kai naam samaavaniaa ||3||
111.e: Those, upon whom the Lord bestows greatness, are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||3||

111.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
111.t: maiaa moh har chetai naahee ||
111.e: Being in love with Maya, they do not think of the Lord.

111.g: ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਧਾ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹੀ ॥
111.t: jamapur badhaa dhukh sahaahee ||
111.e: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they suffer in terrible pain.

111.g: ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
111.t: a(n)naa bolaa kichh nadhar na aavai manmukh paap pachaavaniaa ||4||
111.e: Blind and deaf, they see nothing at all; the self-willed manmukhs rot away in sin. ||4||

111.g: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
111.t: eik ra(n)g raate jo tudh aap liv laae ||
111.e: Those, whom You attach to Your Love, are attuned to Your Love.

111.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
111.t: bhai bhagat terai man bhaae ||
111.e: Through loving devotional worship, they become pleasing to Your Mind.

111.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
111.t: satigur sevan sadhaa sukhadhaataa sabh ichhaa aap pujaavaniaa ||5||
111.e: They serve the True Guru, the Giver of eternal peace, and all their desires are fulfilled. ||5||

111.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
111.t: har jeeau teree sadhaa saranaiee ||
111.e: O Dear Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary forever.

111.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
111.t: aape bakhaseh dhe vaddiaaiee ||
111.e: You Yourself forgive us, and bless us with Glorious Greatness.

111.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
111.t: jamakaal tis neR na aavai jo har har naam dhiaavaniaa ||6||
111.e: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||6||

111.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
111.t: anadhin raate jo har bhaae ||
111.e: Night and day, they are attuned to His Love; they are pleasing to the Lord.

111.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
111.t: merai prabh mele mel milaae ||
111.e: My God merges with them, and unites them in Union.

111.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
111.t: sadhaa sadhaa sache teree saranaiee too(n) aape sach bujhaavaniaa ||7||
111.e: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; You Yourself inspire us to understand the Truth. ||7||

111.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
111.t: jin sach jaataa se sach samaane ||
111.e: Those who know the Truth are absorbed in Truth.

111.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
111.t: har gun gaaveh sach vakhaane ||
111.e: They sing the Lord's Glorious Praises, and speak the Truth.

111.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੪॥
111.t: naanak naam rate bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laavaniaa ||8||3||4||
111.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam remain unattached and balanced; in the home of the inner self, they are absorbed in the primal trance of deep meditation. ||8||3||4||

111.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
111.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
111.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

111.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੁ ਮੁਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
111.t: sabadh marai su muaa jaapai ||
111.e: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad is truly dead.

111.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਪੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
111.t: kaal na chaapai dhukh na sa(n)taapai ||
111.e: Death does not crush him, and pain does not afflict him.

111.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
111.t: jotee vich mil jot samaanee sun man sach samaavaniaa ||1||
111.e: His light merges and is absorbed into the Light, when he hears and merges in the Truth. ||1||

111.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
111.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har kai nai sobhaa paavaniaa ||
111.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Lord's Name, which brings us to glory.

111.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
111.t: satigur sev sach chit laiaa gurmatee sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
111.e: One who serves the True Guru, and focuses his consciousness on Truth, following the Guru's Teachings, is absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||Pause||

111.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਚੀ ਕਚਾ ਚੀਰੁ ਹੰਢਾਏ ॥
111.t: kaiaa kachee kachaa cheer ha(n)ddaae ||
111.e: This human body is transitory, and transitory are the garments it wears.

111.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
111.t: dhoojai laagee mahal na paae ||
111.e: Attached to duality, no one attains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

112.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਦੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
112.t: anadhin jaladhee firai dhin raatee bin pir bahu dhukh paavaniaa ||2||
112.e: Night and day, day and night, they burn. Without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride suffers in terrible pain. ||2||
Her body and her status shall not go with her to the world hereafter.

112.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
112.t: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai tithai chhuTai sach kamaae ||
112.e: Where she is called to answer for her account, there, she shall be emancipated only by true actions.

112.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
112.t: satigur sevan se dhanava(n)te aaithai othai naam samaavaniaa ||3||
112.e: Those who serve the True Guru shall prosper; here and hereafter, they are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||
She who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,
by Guru's Grace, obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as her home.

112.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
112.t: anadhin sadhaa ravai dhin raatee majeeThai ra(n)g banaavaniaa ||4||
112.e: Night and day, day and night, she constantly ravishes and enjoys her Beloved. She is dyed in the permanent color of His Love. ||4||
The Husband Lord abides with everyone, always;
but how rare are those few who, by Guru's Grace, obtain His Glance of Grace.

112.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
112.t: meraa prabh at uoocho uoochaa kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa ||5||
112.e: My God is the Highest of the High; granting His Grace, He merges us into Himself. ||5||
This world is asleep in emotional attachment to Maya.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it ultimately comes to ruin.

112.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੋ ਜਾਗਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
112.t: jis te sutaa so jaagaae gurmat sojhee paavaniaa ||6||
112.e: The One who put it to sleep shall also awaken it. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding dawns. ||6||
One who drinks in this Nectar, shall have his delusions dispelled.
By Guru's Grace, the state of liberation is attained.

112.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
112.t: bhagatee rataa sadhaa bairaagee aap maar milaavaniaa ||7||
112.e: One who is imbued with devotion to the Lord, remains always balanced and detached. Subduing selfishness and conceit, he is united with the Lord. ||7||
He Himself creates, and He Himself assigns us to our tasks.
He Himself gives sustenance to the 8.4 million species of beings.

112.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੫॥
112.t: naanak naam dhiaai sach raate jo tis bhaavai su kaar karaavaniaa ||8||4||5||
112.e: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam are atuned to Truth. They do that which is pleasing to His Will. ||8||4||5||
Maajh, Third Mehla:
Diamonds and rubies are produced deep within the self.
They are assayed and valued tthrough the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

112.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
112.t: jin sach palai sach vakhaaneh sach kasavaTee laavaniaa ||1||
112.e: Those who have gathered Truth, speak Truth; they apply the Touch-stone of Truth. ||1||

112.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
112.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gur kee baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
112.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Word of the Guru's Bani within their minds.

112.g: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
112.t: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan paiaa jotee jot milaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
112.e: In the midst of the darkness of the world, they obtain the Immaculate One, and their light merges into the Light. ||1||Pause||
Within this body are countless vast vistas;
the Immaculate Naam is totally Inaccessible and Infinite.

112.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
112.t: gurmukh hovai soiee paae aape bakhas milaavaniaa ||2||
112.e: He alone becomes Gurmukh and obtains it, whom the Lord forgives, and unites with Himself. ||2||
My Lord and Master implants the Truth.
By Guru's Grace, one's consciousness is attached to the Truth.

112.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
112.t: sacho sach varatai sabhanee thaiee sache sach samaavaniaa ||3||
112.e: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; the true ones merge in Truth. ||3||
The True Carefree Lord is my Beloved.
He cuts out our sinful mistakes and evil actions;

112.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
112.t: prem preet sadhaa dhiaaieeaai bhai bhai bhagat dhiraRaavaniaa ||4||
112.e: with love and affection, meditate forever on Him. He implants the Fear of God and loving devotional worship within us. ||4||

112.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
112.t: teree bhagat sachee je sache bhaavai ||
112.e: Devotional worship is True, if it pleases the True Lord.
He Himself bestows it; He does not regret it later.

112.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
112.t: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa eko dhaataa sabadhe maar jeevaavaniaa ||5||
112.e: He alone is the Giver of all beings. The Lord kills with the Word of His Shabad, and then revives. ||5||

112.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
112.t: har tudh baajhahu mai koiee naahee ||
112.e: Other than You, Lord, nothing is mine.

112.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
112.t: har tudhai sevee tai tudh saalaahee ||
112.e: I serve You, Lord, and I praise You.

112.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
112.t: aape mel laih prabh saache poorai karam too(n) paavaniaa ||6||
112.e: You unite me with Yourself, O True God. Through perfect good karma You are obtained. ||6||

112.g: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
112.t: mai hor na koiee tudhai jehaa ||
112.e: For me, there is no other like You.
By Your Glance of Grace, my body is blessed and sanctified.

112.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
112.t: anadhin saar samaal har raakheh gurmukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||7||
112.e: Night and day, the Lord takes care of us and protects us. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||7||

112.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
112.t: tudh jevadd mai hor na koiee ||
112.e: For me, there is no other as Great as You.
You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.

113.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੬॥
113.t: too(n) aape hee ghaR bha(n)n savaareh naanak naam suhaavaniaa ||8||5||6||
113.e: You Yourself create, destroy and adorn. O Nanak, we are adorned and embellished with the Naam. ||8||5||6||

113.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
113.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
113.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

113.g: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਪੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
113.t: sabh ghaT aape bhoganahaaraa ||
113.e: He is the Enjoyer of all hearts.

113.g: ਅਲਖੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
113.t: alakh varatai agam apaaraa ||
113.e: The Invisible, Inaccessible and Infinite is pervading everywhere.

113.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
113.t: gur kai sabadh meraa har prabh dhiaaieeaai sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||1||
113.e: Meditating on my Lord God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am intuitively absorbed in the Truth. ||1||

113.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
113.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gur sabadh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
113.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who implant the Word of the Guru's Shabad in their minds.

113.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
113.t: sabadh soojhai taa man siau loojhai manasaa maar samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
113.e: When someone understands the Shabad, then he wrestles with his own mind; subduing his desires, he merges with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

113.g: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਹਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
113.t: pa(n)ch dhoot muheh sa(n)saaraa ||
113.e: The five enemies are plundering the world.

113.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
113.t: manmukh a(n)dhe sudh na saaraa ||
113.e: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand or appreciate this.

113.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
113.t: gurmukh hovai su apanaa ghar raakhai pa(n)ch dhoot sabadh pachaavaniaa ||2||
113.e: Those who become Gurmukh-their houses are protected. The five enemies are destroyed by the Shabad. ||2||

113.g: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
113.t: eik gurmukh sadhaa sachai ra(n)g raate ||
113.e: The Gurmukhs are forever imbued with love for the True One.

113.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
113.t: sahaje prabh seveh anadhin maate ||
113.e: They serve God with intuitive ease. Night and day, they are intoxicated with His Love.

113.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
113.t: mil preetam sache gun gaaveh har dhar sobhaa paavaniaa ||3||
113.e: Meeting with their Beloved, they sing the Glorious Praises of the True one; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

113.g: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
113.t: ekam ekai aap upaiaa ||
113.e: First, the One created Himself;

113.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
113.t: dhubidhaa dhoojaa tirabidh maiaa ||
113.e: second, the sense of duality; third, the three-phased Maya.

113.g: ਚਉਥੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਊਚੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
113.t: chauthee pauRee gurmukh uoochee sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||4||
113.e: The fourth state, the highest, is obtained by the Gurmukh, who practices Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

113.g: ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
113.t: sabh hai sachaa je sache bhaavai ||
113.e: Everything which is pleasing to the True Lord is true.

113.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
113.t: jin sach jaataa so sahaj samaavai ||
113.e: Those who know the Truth merge in intuitive peace and poise.

113.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
113.t: gurmukh karanee sache seveh saache jai samaavaniaa ||5||
113.e: The life-style of the Gurmukh is to serve the True Lord. He goes and blends with the True Lord. ||5||

113.g: ਸਚੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥
113.t: sache baajhahu ko avar na dhooaa ||
113.e: Without the True One, there is no other at all.

113.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗੁ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
113.t: dhoojai laag jag khap khap mooaa ||
113.e: Attached to duality, the world is distracted and distressed to death.

113.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
113.t: gurmukh hovai su eko jaanai eko sev sukh paavaniaa ||6||
113.e: One who becomes Gurmukh knows only the One. Serving the One, peace is obtained. ||6||

113.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
113.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh saran tumaaree ||
113.e: All beings and creatures are in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

113.g: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
113.t: aape dhar dhekheh kachee pakee saaree ||
113.e: You place the chessmen on the board; You see the imperfect and the perfect as well.

113.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
113.t: anadhin aape kaar karaae aape mel milaavaniaa ||7||
113.e: Night and day, You cause people to act; You unite them in Union with Yourself. ||7||

113.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
113.t: too(n) aape meleh vekheh hadhoor ||
113.e: You Yourself unite, and You see Yourself close at hand.

113.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
113.t: sabh meh aap rahiaa bharapoor ||
113.e: You Yourself are totally pervading amongst all.

113.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੭॥
113.t: naanak aape aap varatai gurmukh sojhee paavaniaa ||8||6||7||
113.e: O Nanak, God Himself is pervading and permeating everywhere; only the Gurmukhs understand this. ||8||6||7||

113.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
113.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
113.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

113.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
113.t: a(n)mirat baanee gur kee meeThee ||
113.e: The Nectar of the Guru's Bani is very sweet.

113.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
