113.t: gurmukh viralai kinai chakh ddeeThee ||
113.e: Rare are the Gurmukhs who see and taste it.

113.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
113.t: a(n)tar paragaas mahaa ras peevai dhar sachai sabadh vajaavaniaa ||1||
113.e: The Divine Light dawns within, and the supreme essence is found. In the True Court, the Word of the Shabad vibrates. ||1||

113.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
113.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gur charanee chit laavaniaa ||
113.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

113.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
113.t: satigur hai a(n)mirat sar saachaa man naavai mail chukaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
113.e: The True Guru is the True Pool of Nectar; bathing in it, the mind is washed clean of all filth. ||1||Pause||

113.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
113.t: teraa sache kinai a(n)t na paiaa ||
113.e: Your limits, O True Lord, are not known to anyone.

113.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
113.t: gur parasaadh kinai viralai chit laiaa ||
113.e: Rare are those who, by Guru's Grace, focus their consciousness on You.

113.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
113.t: tudh saalaeh na rajaa kabahoo(n) sache naavai kee bhukh laavaniaa ||2||
113.e: Praising You, I am never satisfied; such is the hunger I feel for the True Name. ||2||

113.g: ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
113.t: eko vekhaa avar na beeaa ||
113.e: I see only the One, and no other.

113.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
113.t: gur parasaadhee a(n)mrit peeaa ||
113.e: By Guru's Grace, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

113.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
113.t: gur kai sabadh tikhaa nivaaree sahaje sookh samaavaniaa ||3||
113.e: My thirst is quenched by the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I am absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||3||

113.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
113.t: ratan padhaarath palar tiaagai ||
113.e: The Priceless Jewel is discarded like straw;

113.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
113.t: manmukh a(n)dhaa dhoojai bhai laagai ||
113.e: the blind self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

113.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
113.t: jo beejai soiee fal paae supanai sukh na paavaniaa ||4||
113.e: As they plant, so do they harvest. They shall not obtain peace, even in their dreams. ||4||

113.g: ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
113.t: apanee kirapaa kare soiee jan paae ||
113.e: Those who are blessed with His Mercy find the Lord.

113.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
113.t: gur kaa sabadh ma(n)n vasaae ||
113.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.

114.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
114.t: anadhin sadhaa rahai bhai a(n)dhar bhai maar bharam chukaavaniaa ||5||
114.e: Night and day, they remain in the Fear of God; conquering their fears, their doubts are dispelled. ||5||

114.g: ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
114.t: bharam chukaiaa sadhaa sukh paiaa ||
114.e: Dispelling their doubts, they find a lasting peace.

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
114.t: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa ||
114.e: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is attained.

114.g: ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
114.t: a(n)tar niramal niramal baanee har gun sahaje gaavaniaa ||6||
114.e: Deep within, they are pure, and their words are pure as well; intuitively, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

114.g: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
114.t: simirat saasat bedh vakhaanai ||
114.e: They recite the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas,

114.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
114.t: bharame bhoolaa tat na jaanai ||
114.e: but deluded by doubt, they do not understand the essence of reality.

114.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
114.t: bin satigur seve sukh na paae dhukho dhukh kamaavaniaa ||7||
114.e: Without serving the True Guru, they find no peace; they earn only pain and misery. ||7||

114.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
114.t: aap kare kis aakhai koiee ||
114.e: The Lord Himself acts; unto whom should we complain?

114.g: ਆਖਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
114.t: aakhan jaieeaai je bhoolaa hoiee ||
114.e: How can anyone complain that the Lord has made a mistake?

114.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੭॥੮॥
114.t: naanak aape kare karaae naame naam samaavaniaa ||8||7||8||
114.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself does, and causes things to be done; chanting the Naam, we are absorbed in the Naam. ||8||7||8||

114.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
114.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
114.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

114.g: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
114.t: aape ra(n)ge sahaj subhaae ||
114.e: He Himself imbues us with His Love, with effortless ease.

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
114.t: gur kai sabadh har ra(n)g chaRaae ||
114.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

114.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
114.t: man tan rataa rasanaa ra(n)g chaloolee bhai bhai ra(n)g chaRaavaniaa ||1||
114.e: This mind and body are so imbued, and this tongue is dyed in the deep crimson color of the poppy. Through the Love and the Fear of God, we are dyed in this color. ||1||

114.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
114.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree nirabhau ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
114.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Fearless Lord within their minds.

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
114.t: gur kirapaa te har nirabhau dhiaaiaa bikh bhaujal sabadh taraavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
114.e: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Fearless Lord; the Shabad has carried me across the poisonous world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

114.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
114.t: manmukh mugadh kareh chaturaiee ||
114.e: The idiotic self-willed manmukhs try to be clever,

114.g: ਨਾਤਾ ਧੋਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
114.t: naataa dhotaa thai na paiee ||
114.e: but in spite of their bathing and washing, they shall not be acceptable.

114.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਆਇਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਜਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
114.t: jehaa aaiaa tehaa jaasee kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
114.e: As they came, so shall they go, regretting the mistakes they made. ||2||

114.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
114.t: manmukh a(n)dhe kichhoo na soojhai ||
114.e: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything;

114.g: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਆਏ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
114.t: maran likhai aae nahee boojhai ||
114.e: death was pre-ordained for them when they came into the world, but they do not understand.

114.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
114.t: manmukh karam kare nahee paae bin naavai janam gavaavaniaa ||3||
114.e: The self-willed manmukhs may practice religious rituals, but they do not obtain the Name; without the Name, they lose this life in vain. ||3||

114.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
114.t: sach karanee sabadh hai saar ||
114.e: The practice of Truth is the essence of the Shabad.

114.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
114.t: poorai gur paieeaai mokh dhuaar ||
114.e: Through the Perfect Guru, the gate of salvation is found.

114.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
114.t: anadhin baanee sabadh sunaae sach raate ra(n)g ra(n)gaavaniaa ||4||
114.e: So, night and day, listen to the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad. Let yourself be colored by this love. ||4||

114.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
114.t: rasanaa har ras raatee ra(n)g laae ||
114.e: The tongue, imbued with the Lord's Essence, delights in His Love.

114.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
114.t: man tan mohiaa sahaj subhaae ||
114.e: My mind and body are enticed by the Lord's Sublime Love.

114.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
114.t: sahaje preetam piaaraa paiaa sahaje sahaj milaavaniaa ||5||
114.e: I have easily obtained my Darling Beloved; I am intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

114.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
114.t: jis a(n)dhar ra(n)g soiee gun gaavai ||
114.e: Those who have the Lord's Love within, sing His Glorious Praises;

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
114.t: gur kai sabadh sahaje sukh samaavai ||
114.e: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are intuitively absorbed in celestial peace.

114.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
114.t: hau balihaaree sadhaa tin viTahu gur sevaa chit laavaniaa ||6||
114.e: I am forever a sacrifice to those who dedicate their consciousness to the Guru's Service. ||6||

114.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ॥
114.t: sachaa sacho sach pateejai ||
114.e: The True Lord is pleased with Truth, and only Truth.

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
114.t: gur parasaadhee a(n)dhar bheejai ||
114.e: By Guru's Grace, one's inner being is deeply imbued with His Love.

114.g: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
114.t: bais suthaan har gun gaaveh aape kar sat manaavaniaa ||7||
114.e: Sitting in that blessed place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, who Himself inspires us to accept His Truth. ||7||

114.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
114.t: jis no nadhar kare so paae ||
114.e: That one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtains it.

114.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
114.t: gur parasaadhee haumai jaae ||
114.e: By Guru's Grace, egotism departs.

114.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੮॥੯॥
114.t: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar dhar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||8||8||9||
114.e: O Nanak, that one, within whose mind the Name dwells, is honored in the True Court. ||8||8||9||

114.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
114.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
114.e: Maajh Third Mehla:

114.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
114.t: satigur seviaai vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
114.e: Serving the True Guru is the greatest greatness.

114.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
114.t: har jee achi(n)t vasai man aaiee ||
114.e: The Dear Lord automatically comes to dwell in the mind.

114.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਲਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
114.t: har jeeau safalio birakh hai a(n)mrit jin peetaa tis tikhaa lahaavaniaa ||1||
114.e: The Dear Lord is the fruit-bearing tree; drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, thirst is quenched. ||1||

114.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
114.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sach sa(n)gat mel milaavaniaa ||
114.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the one who leads me to join the True Congregation.

114.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
114.t: har satasa(n)gat aape melai gur sabadhee har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
114.e: The Lord Himself unites me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

115.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
115.t: satigur sevee sabadh suhaiaa ||
115.e: I serve the True Guru; the Word of His Shabad is beautiful.

115.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
115.t: jin har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
115.e: Through it, the Name of the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

115.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
115.t: har niramal haumai mail gavaae dhar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||2||
115.e: The Pure Lord removes the filth of egotism, and we are honored in the True Court. ||2||

115.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
115.t: bin gur naam na paiaa jai ||
115.e: Without the Guru, the Naam cannot be obtained.

115.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
115.t: sidh saadhik rahe bilalai ||
115.e: The Siddhas and the seekers lack it; they weep and wail.

115.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
115.t: bin gur seve sukh na hovee poorai bhaag gur paavaniaa ||3||
115.e: Without serving the True Guru, peace is not obtained; through perfect destiny, the Guru is found. ||3||

115.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਰਸੀ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
115.t: eih man aarasee koiee gurmukh vekhai ||
115.e: This mind is a mirror; how rare are those who, as Gurmukh, see themselves in it.

115.g: ਮੋਰਚਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
115.t: morachaa na laagai jaa haumai sokhai ||
115.e: Rust does not stick to those who burn their ego.

115.g: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
115.t: anahat baanee niramal sabadh vajaae gur sabadhee sach samaavaniaa ||4||
115.e: The Unstruck Melody of the Bani resounds through the Pure Word of the Shabad; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we are absorbed into the True One. ||4||

115.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
115.t: bin satigur kih na dhekhiaa jai ||
115.e: Without the True Guru, the Lord cannot be seen.

115.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
115.t: gur kirapaa kar aap dhitaa dhikhai ||
115.e: Granting His Grace, He Himself has allowed me to see Him.

115.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
115.t: aape aap aap mil rahiaa sahaje sahaj samaavaniaa ||5||
115.e: All by Himself, He Himself is permeating and pervading; He is intuitively absorbed in celestial peace. ||5||

115.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
115.t: gurmukh hovai su ikas siau liv laae ||
115.e: One who becomes Gurmukh embraces love for the One.

115.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
115.t: dhoojaa bharam gur sabadh jalaae ||
115.e: Doubt and duality are burned away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

115.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
115.t: kaiaa a(n)dhar vanaj kare vaapaaraa naam nidhaan sach paavaniaa ||6||
115.e: Within his body, he deals and trades, and obtains the Treasure of the True Name. ||6||

115.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
115.t: gurmukh karanee har keerat saar ||
115.e: The life-style of the Gurmukh is sublime; he sings the Praises of the Lord.

115.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
115.t: gurmukh paae mokh dhuaar ||
115.e: The Gurmukh finds the gate of salvation.

115.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
115.t: anadhin ra(n)g rataa gun gaavai a(n)dhar mahal bulaavaniaa ||7||
115.e: Night and day, he is imbued with the Lord's Love. He sings the Lord's Glorious Praises, and he is called to the Mansion of His Presence. ||7||

115.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
115.t: satigur dhaataa milai milaiaa ||
115.e: The True Guru, the Giver, is met when the Lord leads us to meet Him.

115.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
115.t: poorai bhaag man sabadh vasaiaa ||
115.e: Through perfect destiny, the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.

115.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੯॥੧੦॥
115.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee har sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||8||9||10||
115.e: O Nanak, the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by chanting the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||8||9||10||

115.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
115.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
115.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

115.g: ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਏ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
115.t: aap va(n)n(j)aae taa sabh kichh paae ||
115.e: Those who lose their own selves obtain everything.

115.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
115.t: gur sabadhee sachee liv laae ||
115.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enshrine Love for the True one.

115.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਘਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
115.t: sach vana(n)jeh sach sa(n)ghareh sach vaapaar karaavaniaa ||1||
115.e: They trade in Truth, they gather in Truth, and they deal only in Truth. ||1||

115.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
115.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har gun anadhin gaavaniaa ||
115.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

115.g: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
115.t: hau teraa too(n) Thaakur meraa sabadh vaddiaaiee dhevaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
115.e: I am Yours, You are my Lord and Master. You bestow greatness through the Word of Your Shabad. ||1||Pause||

115.g: ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
115.t: velaa vakhat sabh suhaiaa ||
115.e: That time, that moment is totally beautiful,

115.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
115.t: jit sachaa mere man bhaiaa ||
115.e: when the True One becomes pleasing to my mind.

115.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
115.t: sache seviaai sach vaddiaaiee gur kirapaa te sach paavaniaa ||2||
115.e: Serving the True One, true greatness is obtained. By Guru's Grace, the True One is obtained. ||2||

115.g: ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਏ ॥
115.t: bhaau bhojan satigur tuThai paae ||
115.e: The food of spiritual love is obtained when the True Guru is pleased.

115.g: ਅਨ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
115.t: an ras chookai har ras ma(n)n vasaae ||
115.e: Other essences are forgotten, when the Lord's Essence comes to dwell in the mind.

115.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
115.t: sach sa(n)tokh sahaj sukh baanee poore gur te paavaniaa ||3||
115.e: Truth, contentment and intuitive peace and poise are obtained from the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

115.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
115.t: satigur na seveh moorakh a(n)dh gavaaraa ||
115.e: The blind and ignorant fools do not serve the True Guru;

115.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਇ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
115.t: fir oi kithahu pain mokh dhuaaraa ||
115.e: how will they find the gate of salvation?

115.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
115.t: mar mar ja(n)meh fir fir aaveh jam dhar choTaa khaavaniaa ||4||
115.e: They die and die, over and over again, only to be reborn, over and over again. They are struck down at Death's Door. ||4||

115.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
115.t: sabadhai saadh jaaneh taa aap pachhaaneh ||
115.e: Those who know the essence of the Shabad, understand their own selves.

115.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
115.t: niramal baanee sabadh vakhaaneh ||
115.e: Immaculate is the speech of those who chant the Word of the Shabad.

115.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
115.t: sache sev sadhaa sukh pain nau nidh naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||5||
115.e: Serving the True One, they find a lasting peace; they enshrine the nine treasures of the Naam within their minds. ||5||

115.g: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
115.t: so thaan suhaiaa jo har man bhaiaa ||
115.e: Beautiful is that place, which is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

115.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
115.t: satasa(n)gat beh har gun gaiaa ||
115.e: There, sitting in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

115.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
115.t: anadhin har saalaaheh saachaa niramal naadh vajaavaniaa ||6||
115.e: Night and day, the True One is praised; the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad resounds there. ||6||

116.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਖੋਟਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
116.t: manmukh khoTee raas khoTaa paasaaraa ||
116.e: The wealth of the self-willed manmukhs is false, and false is their ostentatious display.

116.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
116.t: kooR kamaavan dhukh laagai bhaaraa ||
116.e: They practice falsehood, and suffer terrible pain.

116.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
116.t: bharame bhoole firan dhin raatee mar janameh janam gavaavaniaa ||7||
116.e: Deluded by doubt, they wander day and night; through birth and death, they lose their lives. ||7||

116.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੈ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
116.t: sachaa saahib mai at piaaraa ||
116.e: My True Lord and Master is very dear to me.

116.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
116.t: poore gur kai sabadh adhaaraa ||
116.e: The Shabad of the Perfect Guru is my Support.

116.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
116.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee dhukh sukh sam kar jaananiaa ||8||10||11||
116.e: O Nanak, one who obtains the Greatness of the Naam, looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same. ||8||10||11||

116.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
116.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
116.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

116.g: ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
116.t: tereeaa khaanee tereeaa baanee ||
116.e: The four sources of creation are Yours; the spoken word is Yours.

116.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
116.t: bin naavai sabh bharam bhulaanee ||
116.e: Without the Name, all are deluded by doubt.

116.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
116.t: gur sevaa te har naam paiaa bin satigur koi na paavaniaa ||1||
116.e: Serving the Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, no one can receive it. ||1||

116.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
116.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har setee chit laavaniaa ||
116.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Lord.

116.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
116.t: har sachaa gur bhagatee paieeaai sahaje ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
116.e: Through devotion to the Guru, the True One is found; He comes to abide in the mind, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

116.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
116.t: satigur seve taa sabh kichh paae ||
116.e: Serving the True Guru, all things are obtained.

116.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
116.t: jehee manasaa kar laagai tehaa fal paae ||
116.e: As are the desires one harbors, so are the rewards one receives.

116.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਥੂ ਕਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
116.t: satigur dhaataa sabhanaa vathoo kaa poorai bhaag milaavaniaa ||2||
116.e: The True Guru is the Giver of all things; through perfect destiny, He is met. ||2||

116.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
116.t: eih man mailaa ik na dhiaae ||
116.e: This mind is filthy and polluted; it does not meditate on the One.

116.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
116.t: a(n)tar mail laagee bahu dhoojai bhaae ||
116.e: Deep within, it is soiled and stained by the love of duality.

116.g: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਵਧੇਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
116.t: taT teerath dhisa(n)tar bhavai aha(n)kaaree hor vadherai haumai mal laavaniaa ||3||
116.e: The egotists may go on pilgrimages to holy rivers, sacred shrines and foreign lands, but they only gather more of the dirt of egotism. ||3||

116.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
116.t: satigur seve taa mal jaae ||
116.e: Serving the True Guru, filth and pollution are removed.

116.g: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
116.t: jeevat marai har siau chit laae ||
116.e: Those who focus their consciousness on the Lord remain dead while yet alive.

116.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
116.t: har niramal sach mail na laagai sach laagai mail gavaavaniaa ||4||
116.e: The True Lord is Pure; no filth sticks to Him. Those who are attached to the True One have their filth washed away. ||4||

116.g: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
116.t: baajh guroo hai a(n)dh gubaaraa ||
116.e: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

116.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
116.t: agiaanee a(n)dhaa a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
116.e: The ignorant ones are blind-there is only utter darkness for them.

116.g: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
116.t: bisaTaa ke keeRe bisaTaa kamaaveh fir bisaTaa maeh pachaavaniaa ||5||
116.e: The maggots in manure do filthy deeds, and in filth they rot and putrefy. ||5||

116.g: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
116.t: mukate seve mukataa hovai ||
116.e: Serving the Lord of Liberation, liberation is achieved.

116.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
116.t: haumai mamataa sabadhe khovai ||
116.e: The Word of the Shabad eradicates egotism and possessiveness.

116.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
116.t: anadhin har jeeau sachaa sevee poorai bhaag gur paavaniaa ||6||
116.e: So serve the Dear True Lord, night and day. By perfect good destiny, the Guru is found. ||6||

116.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
116.t: aape bakhase mel milaae ||
116.e: He Himself forgives and unites in His Union.

116.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
116.t: poore gur te naam nidh paae ||
116.e: From the Perfect Guru, the Treasure of the Naam is obtained.

116.g: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
116.t: sachai naam sadhaa man sachaa sach seve dhukh gavaavaniaa ||7||
116.e: By the True Name, the mind is made true forever. Serving the True Lord, sorrow is driven out. ||7||

116.g: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
116.t: sadhaa hajoor dhoor na jaanahu ||
116.e: He is always close at hand-do not think that He is far away.

116.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ॥
116.t: gur sabadhee har a(n)tar pachhaanahu ||
116.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Lord deep within your own being.

116.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੧੨॥
116.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||11||12||
116.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is received. Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||8||11||12||

116.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
116.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
116.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

116.g: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
116.t: aaithai saache su aagai saache ||
116.e: Those who are True here, are True hereafter as well.

116.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
116.t: man sachaa sachai sabadh raache ||
116.e: That mind is true, which is attuned to the True Shabad.

116.g: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
116.t: sachaa seveh sach kamaaveh sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||1||
116.e: They serve the True One, and practice Truth; they earn Truth, and only Truth. ||1||

116.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
116.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sachaa naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
116.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the True Name.

116.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
116.t: sache seveh sach samaaveh sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
116.e: They serve the True One, and are absorbed into the True One, singing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||1||Pause||

116.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
116.t: pa(n)ddit paReh saadh na paaveh ||
116.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars read, but they do not taste the essence.

116.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਭਰਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
116.t: dhoojai bhai maiaa man bharamaaveh ||
116.e: In love with duality and Maya, their minds wander, unfocused.

116.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਧਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
116.t: maiaa moh sabh sudh gavaiee kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
116.e: The love of Maya has displaced all their understanding; making mistakes, they live in regret. ||2||

116.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
116.t: satigur milai taa tat paae ||
116.e: But if they should meet the True Guru, then they obtain the essence of reality;

116.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
116.t: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
116.e: the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in their minds.

117.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
117.t: sabadh marai man maarai apunaa mukatee kaa dhar paavaniaa ||3||
117.e: Those who die in the Shabad and subdue their own minds, obtain the door of liberation. ||3||
They erase their sins, and eliminate their anger;

117.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
117.t: gur kaa sabadh rakhai ur dhaare ||
117.e: they keep the Guru's Shabad clasped tightly to their hearts.

117.g: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
117.t: sach rate sadhaa bairaagee haumai maar milaavaniaa ||4||
117.e: Those who are attuned to Truth, remain balanced and detached forever. Subduing their egotism, they are united with the Lord. ||4||
Deep within the nucleus of the self is the jewel; we receive it only if the Lord inspires us to receive it.
The mind is bound by the three dispositions-the three modes of Maya.

117.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
117.t: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thake chauthe padh kee saar na paavaniaa ||5||
117.e: Reading and reciting, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary, but they have not found the supreme essence of the fourth state. ||5||
The Lord Himself dyes us in the color of His Love.

117.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
117.t: se jan raate gur sabadh ra(n)gaae ||
117.e: Only those who are steeped in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are so imbued with His Love.

117.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
117.t: har ra(n)g chaRiaa at apaaraa har ras ras gun gaavaniaa ||6||
117.e: Imbued with the most beautiful color of the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with great pleasure and joy. ||6||

117.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
117.t: gurmukh ridh sidh sach sa(n)jam soiee ||
117.e: To the Gurmukh, the True Lord is wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and strict self-discipline.
Through the spiritual wisdom of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukh is liberated.

117.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
117.t: gurmukh kaar sach kamaaveh sache sach samaavaniaa ||7||
117.e: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||7||
The Gurmukh realizes that the Lord alone creates, and having created, He destroys.
To the Gurmukh, the Lord Himself is social class, status and all honor.

117.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੧੩॥
117.t: naanak gurmukh naam dhiaae naame naam samaavaniaa ||8||12||13||
117.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; through the Naam, they merge in the Naam. ||8||12||13||
Maajh, Third Mehla:
Creation and destruction happen through the Word of the Shabad.
Through the Shabad, creation happens again.

117.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
117.t: gurmukh varatai sabh aape sachaa gurmukh upai samaavaniaa ||1||
117.e: The Gurmukh knows that the True Lord is all-pervading. The Gurmukh understands creation and merger. ||1||

117.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
117.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gur pooraa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
117.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Perfect Guru within their minds.

117.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
117.t: gur te saat bhagat kare dhin raatee gun keh gunee samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
117.e: From the Guru comes peace and tranquility; worship Him with devotion, day and night. Chanting His Glorious Praises, merge into the Glorious Lord. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh sees the Lord on the earth, and the Gurmukh sees Him in the water.
The Gurmukh sees Him in wind and fire; such is the wonder of His Play.

117.g: ਸੋ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
117.t: so niguraa jo mar mar ja(n)mai nigure aavan jaavaniaa ||2||
117.e: One who has no Guru, dies over and over again, only to be re-born. One who has no Guru continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
The One Creator has set this play in motion.

117.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
117.t: kaiaa sareerai vich sabh kichh paiaa ||
117.e: In the frame of the human body, He has placed all things.

117.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
117.t: sabadh bhedh koiee mahal paae mahale mahal bulaavaniaa ||3||
117.e: Those few who are pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. He calls them into His Wondrous Palace. ||3||
True is the Banker, and true are His traders.
They purchase Truth, with infinite love for the Guru.

117.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
117.t: sach vihaajheh sach kamaaveh sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||4||
117.e: They deal in Truth, and they practice Truth. They earn Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

117.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੋ ਵਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
117.t: bin raasee ko vath kiau paae ||
117.e: Without investment capital, how can anyone acquire merchandise?
The self-willed manmukhs have all gone astray.

117.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
117.t: bin raasee sabh khaalee chale khaalee jai dhukh paavaniaa ||5||
117.e: Without true wealth, everyone goes empty-handed; going empty-handed, they suffer in pain. ||5||

117.g: ਇਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
117.t: eik sach vana(n)jeh gur sabadh piaare ||
117.e: Some deal in Truth, through love of the Guru's Shabad.
They save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well.

117.g: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
117.t: aae se paravaan hoe mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||6||
117.e: Very auspicious is the coming of those who meet their Beloved and find peace. ||6||
Deep within the self is the secret, but the fool looks for it outside.
The blind self-willed manmukhs wander around like demons;

117.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਥਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
117.t: jithai vath hovai tithahu koi na paavai manmukh bharam bhulaavaniaa ||7||
117.e: but where the secret is, there, they do not find it. The manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||7||
He Himself calls us, and bestows the Word of the Shabad.
The soul-bride finds intuitive peace and poise in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

117.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੩॥੧੪॥
117.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee aape sun sun dhiaavaniaa ||8||13||14||
117.e: O Nanak, she obtains the glorious greatness of the Naam; she hears it again and again, and she meditates on it. ||8||13||14||
Maajh, Third Mehla:
The True Guru has imparted the True Teachings.

118.g: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
118.t: har chetahu a(n)t hoi sakhaiee ||
118.e: Think of the Lord, who shall be your Help and Support in the end.

118.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
118.t: har agam agochar anaath ajonee satigur kai bhai paavaniaa ||1||
118.e: The Lord is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. He has no master, and He is not born. He is obtained through love of the True Guru. ||1||

118.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
118.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree aap nivaaraniaa ||
118.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who eliminate selfishness and conceit.

118.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
118.t: aap gavaae taa har paae har siau sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
118.e: They eradicate selfishness and conceit, and then find the Lord; they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

118.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
118.t: poorab likhiaa su karam kamaiaa ||
118.e: According to their pre-ordained destiny, they act out their karma.

118.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
118.t: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa ||
118.e: Serving the True Guru, a lasting peace is found.

118.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
118.t: bin bhaagaa gur paieeaai naahee sabadhai mel milaavaniaa ||2||
118.e: Without good fortune, the Guru is not found. Through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||

118.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
118.t: gurmukh alipat rahai sa(n)saare ||
118.e: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected in the midst of the world.

118.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਤਕੀਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
118.t: gur kai takeeaai naam adhaare ||
118.e: The Guru is their cushion, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is their Support.

118.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਖਪਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
118.t: gurmukh jor kare kiaa tis no aape khap dhukh paavaniaa ||3||
118.e: Who can oppress the Gurmukh? One who tries shall perish, writhing in pain. ||3||

118.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
118.t: manmukh a(n)dhe sudh na kaiee ||
118.e: The blind self-willed manmukhs have no understanding at all.

118.g: ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ਹੈ ਜਗਤ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
118.t: aatam ghaatee hai jagat kasaiee ||
118.e: They are the assassins of the self, and the butchers of the world.

118.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਭਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
118.t: ni(n)dhaa kar kar bahu bhaar uThaavai bin majooree bhaar pahuchaavaniaa ||4||
118.e: By continually slandering others, they carry a terrible load, and they carry the loads of others for nothing. ||4||

118.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਾੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
118.t: eih jag vaaRee meraa prabh maalee ||
118.e: This world is a garden, and my Lord God is the Gardener.

118.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਲੀ ॥
118.t: sadhaa samaale ko naahee khaalee ||
118.e: He always takes care of it-nothing is exempt from His Care.

118.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਾਸੂ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
118.t: jehee vaasanaa paae tehee varatai vaasoo vaas janaavaniaa ||5||
118.e: As is the fragrance which He bestows, so is the fragrant flower known. ||5||

118.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
118.t: manmukh rogee hai sa(n)saaraa ||
118.e: The self-willed manmukhs are sick and diseased in the world.

118.g: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
118.t: sukhadhaataa visariaa agam apaaraa ||
118.e: They have forgotten the Giver of peace, the Unfathomable, the Infinite.

118.g: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਤਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
118.t: dhukhe'ee nit fireh bilalaadhe bin gur saa(n)t na paavaniaa ||6||
118.e: These miserable people wander endlessly, crying out in pain; without the Guru, they find no peace. ||6||

118.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
118.t: jin keete soiee bidh jaanai ||
118.e: The One who created them, knows their condition.

118.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
118.t: aap kare taa hukam pachhaanai ||
118.e: And if He inspires them, then they realize the Hukam of His Command.

118.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
118.t: jehaa a(n)dhar paae tehaa varatai aape baahar paavaniaa ||7||
118.e: Whatever He places within them, that is what prevails, and so they outwardly appear. ||7||

118.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
118.t: tis baajhahu sache mai hor na koiee ||
118.e: I know of no other except the True One.

118.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
118.t: jis lai le so niramal hoiee ||
118.e: Those, whom the Lord attaches to Himself, become pure.

118.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੪॥੧੫॥
118.t: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar jis dhevai so paavaniaa ||8||14||15||
118.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the heart of those, unto whom He has given it. ||8||14||15||

118.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
118.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
118.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
118.t: a(n)mirat naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
118.e: Enshrining the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind,

118.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
118.t: haumai meraa sabh dhukh gavaae ||
118.e: all the pains of egotism, selfishness and conceit are eliminated.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
118.t: a(n)mirat baanee sadhaa salaahe a(n)mirat a(n)mrit paavaniaa ||1||
118.e: By continually praising the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, I obtain the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

118.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
118.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree a(n)mirat baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
118.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Bani of the Word within their minds.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
118.t: a(n)mirat baanee ma(n)n vasaae a(n)mrit naam dhiaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
118.e: Enshrining the Ambrosial Bani in their minds, they meditate on the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||Pause||

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਵੈਣੀ ॥ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
118.t: a(n)mrit bolai sadhaa mukh vainee || a(n)mrit vekhai parakhai sadhaa nainee ||
118.e: Those who continually chant the Ambrosial Words of Nectar see and behold this Amrit everywhere with their eyes.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
118.t: a(n)mirat kathaa kahai sadhaa dhin raatee avaraa aakh sunaavaniaa ||2||
118.e: They continually chant the Ambrosial Sermon day and night; chanting it, they cause others to hear it. ||2||

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
118.t: a(n)mirat ra(n)g rataa liv laae ||
118.e: Imbued with the Ambrosial Love of the Lord, they lovingly focus their attention on Him.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
118.t: a(n)mrit gur parasaadhee paae ||
118.e: By Guru's Grace, they receive this Amrit.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
118.t: a(n)mrit rasanaa bolai dhin raatee man tan a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||3||
118.e: They chant the Ambrosial Name with their tongues day and night; their minds and bodies are satisfied by this Amrit. ||3||

118.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
118.t: so kichh karai ju chit na hoiee ||
118.e: That which God does is beyond anyone's consciousness;

118.g: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
118.t: tis dhaa hukam meT na sakai koiee ||
118.e: no one can erase the Hukam of His Command.

118.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
118.t: hukame varatai a(n)mirat baanee hukame a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||4||
118.e: By His Command, the Ambrosial Bani of the Word prevails, and by His Command, we drink in the Amrit. ||4||

118.g: ਅਜਬ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੇ ॥
118.t: ajab ka(n)m karate har kere ||
118.e: The actions of the Creator Lord are marvellous and wonderful.

118.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
118.t: eih man bhoolaa jaa(n)dhaa fere ||
118.e: This mind is deluded, and goes around the wheel of reincarnation.

118.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
118.t: a(n)mirat baanee siau chit laae a(n)mirat sabadh vajaavaniaa ||5||
118.e: Those who focus their consciousness on the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, hear the vibrations of the Ambrosial Word of the Shabad. ||5||

119.e: You Yourself created the counterfeit and the genuine.
You Yourself appraise all people.

119.g: ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
119.t: khare parakh khajaanai paieh khoTe bharam bhulaavaniaa ||6||
119.e: You appraise the true, and place them in Your Treasury; You consign the false to wander in delusion. ||6||
How can I behold You? How can I praise You?
By Guru's Grace, I praise You through the Word of the Shabad.

119.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਣੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
119.t: tere bhaane vich a(n)mrit vasai too(n) bhaanai a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||7||
119.e: In Your Sweet Will, the Amrit is found; by Your Will, You inspire us to drink in this Amrit. ||7||
The Shabad is Amrit; the Lord's Bani is Amrit.
Serving the True Guru, it permeates the heart.

119.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥੧੬॥
119.t: naanak a(n)mirat naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa pee a(n)mrit sabh bhukh leh jaavaniaa ||8||15||16||
119.e: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Naam is forever the Giver of peace; drinking in this Amrit, all hunger is satisfied. ||8||15||16||
Maajh, Third Mehla:
The Ambrosial Nectar rains down, softly and gently.
How rare are those Gurmukhs who find it.

119.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
119.t: a(n)mrit pee sadhaa tirapataase kar kirapaa tirasanaa bujhaavaniaa ||1||
119.e: Those who drink it in are satisfied forever. Showering His Mercy upon them, the Lord quenches their thirst. ||1||

119.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
119.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gurmukh a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||
119.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those Gurmukhs who drink in this Ambrosial Nectar.

119.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
119.t: rasanaa ras chaakh sadhaa rahai ra(n)g raatee sahaje har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
119.e: The tongue tastes the essence, and remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love, intuitively singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's Grace, intuitive understanding is obtained;

119.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
119.t: dhubidhaa maare ikas siau liv laae ||
119.e: subduing the sense of duality, they are in love with the One.

119.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
119.t: nadhar kare taa har gun gaavai nadharee sach samaavaniaa ||2||
119.e: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, then they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; by His Grace, they merge in Truth. ||2||
Above all is Your Glance of Grace, O God.
Upon some it is bestowed less, and upon others it is bestowed more.

119.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
119.t: tujh te baahar kichh na hovai gurmukh sojhee paavaniaa ||3||
119.e: Without You, nothing happens at all; the Gurmukhs understand this. ||3||
The Gurmukhs contemplate the essence of reality;
Your Treasures are overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

119.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
119.t: bin satigur seve koiee na paavai gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||4||
119.e: Without serving the True Guru, no one obtains it. It is obtained only by Guru's Grace. ||4||
Those who serve the True Guru are beautiful.
The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices their inner minds.

119.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
119.t: a(n)mirat man tan baanee rataa a(n)mrit sahaj sunaavaniaa ||5||
119.e: Their minds and bodies are attuned to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word; this Ambrosial Nectar is intuitively heard. ||5||
The deluded, self-willed manmukhs are ruined through the love of duality.

119.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
119.t: naam na levai marai bikh khaae ||
119.e: They do not chant the Naam, and they die, eating poison.

119.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
119.t: anadhin sadhaa visaTaa meh vaasaa bin sevaa janam gavaavaniaa ||6||
119.e: Night and day, they continually sit in manure. Without selfless service, their lives are wasted away. ||6||

119.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਏ ॥
119.t: a(n)mrit peevai jis no aap peeaae ||
119.e: They alone drink in this Amrit, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.
By Guru's Grace, they intuitively enshrine love for the Lord.

119.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
119.t: pooran poor rahiaa sabh aape gurmat nadharee aavaniaa ||7||
119.e: The Perfect Lord is Himself perfectly pervading everywhere; through the Guru's Teachings, He is perceived. ||7||
He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.
He who has created, shall Himself destroy.

119.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੬॥੧੭॥
119.t: naanak naam samaal sadhaa too(n) sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||8||16||17||
119.e: O Nanak, remember the Naam forever, and you shall merge into the True One with intuitive ease. ||8||16||17||
Maajh, Third Mehla:

119.g: ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
119.t: se sach laage jo tudh bhaae ||
119.e: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.
They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.

119.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
119.t: sachai sabadh sachaa saalaahee sachai mel milaavaniaa ||1||
119.e: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||

119.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਿਆ ॥
119.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sach saalaahaniaa ||
119.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.

119.g: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
119.t: sach dhiaain se sach raate sache sach samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
119.e: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||
The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.
By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.

119.g: ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
119.t: tan sachaa rasanaa sach raatee sach sun aakh vakhaananiaa ||2||
119.e: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2||

120.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
120.t: manasaa maar sach samaanee ||
120.e: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;

120.g: ਇਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਡੀਠੀ ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
120.t: ein man ddeeThee sabh aavan jaanee ||
120.e: they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.

120.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
120.t: satigur seve sadhaa man nihachal nij ghar vaasaa paavaniaa ||3||
120.e: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
120.t: gur kai sabadh ridhai dhikhaiaa ||
120.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.

120.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
120.t: maiaa moh sabadh jalaiaa ||
120.e: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.

120.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
120.t: sacho sachaa vekh saalaahee gur sabadhee sach paavaniaa ||4||
120.e: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||

120.g: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
120.t: jo sach raate tin sachee liv laagee ||
120.e: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.

120.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
120.t: har naam samaaleh se vaddabhaagee ||
120.e: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.

120.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
120.t: sachai sabadh aap milaae satasa(n)gat sach gun gaavaniaa ||5||
120.e: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who join the True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||

120.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
120.t: lekhaa paReeaai je lekhe vich hovai ||
120.e: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.

120.g: ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
120.t: oh agam agochar sabadh sudh hovai ||
120.e: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.

120.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
120.t: anadhin sach sabadh saalaahee hor koi na keemat paavaniaa ||6||
120.e: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to know His Worth. ||6||

120.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
120.t: paR paR thaake saa(n)t na aaiee ||
120.e: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.

120.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਲੇ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
120.t: tirasanaa jaale sudh na kaiee ||
120.e: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.

120.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
120.t: bikh bihaajheh bikh moh piaase kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||7||
120.e: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Telling lies, they eat poison. ||7||

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
120.t: gur parasaadhee eko jaanaa ||
120.e: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.

120.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
120.t: dhoojaa maar man sach samaanaa ||
120.e: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.

120.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੧੮॥
120.t: naanak eko naam varatai man a(n)tar gur parasaadhee paavaniaa ||8||17||18||
120.e: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receive it. ||8||17||18||

120.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
120.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
120.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

120.g: ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
120.t: varan roop varateh sabh tere ||
120.e: In all colors and forms, You are pervading.

120.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਫੇਰ ਪਵਹਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
120.t: mar mar ja(n)meh fer paveh ghanere ||
120.e: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation.

120.g: ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
120.t: too(n) eko nihachal agam apaaraa gurmatee boojh bujhaavaniaa ||1||
120.e: You alone are Eternal and Unchanging, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding is imparted. ||1||

120.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
120.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree raam naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
120.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.

120.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
120.t: tis roop na rekhiaa varan na koiee gurmatee aap bujhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
120.e: The Lord has no form, features or color. Through the Guru's Teachings, He inspires us to understand Him. ||1||Pause||

120.g: ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
120.t: sabh ekaa jot jaanai je koiee ||
120.e: The One Light is all-pervading; only a few know this.

120.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
120.t: satigur seviaai paragaT hoiee ||
120.e: Serving the True Guru, this is revealed.

120.g: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
120.t: gupat paragaT varatai sabh thaiee jotee jot milaavaniaa ||2||
120.e: In the hidden and in the obvious, He is pervading all places. Our light merges into the Light. ||2||

120.g: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
120.t: tisanaa agan jalai sa(n)saaraa ||
120.e: The world is burning in the fire of desire,

120.g: ਲੋਭੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
120.t: lobh abhimaan bahut aha(n)kaaraa ||
120.e: in greed, arrogance and excessive ego.

120.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਪਣੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
120.t: mar mar janamai pat gavaae apanee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa ||3||
120.e: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and lose their honor. They waste away their lives in vain. ||3||

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
120.t: gur kaa sabadh ko viralaa boojhai ||
120.e: Those who understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad are very rare.

120.g: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
120.t: aap maare taa tirabhavan soojhai ||
120.e: Those who subdue their egotism, come to know the three worlds.

120.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
120.t: fir oh marai na maranaa hovai sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||4||
120.e: Then, they die, never to die again. They are intuitively absorbed in the True One. ||4||

120.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
120.t: maiaa meh fir chit na laae ||
120.e: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again.

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
120.t: gur kai sabadh sadh rahai samaae ||
120.e: They remain absorbed forever in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

120.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
120.t: sach salaahe sabh ghaT a(n)tar sacho sach suhaavaniaa ||5||
120.e: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessed and exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||

120.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
120.t: sach saalaahee sadhaa hajoore ||
120.e: Praise the True One, who is Ever-present.

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
120.t: gur kai sabadh rahiaa bharapoore ||
120.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading everywhere.

120.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
120.t: gur parasaadhee sach nadharee aavai sache hee sukh paavaniaa ||6||
120.e: By Guru's Grace, we come to behold the True One; from the True One, peace is obtained. ||6||

120.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
120.t: sach man a(n)dhar rahiaa samai ||
120.e: The True One permeates and pervades the mind within.

120.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
120.t: sadhaa sach nihachal aavai na jai ||
120.e: The True One is Eternal and Unchanging; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

120.g: ਸਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
120.t: sache laagai so man niramal gurmatee sach samaavaniaa ||7||
120.e: Those who are attached to the True One are immaculate and pure. Through the Guru's Teachings, they merge in the True One. ||7||

120.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
120.t: sach saalaahee avar na koiee ||
120.e: Praise the True One, and no other.

120.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
120.t: jit seviaai sadhaa sukh hoiee ||
120.e: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

121.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੮॥੧੯॥
121.t: naanak naam rate veechaaree sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||8||18||19||
121.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, reflect deeply on the Truth; they practice only Truth. ||8||18||19||

121.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
121.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
121.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
121.t: niramal sabadh niramal hai baanee ||
121.e: The Word of the Shabad is Immaculate and Pure; the Bani of the Word is Pure.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
121.t: niramal jot sabh maeh samaanee ||
121.e: The Light which is pervading among all is Immaculate.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
121.t: niramal baanee har saalaahee jap har niramal mail gavaavaniaa ||1||
121.e: So praise the Immaculate Word of the Lord's Bani; chanting the Immaculate Name of the Lord, all filth is washed away. ||1||

121.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
121.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sukhadhaataa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
121.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Giver of peace within their minds.

121.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਣਿ ਤਿਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
121.t: har niramal gur sabadh salaahee sabadho sun tisaa miTaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
121.e: Praise the Immaculate Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Listen to the Shabad, and quench your thirst. ||1||Pause||

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
121.t: niramal naam vasiaa man aae ||
121.e: When the Immaculate Naam comes to dwell in the mind,

121.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
121.t: man tan niramal maiaa moh gavaae ||
121.e: the mind and body become Immaculate, and emotional attachment to Maya departs.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
121.t: niramal gun gaavai nit saache ke niramal naadh vajaavaniaa ||2||
121.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate True Lord forever, and the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad shall vibrate within. ||2||

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
121.t: niramal a(n)mrit gur te paiaa ||
121.e: The Immaculate Ambrosial Nectar is obtained from the Guru.

121.g: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
121.t: vichahu aap muaa tithai moh na maiaa ||
121.e: When selfishness and conceit are eradicated from within, then there is no attachment to Maya.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
121.t: niramal giaan dhiaan at niramal niramal baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||3||
121.e: Immaculate is the spiritual wisdom, and utterly immaculate is the meditation, of those whose minds are filled with the Immaculate Bani of the Word. ||3||

121.g: ਜੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
121.t: jo niramal seve su niramal hovai ||
121.e: One who serves the Immaculate Lord becomes immaculate.

121.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
121.t: haumai mail gur sabadhe dhovai ||
121.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the filth of egotism is washed away.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
121.t: niramal vaajai anahadh dhun baanee dhar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||4||
121.e: The Immaculate Bani and the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current vibrate, and in the True Court, honor is obtained. ||4||

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
121.t: niramal te sabh niramal hovai ||
121.e: Through the Immaculate Lord, all become immaculate.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥
121.t: niramal manooaa har sabadh parovai ||
121.e: Immaculate is the mind which weaves the Word of the Lord's Shabad into itself.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
121.t: niramal naam lage baddabhaagee niramal naam suhaavaniaa ||5||
121.e: Blessed and very fortunate are those who are committed to the Immaculate Name; through the Immaculate Name, they are blessed and beautified. ||5||

121.g: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
121.t: so niramal jo sabadhe sohai ||
121.e: Immaculate is the one who is adorned with the Shabad.

121.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹੈ ॥
121.t: niramal naam man tan mohai ||
121.e: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices the mind and body.

121.g: ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
121.t: sach naam mal kadhe na laagai mukh uoojal sach karaavaniaa ||6||
121.e: No filth ever attaches itself to the True Name; one's face is made radiant by the True One. ||6||

121.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
121.t: man mailaa hai dhoojai bhai ||
121.e: The mind is polluted by the love of duality.

121.g: ਮੈਲਾ ਚਉਕਾ ਮੈਲੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
121.t: mailaa chaukaa mailai thai ||
121.e: Filthy is that kitchen, and filthy is that dwelling;

121.g: ਮੈਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
121.t: mailaa khai fir mail vadhaae manmukh mail dhukh paavaniaa ||7||
121.e: eating filth, the self-willed manmukhs become even more filthy. Because of their filth, they suffer in pain. ||7||

121.g: ਮੈਲੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
121.t: maile niramal sabh hukam sabaae ||
121.e: The filthy, and the immaculate as well, are all subject to the Hukam of God's Command.

121.g: ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਏ ॥
121.t: se niramal jo har saache bhaae ||
121.e: They alone are immaculate, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

121.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੯॥੨੦॥
121.t: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar gurmukh mail chukaavaniaa ||8||19||20||
121.e: O Nanak, the Naam abides deep within the minds of the Gurmukhs, who are cleansed of all their filth. ||8||19||20||

121.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
121.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
121.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

121.g: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਊਜਲ ਹੰਸਾ ॥
121.t: govi(n)dh uoojal uoojal ha(n)saa ||
121.e: The Lord of the Universe is radiant, and radiant are His soul-swans.

121.g: ਮਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
121.t: man baanee niramal meree manasaa ||
121.e: Their minds and their speech are immaculate; they are my hope and ideal.

121.g: ਮਨਿ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
121.t: man uoojal sadhaa mukh soheh at uoojal naam dhiaavaniaa ||1||
121.e: Their minds are radiant, and their faces are always beautiful; they meditate on the most radiant Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

121.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
121.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gobi(n)dh gun gaavaniaa ||
121.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

121.g: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
121.t: gobidh gobidh kahai dhin raatee gobidh gun sabadh sunaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
121.e: So chant Gobind, Gobind, the Lord of the Universe, day and night; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind, through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

121.g: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
121.t: gobidh gaaveh sahaj subhaae ||
121.e: Sing of the Lord Gobind with intuitive ease,

121.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਊਜਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
121.t: gur kai bhai uoojal haumai mal jaae ||
121.e: in the Fear of the Guru; you shall become radiant, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

121.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
121.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh raheh bhagat kareh dhin raatee sun gobidh gun gaavaniaa ||2||
121.e: Remain in bliss forever, and perform devotional worship, day and night. Hear and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord Gobind. ||2||

121.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
121.t: manooaa naachai bhagat dhiraRaae ||
121.e: Channel your dancing mind in devotional worship,

121.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
121.t: gur kai sabadh manai man milaae ||
121.e: and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, merge your mind with the Supreme Mind.

121.g: ਸਚਾ ਤਾਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
121.t: sachaa taal poore maiaa moh chukaae sabadhe nirat karaavaniaa ||3||
121.e: Let your true and perfect tune be the subjugation of your love of Maya, and let yourself dance to the Shabad. ||3||

121.g: ਊਚਾ ਕੂਕੇ ਤਨਹਿ ਪਛਾੜੇ ॥
121.t: uoochaa kooke taneh pachhaaRe ||
121.e: People shout out loud and move their bodies,

121.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜਮਕਾਲੇ ॥
121.t: maiaa moh johiaa jamakaale ||
121.e: but if they are emotionally attached to Maya, then the Messenger of Death shall hunt them down.

122.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
122.t: maiaa moh is maneh nachaae a(n)tar kapaT dhukh paavaniaa ||4||
122.e: The love of Maya makes this mind dance, and the deceit within makes people suffer in pain. ||4||

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
122.t: gurmukh bhagat jaa aap karaae ||
122.e: When the Lord inspires one to become Gurmukh, and perform devotional worship,

122.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
122.t: tan man raataa sahaj subhaae ||
122.e: then his body and mind are attuned to His Love with intuitive ease.

122.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
122.t: baanee vajai sabadh vajaae gurmukh bhagat thai paavaniaa ||5||
122.e: The Word of His Bani vibrates, and the Word of His Shabad resounds, for the Gurmukh whose devotional worship is accepted. ||5||

122.g: ਬਹੁ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
122.t: bahu taal poore vaaje vajaae ||
122.e: One may beat upon and play all sorts of instruments,

122.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
122.t: naa ko sune na ma(n)n vasaae ||
122.e: but no one will listen, and no one will enshrine it in the mind.

122.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਿੜ ਬੰਧਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
122.t: maiaa kaaran piR ba(n)dh naachai dhoojai bhai dhukh paavaniaa ||6||
122.e: For the sake of Maya, they set the stage and dance, but they are in love with duality, and they obtain only sorrow. ||6||

122.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
122.t: jis a(n)tar preet lagai so mukataa ||
122.e: Those whose inner beings are attached to the Lord's Love are liberated.

122.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
122.t: ei(n)dhree vas sach sa(n)jam jugataa ||
122.e: They control their sexual desires, and their lifestyle is the self-discipline of Truth.

122.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
122.t: gur kai sabadh sadhaa har dhiaae ehaa bhagat har bhaavaniaa ||7||
122.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they meditate forever on the Lord. This devotional worship is pleasing to the Lord. ||7||

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
122.t: gurmukh bhagat jug chaare hoiee ||
122.e: To live as Gurmukh is devotional worship, throughout the four ages.

122.g: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
122.t: horat bhagat na paae koiee ||
122.e: This devotional worship is not obtained by any other means.

122.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੦॥੨੧॥
122.t: naanak naam gur bhagatee paieeaai gur charanee chit laavaniaa ||8||20||21||
122.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained only through devotion to the Guru. So focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||20||21||

122.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
122.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
122.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

122.g: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
122.t: sachaa sevee sach saalaahee ||
122.e: Serve the True One, and praise the True One.

122.g: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
122.t: sachai nai dhukh kab hee naahee ||
122.e: With the True Name, pain shall never afflict you.

122.g: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
122.t: sukhadhaataa sevan sukh pain gurmat ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
122.e: Those who serve the Giver of peace find peace. They enshrine the Guru's Teachings within their minds. ||1||

122.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
122.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sukh sahaj samaadh lagaavaniaa ||
122.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who intuitively enter into the peace of Samaadhi.

122.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
122.t: jo har seveh se sadhaa soheh sobhaa surat suhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
122.e: Those who serve the Lord are always beautiful. The glory of their intuitive awareness is beautiful. ||1||Pause||

122.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
122.t: sabh ko teraa bhagat kahaae ||
122.e: All call themselves Your devotees,

122.g: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
122.t: seiee bhagat terai man bhaae ||
122.e: but they alone are Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your mind.

122.g: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
122.t: sach baanee tudhai saalaahan ra(n)g raate bhagat karaavaniaa ||2||
122.e: Through the True Word of Your Bani, they praise You; attuned to Your Love, they worship You with devotion. ||2||

122.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
122.t: sabh ko sache har jeeau teraa ||
122.e: All are Yours, O Dear True Lord.

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
122.t: gurmukh milai taa chookai feraa ||
122.e: Meeting the Gurmukh, this cycle of reincarnation comes to an end.

122.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
122.t: jaa tudh bhaavai taa nai rachaaveh too(n) aape naau japaavaniaa ||3||
122.e: When it pleases Your Will, then we merge in the Name. You Yourself inspire us to chant the Name. ||3||

122.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
122.t: gurmatee har ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
122.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine the Lord within my mind.

122.g: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
122.t: harakh sog sabh moh gavaiaa ||
122.e: Pleasure and pain, and all emotional attachments are gone.

122.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
122.t: eikas siau liv laagee sadh hee har naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||4||
122.e: I am lovingly centered on the One Lord forever. I enshrine the Lord's Name within my mind. ||4||

122.g: ਭਗਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
122.t: bhagat ra(n)g raate sadhaa terai chaae ||
122.e: Your devotees are attuned to Your Love; they are always joyful.

122.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
122.t: nau nidh naam vasiaa man aae ||
122.e: The nine treasures of the Naam come to dwell within their minds.

122.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
122.t: poorai bhaag satigur paiaa sabadhe mel milaavaniaa ||5||
122.e: By perfect destiny, they find the True Guru, and through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||5||

122.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
122.t: too(n) dhiaal sadhaa sukhadhaataa ||
122.e: You are Merciful, and always the Giver of peace.

122.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
122.t: too(n) aape meleh gurmukh jaataa ||
122.e: You Yourself unite us; You are known only to the Gurmukhs.

122.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
122.t: too(n) aape dheveh naam vaddaiee naam rate sukh paavaniaa ||6||
122.e: You Yourself bestow the glorious greatness of the Naam; attuned to the Naam, we find peace. ||6||

122.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
122.t: sadhaa sadhaa saache tudh saalaahee ||
122.e: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I praise You.

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
122.t: gurmukh jaataa dhoojaa ko naahee ||
122.e: As Gurmukh, I know no other at all.

122.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਮਨਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
122.t: ekas siau man rahiaa samaae man ma(n)niaai maneh milaavaniaa ||7||
122.e: My mind remains immersed in the One Lord; my mind surrenders to Him, and in my mind I meet Him. ||7||

122.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
122.t: gurmukh hovai so saalaahe ||
122.e: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord.

122.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
122.t: saache Thaakur veparavaahe ||
122.e: Our True Lord and Master is Carefree.

122.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥੨੨॥
122.t: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar gur sabadhee har melaavaniaa ||8||21||22||
122.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with the Lord. ||8||21||22||

122.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
122.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
122.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

122.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
122.t: tere bhagat soheh saachai dharabaare ||
122.e: Your devotees look beautiful in the True Court.

122.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
122.t: gur kai sabadh naam savaare ||
122.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are adorned with the Naam.

122.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
122.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh raheh dhin raatee gun keh gunee samaavaniaa ||1||
122.e: They are forever in bliss, day and night; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, they merge with the Lord of Glory. ||1||

123.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
123.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree naam sun ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
123.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who hear and enshrine the Naam within their minds.

123.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
123.t: har jeeau sachaa uoocho uoochaa haumai maar milaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
123.e: The Dear Lord, the True One, the Highest of the High, subdues their ego and blends them with Himself. ||1||Pause||

123.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
123.t: har jeeau saachaa saachee naiee ||
123.e: True is the Dear Lord, and True is His Name.

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
123.t: gur parasaadhee kisai milaiee ||
123.e: By Guru's Grace, some merge with Him.

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
123.t: gur sabadh mileh se vichhuReh naahee sahaje sach samaavaniaa ||2||
123.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, those who merge with the Lord shall not be separated from Him again. They merge with intuitive ease into the True Lord. ||2||

123.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
123.t: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hoi ||
123.e: There is nothing beyond You;

123.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
123.t: too(n) kar kar vekheh jaaneh soi ||
123.e: You are the One who does, sees, and knows.

123.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
123.t: aape kare karaae karataa gurmat aap milaavaniaa ||3||
123.e: The Creator Himself acts, and inspires others to act. Through the Guru's Teachings, He blends us into Himself. ||3||

123.g: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
123.t: kaaman gunava(n)tee har paae ||
123.e: The virtuous soul-bride finds the Lord;

123.g: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
123.t: bhai bhai seegaar banaae ||
123.e: she decorates herself with the Love and the Fear of God.

123.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਚ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
123.t: satigur sev sadhaa sohaagan sach upadhes samaavaniaa ||4||
123.e: She who serves the True Guru is forever a happy soul-bride. She is absorbed in the true teachings. ||4||

123.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
123.t: sabadh visaaran tinaa Thaur na Thaau ||
123.e: Those who forget the Word of the Shabad have no home and no place of rest.

123.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
123.t: bhram bhoole jiau su(n)n(j)ai ghar kaau ||
123.e: They are deluded by doubt, like a crow in a deserted house.

123.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਦੁਖੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
123.t: halat palat tinee dhovai gavaae dhukhe dhukh vihaavaniaa ||5||
123.e: They forfeit both this world and the next, and they pass their lives suffering in pain and misery. ||5||

123.g: ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਲਿਖਦਿਆ ਕਾਗਦ ਮਸੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
123.t: likhadhiaa likhadhiaa kaagadh mas khoiee ||
123.e: Writing on and on endlessly, they run out of paper and ink.

123.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
123.t: dhoojai bhai sukh paae na koiee ||
123.e: Through the love with duality, no one has found peace.

123.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਤੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
123.t: kooR likheh tai kooR kamaaveh jal jaaveh kooR chit laavaniaa ||6||
123.e: They write falsehood, and they practice falsehood; they are burnt to ashes by focusing their consciousness on falsehood. ||6||

123.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
123.t: gurmukh sacho sach likheh veechaar ||
123.e: The Gurmukhs write and reflect on Truth, and only Truth.

123.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
123.t: se jan sache paaveh mokh dhuaar ||
123.e: The true ones find the gate of salvation.

123.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
123.t: sach kaagadh kalam masavaanee sach likh sach samaavaniaa ||7||
123.e: True is their paper, pen and ink; writing Truth, they are absorbed in the True One. ||7||

123.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
123.t: meraa prabh a(n)tar baiThaa vekhai ||
123.e: My God sits deep within the self; He watches over us.

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
123.t: gur parasaadhee milai soiee jan lekhai ||
123.e: Those who meet the Lord, by Guru's Grace, are acceptable.

123.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੨॥੨੩॥
123.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||22||23||
123.e: O Nanak, glorious greatness is received through the Naam, which is obtained through the Perfect Guru. ||8||22||23||

123.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
123.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
123.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

123.g: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
123.t: aatam raam paragaas gur te hovai ||
123.e: The Divine Light of the Supreme Soul shines forth from the Guru.

123.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
123.t: haumai mail laagee gur sabadhee khovai ||
123.e: The filth stuck to the ego is removed through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

123.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
123.t: man niramal anadhin bhagatee raataa bhagat kare har paavaniaa ||1||
123.e: One who is imbued with devotional worship to the Lord night and day becomes pure. Worshipping the Lord, He is obtained. ||1||

123.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
123.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree aap bhagat karan avaraa bhagat karaavaniaa ||
123.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who themselves worship the Lord, and inspire others to worship Him as well.

123.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
123.t: tinaa bhagat janaa kau sadh namasakaar keejai jo anadhin har gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
123.e: I humbly bow to those devotees who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day. ||1||Pause||

123.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
123.t: aape karataa kaaran karaae ||
123.e: The Creator Lord Himself is the Doer of deeds.

123.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
123.t: jit bhaavai tit kaarai laae ||
123.e: As He pleases, He applies us to our tasks.

123.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
123.t: poorai bhaag gur sevaa hovai gur sevaa te sukh paavaniaa ||2||
123.e: Through perfect destiny, we serve the Guru; serving the Guru, peace is found. ||2||

123.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
123.t: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae ||
123.e: Those who die, and remain dead while yet alive, obtain it.

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
123.t: gur parasaadhee har ma(n)n vasaae ||
123.e: By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Lord within their minds.

123.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
123.t: sadhaa mukat har ma(n)n vasaae sahaje sahaj samaavaniaa ||3||
123.e: Enshrining the Lord within their minds, they are liberated forever. With intuitive ease, they merge into the Lord. ||3||

123.g: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
123.t: bahu karam kamaavai mukat na paae ||
123.e: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they do not obtain liberation through them.

123.g: ਦੇਸੰਤਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਏ ॥
123.t: dhesa(n)tar bhavai dhoojai bhai khuaae ||
123.e: They wander around the countryside, and in love with duality, they are ruined.

123.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕਪਟੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
123.t: birathaa janam gavaiaa kapaTee bin sabadhai dhukh paavaniaa ||4||
123.e: The deceitful lose their lives in vain; without the Word of the Shabad, they obtain only misery. ||4||

123.g: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
123.t: dhaavat raakhai Thaak rahaae ||
123.e: Those who restrain their wandering mind, keeping it steady and stable,

123.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
123.t: gur parasaadhee param padh paae ||
123.e: obtain the supreme status, by Guru's Grace.

123.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
123.t: satigur aape mel milaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||5||
123.e: The True Guru Himself unites us in Union with the Lord. Meeting the Beloved, peace is obtained. ||5||

124.g: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
124.t: eik kooR laage kooRe fal paae ||
124.e: Some are stuck in falsehood, and false are the rewards they receive.

124.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
124.t: dhoojai bhai birathaa janam gavaae ||
124.e: In love with duality, they waste away their lives in vain.

124.g: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
124.t: aap ddube sagale kul ddobe kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||6||
124.e: They drown themselves, and drown their entire family; speaking lies, they eat poison. ||6||

124.g: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
124.t: eis tan meh man ko gurmukh dhekhai ||
124.e: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, look within their bodies, into their minds.

124.g: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
124.t: bhai bhagat jaa haumai sokhai ||
124.e: Through loving devotion, their ego evaporates.

124.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
124.t: sidh saadhik monidhaaree rahe liv lai tin bhee tan meh man na dhikhaavaniaa ||7||
124.e: The Siddhas, the seekers and the silent sages continually, lovingly focus their consciousness, but they have not seen the mind within the body. ||7||

124.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
124.t: aap karaae karataa soiee ||
124.e: The Creator Himself inspires us to work;

124.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
124.t: hor k kare keetai kiaa hoiee ||
124.e: what can anyone else do? What can be done by our doing?

124.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੩॥੨੪॥
124.t: naanak jis naam dhevai so levai naamo ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||23||24||
124.e: O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Name; we receive it, and enshrine it within the mind. ||8||23||24||

124.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
124.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
124.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

124.g: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
124.t: eis gufaa meh akhuT bha(n)ddaaraa ||
124.e: Within this cave, there is an inexhaustible treasure.

124.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
124.t: tis vich vasai har alakh apaaraa ||
124.e: Within this cave, the Invisible and Infinite Lord abides.

124.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
124.t: aape gupat paragaT hai aape gur sabadhee aap va(n)n(j)aavaniaa ||1||
124.e: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, selfishness and conceit are eliminated. ||1||

124.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
124.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree a(n)mirat naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
124.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their minds.

124.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
124.t: a(n)mirat naam mahaa ras meeThaa gurmatee a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
124.e: The taste of the Ambrosial Naam is very sweet! Through the Guru's Teachings, drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
