124.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
124.t: haumai maar bajar kapaaT khulaiaa ||
124.e: Subduing egotism, the rigid doors are opened.

124.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
124.t: naam amolak gur parasaadhee paiaa ||
124.e: The Priceless Naam is obtained by Guru's Grace.

124.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
124.t: bin sabadhai naam na paae koiee gur kirapaa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||2||
124.e: Without the Shabad, the Naam is not obtained. By Guru's Grace, it is implanted within the mind. ||2||

124.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
124.t: gur giaan a(n)jan sach netree paiaa ||
124.e: The Guru has applied the true ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.

124.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
124.t: a(n)tar chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||
124.e: Deep within, the Divine Light has dawned, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.

124.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
124.t: jotee jot milee man maaniaa har dhar sobhaa paavaniaa ||3||
124.e: My light has merged into the Light; my mind has surrendered, and I am blessed with Glory in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

124.g: ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
124.t: sareerahu bhaalan ko baahar jaae || naam na lahai bahut vegaar dhukh paae ||
124.e: Those who look outside the body, searching for the Lord, shall not receive the Naam; they shall instead be forced to suffer the terrible pains of slavery.

124.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਆਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
124.t: manmukh a(n)dhe soojhai naahee fir ghir aai gurmukh vath paavaniaa ||4||
124.e: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand; but when they return once again to their own home, then, as Gurmukh, they find the genuine article. ||4||

124.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
124.t: gur parasaadhee sachaa har paae ||
124.e: By Guru's Grace, the True Lord is found.

124.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
124.t: man tan vekhai haumai mail jaae ||
124.e: Within your mind and body, see the Lord, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

124.g: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
124.t: bais suthaan sadh har gun gaavai sachai sabadh samaavaniaa ||5||
124.e: Sitting in that place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever, and be absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

124.g: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
124.t: nau dhar Thaake dhaavat rahaae ||
124.e: Those who close off the nine gates, and restrain the wandering mind,

124.g: ਦਸਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
124.t: dhasavai nij ghar vaasaa paae ||
124.e: come to dwell in the Home of the Tenth Gate.

124.g: ਓਥੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
124.t: othai anahadh sabadh vajeh dhin raatee gurmatee sabadh sunaavaniaa ||6||
124.e: There, the Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates day and night. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Shabad is heard. ||6||

124.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਨੇਰਾ ॥
124.t: bin sabadhai a(n)tar aaneraa ||
124.e: Without the Shabad, there is only darkness within.

124.g: ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
124.t: n vasat lahai na chookai feraa ||
124.e: The genuine article is not found, and the cycle of reincarnation does not end.

124.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਦਰੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
124.t: satigur hath ku(n)jee horat dhar khulai naahee gur poorai bhaag milaavaniaa ||7||
124.e: The key is in the hands of the True Guru; no one else can open this door. By perfect destiny, He is met. ||7||

124.g: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
124.t: gupat paragaT too(n) sabhanee thaiee ||
124.e: You are the hidden and the revealed in all places.

124.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
124.t: gur parasaadhee mil sojhee paiee ||
124.e: Receiving Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained.

124.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੪॥੨੫॥
124.t: naanak naam salaeh sadhaa too(n) gurmukh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||24||25||
124.e: O Nanak, praise the Naam forever; as Gurmukh, enshrine it within the mind. ||8||24||25||

124.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
124.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
124.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

124.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
124.t: gurmukh milai milaae aape ||
124.e: The Gurmukhs meet the Lord, and inspire others to meet Him as well.

124.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
124.t: kaal na johai dhukh na sa(n)taape ||
124.e: Death does not see them, and pain does not afflict them.

124.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਭ ਤੋੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
124.t: haumai maar ba(n)dhan sabh toRai gurmukh sabadh suhaavaniaa ||1||
124.e: Subduing egotism, they break all their bonds; as Gurmukh, they are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

124.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
124.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har har naam suhaavaniaa ||
124.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who look beautiful in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

124.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
124.t: gurmukh gaavai gurmukh naachai har setee chit laavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
124.e: The Gurmukhs sing, the Gurmukhs dance, and focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

125.e: The Gurmukhs are celebrated in life and death.
Their lives are not wasted; they realize the Word of the Shabad.

125.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
125.t: gurmukh marai na kaal na khaae gurmukh sach samaavaniaa ||2||
125.e: The Gurmukhs do not die; they are not consumed by death. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||
The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord.
The Gurmukhs eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

125.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
125.t: aap tarai kul sagale taare gurmukh janam savaaraniaa ||3||
125.e: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well. The Gurmukhs redeem their lives. ||3||

125.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
125.t: gurmukh dhukh kadhe na lagai sareer ||
125.e: The Gurmukhs never suffer bodily pain.
The Gurmukhs have the pain of egotism taken away.

125.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
125.t: gurmukh man niramal fir mail na laagai gurmukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||4||
125.e: The minds of the Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; no filth ever sticks to them again. The Gurmukhs merge in celestial peace. ||4||
The Gurmukhs obtain the Greatness of the Naam.
The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and obtain honor.

125.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
125.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee gurmukh sabadh karaavaniaa ||5||
125.e: They remain in bliss forever, day and night. The Gurmukhs practice the Word of the Shabad. ||5||
The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Shabad, night and day.
The Gurmukhs are known throughout the four ages.

125.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
125.t: gurmukh gun gaavai sadhaa niramal sabadhe bhagat karaavaniaa ||6||
125.e: The Gurmukhs always sing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord. Through the Shabad, they practice devotional worship. ||6||
Without the Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness.
Seized by the Messenger of Death, people cry out and scream.

125.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
125.t: anadhin rogee bisaTaa ke keeRe bisaTaa meh dhukh paavaniaa ||7||
125.e: Night and day, they are diseased, like maggots in manure, and in manure they endure agony. ||7||
The Gurmukhs know that the Lord alone acts, and causes others to act.
In the hearts of the Gurmukhs, the Lord Himself comes to dwell.

125.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੫॥੨੬॥
125.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||25||26||
125.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained. It is received from the Perfect Guru. ||8||25||26||
Maajh, Third Mehla:
The One Light is the light of all bodies.
The Perfect True Guru reveals it through the Word of the Shabad.

125.g: ਆਪੇ ਫਰਕੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
125.t: aape farak keeton ghaT a(n)tar aape banat banaavaniaa ||1||
125.e: He Himself instills the sense of separation within our hearts; He Himself created the Creation. ||1||

125.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
125.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||
125.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

125.g: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
125.t: baajh guroo ko sahaj na paae gurmukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
125.e: Without the Guru, no one obtains intuitive wisdom; the Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||1||Pause||

125.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਹਿ ॥
125.t: too(n) aape soheh aape jag moheh ||
125.e: You Yourself are Beautiful, and You Yourself entice the world.
You Yourself, by Your Kind Mercy, weave the thread of the world.

125.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
125.t: too(n) aape dhukh sukh dheveh karate gurmukh har dhekhaavaniaa ||2||
125.e: You Yourself bestow pain and pleasure, O Creator. The Lord reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||2||
The Creator Himself acts, and causes others to act.
Through Him, the Word of the Guru's Shabad is enshrined within the mind.

125.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
125.t: sabadhe upajai a(n)mirat baanee gurmukh aakh sunaavaniaa ||3||
125.e: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani emanates from the Word of the Shabad. The Gurmukh speaks it and hears it. ||3||
He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer.
One who breaks out of bondage is liberated forever.

125.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
125.t: sadhaa mukat aape hai sachaa aape alakh lakhaavaniaa ||4||
125.e: The True Lord is liberated forever. The Unseen Lord causes Himself to be seen. ||4||
He Himself is Maya, and He Himself is the Illusion.
He Himself has generated emotional attachment throughout the entire universe.

125.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
125.t: aape gunadhaataa gun gaavai aape aakh sunaavaniaa ||5||
125.e: He Himself is the Giver of Virtue; He Himself sings the Lord's Glorious Praises. He chants them and causes them to be heard. ||5||
He Himself acts, and causes others to act.
He Himself establishes and disestablishes.

125.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
125.t: tujh te baahar kachhoo na hovai too(n) aape kaarai laavaniaa ||6||
125.e: Without You, nothing can be done. You Yourself have engaged all in their tasks. ||6||
He Himself kills, and He Himself revives.
He Himself unites us, and unites us in Union with Himself.

125.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
125.t: sevaa te sadhaa sukh paiaa gurmukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||7||
125.e: Through selfless service, eternal peace is obtained. The Gurmukh is absorbed in intuitive peace. ||7||

126.g: ਆਪੇ ਊਚਾ ਊਚੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
126.t: aape uoochaa uoocho hoiee ||
126.e: He Himself is the Highest of the High.

126.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ ਸੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
126.t: jis aap vikhaale su vekhai koiee ||
126.e: How rare are those who behold Him. He causes Himself to be seen.

126.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੬॥੨੭॥
126.t: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar aape vekh vikhaalaniaa ||8||26||27||
126.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the hearts of those who see the Lord themselves, and inspire others to see Him as well. ||8||26||27||

126.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
126.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
126.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

126.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
126.t: meraa prabh bharapoor rahiaa sabh thaiee ||
126.e: My God is pervading and permeating all places.

126.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
126.t: gur parasaadhee ghar hee meh paiee ||
126.e: By Guru's Grace, I have found Him within the home of my own heart.

126.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
126.t: sadhaa sarevee ik man dhiaaiee gurmukh sach samaavaniaa ||1||
126.e: I serve Him constantly, and I meditate on Him single-mindedly. As Gurmukh, I am absorbed in the True One. ||1||

126.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
126.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree jagajeevan ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
126.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord, the Life of the World, within their minds.

126.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
126.t: har jagajeevan nirabhau dhaataa gurmat sahaj samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
126.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I merge with intuitive ease into the Lord, the Life of the World, the Fearless One, the Great Giver. ||1||Pause||

126.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਧਉਲੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ॥
126.t: ghar meh dharatee dhaul paataalaa ||
126.e: Within the home of the self is the earth, its support and the nether regions of the underworld.

126.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
126.t: ghar hee meh preetam sadhaa hai baalaa ||
126.e: Within the home of the self is the Eternally Young Beloved.

126.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
126.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai sukhadhaataa gurmat sahaj samaavaniaa ||2||
126.e: The Giver of peace is eternally blissful. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||2||

126.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
126.t: kaiaa a(n)dhar haumai meraa ||
126.e: When the body is filled with ego and selfishness,

126.g: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
126.t: ja(n)man maran na chookai feraa ||
126.e: the cycle of birth and death does not end.

126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
126.t: gurmukh hovai su haumai maare sacho sach dhiaavaniaa ||3||
126.e: One who becomes Gurmukh subdues egotism, and meditates on the Truest of the True. ||3||

126.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਾਈ ॥
126.t: kaiaa a(n)dhar paap pu(n)n dhui bhaiee ||
126.e: Within this body are the two brothers, sin and virtue.

126.g: ਦੁਹੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
126.t: dhuhee mil kai sirasaT upaiee ||
126.e: When the two joined together, the Universe was produced.

126.g: ਦੋਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
126.t: dhovai maar jai ikat ghar aavai gurmat sahaj samaavaniaa ||4||
126.e: Subduing both, and entering into the Home of the One, through the Guru's Teachings, we are absorbed in intuitive peace. ||4||

126.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਨੇਰਾ ॥
126.t: ghar hee maeh dhoojai bhai aneraa ||
126.e: Within the home of the self is the darkness of the love of duality.

126.g: ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਛੋਡੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
126.t: chaanan hovai chhoddai haumai meraa ||
126.e: When the Divine Light dawns, ego and selfishness are dispelled.

126.g: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
126.t: paragaT sabadh hai sukhadhaataa anadhin naam dhiaavaniaa ||5||
126.e: The Giver of peace is revealed through the Shabad, meditating upon the Naam, night and day. ||5||

126.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
126.t: a(n)tar jot paragaT paasaaraa ||
126.e: Deep within the self is the Light of God; It radiates throughout the expanse of His creation.

126.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
126.t: gur saakhee miTiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
126.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.

126.g: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
126.t: kamal bigaas sadhaa sukh paiaa jotee jot milaavaniaa ||6||
126.e: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and eternal peace is obtained, as one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

126.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
126.t: a(n)dhar mahal ratanee bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
126.e: Within the mansion is the treasure house, overflowing with jewels.

126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
126.t: gurmukh paae naam apaaraa ||
126.e: The Gurmukh obtains the Infinite Naam, the Name of the Lord.

126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
126.t: gurmukh vanaje sadhaa vaapaaree laahaa naam sadh paavaniaa ||7||
126.e: The Gurmukh, the trader, always purchases the merchandise of the Naam, and always reaps profits. ||7||

126.g: ਆਪੇ ਵਥੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ॥
126.t: aape vath raakhai aape dhei ||
126.e: The Lord Himself keeps this merchandise in stock, and He Himself distributes it.

126.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
126.t: gurmukh vanajeh keiee kei ||
126.e: Rare is that Gurmukh who trades in this.

126.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੭॥੨੮॥
126.t: naanak jis nadhar kare so paae kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||27||28||
126.e: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain it. Through His Mercy, it is enshrined in the mind. ||8||27||28||

126.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
126.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
126.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

126.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
126.t: har aape mele sev karaae ||
126.e: The Lord Himself leads us to merge with Him and serve Him.

126.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
126.t: gur kai sabadh bhaau dhoojaa jaae ||
126.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the love of duality is eradicated.

126.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
126.t: har niramal sadhaa gunadhaataa har gun meh aap samaavaniaa ||1||
126.e: The Immaculate Lord is the Bestower of eternal virtue. The Lord Himself leads us to merge in His Virtuous Goodness. ||1||

126.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
126.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree sach sachaa hiradhai vasaavaniaa ||
126.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Truest of the True within their hearts.

126.g: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
126.t: sachaa naam sadhaa hai niramal gur sabadhee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
126.e: The True Name is eternally pure and immaculate. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is enshrined within the mind. ||1||Pause||

126.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
126.t: aape gur dhaataa karam bidhaataa ||
126.e: The Guru Himself is the Giver, the Architect of Destiny.

126.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
126.t: sevak seveh gurmukh har jaataa ||
126.e: The Gurmukh, the humble servant who serves the Lord, comes to know Him.

126.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
126.t: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa jan soheh gurmat har ras paavaniaa ||2||
126.e: Those humble beings look beautiful forever in the Ambrosial Naam. Through the Guru's Teachings, they receive the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

126.g: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
126.t: eis gufaa meh ik thaan suhaiaa ||
126.e: Within the cave of this body, there is one beautiful place.

126.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
126.t: poorai gur haumai bharam chukaiaa ||
126.e: Through the Perfect Guru, ego and doubt are dispelled.

126.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
126.t: anadhin naam salaahan ra(n)g raate gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||3||
126.e: Night and day, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; imbued with the Lord's Love, by Guru's Grace, you shall find Him. ||3||

127.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
127.t: gur kai sabadh ih gufaa veechaare ||
127.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, search this cave.

127.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
127.t: naam nira(n)jan a(n)tar vasai muraare ||
127.e: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the self.

127.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
127.t: har gun gaavai sabadh suhaae mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||4||
127.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and decorate yourself with the Shabad. Meeting with your Beloved, you shall find peace. ||4||

127.g: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
127.t: jam jaagaatee dhoojai bhai kar laae ||
127.e: The Messenger of Death imposes his tax on those who are attached to duality.

127.g: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਏ ॥
127.t: naavahu bhoole dhei sajaae ||
127.e: He inflicts punishment on those who forget the Name.

127.g: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਲੇਵੈ ਰਤੀਅਹੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲ ਕਢਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
127.t: ghaRee muhat kaa lekhaa levai rateeahu maasaa tol kaddaavaniaa ||5||
127.e: They are called to account for each instant and each moment. Every grain, every particle, is weighed and counted. ||5||

127.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਦੂਜੈ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
127.t: peieeaRai pir chete naahee || dhoojai muThee rovai dhaahee ||
127.e: One who does not remember her Husband Lord in this world is being cheated by duality; she shall weep bitterly in the end.

127.g: ਖਰੀ ਕੁਆਲਿਓ ਕੁਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
127.t: kharee kuaalio kuroop kulakhanee supanai pir nahee paavaniaa ||6||
127.e: She is from an evil family; she is ugly and vile. Even in her dreams, she does not meet her Husband Lord. ||6||

127.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
127.t: peieeaRai pir ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
127.e: She who enshrines her Husband Lord in her mind in this world

127.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
127.t: poorai gur hadhoor dhikhaiaa ||
127.e: His Presence is revealed to her by the Perfect Guru.

127.g: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
127.t: kaaman pir raakhiaa ka(n)Th lai sabadhe pir raavai sej suhaavaniaa ||7||
127.e: That soul-bride keeps her Husband Lord clasped tightly to her heart, and through the Word of the Shabad, she enjoys her Husband Lord upon His Beautiful Bed. ||7||

127.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਦਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
127.t: aape dhevai sadh bulaae ||
127.e: The Lord Himself sends out the call, and He summons us to His Presence.

127.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
127.t: aapanaa naau ma(n)n vasaae ||
127.e: He enshrines His Name within our minds.

127.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੮॥੨੯॥
127.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee anadhin sadhaa gun gaavaniaa ||8||28||29||
127.e: O Nanak, one who receives the greatness of the Naam night and day, constantly sings His Glorious Praises. ||8||28||29||

127.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
127.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
127.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

127.g: ਊਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
127.t: uootam janam suthaan hai vaasaa ||
127.e: Sublime is their birth, and the place where they dwell.

127.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
127.t: satigur seveh ghar maeh udhaasaa ||
127.e: Those who serve the True Guru remain detached in the home of their own being.

127.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
127.t: har ra(n)g raheh sadhaa ra(n)g raate har ras man tirapataavaniaa ||1||
127.e: They abide in the Lord's Love, and constantly imbued with His Love, their minds are satisfied and fulfilled with the Lord's Essence. ||1||

127.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
127.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree paR bujh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
127.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who read of the Lord, who understand and enshrine Him within their minds.

127.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
127.t: gurmukh paReh har naam salaaheh dhar sachai sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
127.e: The Gurmukhs read and praise the Lord's Name; they are honored in the True Court. ||1||Pause||

127.g: ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
127.t: alakh abheau har rahiaa samaae ||
127.e: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere.

127.g: ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਕਿਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
127.t: aupai na kitee paiaa jaae ||
127.e: He cannot be obtained by any effort.

127.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
127.t: kirapaa kare taa satigur bheTai nadharee mel milaavaniaa ||2||
127.e: If the Lord grants His Grace, then we come to meet the True Guru. By His Kindness, we are united in His Union. ||2||

127.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
127.t: dhoojai bhai paRai nahee boojhai ||
127.e: One who reads, while attached to duality, does not understand.

127.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
127.t: tirabidh maiaa kaaran loojhai ||
127.e: He yearns for the three-phased Maya.

127.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
127.t: tirabidh ba(n)dhan tooTeh gur sabadhee gur sabadhee mukat karaavaniaa ||3||
127.e: The bonds of the three-phased Maya are broken by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Through the Guru's Shabad, liberation is achieved. ||3||

127.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
127.t: eih man cha(n)chal vas na aavai ||
127.e: This unstable mind cannot be held steady.

127.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
127.t: dhubidhaa laagai dheh dhis dhaavai ||
127.e: Attached to duality, it wanders in the ten directions.

127.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
127.t: bikh kaa keeRaa bikh meh raataa bikh hee maeh pachaavaniaa ||4||
127.e: It is a poisonous worm, drenched with poison, and in poison it rots away. ||4||

127.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ ॥
127.t: hau hau kare tai aap janaae ||
127.e: Practicing egotism and selfishness, they try to impress others by showing off.

127.g: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
127.t: bahu karam karai kichh thai na paae ||
127.e: They perform all sorts of rituals, but they gain no acceptance.

127.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
127.t: tujh te baahar kichhoo na hovai bakhase sabadh suhaavaniaa ||5||
127.e: Without You, Lord, nothing happens at all. You forgive those who are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad. ||5||

127.g: ਉਪਜੈ ਪਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
127.t: aupajai pachai har boojhai naahee ||
127.e: They are born, and they die, but they do not understand the Lord.

127.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
127.t: anadhin dhoojai bhai firaahee ||
127.e: Night and day, they wander, in love with duality.

127.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
127.t: manmukh janam giaa hai birathaa a(n)t giaa pachhutaavaniaa ||6||
127.e: The lives of the self-willed manmukhs are useless; in the end, they die, regretting and repenting. ||6||

127.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਏ ॥
127.t: pir paradhes sigaar banaae ||
127.e: The Husband is away, and the wife is getting dressed up.

127.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁ ਐਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
127.t: manmukh a(n)dh aaise karam kamaae ||
127.e: This is what the blind, self-willed manmukhs are doing.

127.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
127.t: halat na sobhaa palat na ddoiee birathaa janam gavaavaniaa ||7||
127.e: They are not honored in this world, and they shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. They are wasting their lives in vain. ||7||

127.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
127.t: har kaa naam kinai viralai jaataa ||
127.e: How rare are those who know the Name of the Lord!

127.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
127.t: poore gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||
127.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, the Lord is realized.

127.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
127.t: anadhin bhagat kare dhin raatee sahaje hee sukh paavaniaa ||8||
127.e: Night and day, they perform the Lord's devotional service; day and night, they find intuitive peace. ||8||

127.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
127.t: sabh meh varatai eko soiee ||
127.e: That One Lord is pervading in all.

127.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
127.t: gurmukh viralaa boojhai koiee ||
127.e: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

127.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੯॥੨੯॥੩੦॥
127.t: naanak naam rate jan soheh kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa ||9||29||30||
127.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are beautiful. Granting His Grace, God unites them with Himself. ||9||29||30||

128.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
128.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
128.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

128.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
128.t: manmukh paReh pa(n)ddit kahaaveh ||
128.e: The self-willed manmukhs read and recite; they are called Pandits-spiritual scholars.

128.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
128.t: dhoojai bhai mahaa dhukh paaveh ||
128.e: But they are in love with duality, and they suffer in terrible pain.

128.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
128.t: bikhiaa maate kichh soojhai naahee fir fir joonee aavaniaa ||1||
128.e: Intoxicated with vice, they understand nothing at all. They are reincarnated, over and over again. ||1||

128.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
128.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree haumai maar milaavaniaa ||
128.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who subdue their ego, and unite with the Lord.

128.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
128.t: gur sevaa te har man vasiaa har ras sahaj peeaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
128.e: They serve the Guru, and the Lord dwells within their minds; they intuitively drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

128.g: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
128.t: vedh paReh har ras nahee aaiaa ||
128.e: The Pandits read the Vedas, but they do not obtain the Lord's essence.

128.g: ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
128.t: vaadh vakhaaneh mohe maiaa ||
128.e: Intoxicated with Maya, they argue and debate.

128.g: ਅਗਿਆਨਮਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
128.t: agiaanamatee sadhaa a(n)dhiaaraa gurmukh boojh har gaavaniaa ||2||
128.e: The foolish intellectuals are forever in spiritual darkness. The Gurmukhs understand, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

128.g: ਅਕਥੋ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
128.t: akatho katheeaai sabadh suhaavai ||
128.e: The Indescribable is described only through the beauteous Word of the Shabad.

128.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
128.t: gurmatee man sacho bhaavai ||
128.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Truth becomes pleasing to the mind.

128.g: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
128.t: sacho sach raveh dhin raatee ih man sach ra(n)gaavaniaa ||3||
128.e: Those who speak of the truest of the true, day and night-their minds are imbued with the Truth. ||3||

128.g: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
128.t: jo sach rate tin sacho bhaavai ||
128.e: Those who are attuned to Truth, love the Truth.

128.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥
128.t: aape dhei na pachhotaavai ||
128.e: The Lord Himself bestows this gift; He shall not take it back.

128.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
128.t: gur kai sabadh sadhaa sach jaataa mil sache sukh paavaniaa ||4||
128.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the True Lord is known forever; meeting the True One, peace is found. ||4||

128.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
128.t: kooR kusat tinaa mail na laagai || gur parasaadhee anadhin jaagai ||
128.e: The filth of fraud and falsehood does not stick to those who, by Guru's Grace, remain awake and aware, night and day.

128.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
128.t: niramal naam vasai ghaT bheetar jotee jot milaavaniaa ||5||
128.e: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; their light merges into the Light. ||5||

128.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
128.t: trai gun paReh har tat na jaaneh ||
128.e: They read about the three qualities, but they do not know the essential reality of the Lord.

128.g: ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
128.t: moolahu bhule gur sabadh na pachhaaneh ||
128.e: They forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all, and they do not recognize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

128.g: ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
128.t: moh biaape kichh soojhai naahee gur sabadhee har paavaniaa ||6||
128.e: They are engrossed in emotional attachment; they do not understand anything at all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is found. ||6||

128.g: ਵੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
128.t: vedh pukaarai tirabidh maiaa ||
128.e: The Vedas proclaim that Maya is of three qualities.

128.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
128.t: manmukh na boojheh dhoojai bhaiaa ||
128.e: The self-willed manmukhs, in love with duality, do not understand.

128.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
128.t: trai gun paReh har ek na jaaneh bin boojhe dhukh paavaniaa ||7||
128.e: They read of the three qualities, but they do not know the One Lord. Without understanding, they obtain only pain and suffering. ||7||

128.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
128.t: jaa tis bhaavai taa aap milaae ||
128.e: When it pleases the Lord, He unites us with Himself.

128.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
128.t: gur sabadhee sahasaa dhookh chukaae ||
128.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, skepticism and suffering are dispelled.

128.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੦॥੩੧॥
128.t: naanak naavai kee sachee vaddiaaiee naamo ma(n)n sukh paavaniaa ||8||30||31||
128.e: O Nanak, True is the Greatness of the Name. Believing in the Name, peace is obtained. ||8||30||31||

128.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
128.t: maajh mahalaa teejaa ||
128.e: Maajh, Third Mehla:

128.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
128.t: niragun saragun aape soiee ||
128.e: The Lord Himself is Unmanifest and Unrelated; He is Manifest and Related as well.

128.g: ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
128.t: tat pachhaanai so pa(n)ddit hoiee ||
128.e: Those who recognize this essential reality are the true Pandits, the spiritual scholars.

128.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
128.t: aap tarai sagale kul taarai har naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
128.e: They save themselves, and save all their families and ancestors as well, when they enshrine the Lord's Name in the mind. ||1||

128.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
128.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree har ras chakh saadh paavaniaa ||
128.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who taste the essence of the Lord, and savor its taste.

128.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
128.t: har ras chaakheh se jan niramal niramal naam dhiaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
128.e: Those who taste this essence of the Lord are the pure, immaculate beings. They meditate on the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

128.g: ਸੋ ਨਿਹਕਰਮੀ ਜੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
128.t: so nihakaramee jo sabadh beechaare ||
128.e: Those who reflect upon the Shabad are beyond karma.

128.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
128.t: a(n)tar tat giaan haumai maare ||
128.e: They subdue their ego, and find the essence of wisdom, deep within their being.

128.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
128.t: naam padhaarath nau nidh paae trai gun meT samaavaniaa ||2||
128.e: They obtain the nine treasures of the wealth of the Naam. Rising above the three qualities, they merge into the Lord. ||2||

128.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਹਕਰਮੀ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
128.t: haumai karai nihakaramee na hovai ||
128.e: Those who act in ego do not go beyond karma.

128.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
128.t: gur parasaadhee haumai khovai ||
128.e: It is only by Guru's Grace that one is rid of ego.

128.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
128.t: a(n)tar bibek sadhaa aap veechaare gur sabadhee gun gaavaniaa ||3||
128.e: Those who have discriminating minds, continually examine their own selves. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they sing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||3||

128.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਈ ॥ ਸੰਤ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
128.t: har sar saagar niramal soiee || sa(n)t chugeh nit gurmukh hoiee ||
128.e: The Lord is the most pure and sublime Ocean. The Saintly Gurmukhs continually peck at the Naam, like swans pecking at pearls in the ocean.

128.g: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
128.t: eisanaan kareh sadhaa dhin raatee haumai mail chukaavaniaa ||4||
128.e: They bathe in it continually, day and night, and the filth of ego is washed away. ||4||

128.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
128.t: niramal ha(n)saa prem piaar || har sar vasai haumai maar ||
128.e: The pure swans, with love and affection, dwell in the Ocean of the Lord, and subdue their ego.

129.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
129.t: ahinis preet sabadh saachai har sar vaasaa paavaniaa ||5||
129.e: Day and night, they are in love with the True Word of the Shabad. They obtain their home in the Ocean of the Lord. ||5||

129.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਗੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
129.t: manmukh sadhaa bag mailaa haumai mal laiee ||
129.e: The self-willed manmukhs shall always be filthy cranes, smeared with the filth of ego.

129.g: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਪਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
129.t: eisanaan karai par mail na jaiee ||
129.e: They may bathe, but their filth is not removed.

129.g: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
129.t: jeevat marai gur sabadh beechaarai haumai mail chukaavaniaa ||6||
129.e: One who dies while yet alive, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is rid of this filth of ego. ||6||
The Priceless Jewel is found, in the home of one's own being,
when one listens to the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect True Guru.

129.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
129.t: gur parasaadh miTiaa a(n)dhiaaraa ghaT chaanan aap pachhaananiaa ||7||
129.e: By Guru's Grace, the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled; I have come to recognize the Divine Light within my own heart. ||7||
The Lord Himself creates, and He Himself beholds.
Serving the True Guru, one becomes acceptable.

129.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩੧॥੩੨॥
129.t: naanak naam vasai ghaT a(n)tar gur kirapaa te paavaniaa ||8||31||32||
129.e: O Nanak, the Naam dwells deep within the heart; by Guru's Grace, it is obtained. ||8||31||32||
Maajh, Third Mehla:
The whole world is engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.
Those who are controlled by the three qualities are attached to Maya.

129.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
129.t: gur parasaadhee ko viralaa boojhai chauthai padh liv laavaniaa ||1||
129.e: By Guru's Grace, a few come to understand; they center their consciousness in the fourth state. ||1||

129.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
129.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree maiaa moh sabadh jalaavaniaa ||
129.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who burn away their emotional attachment to Maya, through the Shabad.

129.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
129.t: maiaa moh jalaae so har siau chit laae har dhar mahalee sobhaa paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
129.e: Those who burn away this attachment to Maya, and focus their consciousness on the Lord are honored in the True Court, and the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||
The source, the root, of the gods and goddesses is Maya.
For them, the Simritees and the Shaastras were composed.

129.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
129.t: kaam karodh pasariaa sa(n)saare aai jai dhukh paavaniaa ||2||
129.e: Sexual desire and anger are diffused throughout the universe. Coming and going, people suffer in pain. ||2||

129.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
129.t: tis vich giaan ratan ik paiaa ||
129.e: The jewel of spiritual wisdom was placed within the universe.
By Guru's Grace, it is enshrined within the mind.

129.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
129.t: jat sat sa(n)jam sach kamaavai gur poorai naam dhiaavaniaa ||3||
129.e: Celibacy, chastity, self-discipline and the practice of truthfulness are obtained from the Perfect Guru, by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
In this world of her parents' home, the soul-bride has been deluded by doubt.
Attached to duality, she later comes to regret it.

129.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਦੋਵੈ ਗਵਾਏ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
129.t: halat palat dhovai gavaae supanai sukh na paavaniaa ||4||
129.e: She forfeits both this world and the next, and even in her dreams, she does not find peace. ||4||
The soul-bride who remembers her Husband Lord in this world,
by Guru's Grace, sees Him close at hand.

129.g: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
129.t: pir kai sahaj rahai ra(n)g raatee sabadh si(n)gaar banaavaniaa ||5||
129.e: She remains intuitively attuned to the Love of her Beloved; she makes the Word of His Shabad her decoration. ||5||
Blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who find the True Guru;
through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they burn their love of duality.

129.g: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
129.t: eko rav rahiaa ghaT a(n)tar mil satasa(n)gat har gun gaavaniaa ||6||
129.e: The One Lord is permeating and pervading deep within the heart. Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||6||

129.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥
129.t: satigur na seve so kaahe aaiaa ||
129.e: Those who do not serve the True Guru-why did they even come into this world?
Cursed are their lives; they have uselessly wasted this human life.

129.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
129.t: manmukh naam chit na aavai bin naavai bahu dhukh paavaniaa ||7||
129.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not remember the Naam. Without the Naam, they suffer in terrible pain. ||7||
The One who created the Universe, He alone knows it.
He unites with Himself those who realize the Shabad.

129.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੨॥੩੩॥
129.t: naanak naam miliaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaavaniaa ||8||1||32||33||
129.e: O Nanak, they alone receive the Naam, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is recorded. ||8||1||32||33||
Maajh, Fourth Mehla:
The Primal Being is Himself remote and beyond.
He Himself establishes, and having established, He disestablishes.

129.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
129.t: sabh meh varatai eko soiee gurmukh sobhaa paavaniaa ||1||
129.e: The One Lord is pervading in all; those who become Gurmukh are honored. ||1||

129.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
129.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree nira(n)kaaree naam dhiaavaniaa ||
129.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.

130.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
130.t: tis roop na rekhiaa ghaT ghaT dhekhiaa gurmukh alakh lakhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
130.e: He has no form or shape; He is seen within each and every heart. The Gurmukh comes to know the unknowable. ||1||Pause||
You are God, Kind and Merciful.

130.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
130.t: tudh bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
130.e: Without You, there is no other at all.

130.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
130.t: gur parasaadh kare naam dhevai naame naam samaavaniaa ||2||
130.e: When the Guru showers His Grace upon us, He blesses us with the Naam; through the Naam, we merge in the Naam. ||2||
You Yourself are the True Creator Lord.
Your treasures are overflowing with devotional worship.

130.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
130.t: gurmukh naam milai man bheejai sahaj samaadh lagaavaniaa ||3||
130.e: The Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. Their minds are enraptured, and they easily and intuitively enter into Samaadhi. ||3||
Night and day, I sing Your Glorious Praises, God.
I praise You, O my Beloved.

130.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
130.t: tudh bin avar na koiee jaachaa gur parasaadhee too(n) paavaniaa ||4||
130.e: Without You, there is no other for me to seek out. It is only by Guru's Grace that You are found. ||4||
The limits of the Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord cannot be found.

130.g: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
130.t: apanee kirapaa kareh too(n) laih milaiee ||
130.e: Bestowing Your Mercy, You merge us into Yourself.

130.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
130.t: poore gur kai sabadh dhiaaieeaai sabadh sev sukh paavaniaa ||5||
130.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Lord. Serving the Shabad, peace is found. ||5||
Praiseworthy is the tongue which sings the Lord's Glorious Praises.
Praising the Naam, one becomes pleasing to the True One.

130.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਚੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
130.t: gurmukh sadhaa rahai ra(n)g raatee mil sache sobhaa paavaniaa ||6||
130.e: The Gurmukh remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love. Meeting the True Lord, glory is obtained. ||6||
The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego.
They lose their whole lives in the gamble.

130.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
130.t: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa fir fir aavan jaavaniaa ||7||
130.e: Within is the terrible darkness of greed, and so they come and go in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

130.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
130.t: aape karataa dhe vaddiaaiee || jin kau aap likhat dhur paiee ||
130.e: The Creator Himself bestows Glory on those whom He Himself has so pre-destined.

130.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੪॥
130.t: naanak naam milai bhau bha(n)jan gur sabadhee sukh paavaniaa ||8||1||34||
130.e: O Nanak, they receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Destroyer of fear; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they find peace. ||8||1||34||
Maajh, Fifth Mehla, First House:
The Unseen Lord is within, but He cannot be seen.
He has taken the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and He keeps it well concealed.

130.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
130.t: agam agochar sabh te uoochaa gur kai sabadh lakhaavaniaa ||1||
130.e: The Inaccessible and Incomprehensible Lord is the highest of all. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known. ||1||

130.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
130.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree kal meh naam sunaavaniaa ||
130.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who chant the Naam, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

130.g: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਧਾਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
130.t: sa(n)t piaare sachai dhaare vaddabhaagee dharasan paavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
130.e: The Beloved Saints were established by the True Lord. By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of their Darshan is obtained. ||1||Pause||
The One who is sought by the Siddhas and the seekers,
upon whom Brahma and Indra meditate within their hearts,

130.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸਾ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
130.t: koT teteesaa khojeh taa kau gur mil hiradhai gaavaniaa ||2||
130.e: whom the three hundred thirty million demi-gods search for-meeting the Guru, one comes to sing His Praises within the heart. ||2||
Twenty-four hours a day, the wind breathes Your Name.
The earth is Your servant, a slave at Your Feet.

130.g: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
130.t: khaanee baanee sarab nivaasee sabhanaa kai man bhaavaniaa ||3||
130.e: In the four sources of creation, and in all speech, You dwell. You are dear to the minds of all. ||3||
The True Lord and Master is known to the Gurmukhs.
He is realized through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru.

130.g: ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਅਘਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
130.t: jin peeaa seiee tirapataase sache sach aghaavaniaa ||4||
130.e: Those who drink it in are satisfied. Through the Truest of the True, they are fulfilled. ||4||
In the home of their own beings, they are peacefully and comfortably at ease.
They are blissful, enjoying pleasures, and eternally joyful.

130.g: ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
130.t: so dhanava(n)taa so vadd saahaa jo gur charanee man laavaniaa ||5||
130.e: They are wealthy, and the greatest kings; they center their minds on the Guru's Feet. ||5||
First, You created nourishment;
then, You created the living beings.

130.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
130.t: tudh jevadd dhaataa avar na suaamee lavai na koiee laavaniaa ||6||
130.e: There is no other Giver as Great as You, O my Lord and Master. None approach or equal You. ||6||

130.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
130.t: jis too(n) tuThaa so tudh dhiaae ||
130.e: Those who are pleasing to You meditate on You.
They practice the Mantra of the Holy.

130.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
130.t: aap tarai sagale kul taare tis dharageh Thaak na paavaniaa ||7||
130.e: They themselves swim across, and they save all their ancestors and families as well. In the Court of the Lord, they meet with no obstruction. ||7||

131.g: ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਤੂੰ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
131.t: too(n) vaddaa too(n) uoocho uoochaa ||
131.e: You are so Great! You are the Highest of the High!

131.g: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੂਚੋ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
131.t: too(n) bea(n)t at moocho moochaa ||
131.e: You are Infinite, You are Everything!

131.g: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੫॥
131.t: hau kurabaanee terai va(n)n(j)aa naanak dhaas dhasaavaniaa ||8||1||35||
131.e: I am a sacrifice to You. Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||8||1||35||

131.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
131.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
131.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
131.t: kaunu su mukataa kaunu su jugataa ||
131.e: Who is liberated, and who is united?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
131.t: kaunu su giaanee kaunu su bakataa ||
131.e: Who is a spiritual teacher, and who is a preacher?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
131.t: kaunu su girahee kaun udhaasee kaunu su keemat paae jeeau ||1||
131.e: Who is a house-holder, and who is a renunciate? Who can estimate the Lord's Value? ||1||

131.g: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
131.t: kin bidh baadhaa kin bidh chhooTaa ||
131.e: How is one bound, and how is one freed of his bonds?

131.g: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
131.t: kin bidh aavan jaavan tooTaa ||
131.e: How can one escape from the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation?

131.g: ਕਉਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਉਣ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
131.t: kaun karam kaun nihakaramaa kaunu su kahai kahaae jeeau ||2||
131.e: Who is subject to karma, and who is beyond karma? Who chants the Name, and inspires others to chant it? ||2||

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
131.t: kaunu su sukheeaa kaunu su dhukheeaa ||
131.e: Who is happy, and who is sad?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
131.t: kaunu su sanamukh kaun vemukheeaa ||
131.e: Who, as sunmukh, turns toward the Guru, and who, as vaymukh, turns away from the Guru?

131.g: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
131.t: kin bidh mileeaai kin bidh bichhurai ieh bidh kaun pragaTaae jeeau ||3||
131.e: How can one meet the Lord? How is one separated from Him? Who can reveal the way to me? ||3||

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
131.t: kaunu su akhar jit dhaavat rahataa ||
131.e: What is that Word, by which the wandering mind can be restrained?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
131.t: kaun upadhes jit dhukh sukh sam sahataa ||
131.e: What are those teachings, by which we may endure pain and pleasure alike?

131.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
131.t: kaunu su chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae kin bidh keeratan gaae jeeau ||4||
131.e: What is that lifestyle, by which we may come to meditate on the Supreme Lord? How may we sing the Kirtan of His Praises? ||4||

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
131.t: gurmukh mukataa gurmukh jugataa ||
131.e: The Gurmukh is liberated, and the Gurmukh is linked.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
131.t: gurmukh giaanee gurmukh bakataa ||
131.e: The Gurmukh is the spiritual teacher, and the Gurmukh is the preacher.

131.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
131.t: dha(n)n girahee udhaasee gurmukh gurmukh keemat paae jeeau ||5||
131.e: Blessed is the Gurmukh, the householder and the renunciate. The Gurmukh knows the Lord's Value. ||5||

131.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
131.t: haumai baadhaa gurmukh chhooTaa ||
131.e: Egotism is bondage; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
131.t: gurmukh aavan jaavan tooTaa ||
131.e: The Gurmukh escapes the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
131.t: gurmukh karam gurmukh nihakaramaa gurmukh kare su subhaae jeeau ||6||
131.e: The Gurmukh performs actions of good karma, and the Gurmukh is beyond karma. Whatever the Gurmukh does, is done in good faith. ||6||

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
131.t: gurmukh sukheeaa manmukh dhukheeaa ||
131.e: The Gurmukh is happy, while the self-willed manmukh is sad.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
131.t: gurmukh sanamukh manmukh vemukheeaa ||
131.e: The Gurmukh turns toward the Guru, and the self-willed manmukh turns away from the Guru.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
131.t: gurmukh mileeaai manmukh vichhurai gurmukh bidh pragaTaae jeeau ||7||
131.e: The Gurmukh is united with the Lord, while the manmukh is separated from Him. The Gurmukh reveals the way. ||7||

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
131.t: gurmukh akhar jit dhaavat rahataa ||
131.e: The Guru's Instruction is the Word, by which the wandering mind is restrained.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
131.t: gurmukh upadhes dhukh sukh sam sahataa ||
131.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, we can endure pain and pleasure alike.

131.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
131.t: gurmukh chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae gurmukh keeratan gaae jeeau ||8||
131.e: To live as Gurmukh is the lifestyle by which we come to meditate on the Supreme Lord. The Gurmukh sings the Kirtan of His Praises. ||8||

131.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਆਪੇ ॥
131.t: sagalee banat banaiee aape ||
131.e: The Lord Himself created the entire creation.

131.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
131.t: aape kare karaae thaape ||
131.e: He Himself acts, and causes others to act. He Himself establishes.

131.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥੨॥੩੬॥
131.t: eikas te hoio ana(n)taa naanak ekas maeh samaae jeeau ||9||2||36||
131.e: From oneness, He has brought forth the countless multitudes. O Nanak, they shall merge into the One once again. ||9||2||36||

131.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
131.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ||
131.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla:

131.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
131.t: prabh abinaasee taa kiaa kaaRaa ||
131.e: God is Eternal and Imperishable, so why should anyone be anxious?

131.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
131.t: har bhagava(n)taa taa jan kharaa sukhaalaa ||
131.e: The Lord is Wealthy and Prosperous, so His humble servant should feel totally secure.

131.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
131.t: jeea praan maan sukhadhaataa too(n) kareh soiee sukh paavaniaa ||1||
131.e: O Giver of peace of the soul, of life, of honor-as You ordain, I obtain peace. ||1||

131.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
131.t: hau vaaree jeeau vaaree gurmukh man tan bhaavaniaa ||
131.e: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that Gurmukh whose mind and body are pleased with You.

131.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
131.t: too(n) meraa parabat too(n) meraa olaa tum sa(n)g lavai na laavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
131.e: You are my mountain, You are my shelter and shield. No one can rival You. ||1||Pause||

131.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
131.t: teraa keetaa jis laagai meeThaa ||
131.e: That person, unto whom Your actions seem sweet,

131.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
131.t: ghaT ghaT paarabraham tin jan ddeeThaa ||
131.e: comes to see the Supreme Lord God in each and every heart.

131.g: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
131.t: thaan thana(n)tar too(n)hai too(n)hai iko ik varataavaniaa ||2||
131.e: In all places and interspaces, You exist. You are the One and Only Lord, pervading everywhere. ||2||

131.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
131.t: sagal manorath too(n) dhevanahaaraa ||
131.e: You are the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires.

131.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
131.t: bhagatee bhai bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
131.e: Your treasures are overflowing with love and devotion.

131.g: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
131.t: dhiaa dhaar raakhe tudh seiee poorai karam samaavaniaa ||3||
131.e: Showering Your Mercy, You protect those who, through perfect destiny, merge into You. ||3||

132.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕੰਢੈ ਚਾੜੇ ॥
132.t: a(n)dh koop te ka(n)ddai chaaRe ||
132.e: You pulled me out of the deep, dark well onto the dry ground.

132.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਾਸ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
132.t: kar kirapaa dhaas nadhar nihaale ||
132.e: Showering Your Mercy, You blessed Your servant with Your Glance of Grace.

132.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
132.t: gun gaaveh pooran abinaasee keh sun toT na aavaniaa ||4||
132.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Immortal Lord. By speaking and hearing these Praises, they are not used up. ||4||

132.g: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
132.t: aaithai othai too(n)hai rakhavaalaa ||
132.e: Here and hereafter, You are our Protector.

132.g: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
132.t: maat garabh meh tum hee paalaa ||
132.e: In the womb of the mother, You cherish and nurture the baby.

132.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
132.t: maiaa agan na pohai tin kau ra(n)g rate gun gaavaniaa ||5||
132.e: The fire of Maya does not affect those who are imbued with the Lord's Love; they sing His Glorious Praises. ||5||

132.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
132.t: kiaa gun tere aakh samaalee ||
132.e: What Praises of Yours can I chant and contemplate?

132.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
132.t: man tan a(n)tar tudh nadhar nihaalee ||
132.e: Deep within my mind and body, I behold Your Presence.

132.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
132.t: too(n) meraa meet saajan meraa suaamee tudh bin avar na jaananiaa ||6||
132.e: You are my Friend and Companion, my Lord and Master. Without You, I do not know any other at all. ||6||

132.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
132.t: jis kau too(n) prabh bhiaa sahaiee ||
132.e: O God, that one, unto whom You have given shelter,

132.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
132.t: tis tatee vaau na lagai kaiee ||
132.e: is not touched by the hot winds.

132.g: ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
132.t: too saahib saran sukhadhaataa satasa(n)gat jap pragaTaavaniaa ||7||
132.e: O my Lord and Master, You are my Sanctuary, the Giver of peace. Chanting, meditating on You in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, You are revealed. ||7||

132.g: ਤੂੰ ਊਚ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
132.t: too(n) uooch athaahu apaar amolaa ||
132.e: You are Exalted, Unfathomable, Infinite and Invaluable.

132.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੋਲਾ ॥
132.t: too(n) saachaa saahib dhaas teraa golaa ||
132.e: You are my True Lord and Master. I am Your servant and slave.

132.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੩੭॥
132.t: too(n) meeraa saachee Thakuraiee naanak bal bal jaavaniaa ||8||3||37||
132.e: You are the King, Your Sovereign Rule is True. Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||8||3||37||

132.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
132.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa ||
132.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

132.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਦਯੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
132.t: nit nit dhay samaaleeaai ||
132.e: Continually, continuously, remember the Merciful Lord.

132.g: ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
132.t: mool na manahu visaareeaai || rahaau ||
132.e: Never forget Him from your mind. ||Pause||

132.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
132.t: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat paieeaai ||
132.e: Join the Society of the Saints,

132.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪੰਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
132.t: jit jam kai pa(n)th na jaieeaai ||
132.e: and you shall not have to go down the path of Death.

132.g: ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੁਲਹਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
132.t: tosaa har kaa naam lai tere kuleh na laagai gaal jeeau ||1||
132.e: Take the Provisions of the Lord's Name with you, and no stain shall attach itself to your family. ||1||

132.g: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੰਦੇ ਸਾਂਈਐ ॥
132.t: jo simara(n)dhe saa(n)ieeaai ||
132.e: Those who meditate on the Master

132.g: ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਸੇਈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
132.t: narak na seiee paieeaai ||
132.e: shall not be thrown down into hell.

132.g: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
132.t: tatee vaau na lagiee jin man vuThaa aai jeeau ||2||
132.e: Even the hot winds shall not touch them. The Lord has come to dwell within their minds. ||2||

132.g: ਸੇਈ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਣੇ ॥
132.t: seiee su(n)dhar sohane ||
132.e: They alone are beautiful and attractive,

132.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਨ ਬੈਹਣੇ ॥
132.t: saadhasa(n)g jin baihane ||
132.e: who abide in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

132.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੰਜਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
132.t: har dhan jinee sa(n)jiaa seiee ga(n)bheer apaar jeeau ||3||
132.e: Those who have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name-they alone are deep and thoughtful and vast. ||3||

132.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਪੀਵੀਐ ॥
132.t: har amiau rasain peeveeaai ||
132.e: Drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name,

132.g: ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਵੀਐ ॥
132.t: muh ddiThai jan kai jeeveeaai ||
132.e: and live by beholding the face of the Lord's servant.

132.g: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਵ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
132.t: kaaraj sabh savaar lai nit poojahu gur ke paav jeeau ||4||
132.e: Let all your affairs be resolved, by continually worshipping the Feet of the Guru. ||4||

132.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ॥ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਜਾਪਣਾ ॥
132.t: jo har keetaa aapanaa || tineh gusaiee jaapanaa ||
132.e: He alone meditates on the Lord of the World, whom the Lord has made His Own.

132.g: ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
132.t: so sooraa paradhaan so masatak jis dhai bhaag jeeau ||5||
132.e: He alone is a warrior, and he alone is the chosen one, upon whose forehead good destiny is recorded. ||5||

132.g: ਮਨ ਮੰਧੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਗਾਹੀਆ ॥
132.t: man ma(n)dhe prabh avagaaheeaa ||
132.e: Within my mind, I meditate on God.

132.g: ਏਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ॥
132.t: eh ras bhogan paatisaaheeaa ||
132.e: For me, this is like the enjoyment of princely pleasures.

132.g: ਮੰਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਤਰੇ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
132.t: ma(n)dhaa mool na upajio tare sachee kaarai laag jeeau ||6||
132.e: Evil does not well up within me, since I am saved, and dedicated to truthful actions. ||6||

132.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
132.t: karataa ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
132.e: I have enshrined the Creator within my mind;

132.g: ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
132.t: janamai kaa fal paiaa ||
132.e: I have obtained the fruits of life's rewards.

132.g: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
132.t: man bhaava(n)dhaa ka(n)t har teraa thir hoaa sohaag jeeau ||7||
132.e: If your Husband Lord is pleasing to your mind, then your married life shall be eternal. ||7||

132.g: ਅਟਲ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
132.t: aTal padhaarath paiaa ||
132.e: I have obtained everlasting wealth;

132.g: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥
132.t: bhai bha(n)jan kee saranaiaa ||
132.e: I have found the Sanctuary of the Dispeller of fear.

132.g: ਲਾਇ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੪॥੩੮॥
132.t: lai a(n)chal naanak taarian jitaa janam apaar jeeau ||8||4||38||
132.e: Grasping hold of the hem of the Lord's robe, Nanak is saved. He has won the incomparable life. ||8||4||38||

132.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
132.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
132.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

132.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
132.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa ||
132.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

132.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
132.t: har jap jape man dheere ||1|| rahaau ||
132.e: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, the mind is held steady. ||1||Pause||

132.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਭੈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
132.t: simar simar gurdheau miT ge bhai dhoore ||1||
132.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Divine Guru, one's fears are erased and dispelled. ||1||

132.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਝੂਰੇ ॥੨॥
132.t: saran aavai paarabraham kee taa fir kaahe jhoore ||2||
132.e: Entering the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God, how could anyone feel grief any longer? ||2||

133.g: ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੩॥
133.t: charan sev sa(n)t saadh ke sagal manorath poore ||3||
133.e: Serving at the Feet of the Holy Saints, all desires are fulfilled. ||3||

133.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੪॥
133.t: ghaT ghaT ek varatadhaa jal thal maheeal poore ||4||
133.e: In each and every heart, the One Lord is pervading. He is totally permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||4||

133.g: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੫॥
133.t: paap binaasan seviaa pavitr sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||5||
133.e: I serve the Destroyer of sin, and I am sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||

133.g: ਸਭ ਛਡਾਈ ਖਸਮਿ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਠਰੂਰੇ ॥੬॥
133.t: sabh chhaddaiee khasam aap har jap bhiee Tharoore ||6||
133.e: My Lord and Master Himself has saved me completely; I am comforted by meditating on the Lord. ||6||

133.g: ਕਰਤੈ ਕੀਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
133.t: karatai keeaa tapaavaso dhusaT mue hoi moore ||7||
133.e: The Creator has passed judgement, and the evil-doers have been silenced and killed. ||7||

133.t: naanak rataa sach nai har vekhai sadhaa hajoore ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||
133.e: Nanak is attuned to the True Name; he beholds the Presence of the Ever-present Lord. ||8||5||39||1||32||1||5||39||

133.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਂਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
133.t: baareh maahaa maa(n)jh mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
133.e: Baarah Maahaa ~ The Twelve Months: Maajh, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

133.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
133.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
133.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

133.g: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਵੀਛੁੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
133.t: kirat karam ke veechhuRe kar kirapaa melahu raam ||
133.e: By the actions we have committed, we are separated from You. Please show Your Mercy, and unite us with Yourself, Lord.

133.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਥਕਿ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
133.t: chaar ku(n)T dheh dhis bhrame thak aae prabh kee saam ||
133.e: We have grown weary of wandering to the four corners of the earth and in the ten directions. We have come to Your Sanctuary, God.

133.g: ਧੇਨੁ ਦੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥
133.t: dhen dhudhai te baaharee kitai na aavai kaam ||
133.e: Without milk, a cow serves no purpose.

133.g: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਖ ਕੁਮਲਾਵਤੀ ਉਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਮ ॥
133.t: jal bin saakh kumalaavatee upajeh naahee dhaam ||
133.e: Without water, the crop withers, and it will not bring a good price.

133.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹ ਨ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸਾਜਨੈ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥
133.t: har naeh na mileeaai saajanai kat paieeaai bisaraam ||
133.e: If we do not meet the Lord, our Friend, how can we find our place of rest?

133.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਈ ਭਠਿ ਨਗਰ ਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
133.t: jit ghar har ka(n)t na pragaTiee bhaTh nagar se graam ||
133.e: Those homes, those hearts, in which the Husband Lord is not manifest-those towns and villages are like burning furnaces.

133.g: ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਸਣੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਮ ॥
133.t: srab seegaar ta(n)bol ras san dhehee sabh khaam ||
133.e: All decorations, the chewing of betel to sweeten the breath, and the body itself, are all useless and vain.

133.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ਮੀਤ ਸਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਮ ॥
133.t: prabh suaamee ka(n)t vihooneeaa meet sajan sabh jaam ||
133.e: Without God, our Husband, our Lord and Master, all friends and companions are like the Messenger of Death.

133.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
133.t: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa kar kirapaa dheejai naam ||
133.e: This is Nanak's prayer: ""Please show Your Mercy, and bestow Your Name.

133.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
133.t: har melahu suaamee sa(n)g prabh jis kaa nihachal dhaam ||1||
133.e: O my Lord and Master, please unite me with Yourself, O God, in the Eternal Mansion of Your Presence"". ||1||

133.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
133.t: chet govi(n)dh araadheeaai hovai ana(n)dh ghanaa ||
133.e: In the month of Chayt, by meditating on the Lord of the Universe, a deep and profound joy arises.

133.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਣਾ ॥
133.t: sa(n)t janaa mil paieeaai rasanaa naam bhanaa ||
133.e: Meeting with the humble Saints, the Lord is found, as we chant His Name with our tongues.

133.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਗਣਾ ॥
133.t: jin paiaa prabh aapanaa aae tiseh ganaa ||
133.e: Those who have found God-blessed is their coming into this world.

133.g: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਣਾ ॥
133.t: eik khin tis bin jeevanaa birathaa janam janaa ||
133.e: Those who live without Him, for even an instant-their lives are rendered useless.

133.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਰਵਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਣਾ ॥
133.t: jal thal maheeal pooriaa raviaa vich vanaa ||
133.e: The Lord is totally pervading the water, the land, and all space. He is contained in the forests as well.

133.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਤੜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਣਾ ॥
133.t: so prabh chit na aaviee kitaRaa dhukh ganaa ||
133.e: Those who do not remember God-how much pain must they suffer!

133.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਣਾ ॥
133.t: jinee raaviaa so prabhoo ti(n)naa bhaag manaa ||
133.e: Those who dwell upon their God have great good fortune.

133.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੰਉ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਾ ॥
133.t: har dharasan ka(n)au man lochadhaa naanak piaas manaa ||
133.e: My mind yearns for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. O Nanak, my mind is so thirsty!

133.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਾ ॥੨॥
133.t: chet milaae so prabhoo tis kai pai lagaa ||2||
133.e: I touch the feet of one who unites me with God in the month of Chayt. ||2||

133.g: ਵੈਸਾਖਿ ਧੀਰਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਵਾਢੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ॥
133.t: vaisaakh dheeran kiau vaaddeeaa jinaa prem bichhoh ||
133.e: In the month of Vaisaakh, how can the bride be patient? She is separated from her Beloved.

133.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
133.t: har saajan purakh visaar kai lagee maiaa dhoh ||
133.e: She has forgotten the Lord, her Life-companion, her Master; she has become attached to Maya, the deceitful one.

133.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਓਹੁ ॥
133.t: putr kalatr na sa(n)g dhanaa har avinaasee oh ||
133.e: Neither son, nor spouse, nor wealth shall go along with you-only the Eternal Lord.

133.g: ਪਲਚਿ ਪਲਚਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੁਈ ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਮੋਹੁ ॥
133.t: palach palach sagalee muiee jhooThai dha(n)dhai moh ||
133.e: Entangled and enmeshed in the love of false occupations, the whole world is perishing.

133.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਲਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਹਿ ॥
133.t: eikas har ke naam bin agai lie'eeh khoh ||
133.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the One Lord, they lose their lives in the hereafter.

133.g: ਦਯੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
133.t: dhay visaar viguchanaa prabh bin avar na koi ||
133.e: Forgetting the Merciful Lord, they are ruined. Without God, there is no other at all.

133.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
133.t: preetam charanee jo lage tin kee niramal soi ||
133.e: Pure is the reputation of those who are attached to the Feet of the Beloved Lord.

134.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
134.t: naanak kee prabh benatee prabh milahu paraapat hoi ||
134.e: Nanak makes this prayer to God: ""Please, come and unite me with Yourself.""

134.g: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਗੈ ਜਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
134.t: vaisaakh suhaavaa taa(n) lagai jaa sa(n)t bheTai har soi ||3||
134.e: The month of Vaisaakh is beautiful and pleasant, when the Saint causes me to meet the Lord. ||3||

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠਿ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵੰਨਿ ॥
134.t: har jeTh juRa(n)dhaa loReeaai jis agai sabh niva(n)n ||
134.e: In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humility before Him.

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਦਾਵਣਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
134.t: har sajan dhaavan lagiaa kisai na dheiee ba(n)n ||
134.e: One who has grasped the hem of the robe of the Lord, the True Friend-no one can keep him in bondage.

134.g: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਉਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
134.t: maanak motee naam prabh un lagai naahee sa(n)n ||
134.e: God's Name is the Jewel, the Pearl. It cannot be stolen or taken away.

134.g: ਰੰਗ ਸਭੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਨਿ ॥
134.t: ra(n)g sabhe naarainai jete man bhaava(n)n ||
134.e: In the Lord are all pleasures which please the mind.

134.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਅ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
134.t: jo har loRe so kare soiee jeea kara(n)n ||
134.e: As the Lord wishes, so He acts, and so His creatures act.

134.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਈ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥
134.t: jo prabh keete aapane seiee kahe'eeh dha(n)n ||
134.e: They alone are called blessed, whom God has made His Own.

134.g: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਰੋਵੰਨਿ ॥
134.t: aapan leeaa je milai vichhuR kiau rova(n)n ||
134.e: If people could meet the Lord by their own efforts, why would they be crying out in the pain of separation?

134.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੰਨਿ ॥
134.t: saadhoo sa(n)g paraapate naanak ra(n)g maana(n)n ||
134.e: Meeting Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, celestial bliss is enjoyed.

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
134.t: har jeTh ra(n)geelaa tis dhanee jis kai bhaag matha(n)n ||4||
134.e: In the month of Jayt'h, the playful Husband Lord meets her, upon whose forehead such good destiny is recorded. ||4||

134.g: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਤਪੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
134.t: aasaaR tapa(n)dhaa tis lagai har naahu na ji(n)naa paas ||
134.e: The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to their Husband Lord.

134.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਸੰਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
134.t: jagajeevan purakh tiaag kai maanas sa(n)dhee aas ||
134.e: They have forsaken God the Primal Being, the Life of the World, and they have come to rely upon mere mortals.

134.g: ਦੁਯੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਗਲਿ ਪਈਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
134.t: dhuyai bhai vigucheeaai gal piees jam kee faas ||
134.e: In the love of duality, the soul-bride is ruined; around her neck she wears the noose of Death.

134.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਮਥੈ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
134.t: jehaa beejai so lunai mathai jo likhiaas ||
134.e: As you plant, so shall you harvest; your destiny is recorded on your forehead.

134.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਗਈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
134.t: rain vihaanee pachhutaanee uTh chalee giee niraas ||
134.e: The life-night passes away, and in the end, one comes to regret and repent, and then depart with no hope at all.

134.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਾਧੂ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥
134.t: jin kau saadhoo bheTeeaai so dharageh hoi khalaas ||
134.e: Those who meet with the Holy Saints are liberated in the Court of the Lord.

134.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
134.t: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee tere dharasan hoi piaas ||
134.e: Show Your Mercy to me, O God; I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

134.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
134.t: prabh tudh bin dhoojaa ko nahee naanak kee aradhaas ||
134.e: Without You, God, there is no other at all. This is Nanak's humble prayer.

134.g: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੫॥
134.t: aasaaR suha(n)dhaa tis lagai jis man har charan nivaas ||5||
134.e: The month of Aasaarh is pleasant, when the Feet of the Lord abide in the mind. ||5||

134.g: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
134.t: saavan sarasee kaamanee charan kamal siau piaar ||
134.e: In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

134.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
134.t: man tan rataa sach ra(n)g iko naam adhaar ||
134.e: Her mind and body are imbued with the Love of the True One; His Name is her only Support.

134.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਕੂੜਾਵਿਆ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
134.t: bikhiaa ra(n)g kooRaaviaa dhisan sabhe chhaar ||
134.e: The pleasures of corruption are false. All that is seen shall turn to ashes.

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
134.t: har a(n)mirat boo(n)dh suhaavanee mil saadhoo peevanahaar ||
134.e: The drops of the Lord's Nectar are so beautiful! Meeting the Holy Saint, we drink these in.

134.g: ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
134.t: van tin prabh sa(n)g mauliaa sa(n)mrath purakh apaar ||
134.e: The forests and the meadows are rejuvenated and refreshed with the Love of God, the All-powerful, Infinite Primal Being.

134.g: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਨੋ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
134.t: har milanai no man lochadhaa karam milaavanahaar ||
134.e: My mind yearns to meet the Lord. If only He would show His Mercy, and unite me with Himself!

134.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
134.t: jinee sakhe'ee prabh paiaa ha(n)au tin kai sadh balihaar ||
134.e: Those brides who have obtained God-I am forever a sacrifice to them.

134.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
134.t: naanak har jee miaa kar sabadh savaaranahaar ||
134.e: O Nanak, when the Dear Lord shows kindness, He adorns His bride with the Word of His Shabad.

134.g: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
134.t: saavan tinaa suhaaganee jin raam naam ur haar ||6||
134.e: Saawan is delightful for those happy soul-brides whose hearts are adorned with the Necklace of the Lord's Name. ||6||

134.g: ਭਾਦੁਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
134.t: bhaadhui bharam bhulaaneeaa dhoojai lagaa het ||
134.e: In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment to duality.

134.g: ਲਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
134.t: lakh seegaar banaiaa kaaraj naahee ket ||
134.e: She may wear thousands of ornaments, but they are of no use at all.

134.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਸਸੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਕਹਸਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
134.t: jit dhin dheh binasasee tit velai kahasan pret ||
134.e: On that day when the body perishes-at that time, she becomes a ghost.

134.g: ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਨਿ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਨੀ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
134.t: pakaR chalain dhoot jam kisai na dhenee bhet ||
134.e: The Messenger of Death seizes and holds her, and does not tell anyone his secret.

134.g: ਛਡਿ ਖੜੋਤੇ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
134.t: chhadd khaRote khinai maeh jin siau lagaa het ||
134.e: And her loved ones-in an instant, they move on, leaving her all alone.

134.g: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਪੇ ਸਿਆਹਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਤੁ ॥
134.t: hath maroRai tan kape siaahahu hoaa set ||
134.e: She wrings her hands, her body writhes in pain, and she turns from black to white.

134.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਾ ਸੰਦੜਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
134.t: jehaa beejai so lunai karamaa sa(n)dhaRaa khet ||
134.e: As she has planted, so does she harvest; such is the field of karma.

134.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਤੁ ॥
134.t: naanak prabh saranaagatee charan bohith prabh dhet ||
134.e: Nanak seeks God's Sanctuary; God has given him the Boat of His Feet.

134.g: ਸੇ ਭਾਦੁਇ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੭॥
134.t: se bhaadhui narak na paie'eeh gur rakhan vaalaa het ||7||
134.e: Those who love the Guru, the Protector and Savior, in Bhaadon, shall not be thrown down into hell. ||7||

134.g: ਅਸੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਮਾਹੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
134.t: asun prem umaahaRaa kiau mileeaai har jai ||
134.e: In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord?

135.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਦਰਸਨ ਘਣੀ ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
135.t: man tan piaas dharasan ghanee koiee aan milaavai mai ||
135.e: My mind and body are so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Won't someone please come and lead me to him, O my mother.

135.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
135.t: sa(n)t sahaiee prem ke hau tin kai laagaa pai ||
135.e: The Saints are the helpers of the Lord's lovers; I fall and touch their feet.

135.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
135.t: vin prabh kiau sukh paieeaai dhoojee naahee jai ||
135.e: Without God, how can I find peace? There is nowhere else to go.

135.g: ਜਿੰਨੑੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
135.t: ji(n)n(h)ee chaakhiaa prem ras se tirapat rahe aaghai ||
135.e: Those who have tasted the sublime essence of His Love, remain satisfied and fulfilled.

135.g: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
135.t: aap tiaag binatee kareh leh prabhoo laR lai ||
135.e: They renounce their selfishness and conceit, and they pray, ""God, please attach me to the hem of Your robe.""

135.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ਸਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
135.t: jo har ka(n)t milaieeaa s vichhuR kateh na jai ||
135.e: Those whom the Husband Lord has united with Himself, shall not be separated from Him again.

135.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਿਣੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
135.t: prabh vin dhoojaa ko nahee naanak har saranai ||
135.e: Without God, there is no other at all. Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord.

135.g: ਅਸੂ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਸੰਦੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੮॥
135.t: asoo sukhee vasa(n)dheeaa jinaa miaa har rai ||8||
135.e: In Assu, the Lord, the Sovereign King, has granted His Mercy, and they dwell in peace. ||8||

135.g: ਕਤਿਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
135.t: katik karam kamaavane dhos na kaahoo jog ||
135.e: In the month of Katak, do good deeds. Do not try to blame anyone else.

135.g: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਤੇ ਭੁਲਿਆਂ ਵਿਆਪਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
135.t: paramesar te bhuliaa(n) viaapan sabhe rog ||
135.e: Forgetting the Transcendent Lord, all sorts of illnesses are contracted.

135.g: ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਲਗਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
135.t: vemukh hoe raam te lagan janam vijog ||
135.e: Those who turn their backs on the Lord shall be separated from Him and consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.

135.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਉੜੇ ਹੋਇ ਗਏ ਜਿਤੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੋਗ ॥
135.t: khin meh kauRe hoi ge jitaRe maiaa bhog ||
135.e: In an instant, all of Maya's sensual pleasures turn bitter.

135.g: ਵਿਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਥੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰੋਜ ॥
135.t: vich na koiee kar sakai kis thai roveh roj ||
135.e: No one can then serve as your intermediary. Unto whom can we turn and cry?

135.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
135.t: keetaa kichhoo na hoviee likhiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||
135.e: By one's own actions, nothing can be done; destiny was pre-determined from the very beginning.

135.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਓਗ ॥
135.t: vaddabhaagee meraa prabh milai taa(n) utareh sabh biog ||
135.e: By great good fortune, I meet my God, and then all pain of separation departs.

135.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥
135.t: naanak kau prabh raakh leh mere saahib ba(n)dhee moch ||
135.e: Please protect Nanak, God; O my Lord and Master, please release me from bondage.

135.g: ਕਤਿਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਸੋਚ ॥੯॥
135.t: katik hovai saadhasa(n)g binaseh sabhe soch ||9||
