135.e: In Katak, in the Company of the Holy, all anxiety vanishes. ||9||

135.g: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਠੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.t: ma(n)ghir maeh soha(n)dheeaa har pir sa(n)g baiThaReeaaeh ||
135.e: In the month of Maghar, those who sit with their Beloved Husband Lord are beautiful.

135.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਮੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.t: tin kee sobhaa kiaa ganee j saahib melaReeaaeh ||
135.e: How can their glory be measured? Their Lord and Master blends them with Himself.

135.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.t: tan man mauliaa raam siau sa(n)g saadh sahelaReeaaeh ||
135.e: Their bodies and minds blossom forth in the Lord; they have the companionship of the Holy Saints.

135.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸੇ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.t: saadh janaa te baaharee se rahan ikelaReeaaeh ||
135.e: Those who lack the Company of the Holy, remain all alone.

135.g: ਤਿਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੇ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.t: tin dhukh na kabahoo utarai se jam kai vas paReeaaeh ||
135.e: Their pain never departs, and they fall into the grip of the Messenger of Death.

135.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਖੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.t: jinee raaviaa prabh aapanaa se dhisan nit khaReeaaeh ||
135.e: Those who have ravished and enjoyed their God, are seen to be continually exalted and uplifted.

135.g: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.t: ratan javehar laal har ka(n)Th tinaa jaReeaaeh ||
135.e: They wear the Necklace of the jewels, emeralds and rubies of the Lord's Name.

135.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੀਆਹ ॥
135.t: naanak baa(n)chhai dhooR tin prabh saranee dhar paReeaaeh ||
135.e: Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Door.

135.g: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੜੀਆਹ ॥੧੦॥
135.t: ma(n)ghir prabh aaraadhanaa bahuR na janamaReeaaeh ||10||
135.e: Those who worship and adore God in Maghar, do not suffer the cycle of reincarnation ever again. ||10||

135.g: ਪੋਖਿ ਤੁਖਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
135.t: pokh tukhaar na viaapiee ka(n)Th miliaa har naahu ||
135.e: In the month of Poh, the cold does not touch those, whom the Husband Lord hugs close in His Embrace.

135.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਲਗੜਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
135.t: man bedhiaa charanaarabi(n)dh dharasan lagaRaa saahu ||
135.e: Their minds are transfixed by His Lotus Feet. They are attached to the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

135.g: ਓਟ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
135.t: oT govi(n)dh gopaal rai sevaa suaamee laahu ||
135.e: Seek the Protection of the Lord of the Universe; His service is truly profitable.

135.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹੁ ॥
135.t: bikhiaa poh na sakiee mil saadhoo gun gaahu ||
135.e: Corruption shall not touch you, when you join the Holy Saints and sing the Lord's Praises.

135.g: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥
135.t: jeh te upajee teh milee sachee preet samaahu ||
135.e: From where it originated, there the soul is blended again. It is absorbed in the Love of the True Lord.

135.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੀਆਹੁ ॥
135.t: kar geh leenee paarabraham bahuR na vichhuReeaahu ||
135.e: When the Supreme Lord God grasps someone's hand, he shall never again suffer separation from Him.

135.g: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬੇਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥
135.t: baar jaau lakh bereeaa har sajan agam agaahu ||
135.e: I am a sacrifice, 100,000 times, to the Lord, my Friend, the Unapproachable and Unfathomable.

135.g: ਸਰਮ ਪਈ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਈਆਹੁ ॥
135.t: saram piee naarainai naanak dhar pieeaahu ||
135.e: Please preserve my honor, Lord; Nanak begs at Your Door.

135.g: ਪੋਖੁ ਸੋੁਹੰਦਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧੧॥
135.t: pokh suoha(n)dhaa sarab sukh jis bakhase veparavaahu ||11||
135.e: Poh is beautiful, and all comforts come to that one, whom the Carefree Lord has forgiven. ||11||

135.g: ਮਾਘਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਧੂੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
135.t: maagh majan sa(n)g saadhooaa dhooRee kar isanaan ||
135.e: In the month of Maagh, let your cleansing bath be the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

135.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
135.t: har kaa naam dhiaai sun sabhanaa no kar dhaan ||
135.e: Meditate and listen to the Name of the Lord, and give it to everyone.

135.g: ਜਨਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
135.t: janam karam mal utarai man te jai gumaan ||
135.e: In this way, the filth of lifetimes of karma shall be removed, and egotistical pride shall vanish from your mind.

136.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਸੁਆਨੁ ॥
136.t: kaam karodh na moheeaai binasai lobh suaan ||
136.e: Sexual desire and anger shall not seduce you, and the dog of greed shall depart.

136.g: ਸਚੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
136.t: sachai maarag chaladhiaa usatat kare jahaan ||
136.e: Those who walk on the Path of Truth shall be praised throughout the world.

136.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਗਲ ਪੁੰਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
136.t: aThasaTh teerath sagal pu(n)n jeea dhiaa paravaan ||
136.e: Be kind to all beings-this is more meritorious than bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage and the giving of charity.

136.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
136.t: jis no dhevai dhiaa kar soiee purakh sujaan ||
136.e: That person, upon whom the Lord bestows His Mercy, is a wise person.

136.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
136.t: jinaa miliaa prabh aapanaa naanak tin kurabaan ||
136.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have merged with God.

136.g: ਮਾਘਿ ਸੁਚੇ ਸੇ ਕਾਂਢੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੨॥
136.t: maagh suche se kaa(n)dde'eeh jin pooraa gur miharavaan ||12||
136.e: In Maagh, they alone are known as true, unto whom the Perfect Guru is Merciful. ||12||

136.g: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
136.t: falagun ana(n)dh upaarajanaa har sajan pragaTe aai ||
136.e: In the month of Phalgun, bliss comes to those, unto whom the Lord, the Friend, has been revealed.

136.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
136.t: sa(n)t sahaiee raam ke kar kirapaa dheeaa milai ||
136.e: The Saints, the Lord's helpers, in their mercy, have united me with Him.

136.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹੁਣਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
136.t: sej suhaavee sarab sukh hun dhukhaa naahee jai ||
136.e: My bed is beautiful, and I have all comforts. I feel no sadness at all.

136.g: ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
136.t: eichh punee vaddabhaaganee var paiaa har rai ||
136.e: My desires have been fulfilled-by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sovereign Lord as my Husband.

136.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹੀਆ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਲਾਇ ॥
136.t: mil saheeaa ma(n)gal gaavahee geet govi(n)dh alai ||
136.e: Join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of rejoicing and the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.

136.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
136.t: har jehaa avar na dhisiee koiee dhoojaa lavai na lai ||
136.e: There is no other like the Lord-there is no equal to Him.

136.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
136.t: halat palat savaarion nihachal dhiteean jai ||
136.e: He embellishes this world and the world hereafter, and He gives us our permanent home there.

136.g: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਰਖਿਅਨੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਨਮੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
136.t: sa(n)saar saagar te rakhian bahuR na janamai dhai ||
136.e: He rescues us from the world-ocean; never again do we have to run the cycle of reincarnation.

136.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਣ ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
136.t: jihavaa ek anek gun tare naanak charanee pai ||
136.e: I have only one tongue, but Your Glorious Virtues are beyond counting. Nanak is saved, falling at Your Feet.

136.g: ਫਲਗੁਣਿ ਨਿਤ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
136.t: falagun nit salaaheeaai jis no til na tamai ||13||
136.e: In Phalgun, praise Him continually; He has not even an iota of greed. ||13||

136.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਰੇ ॥
136.t: jin jin naam dhiaaiaa tin ke kaaj sare ||
136.e: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord-their affairs are all resolved.

136.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
136.t: har gur pooraa aaraadhiaa dharageh sach khare ||
136.e: Those who meditate on the Perfect Guru, the Lord-Incarnate-they are judged true in the Court of the Lord.

136.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
136.t: sarab sukhaa nidh charan har bhaujal bikham tare ||
136.e: The Lord's Feet are the Treasure of all peace and comfort for them; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.

136.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਰੇ ॥
136.t: prem bhagat tin paieeaa bikhiaa naeh jare ||
136.e: They obtain love and devotion, and they do not burn in corruption.

136.g: ਕੂੜ ਗਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਸੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਚਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
136.t: kooR ge dhubidhaa nasee pooran sach bhare ||
136.e: Falsehood has vanished, duality has been erased, and they are totally overflowing with Truth.

136.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
136.t: paarabraham prabh sevadhe man a(n)dhar ek dhare ||
136.e: They serve the Supreme Lord God, and enshrine the One Lord within their minds.

136.g: ਮਾਹ ਦਿਵਸ ਮੂਰਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
136.t: maeh dhivas moorat bhale jis kau nadhar kare ||
136.e: The months, the days, and the moments are auspicious, for those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace.

136.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਰਸ ਦਾਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੪॥੧॥
136.t: naanak ma(n)gai dharas dhaan kirapaa karahu hare ||14||1||
136.e: Nanak begs for the blessing of Your Vision, O Lord. Please, shower Your Mercy upon me! ||14||1||

136.g: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਣਿ
136.t: maajh mahalaa panjavaa dhin rain
136.e: Maajh, Fifth Mehla: Day And Night:

136.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
136.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
136.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

136.g: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਰੈਣ ॥
136.t: sevee satigur aapanaa har simaree dhin sabh rain ||
136.e: I serve my True Guru, and meditate on Him all day and night.

136.g: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵਾਂ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਿਠੜੇ ਵੈਣ ॥
136.t: aap tiaag saranee pavaa(n) mukh bolee miThaRe vain ||
136.e: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, I seek His Sanctuary, and speak sweet words to Him.

136.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣ ॥
136.t: janam janam kaa vichhuRiaa har melahu sajan sain ||
136.e: Through countless lifetimes and incarnations, I was separated from Him. O Lord, you are my Friend and Companion-please unite me with Yourself.

136.g: ਜੋ ਜੀਅ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਸੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨ ਵਸਨਿ ਭੈਣ ॥
136.t: jo jeea har te vichhuRe se sukh na vasan bhain ||
136.e: Those who are separated from the Lord do not dwell in peace, O sister.

136.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਚੈਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਖੋਜਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਗੈਣ ॥
136.t: har pir bin chain na paieeaai khoj ddiThe sabh gain ||
136.e: Without their Husband Lord, they find no comfort. I have searched and seen all realms.

136.g: ਆਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੇਣ ॥
136.t: aap kamaanai vichhuRee dhos na kaahoo dhen ||
136.e: My own evil actions have kept me separate from Him; why should I accuse anyone else?

136.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਣ ॥
136.t: kar kirapaa prabh raakh leh hor naahee karan karen ||
136.e: Bestow Your Mercy, God, and save me! No one else can bestow Your Mercy.

136.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਖਾਕੂ ਰੂਲਣਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਥੈ ਵੈਣ ॥
136.t: har tudh vin khaakoo roolanaa kaheeaai kithai vain ||
136.e: Without You, Lord, we roll around in the dust. Unto whom should we utter our cries of distress?

136.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣ ॥੧॥
136.t: naanak kee bena(n)teeaa har surajan dhekhaa nain ||1||
136.e: This is Nanak's prayer: ""May my eyes behold the Lord, the Angelic Being.""||1||

136.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
136.t: jeea kee birathaa so sune har sa(n)mrith purakh apaar ||
136.e: The Lord hears the anguish of the soul; He is the All-powerful and Infinite Primal Being.

136.g: ਮਰਣਿ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਣਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
136.t: maran jeevan aaraadhanaa sabhanaa kaa aadhaar ||
136.e: In death and in life, worship and adore the Lord, the Support of all.

137.g: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ ਵਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
137.t: sasurai peieeaai tis ka(n)t kee vaddaa jis paravaar ||
137.e: In this world and in the next, the soul-bride belongs to her Husband Lord, who has such a vast family.

137.g: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
137.t: uoochaa agam agaadh bodh kichh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
137.e: He is Lofty and Inaccessible. His Wisdom is Unfathomable.

137.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
137.t: sevaa saa tis bhaavasee sa(n)taa kee hoi chhaar ||
137.e: He has no end or limitation. That service is pleasing to Him, which makes one humble, like the dust of the feet of the Saints.

137.g: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੈਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
137.t: dheenaa naath dhaiaal dhev patit udhaaranahaar ||
137.e: He is the Patron of the poor, the Merciful, Luminous Lord, the Redeemer of sinners.

137.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
137.t: aadh jugaadhee rakhadhaa sach naam karataar ||
137.e: From the very beginning, and throughout the ages, the True Name of the Creator has been our Saving Grace.

137.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
137.t: keemat koi na jaaniee ko naahee tolanahaar ||
137.e: No one can know His Value; no one can weigh it.

137.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
137.t: man tan a(n)tar vas rahe naanak nahee sumaar ||
137.e: He dwells deep within the mind and body. O Nanak, He cannot be measured.

137.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੰਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
137.t: dhin rain j prabh ka(n)au sevadhe tin kai sadh balihaar ||2||
137.e: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve God, day and night. ||2||

137.g: ਸੰਤ ਅਰਾਧਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ॥
137.t: sa(n)t araadhan sadh sadhaa sabhanaa kaa bakhasi(n)dh ||
137.e: The Saints worship and adore Him forever and ever; He is the Forgiver of all.

137.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਿਤੀਨੁ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
137.t: jeeau pi(n)dd jin saajiaa kar kirapaa dhiteen ji(n)dh ||
137.e: He fashioned the soul and the body, and by His Kindness, He bestowed the soul.

137.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
137.t: gur sabadhee aaraadheeaai japeeaai niramal ma(n)t ||
137.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, worship and adore Him, and chant His Pure Mantra.

137.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ॥
137.t: keemat kahan na jaieeaai paramesur bea(n)t ||
137.e: His Value cannot be evaluated. The Transcendent Lord is endless.

137.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਰਾਇਣੋ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਗਵੰਤੁ ॥
137.t: jis man vasai naraino so kaheeaai bhagava(n)t ||
137.e: That one, within whose mind the Lord abides, is said to be most fortunate.

137.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
137.t: jeea kee lochaa pooreeaai milai suaamee ka(n)t ||
137.e: The soul's desires are fulfilled, upon meeting the Master, our Husband Lord.

137.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਦੋਖ ਸਭੇ ਹੀ ਹੰਤੁ ॥
137.t: naanak jeevai jap haree dhokh sabhe hee ha(n)t ||
137.e: Nanak lives by chanting the Lord's Name; all sorrows have been erased.

137.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੰਤੁ ॥੩॥
137.t: dhin rain jis na visarai so hariaa hovai ja(n)t ||3||
137.e: One who does not forget Him, day and night, is continually rejuvenated. ||3||

137.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਣੋ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
137.t: sarab kalaa prabh poorano ma(n)n(j) nimaanee thaau ||
137.e: God is overflowing with all powers. I have no honor-He is my resting place.

137.g: ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨਾਉ ॥
137.t: har oT gahee man a(n)dhare jap jap jeevaa(n) naau ||
137.e: I have grasped the Support of the Lord within my mind; I live by chanting and meditating on His Name.

137.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਨ ਧੂੜੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
137.t: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee jan dhooRee sa(n)g samaau ||
137.e: Grant Your Grace, God, and bless me, that I may merge into the dust of the feet of the humble.

137.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
137.t: jiau too(n) raakheh tiau rahaa teraa dhitaa painaa khaau ||
137.e: As You keep me, so do I live. I wear and eat whatever You give me.

137.g: ਉਦਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
137.t: audham soiee karai prabh mil saadhoo gun gaau ||
137.e: May I make the effort, O God, to sing Your Glorious Praises in the Company of the Holy.

137.g: ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਕੂਕਣ ਜਾਉ ॥
137.t: dhoojee jai na sujhiee kithai kookan jaau ||
137.e: I can conceive of no other place; where could I go to lodge a complaint?

137.g: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਤਮ ਹਰਣ ਊਚੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਮਾਉ ॥
137.t: agiaan binaasan tam haran uooche agam amaau ||
137.e: You are the Dispeller of ignorance, the Destroyer of darkness, O Lofty, Unfathomable and Unapproachable Lord.

137.g: ਮਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
137.t: man vichhuRiaa har meleeaai naanak eh suaau ||
137.e: Please unite this separated one with Yourself; this is Nanak's yearning.

137.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
137.t: sarab kaliaanaa tit dhin har parasee gur ke paau ||4||1||
137.e: That day shall bring every joy, O Lord, when I take to the Feet of the Guru. ||4||1||

137.g: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧  ਮਲਕ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹੜਾ ਸੋਹੀਆ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
137.t: vaar maajh kee tathaa salok mahalaa pehilaa  malak mureedh tathaa cha(n)dhrahaRaa soheeaa kee dhunee gaavanee ||
137.e: Vaar In Maajh, And Shaloks Of The First Mehla: To Be Sung To The Tune Of ""Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa""

137.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
137.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
137.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

137.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
137.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
137.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

137.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤਿਹ ਲੋਇ ॥
137.t: gur dhaataa gur hivai ghar gur dheepak teh loi ||
137.e: The Guru is the Giver; the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the three worlds.

137.g: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
137.t: amar padhaarath naanakaa man maaniaai sukh hoi ||1||
137.e: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace. ||1||

137.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
137.e: First Mehla:

137.g: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਥਣ ਦੁਧਿ ॥
137.t: pahilai piaar lagaa than dhudh ||
137.e: First, the baby loves mother's milk;

137.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
137.t: dhoojai mai baap kee sudh ||
137.e: second, he learns of his mother and father;

137.g: ਤੀਜੈ ਭਯਾ ਭਾਭੀ ਬੇਬ ॥
137.t: teejai bhayaa bhaabhee beb ||
137.e: third, his brothers, sisters-in-law and sisters;

137.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਉਪੰਨੀ ਖੇਡ ॥
137.t: chauthai piaar upa(n)nee khedd ||
137.e: fourth, the love of play awakens.

137.g: ਪੰਜਵੈ ਖਾਣ ਪੀਅਣ ਕੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
137.t: pa(n)javai khaan peean kee dhaat ||
137.e: Fifth, he runs after food and drink;

137.g: ਛਿਵੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
137.t: chhivai kaam na puchhai jaat ||
137.e: sixth, in his sexual desire, he does not respect social customs.

137.g: ਸਤਵੈ ਸੰਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
137.t: satavai sa(n)j keeaa ghar vaas ||
137.e: Seventh, he gathers wealth and dwells in his house;

137.g: ਅਠਵੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਨ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
137.t: aThavai karodh hoaa tan naas ||
137.e: eighth, he becomes angry, and his body is consumed.

137.g: ਨਾਵੈ ਧਉਲੇ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
137.t: naavai dhaule ubhe saeh ||
137.e: Ninth, he turns grey, and his breathing becomes labored;

137.g: ਦਸਵੈ ਦਧਾ ਹੋਆ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
137.t: dhasavai dhadhaa hoaa suaaeh ||
137.e: tenth, he is cremated, and turns to ashes.

137.g: ਗਏ ਸਿਗੀਤ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਧਾਹ ॥
137.t: ge sigeet pukaaree dhaeh ||
137.e: His companions send him off, crying out and lamenting.

137.g: ਉਡਿਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਦਸਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
137.t: auddiaa ha(n)s dhasaae raeh ||
137.e: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to go.

138.g: ਆਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
138.t: aaiaa giaa muiaa naau ||
138.e: He came and he went, and now, even his name has died.

138.g: ਪਿਛੈ ਪਤਲਿ ਸਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਵ ॥
138.t: pichhai patal sadhih kaav ||
138.e: After he left, food was offered on leaves, and the birds were called to come and eat.

138.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
138.t: naanak manmukh a(n)dh piaar ||
138.e: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs love the darkness.

138.g: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਡੁਬਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
138.t: baajh guroo ddubaa sa(n)saar ||2||
138.e: Without the Guru, the world is drowning. ||2||

138.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
138.e: First Mehla:

138.g: ਦਸ ਬਾਲਤਣਿ ਬੀਸ ਰਵਣਿ ਤੀਸਾ ਕਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
138.t: dhas baalatan bees ravan teesaa kaa su(n)dhar kahaavai ||
138.e: At the age of ten, he is a child; at twenty, a youth, and at thirty, he is called handsome.

138.g: ਚਾਲੀਸੀ ਪੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਚਾਸੀ ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ ਸਠੀ ਕੇ ਬੋਢੇਪਾ ਆਵੈ ॥
138.t: chaaleesee pur hoi pachaasee pag khisai saThee ke boddepaa aavai ||
138.e: At forty, he is full of life; at fifty, his foot slips, and at sixty, old age is upon him.

138.g: ਸਤਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਅਸੀਹਾਂ ਕਾ ਵਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
138.t: satar kaa matiheen aseehaa(n) kaa viauhaar na paavai ||
138.e: At seventy, he loses his intellect, and at eighty, he cannot perform his duties.

138.g: ਨਵੈ ਕਾ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਣੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਪ ਬਲੁ ॥
138.t: navai kaa sihajaasanee mool na jaanai ap bal ||
138.e: At ninety, he lies in his bed, and he cannot understand his weakness.

138.g: ਢੰਢੋਲਿਮੁ ਢੂਢਿਮੁ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਧੂਏ ਕਾ ਧਵਲਹਰੁ ॥੩॥
138.t: dda(n)ddolim ddooddim ddiTh mai naanak jag dhooe kaa dhavalahar ||3||
138.e: After seeking and searching for such a long time, O Nanak, I have seen that the world is just a mansion of smoke. ||3||

138.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
138.t: pauRee ||
138.e: Pauree:

138.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਤੀ ॥
138.t: too(n) karataa purakh aga(n)m hai aap sirasaT upaatee ||
138.e: You, O Creator Lord, are Unfathomable. You Yourself created the Universe,

138.g: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
138.t: ra(n)g para(n)g upaarajanaa bahu bahu bidh bhaatee ||
138.e: its colors, qualities and varieties, in so many ways and forms.

138.g: ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮਾਤੀ ॥
138.t: too(n) jaaneh jin upaieeaai sabh khel tumaatee ||
138.e: You created it, and You alone understand it. It is all Your Play.

138.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
138.t: eik aaveh ik jaeh uTh bin naavai mar jaatee ||
138.e: Some come, and some arise and depart; but without the Name, all are bound to die.

138.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
138.t: gurmukh ra(n)g chalooliaa ra(n)g har ra(n)g raatee ||
138.e: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the deep crimson color of the poppy; they are dyed in the color of the Lord's Love.

138.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੀ ॥
138.t: so sevahu sat nira(n)jano har purakh bidhaatee ||
138.e: So serve the True and Pure Lord, the Supremely Powerful Architect of Destiny.

138.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਵਡਾਤੀ ॥
138.t: too(n) aape aap sujaan hai vadd purakh vaddaatee ||
138.e: You Yourself are All-knowing. O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great!

138.g: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਚਿਆ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
138.t: jo man chit tudh dhiaaidhe mere sachiaa bal bal hau tin jaatee ||1||
138.e: O my True Lord, I am a sacrifice, a humble sacrifice, to those who meditate on You within their conscious mind. ||1||

138.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
138.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
138.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

138.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਰਖਿਆ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
138.t: jeeau pai tan saajiaa rakhiaa banat banai ||
138.e: He placed the soul in the body which He had fashioned. He protects the Creation which He has created.

138.g: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
138.t: akhee dhekhai jihavaa bolai ka(n)nee surat samai ||
138.e: With their eyes, they see, and with their tongues, they speak; with their ears, they bring the mind to awareness.

138.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲੈ ਹਥੀ ਕਰਣਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
138.t: pairee chalai hathee karanaa dhitaa painai khai ||
138.e: With their feet, they walk, and with their hands, they work; they wear and eat whatever is given.

138.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
138.t: jin rach rachiaa tiseh na jaanai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamai ||
138.e: They do not know the One who created the Creation. The blind fools do their dark deeds.

138.g: ਜਾ ਭਜੈ ਤਾ ਠੀਕਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾੜਤ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
138.t: jaa bhajai taa Theekar hovai ghaaRat ghaRee na jai ||
138.e: When the pitcher of the body breaks and shatters into pieces, it cannot be re-created again.

138.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
138.t: naanak gur bin naeh pat pat vin paar na pai ||1||
138.e: O Nanak, without the Guru, there is no honor; without honor, no one is carried across. ||1||

138.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
138.e: Second Mehla:

138.g: ਦੇਂਦੇ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.t: dhe(n)dhe thaavahu dhitaa cha(n)gaa manmukh aaisaa jaaneeaai ||
138.e: They prefer the gift, instead of the Giver; such is the way of the self-willed manmukhs.

138.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.t: surat mat chaturaiee taa kee kiaa kar aakh vakhaaneeaai ||
138.e: What can anyone say about their intelligence, their understanding or their cleverness?

138.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.t: a(n)tar beh kai karam kamaavai so chahu ku(n)ddee jaaneeaai ||
138.e: The deeds which one commits, while sitting in one's own home, are known far and wide, in the four directions.

138.g: ਜੋ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਨਾਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਾਪਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.t: jo dharam kamaavai tis dharam naau hovai paap kamaanai paapee jaaneeaai ||
138.e: One who lives righteously is known as righteous; one who commits sins is known as a sinner.

138.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
138.t: too(n) aape khel kareh sabh karate kiaa dhoojaa aakh vakhaaneeaai ||
138.e: You Yourself enact the entire play, O Creator. Why should we speak of any other?

138.g: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਦਿਖਾ ਸਿਆਣੀਐ ॥
138.t: jichar teree jot tichar jotee vich too(n) boleh vin jotee koiee kichh karih dhikhaa siaaneeaai ||
138.e: As long as Your Light is within the body, You speak through that Light. Without Your Light, who can do anything? Show me any such cleverness!

138.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨॥
138.t: naanak gurmukh nadharee aaiaa har iko sughaR sujaaneeaai ||2||
138.e: O Nanak, the Lord alone is Perfect and All-knowing; He is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||2||

138.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
138.t: pauRee ||
138.e: Pauree:

138.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
138.t: tudh aape jagat upai kai tudh aape dha(n)dhai laiaa ||
138.e: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself put it to work.

138.g: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
138.t: moh Thagaulee pai kai tudh aapahu jagat khuaaiaa ||
138.e: Administering the drug of emotional attachment, You Yourself have led the world astray.

138.g: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਹੈ ਨਹ ਤਿਪਤੈ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
138.t: tisanaa a(n)dhar agan hai neh tipatai bhukhaa tihaiaa ||
138.e: The fire of desire is deep within; unsatisfied, people remain hungry and thirsty.

138.g: ਸਹਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
138.t: sahasaa ih sa(n)saar hai mar ja(n)mai aaiaa jaiaa ||
138.e: This world is an illusion; it dies and it is re-born-it comes and it goes in reincarnation.

138.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਸਭਿ ਥਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
138.t: bin satigur moh na tuTiee sabh thake karam kamaiaa ||
138.e: Without the True Guru, emotional attachment is not broken. All have grown weary of performing empty rituals.

138.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਜਾ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
138.t: gurmatee naam dhiaaieeaai sukh rajaa jaa tudh bhaiaa ||
138.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Filled with a joyful peace, they surrender to Your Will.

138.g: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
138.t: kul udhaare aapanaa dha(n)n janedhee maiaa ||
138.e: They save their families and ancestors; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

139.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
139.t: sobhaa surat suhaavanee jin har setee chit laiaa ||2||
139.e: Beautiful and sublime is the glory and the understanding of those who focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||2||

139.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
139.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
139.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

139.g: ਅਖੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕੰਨਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ॥
139.t: akhee baajhahu vekhanaa vin ka(n)naa sunanaa ||
139.e: To see without eyes; to hear without ears;

139.g: ਪੈਰਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਚਲਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਥਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
139.t: pairaa baajhahu chalanaa vin hathaa karanaa ||
139.e: to walk without feet; to work without hands;

139.g: ਜੀਭੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਇਉ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
139.t: jeebhai baajhahu bolanaa iau jeevat maranaa ||
139.e: to speak without a tongue-like this, one remains dead while yet alive.

139.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਤਉ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥
139.t: naanak hukam pachhaan kai tau khasamai milanaa ||1||
139.e: O Nanak, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merge with your Lord and Master. ||1||

139.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
139.e: Second Mehla:

139.g: ਦਿਸੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
139.t: dhisai suneeaai jaaneeaai saau na paiaa jai ||
139.e: He is seen, heard and known, but His subtle essence is not obtained.

139.g: ਰੁਹਲਾ ਟੁੰਡਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
139.t: ruhalaa Tu(n)ddaa a(n)dhulaa kiau gal lagai dhai ||
139.e: How can the lame, armless and blind person run to embrace the Lord?

139.g: ਭੈ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਭਾਵ ਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
139.t: bhai ke charan kar bhaav ke loin surat karei ||
139.e: Let the Fear of God be your feet, and let His Love be your hands; let His Understanding be your eyes.

139.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ ਇਵ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
139.t: naanak kahai siaane'ee iv ka(n)t milaavaa hoi ||2||
139.e: Says Nanak, in this way, O wise soul-bride, you shall be united with your Husband Lord. ||2||

139.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
139.t: pauRee ||
139.e: Pauree:

139.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: sadhaa sadhaa too(n) ek hai tudh dhoojaa khel rachaiaa ||
139.e: Forever and ever, You are the only One; You set the play of duality in motion.

139.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: haumai garab upai kai lobh a(n)tar ja(n)taa paiaa ||
139.e: You created egotism and arrogant pride, and You placed greed within our beings.

139.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too sabh kare teraa karaiaa ||
139.e: Keep me as it pleases Your Will; everyone acts as You cause them to act.

139.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: eikanaa bakhaseh mel laih gurmatee tudhai laiaa ||
139.e: Some are forgiven, and merge with You; through the Guru's Teachings, we are joined to You.

139.g: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: eik khaRe kareh teree chaakaree vin naavai hor na bhaiaa ||
139.e: Some stand and serve You; without the Name, nothing else pleases them.

139.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਾਰ ਵੇਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: hor kaar vekaar hai ik sachee kaarai laiaa ||
139.e: Any other task would be worthless to them-You have enjoined them to Your True Service.

139.g: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: put kalat kuTa(n)b hai ik alipat rahe jo tudh bhaiaa ||
139.e: In the midst of children, spouse and relations, some still remain detached; they are pleasing to Your Will.

139.g: ਓਹਿ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
139.t: oh a(n)dharahu baaharahu niramale sachai nai samaiaa ||3||
139.e: Inwardly and outwardly, they are pure, and they are absorbed in the True Name. ||3||

139.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
139.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
139.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

139.g: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੈ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਕਰੀ ਕੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
139.t: suine kai parabat gufaa karee kai paanee piaal ||
139.e: I may make a cave, in a mountain of gold, or in the water of the nether regions;

139.g: ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਉਰਧਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
139.t: kai vich dharatee kai aakaasee uradh rahaa sir bhaar ||
139.e: I may remain standing on my head, upside-down, on the earth or up in the sky;

139.g: ਪੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਾ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਿ ॥
139.t: pur kar kaiaa kapaR pahiraa dhovaa sadhaa kaar ||
139.e: I may totally cover my body with clothes, and wash them continually;

139.g: ਬਗਾ ਰਤਾ ਪੀਅਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
139.t: bagaa rataa peealaa kaalaa bedhaa karee pukaar ||
139.e: I may shout out loud, the white, red, yellow and black Vedas;

139.g: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਰਹਾ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
139.t: hoi kucheel rahaa mal dhaaree dhuramat mat vikaar ||
139.e: I may even live in dirt and filth. And yet, all this is just a product of evil-mindedness, and intellectual corruption.

139.g: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਹੋਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
139.t: naa hau naa mai naa hau hovaa naanak sabadh veechaar ||1||
139.e: I was not, I am not, and I will never be anything at all! O Nanak, I dwell only on the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

139.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
139.e: First Mehla:

139.g: ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਖਾਲਿ ਪਖਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
139.t: vasatr pakhaal pakhaale kaiaa aape sa(n)jam hovai ||
139.e: They wash their clothes, and scrub their bodies, and try to practice self-discipline.

139.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
139.t: a(n)tar mail lagee nahee jaanai baaharahu mal mal dhovai ||
139.e: But they are not aware of the filth staining their inner being, while they try and try to wash off the outer dirt.

139.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
139.t: a(n)dhaa bhool piaa jam jaale ||
139.e: The blind go astray, caught by the noose of Death.

139.g: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
139.t: vasat paraiee apunee kar jaanai haumai vich dhukh ghaale ||
139.e: They see other people's property as their own, and in egotism, they suffer in pain.

139.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
139.t: naanak gurmukh haumai tuTai taa har har naam dhiaavai ||
139.e: O Nanak, the egotism of the Gurmukhs is broken, and then, they meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

139.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
139.t: naam jape naamo aaraadhe naame sukh samaavai ||2||
139.e: They chant the Naam, meditate on the Naam, and through the Naam, they are absorbed in peace. ||2||

139.g: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
139.t: pavaRee ||
139.e: Pauree:

139.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: kaiaa ha(n)s sa(n)jog mel milaiaa ||
139.e: Destiny has brought together and united the body and the soul-swan.

139.g: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: tin hee keeaa vijog jin upaiaa ||
139.e: He who created them, also separates them.

139.g: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗੁ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: moorakh bhoge bhog dhukh sabaiaa ||
139.e: The fools enjoy their pleasures; they must also endure all their pains.

139.g: ਸੁਖਹੁ ਉਠੇ ਰੋਗ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: sukhahu uThe rog paap kamaiaa ||
139.e: From pleasures, arise diseases and the commission of sins.

139.g: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: harakhahu sog vijog upai khapaiaa ||
139.e: From sinful pleasures come sorrow, separation, birth and death.

139.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: moorakh ganat ganai jhagaRaa paiaa ||
139.e: The fools try to account for their misdeeds, and argue uselessly.

139.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
139.t: satigur hath nibeR jhagaR chukaiaa ||
139.e: The judgement is in the Hands of the True Guru, who puts an end to the argument.

139.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
139.t: karataa kare su hog na chalai chalaiaa ||4||
139.e: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. It cannot be changed by anyone's efforts. ||4||

139.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
139.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
139.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

139.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
139.t: kooR bol muradhaar khai ||
139.e: Telling lies, they eat dead bodies.

140.g: ਅਵਰੀ ਨੋ ਸਮਝਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
140.t: avaree no samajhaavan jai ||
140.e: And yet, they go out to teach others.

140.g: ਮੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
140.t: muThaa aap muhaae saathai ||
140.e: They are deceived, and they deceive their companions.

140.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
140.t: naanak aaisaa aagoo jaapai ||1||
140.e: O Nanak, such are the leaders of men. ||1||

140.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
140.t: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
140.e: Fourth Mehla:

140.g: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਏ ॥
140.t: jis dhai a(n)dhar sach hai so sachaa naam mukh sach alaae ||
140.e: Those, within whom the Truth dwells, obtain the True Name; they speak only the Truth.

140.g: ਓਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਦਾ ਹੋਰਨਾ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
140.t: oh har maarag aap chaladhaa horanaa no har maarag paae ||
140.e: They walk on the Lord's Path, and inspire others to walk on the Lord's Path as well.

140.g: ਜੇ ਅਗੈ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਹੈ ਛਪੜਿ ਨਾਤੈ ਸਗਵੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
140.t: je agai teerath hoi taa mal lahai chhapaR naatai sagavee mal laae ||
140.e: Bathing in a pool of holy water, they are washed clean of filth. But, by bathing in a stagnant pond, they are contaminated with even more filth.

140.g: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
140.t: teerath pooraa satiguroo jo anadhin har har naam dhiaae ||
140.e: The True Guru is the Perfect Pool of Holy Water. Night and day, He meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

140.g: ਓਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
140.t: oh aap chhuTaa kuTa(n)b siau dhe har har naam sabh sirasaT chhaddaae ||
140.e: He is saved, along with his family; bestowing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, He saves the whole world.

140.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
140.t: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo aap japai avaraa naam japaae ||2||
140.e: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to one who himself chants the Naam, and inspires others to chant it as well. ||2||

140.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
140.t: pauRee ||
140.e: Pauree:

140.g: ਇਕਿ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
140.t: eik ka(n)dh mool chun khaeh van kha(n)dd vaasaa ||
140.e: Some pick and eat fruits and roots, and live in the wilderness.

140.g: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਵਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸਾ ॥
140.t: eik bhagavaa ves kar fireh jogee sa(n)niaasaa ||
140.e: Some wander around wearing saffron robes, as Yogis and Sanyaasees.

140.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
140.t: a(n)dhar tirasanaa bahut chhaadhan bhojan kee aasaa ||
140.e: But there is still so much desire within them-they still yearn for clothes and food.

140.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਨ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
140.t: birathaa janam gavai na girahee na udhaasaa ||
140.e: They waste their lives uselessly; they are neither householders nor renunciates.

140.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ॥
140.t: jamakaal sirahu na utarai tirabidh manasaa ||
140.e: The Messenger of Death hangs over their heads, and they cannot escape the three-phased desire.

140.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
140.t: gurmatee kaal na aavai neRai jaa hovai dhaasan dhaasaa ||
140.e: Death does not even approach those who follow the Guru's Teachings, and become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

140.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥
140.t: sachaa sabadh sach man ghar hee maeh udhaasaa ||
140.e: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their true minds; within the home of their own inner beings, they remain detached.

140.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
140.t: naanak satigur sevan aapanaa se aasaa te niraasaa ||5||
140.e: O Nanak, those who serve their True Guru, rise from desire to desirelessness. ||5||

140.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
140.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
140.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

140.g: ਜੇ ਰਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਕਪੜੈ ਜਾਮਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਲੀਤੁ ॥
140.t: je rat lagai kapaRai jaamaa hoi paleet ||
140.e: If one's clothes are stained with blood, the garment becomes polluted.

140.g: ਜੋ ਰਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਮਾਣਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
140.t: jo rat peeveh maanasaa tin kiau niramal cheet ||
140.e: Those who suck the blood of human beings-how can their consciousness be pure?

140.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਿ ਹਛੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
140.t: naanak naau khudhai kaa dhil hachhai mukh leh ||
140.e: O Nanak, chant the Name of God, with heart-felt devotion.

140.g: ਅਵਰਿ ਦਿਵਾਜੇ ਦੁਨੀ ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਅਮਲ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
140.t: avar dhivaaje dhunee ke jhooThe amal kareh ||1||
140.e: Everything else is just a pompous worldly show, and the practice of false deeds. ||1||

140.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
140.e: First Mehla:

140.g: ਜਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵਾ ॥
140.t: jaa hau naahee taa kiaa aakhaa kih naahee kiaa hovaa ||
140.e: Since I am no one, what can I say? Since I am nothing, what can I be?

140.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਥਨਾ ਭਰਿਆ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵਾਂ ॥
140.t: keetaa karanaa kahiaa kathanaa bhariaa bhar bhar dhovaa(n) ||
140.e: As He created me, so I act. As He causes me to speak, so I speak. I am full and overflowing with sins-if only I could wash them away!

140.g: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਾ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਹੋਵਾਂ ॥
140.t: aap na bujhaa lok bujhaiee aaisaa aagoo hovaa(n) ||
140.e: I do not understand myself, and yet I try to teach others. Such is the guide I am!

140.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਸੇ ਰਾਹੈ ਸਭਸੁ ਮੁਹਾਏ ਸਾਥੈ ॥
140.t: naanak a(n)dhaa hoi kai dhase raahai sabhas muhaae saathai ||
140.e: O Nanak, the one who is blind shows others the way, and misleads all his companions.

140.g: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ਸੁ ਐਸਾ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
140.t: agai giaa muhe muh paeh su aaisaa aagoo jaapai ||2||
140.e: But, going to the world hereafter, he shall be beaten and kicked in the face; then, it will be obvious, what sort of guide he was! ||2||

140.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
140.t: pauRee ||
140.e: Pauree:

140.g: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੂੰ ਘੜੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
140.t: maahaa rutee sabh too(n) ghaRee moorat veechaaraa ||
140.e: Through all the months and the seasons, the minutes and the hours, I dwell upon You, O Lord.

140.g: ਤੂੰ ਗਣਤੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
140.t: too(n) ganatai kinai na paio sache alakh apaaraa ||
140.e: No one has attained You by clever calculations, O True, Unseen and Infinite Lord.

140.g: ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
140.t: paRiaa moorakh aakheeaai jis lab lobh aha(n)kaaraa ||
140.e: That scholar who is full of greed, arrogant pride and egotism, is known to be a fool.

140.g: ਨਾਉ ਪੜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
140.t: naau paReeaai naau bujheeaai gurmatee veechaaraa ||
140.e: So read the Name, and realize the Name, and contemplate the Guru's Teachings.

140.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
140.t: gurmatee naam dhan khaTiaa bhagatee bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
140.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I have earned the wealth of the Naam; I possess the storehouses, overflowing with devotion to the Lord.

140.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
140.t: niramal naam ma(n)niaa dhar sachai sachiaaraa ||
140.e: Believing in the Immaculate Naam, one is hailed as true, in the True Court of the Lord.

140.g: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
140.t: jis dhaa jeeau paraan hai a(n)tar jot apaaraa ||
140.e: The Divine Light of the Infinite Lord, who owns the soul and the breath of life, is deep within the inner being.

140.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
140.t: sachaa saahu ik too(n) hor jagat vanajaaraa ||6||
140.e: You alone are the True Banker, O Lord; the rest of the world is just Your petty trader. ||6||

140.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
140.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
140.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

140.g: ਮਿਹਰ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਹਕੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
140.t: mihar maseet sidhak musalaa hak halaal kuraan ||
140.e: Let mercy be your mosque, faith your prayer-mat, and honest living your Koran.

140.g: ਸਰਮ ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ ਰੋਜਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ॥
140.t: saram su(n)nat seel rojaa hoh musalamaan ||
140.e: Make modesty your circumcision, and good conduct your fast. In this way, you shall be a true Muslim.

140.g: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਬਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਕਲਮਾ ਕਰਮ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥
140.t: karanee kaabaa sach peer kalamaa karam nivaaj ||
140.e: Let good conduct be your Kaabaa, Truth your spiritual guide, and the karma of good deeds your prayer and chant.

140.g: ਤਸਬੀ ਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖੈ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
140.t: tasabee saa tis bhaavasee naanak rakhai laaj ||1||
140.e: Let your rosary be that which is pleasing to His Will. O Nanak, God shall preserve your honor. ||1||

141.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
141.e: First Mehla

141.g: ਹਕੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰ ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ ॥
141.t: hak paraiaa naanakaa us sooar us gai ||
141.e: : To take what rightfully belongs to another, is like a Muslim eating pork, or a Hindu eating beef.

141.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ਹਾਮਾ ਤਾ ਭਰੇ ਜਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
141.t: gur peer haamaa taa bhare jaa muradhaar na khai ||
141.e: Our Guru, our Spiritual Guide, stands by us, if we do not eat those carcasses.

141.g: ਗਲੀ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
141.t: galee bhisat na jaieeaai chhuTai sach kamai ||
141.e: By mere talk, people do not earn passage to Heaven. Salvation comes only from the practice of Truth.

141.g: ਮਾਰਣ ਪਾਹਿ ਹਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
141.t: maaran paeh haraam meh hoi halaal na jai ||
141.e: By adding spices to forbidden foods, they are not made acceptable.

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਈ ਕੂੜੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
141.t: naanak galee kooReeiee kooRo palai pai ||2||
141.e: O Nanak, from false talk, only falsehood is obtained. ||2||

141.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
141.e: First Mehla:

141.g: ਪੰਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਵਖਤ ਪੰਜਿ ਪੰਜਾ ਪੰਜੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
141.t: pa(n)j nivaajaa vakhat pa(n)j pa(n)jaa pa(n)je naau ||
141.e: There are five prayers and five times of day for prayer; the five have five names.

141.g: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਲਾਲ ਦੁਇ ਤੀਜਾ ਖੈਰ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
141.t: pahilaa sach halaal dhui teejaa khair khudhai ||
141.e: Let the first be truthfulness, the second honest living, and the third charity in the Name of God.

141.g: ਚਉਥੀ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਜਵੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
141.t: chauthee neeat raas man pa(n)javee sifat sanai ||
141.e: Let the fourth be good will to all, and the fifth the praise of the Lord.

141.g: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਲਮਾ ਆਖਿ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥
141.t: karanee kalamaa aakh kai taa musalamaan sadhai ||
141.e: Repeat the prayer of good deeds, and then, you may call yourself a Muslim.

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇਤੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
141.t: naanak jete kooRiaar kooRai kooRee pai ||3||
141.e: O Nanak, the false obtain falsehood, and only falsehood. ||3||

141.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
141.t: pauRee ||
141.e: Pauree:

141.g: ਇਕਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜਦੇ ਇਕਿ ਕਚੈ ਦੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
141.t: eik ratan padhaarath vanajadhe ik kachai dhe vaapaaraa ||
141.e: Some trade in priceless jewels, while others deal in mere glass.

141.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
141.t: satigur tuThai paieean a(n)dhar ratan bha(n)ddaaraa ||
141.e: When the True Guru is pleased, we find the treasure of the jewel, deep within the self.

141.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ॥
141.t: vin gur kinai na ladhiaa a(n)dhe bhauk mue kooRiaaraa ||
141.e: Without the Guru, no one has found this treasure. The blind and the false have died in their endless wanderings.

141.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
141.t: manmukh dhoojai pach mue naa boojheh veechaaraa ||
141.e: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in duality. They do not understand contemplative meditation.

141.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
141.t: eikas baajhahu dhoojaa ko nahee kis agai kareh pukaaraa ||
141.e: Without the One Lord, there is no other at all. Unto whom should they complain?

141.g: ਇਕਿ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਸਦਾ ਭਉਕਦੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਰੇ ਤੁਜਾਰਾ ॥
141.t: eik niradhan sadhaa bhaukadhe ikanaa bhare tujaaraa ||
141.e: Some are destitute, and wander around endlessly, while others have storehouses of wealth.

141.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰਾ ॥
141.t: vin naavai hor dhan naahee hor bikhiaa sabh chhaaraa ||
141.e: Without God's Name, there is no other wealth. Everything else is just poison and ashes.

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
141.t: naanak aap karaae kare aap hukam savaaranahaaraa ||7||
141.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself acts, and causes others to act; by the Hukam of His Command, we are embellished and exalted. ||7||

141.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
141.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
141.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

141.g: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵਣੁ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
141.t: musalamaan kahaavan musakal jaa hoi taa musalamaan kahaavai ||
141.e: It is difficult to be called a Muslim; if one is truly a Muslim, then he may be called one.

141.g: ਅਵਲਿ ਅਉਲਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਮਸਕਲ ਮਾਨਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਮੁਸਾਵੈ ॥
141.t: aval aaul dheen kar miThaa masakal maanaa maal musaavai ||
141.e: First, let him savor the religion of the Prophet as sweet; then, let his pride of his possessions be scraped away.

141.g: ਹੋਇ ਮੁਸਲਿਮੁ ਦੀਨ ਮੁਹਾਣੈ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
141.t: hoi musalim dheen muhaanai maran jeevan kaa bharam chukaavai ||
141.e: Becoming a true Muslim, a disciple of the faith of Mohammed, let him put aside the delusion of death and life.

141.g: ਰਬ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਿਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
141.t: rab kee rajai ma(n)ne sir upar karataa ma(n)ne aap gavaavai ||
141.e: As he submits to God's Will, and surrenders to the Creator, he is rid of selfishness and conceit.

141.g: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਿਹਰੰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
141.t: tau naanak sarab jeeaa mihara(n)mat hoi ta musalamaan kahaavai ||1||
141.e: And when, O Nanak, he is merciful to all beings, only then shall he be called a Muslim. ||1||

141.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
141.t: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
141.e: Fourth Mehla:

141.g: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥
141.t: parahar kaam karodh jhooTh ni(n)dhaa taj maiaa aha(n)kaar chukaavai ||
141.e: Renounce sexual desire, anger, falsehood and slander; forsake Maya and eliminate egotistical pride.

141.g: ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
141.t: taj kaam kaaminee moh tajai taa a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan paavai ||
141.e: Renounce sexual desire and promiscuity, and give up emotional attachment. Only then shall you obtain the Immaculate Lord amidst the darkness of the world.

141.g: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਤਜਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
141.t: taj maan abhimaan preet sut dhaaraa taj piaas aas raam liv laavai ||
141.e: Renounce selfishness, conceit and arrogant pride, and your love for your children and spouse. Abandon your thirsty hopes and desires, and embrace love for the Lord.

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
141.t: naanak saachaa man vasai saach sabadh har naam samaavai ||2||
141.e: O Nanak, the True One shall come to dwell in your mind. Through the True Word of the Shabad, you shall be absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

141.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
141.t: pauRee ||
141.e: Pauree:

141.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਯਤਿ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਹਸੀਓ ॥
141.t: raaje rayat sikadhaar koi na rahaseeo ||
141.e: Neither the kings, nor their subjects, nor the leaders shall remain.

141.g: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਹਸੀਓ ॥
141.t: haT paTan baajaar hukamee ddahaseeo ||
141.e: The shops, the cities and the streets shall eventually disintegrate, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

141.g: ਪਕੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
141.t: pake ba(n)k dhuaar moorakh jaanai aapane ||
141.e: Those solid and beautiful mansions-the fools think that they belong to them.

141.g: ਦਰਬਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਰੀਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਣੇ ॥
141.t: dharab bhare bha(n)ddaar reete ik khane ||
141.e: The treasure-houses, filled with wealth, shall be emptied out in an instant.

141.g: ਤਾਜੀ ਰਥ ਤੁਖਾਰ ਹਾਥੀ ਪਾਖਰੇ ॥ ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ਕਿਥੈ ਸਿ ਆਪਣੇ ॥ ਤੰਬੂ ਪਲੰਘ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਸਰਾਇਚੇ ਲਾਲਤੀ ॥
141.t: taajee rath tukhaar haathee paakhare || baag milakh ghar baar kithai s aapane || ta(n)boo pala(n)gh nivaar saraiche laalatee ||
141.e: The horses, chariots, camels and elephants, with all their decorations; the gardens, lands, houses, tents, soft beds and satin pavilions-Oh, where are those things, which they believe to be their own?

141.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਿਨਾਖਤੁ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ॥੮॥
141.t: naanak sach dhaataar sinaakhat kudharatee ||8||
141.e: O Nanak, the True One is the Giver of all; He is revealed through His All-powerful Creative Nature. ||8||

141.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
141.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
141.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

141.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੇਣਵਾ ਸੁੰਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੁਧੁ ਘੀਉ ॥
141.t: nadheeaa hoveh dhenavaa su(n)m hoveh dhudh gheeau ||
141.e: If the rivers became cows, giving milk, and the spring water became milk and ghee;

141.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਵੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
141.t: sagalee dharatee sakar hovai khusee kare nit jeeau ||
141.e: If all the earth became sugar, to continually excite the mind;

142.g: ਪਰਬਤੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
142.t: parabat suinaa rupaa hovai heere laal jaRaau ||
142.e: if the mountains became gold and silver, studded with gems and jewels

142.g: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥
142.t: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||1||
142.e: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||1||
First Mehla:

142.g: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮੇਵਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਗਰੁੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
142.t: bhaar aThaareh mevaa hovai garuRaa hoi suaau ||
142.e: If all the eighteen loads of vegetation became fruits,

142.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
142.t: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui firadhe rakhe'eeh nihachal hovai thaau ||
142.e: and the growing grass became sweet rice; if I were able to stop the sun and the moon in their orbits and hold them perfectly steady

142.g: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥
142.t: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||2||
142.e: -even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||2||
First Mehla:

142.g: ਜੇ ਦੇਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਾਪ ਗਰਹ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
142.t: je dhehai dhukh laieeaai paap gareh dhui raahu ||
142.e: If my body were afflicted with pain, under the evil influence of unlucky stars;

142.g: ਰਤੁ ਪੀਣੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
142.t: rat peene raaje sirai upar rakhe'eeh evai jaapai bhaau ||
142.e: and if the blood-sucking kings were to hold power over me

142.g: ਭੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੩॥
142.t: bhee too(n)hai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||3||
142.e: -even if this were my condition, I would still worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||3||
First Mehla:

142.g: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਉ ॥
142.t: agee paalaa kapaR hovai khaanaa hovai vaau ||
142.e: If fire and ice were my clothes, and the wind was my food;

142.g: ਸੁਰਗੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੋ ਜਾਉ ॥
142.t: suragai dheeaa mohaneeaa isatareeaa hovan naanak sabho jaau ||
142.e: and even if the enticing heavenly beauties were my wives, O Nanak-all this shall pass away!

142.g: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਖਣ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਉ ॥੪॥
142.t: bhee toohai saalaahanaa aakhan lahai na chaau ||4||
142.e: Even then, I would worship and adore You, and my longing to chant Your Praises would not decrease. ||4||
Pauree:
The foolish demon, who does evil deeds, does not know his Lord and Master.

142.g: ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ॥
142.t: so kaheeaai dhevaanaa aap na pachhaaniee ||
142.e: Call him a mad-man, if he does not understand himself.
The strife of this world is evil; these struggles are consuming it.
Without the Lord's Name, life is worthless. Through doubt, the people are being destroyed.

142.g: ਰਾਹ ਦੋਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਝਸੀ ॥
142.t: raeh dhovai ik jaanai soiee sijhasee ||
142.e: One who recognizes that all spiritual paths lead to the One shall be emancipated.
One who speaks lies shall fall into hell and burn.
In all the world, the most blessed and sanctified are those who remain absorbed in Truth.
One who eliminates selfishness and conceit is redeemed in the Court of the Lord. ||9||
First Mehla, Shalok:

142.g: ਸੋ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
142.t: so jeeviaa jis man vasiaa soi ||
142.e: They alone are truly alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.
O Nanak, no one else is truly alive;
those who merely live shall depart in dishonor;
everything they eat is impure.

142.g: ਰਾਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਲਿ ਰੰਗੁ ॥ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਨਚੈ ਨੰਗੁ ॥
142.t: raaj ra(n)g maal ra(n)g || ra(n)g rataa nachai na(n)g ||
142.e: Intoxicated with power and thrilled with wealth, they delight in their pleasures, and dance about shamelessly.
O Nanak, they are deluded and defrauded.
Without the Lord's Name, they lose their honor and depart. ||1||
First Mehla:
What good is food, and what good are clothes,
if the True Lord does not abide within the mind?

142.g: ਕਿਆ ਮੇਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਘਿਉ ਗੁੜੁ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੈਦਾ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
142.t: kiaa mevaa kiaa ghiau guR miThaa kiaa maidhaa kiaa maas ||
142.e: What good are fruits, what good is ghee, sweet jaggery, what good is flour, and what good is meat?

142.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸ ॥
142.t: kiaa kapaR kiaa sej sukhaalee keejeh bhog bilaas ||
142.e: What good are clothes, and what good is a soft bed, to enjoy pleasures and sensual delights?

142.g: ਕਿਆ ਲਸਕਰ ਕਿਆ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸੀ ਆਵੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
142.t: kiaa lasakar kiaa neb khavaasee aavai mahalee vaas ||
142.e: What good is an army, and what good are soldiers, servants and mansions to live in?

142.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੇ ਟੋਲ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
142.t: naanak sache naam vin sabhe Tol vinaas ||2||
142.e: O Nanak, without the True Name, all this paraphernalia shall disappear. ||2||
Pauree:

142.g: ਜਾਤੀ ਦੈ ਕਿਆ ਹਥਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੀਐ ॥
142.t: jaatee dhai kiaa hath sach parakheeaai ||
142.e: What good is social class and status? Truthfulness is measured within.
Pride in one's status is like poison-holding it in your hand and eating it, you shall die.

142.g: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
142.t: sache kee sirakaar jug jug jaaneeaai ||
142.e: The True Lord's Sovereign Rule is known throughout the ages.
One who respects the Hukam of the Lord's Command is honored and respected in the Court of the Lord.
By the Order of our Lord and Master, we have been brought into this world.
The Drummer, the Guru, has announced the Lord's meditation, through the Word of the Shabad.
Some have mounted their horses in response, and others are saddling up.
Some have tied up their bridles, and others have already ridden off. ||10||
Shalok, First Mehla:

142.g: ਜਾ ਪਕਾ ਤਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਰਹੀ ਸੁ ਪਲਰਿ ਵਾੜਿ ॥
142.t: jaa pakaa taa kaTiaa rahee su palar vaaR ||
142.e: When the crop is ripe, then it is cut down; only the stalks are left standing.

142.g: ਸਣੁ ਕੀਸਾਰਾ ਚਿਥਿਆ ਕਣੁ ਲਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਝਾੜਿ ॥
142.t: san keesaaraa chithiaa kan liaa tan jhaaR ||
142.e: The corn on the cob is put into the thresher, and the kernels are separated from the cobs.

142.g: ਦੁਇ ਪੁੜ ਚਕੀ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣ ਆਇ ਬਹਿਠੁ ॥
142.t: dhui puR chakee joR kai peesan aai bahiTh ||
142.e: Placing the kernels between the two mill-stones, people sit and grind the corn.

142.g: ਜੋ ਦਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੁ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਬੁ ਡਿਠੁ ॥੧॥
142.t: jo dhar rahe su ubare naanak ajab ddiTh ||1||
142.e: Those kernels which stick to the central axle are spared-Nanak has seen this wonderful vision! ||1||
First Mehla:

142.g: ਵੇਖੁ ਜਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
142.t: vekh j miThaa kaTiaa kaT kuT badhaa pai ||
142.e: Look, and see how the sugar-cane is cut down. After cutting away its branches, its feet are bound together into bundles,

143.g: ਖੁੰਢਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਮਲ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
143.t: khu(n)ddaa a(n)dhar rakh kai dhen su mal sajai ||
143.e: and then, it is placed between the wooden rollers and crushed.

143.g: ਰਸੁ ਕਸੁ ਟਟਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਪੈ ਤੈ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
143.t: ras kas TaTar paieeaai tapai tai vilalai ||
143.e: What punishment is inflicted upon it! Its juice is extracted and placed in the cauldron; as it is heated, it groans and cries out.

143.g: ਭੀ ਸੋ ਫੋਗੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਦਿਚੈ ਅਗਿ ਜਾਲਾਇ ॥
143.t: bhee so fog samaaleeaai dhichai ag jaalai ||
143.e: And then, the crushed cane is collected and burnt in the fire below.

143.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਠੈ ਪਤਰੀਐ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
143.t: naanak miThai patareeaai vekhahu lokaa aai ||2||
143.e: Nanak: come, people, and see how the sweet sugar-cane is treated! ||2||

143.g: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
143.t: pavaRee ||
143.e: Pauree:

143.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਸ ਘਣੇਰਿਆ ॥
143.t: eikanaa maran na chit aas ghaneriaa ||
143.e: Some do not think of death; they entertain great hopes.

143.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰਿਆ ॥
143.t: mar mar ja(n)meh nit kisai na keriaa ||
143.e: They die, and are re-born, and die, over and over again. They are of no use at all!

143.g: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹਨਿ ਚੰਗੇਰਿਆ ॥
143.t: aapanaRai man chit kahan cha(n)geriaa ||
143.e: In their conscious minds, they call themselves good.

143.g: ਜਮਰਾਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੇਰਿਆ ॥
143.t: jamaraajai nit nit manmukh heriaa ||
143.e: The King of the Angels of Death hunts down those self-willed manmukhs, over and over again.

143.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲੂਣ ਹਾਰਾਮ ਕਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
143.t: manmukh loon haaraam kiaa na jaaniaa ||
143.e: The manmukhs are false to their own selves; they feel no gratitude for what they have been given.

143.g: ਬਧੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਸਲਾਮ ਖਸਮ ਨ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
143.t: badhe karan salaam khasam na bhaaniaa ||
143.e: Those who merely perform rituals of worship are not pleasing to their Lord and Master.

143.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
143.t: sach milai mukh naam saahib bhaavasee ||
143.e: Those who attain the True Lord and chant His Name are pleasing to the Lord.

143.g: ਕਰਸਨਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸੀ ॥੧੧॥
143.t: karasan takhat salaam likhiaa paavasee ||11||
143.e: They worship the Lord and bow at His Throne. They fulfill their pre-ordained destiny. ||11||

143.g: ਮਃ ੧ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
143.t: mahalaa pehilaa salok ||
143.e: First Mehla, Shalok:

143.g: ਮਛੀ ਤਾਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਕਿਆ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
143.t: machhee taaroo kiaa kare pa(n)khee kiaa aakaas ||
143.e: What can deep water do to a fish? What can the vast sky do to a bird?

143.g: ਪਥਰ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਸਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
143.t: pathar paalaa kiaa kare khusare kiaa ghar vaas ||
143.e: What can cold do to a stone? What is married life to a eunuch?

143.g: ਕੁਤੇ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਕੁਤੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
143.t: kute cha(n)dhan laieeaai bhee so kutee dhaat ||
143.e: You may apply sandalwood oil to a dog, but he will still be a dog.

143.g: ਬੋਲਾ ਜੇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪਾਠ ॥
143.t: bolaa je samajhaieeaai paRe'eh si(n)mirat paaTh ||
143.e: You may try to teach a deaf person by reading the Simritees to him, but how will he learn?

143.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਦੀਵੇ ਬਲਹਿ ਪਚਾਸ ॥
143.t: a(n)dhaa chaanan rakheeaai dheeve baleh pachaas ||
143.e: You may place a light before a blind man and burn fifty lamps, but how will he see?

143.g: ਚਉਣੇ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਵੈ ਘਾਸੁ ॥
143.t: chaune suinaa paieeaai chun chun khaavai ghaas ||
143.e: You may place gold before a herd of cattle, but they will pick out the grass to eat.

143.g: ਲੋਹਾ ਮਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਢਹੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਕਪਾਸ ॥
143.t: lohaa maaran paieeaai ddahai na hoi kapaas ||
143.e: You may add flux to iron and melt it, but it will not become soft like cotton.

143.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖ ਏਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
143.t: naanak moorakh eh gun bole sadhaa vinaas ||1||
143.e: O Nanak, this is the nature of a fool-everything he speaks is useless and wasted. ||1||

143.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
143.e: First Mehla:

143.g: ਕੈਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: kaihaa ka(n)chan tuTai saar ||
143.e: When pieces of bronze or gold or iron break,

143.g: ਅਗਨੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਏ ਲੋਹਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: aganee ga(n)dd paae lohaar ||
143.e: the metal-smith welds them together again in the fire, and the bond is established.

143.g: ਗੋਰੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਤੁਟੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: goree setee tuTai bhataar ||
143.e: If a husband leaves his wife,

143.g: ਪੁਤਂੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
143.t: puta(n)ee ga(n)dd pavai sa(n)saar ||
143.e: their children may bring them back together in the world, and the bond is established.

143.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
143.t: raajaa ma(n)gai dhitai ga(n)dd pai ||
143.e: When the king makes a demand, and it is met, the bond is established.

143.g: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਜਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
143.t: bhukhiaa ga(n)dd pavai jaa khai ||
143.e: When the hungry man eats, he is satisfied, and the bond is established.

143.g: ਕਾਲਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨਦੀਆ ਮੀਹ ਝੋਲ ॥
143.t: kaalaa ga(n)dd nadheeaa meeh jhol ||
143.e: In the famine, the rain fills the streams to overflowing, and the bond is established.

143.g: ਗੰਢੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਮਿਠੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
143.t: ga(n)dd pareetee miThe bol ||
143.e: There is a bond between love and words of sweetness.

143.g: ਬੇਦਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
143.t: bedhaa ga(n)dd bole sach koi ||
143.e: When one speaks the Truth, a bond is established with the Holy Scriptures.

143.g: ਮੁਇਆ ਗੰਢੁ ਨੇਕੀ ਸਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
143.t: muiaa ga(n)dd nekee sat hoi ||
143.e: Through goodness and truth, the dead establish a bond with the living.

143.g: ਏਤੁ ਗੰਢਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: et ga(n)dd varatai sa(n)saar ||
143.e: Such are the bonds which prevail in the world.

143.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਾਰ ॥
143.t: moorakh ga(n)dd pavai muh maar ||
143.e: The fool establishes his bonds only when he is slapped in the face.

143.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: naanak aakhai eh beechaar ||
143.e: Nanak says this after deep reflection:

143.g: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਗੰਢੁ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
143.t: sifatee ga(n)dd pavai dharabaar ||2||
143.e: through the Lord's Praise, we establish a bond with His Court. ||2||

143.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
143.t: pauRee ||
143.e: Pauree:

143.g: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਕੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: aape kudharat saaj kai aape kare beechaar ||
143.e: He Himself created and adorned the Universe, and He Himself contemplates it.

143.g: ਇਕਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਇਕਿ ਖਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: eik khoTe ik khare aape parakhanahaar ||
143.e: Some are counterfeit, and some are genuine. He Himself is the Appraiser.

143.g: ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਬਾਹਰ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
143.t: khare khajaanai paie'eeh khoTe saTe'eeh baahar vaar ||
143.e: The genuine are placed in His Treasury, while the counterfeit are thrown away.

143.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਟੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
143.t: khoTe sachee dharageh suTe'eeh kis aagai kareh pukaar ||
143.e: The counterfeit are thrown out of the True Court-unto whom should they complain?

143.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਿਛੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: satigur pichhai bhaj paveh ehaa karanee saar ||
143.e: They should worship and follow the True Guru-this is the lifestyle of excellence.

143.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਟਿਅਹੁ ਖਰੇ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
143.t: satigur khoTiahu khare kare sabadh savaaranahaar ||
143.e: The True Guru converts the counterfeit into genuine; through the Word of the Shabad, He embellishes and exalts us.

143.g: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
143.t: sachee dharageh ma(n)neean gur kai prem piaar ||
143.e: Those who have enshrined love and affection for the Guru, are honored in the True Court.

143.g: ਗਣਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੀ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧੨॥
143.t: ganat tinaa dhee ko kiaa kare jo aap bakhase karataar ||12||
143.e: Who can estimate the value of those who have been forgiven by the Creator Lord Himself? ||12||

143.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
143.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
143.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

143.g: ਹਮ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਪੀਰਾ ਮਸਾਇਕਾ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
143.t: ham jer jimee dhuneeaa peeraa masaikaa raiaa ||
143.e: All the spiritual teachers, their disciples and the rulers of the world shall be buried under the ground.

143.g: ਮੇ ਰਵਦਿ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹਾ ਅਫਜੂ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
143.t: me ravadh baadhisaahaa afajoo khudhai ||
143.e: The emperors shall also pass away; God alone is Eternal.

143.g: ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੧॥
143.t: ek toohee ek tuhee ||1||
143.e: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||1||

143.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
143.e: First Mehla:

143.g: ਨ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵਾ ਨਰਾ ॥ ਨ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਧਰਾ ॥
143.t: n dhev dhaanavaa naraa || na sidh saadhikaa dharaa ||
143.e: Neither the angels, nor the demons, nor human beings, nor the Siddhas, nor the seekers shall remain on the earth.

143.g: ਅਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਦਿਗਰਿ ਕੁਈ ॥
143.t: asat ek dhigar kuiee ||
143.e: Who else is there?

144.e: You alone, Lord, You alone. ||2||
First Mehla:

144.g: ਨ ਦਾਦੇ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਆਦਮੀ ॥ ਨ ਸਪਤ ਜੇਰ ਜਿਮੀ ॥
144.t: n dhaadhe dhiha(n)dh aadhamee || na sapat jer jimee ||
144.e: Neither the just, nor the generous, nor any humans at all, nor the seven realms beneath the earth, shall remain.
The One Lord alone exists. Who else is there?
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||3||
First Mehla:

144.g: ਨ ਸੂਰ ਸਸਿ ਮੰਡਲੋ ॥ ਨ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਨਹ ਜਲੋ ॥ ਅੰਨ ਪਉਣ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਕੁਈ ॥
144.t: n soor sas ma(n)ddalo || na sapat dheep neh jalo || a(n)n paun thir na kuiee ||
144.e: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the planets, nor the seven continents, nor the oceans, nor food, nor the wind-nothing is permanent.
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||4||
First Mehla:
Our sustenance is not in the hands of any person.
The hopes of all rest in the One Lord.
The One Lord alone exists-who else is there?
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||5||
First Mehla:
The birds have no money in their pockets.
They place their hopes on trees and water.
He alone is the Giver.
You alone, Lord, You alone. ||6||
First Mehla:
O Nanak, that destiny which is pre-ordained and written on one's forehead
no one can erase it.
The Lord infuses strength, and He takes it away again.
You alone, O Lord, You alone. ||7||
Pauree:
True is the Hukam of Your Command. To the Gurmukh, it is known.
Through the Guru's Teachings, selfishness and conceit are eradicated, and the Truth is realized.
True is Your Court. It is proclaimed and revealed through the Word of the Shabad.
Meditating deeply on the True Word of the Shabad, I have merged into the Truth.
The self-willed manmukhs are always false; they are deluded by doubt.

144.g: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
144.t: visaTaa a(n)dhar vaas saadh na jaaniaa ||
144.e: They dwell in manure, and they do not know the taste of the Name.

144.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
144.t: vin naavai dhukh pai aavan jaaniaa ||
144.e: Without the Name, they suffer the agonies of coming and going.

144.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੧੩॥
144.t: naanak paarakh aap jin khoTaa kharaa pachhaaniaa ||13||
144.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself is the Appraiser, who distinguishes the counterfeit from the genuine. ||13||
Shalok, First Mehla:

144.g: ਸੀਹਾ ਬਾਜਾ ਚਰਗਾ ਕੁਹੀਆ ਏਨਾ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਘਾਹ ॥
144.t: seehaa baajaa charagaa kuheeaa enaa khavaale ghaeh ||
144.e: Tigers, hawks, falcons and eagles-the Lord could make them eat grass.

144.g: ਘਾਹੁ ਖਾਨਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹ ॥
144.t: ghaahu khaan tinaa maas khavaale eh chalaae raeh ||
144.e: And those animals which eat grass-He could make them eat meat. He could make them follow this way of life.

144.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਟਿਬੇ ਦੇਖਾਲੇ ਥਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
144.t: nadheeaa vich Tibe dhekhaale thalee kare asagaeh ||
144.e: He could raise dry land from the rivers, and turn the deserts into bottomless oceans.

144.g: ਕੀੜਾ ਥਾਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਲਸਕਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਆਹ ॥
144.t: keeRaa thaap dhei paatisaahee lasakar kare suaaeh ||
144.e: He could appoint a worm as king, and reduce an army to ashes.

144.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਲੈ ਸਾਹਾ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਕਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥
144.t: jete jeea jeeveh lai saahaa jeevaale taa k asaeh ||
144.e: All beings and creatures live by breathing, but He could keep us alive, even without the breath.

144.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਦੇਇ ਗਿਰਾਹ ॥੧॥
144.t: naanak jiau jiau sache bhaavai tiau tiau dhei giraeh ||1||
144.e: O Nanak, as it pleases the True Lord, He gives us sustenance. ||1||
First Mehla:
Some eat meat, while others eat grass.
Some have all the thirty-six varieties of delicacies,
while others live in the dirt and eat mud.
Some control the breath, and regulate their breathing.
Some live by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord.
The Great Giver lives; no one dies.

144.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
144.t: naanak muThe jaeh naahee man soi ||2||
144.e: O Nanak, those who do not enshrine the Lord within their minds are deluded. ||2||
Pauree:

144.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
144.t: poore gur kee kaar karam kamaieeaai ||
144.e: By the karma of good actions, some come to serve the Perfect Guru.
Through the Guru's Teachings, some eliminate selfishness and conceit, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Undertaking any other task, they waste their lives in vain.

144.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਵਿਸੁ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
144.t: vin naavai sabh vis paijhai khaieeaai ||
144.e: Without the Name, all that they wear and eat is poison.
Praising the True Word of the Shabad, they merge with the True Lord.

144.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
144.t: vin satigur seve naahee sukh nivaas fir fir aaieeaai ||
144.e: Without serving the True Guru, they do not obtain the home of peace; they are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again.
Investing counterfeit capital, they earn only falsehood in the world.

144.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੪॥
144.t: naanak sach kharaa saalaeh pat siau jaieeaai ||14||
144.e: O Nanak, singing the Praises of the Pure, True Lord, they depart with honor. ||14||
Shalok, First Mehla:

144.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਵਾਵਹਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
144.t: tudh bhaavai taa vaaveh gaaveh tudh bhaavai jal naaveh ||
144.e: When it pleases You, we play music and sing; when it pleases You, we bathe in water.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.t: jaa tudh bhaaveh taa kareh bibhootaa si(n)n(g)ee naadh vajaaveh ||
145.e: When it pleases You, we smear our bodies with ashes, and blow the horn and the conch shell.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਮੁਲਾ ਸੇਖ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.t: jaa tudh bhaavai taa paReh katebaa mulaa sekh kahaaveh ||
145.e: When it pleases You, we read the Islamic Scriptures, and are acclaimed as Mullahs and Shaykhs.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.t: jaa tudh bhaavai taa hoveh raaje ras kas bahut kamaaveh ||
145.e: When it pleases You, we become kings, and enjoy all sorts of tastes and pleasures.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਗ ਵਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਰ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.t: jaa tudh bhaavai teg vagaaveh sir mu(n)ddee kaT jaaveh ||
145.e: When it pleases You, we wield the sword, and cut off the heads of our enemies.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
145.t: jaa tudh bhaavai jaeh dhisa(n)tar sun galaa ghar aaveh ||
145.e: When it pleases You, we go out to foreign lands; hearing news of home, we come back again.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
145.t: jaa tudh bhaavai nai rachaaveh tudh bhaane too(n) bhaaveh ||
145.e: When it pleases You, we are attuned to the Name, and when it pleases You, we become pleasing to You.

145.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
145.t: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee hor sagale kooR kamaaveh ||1||
145.e: Nanak utters this one prayer; everything else is just the practice of falsehood. ||1||

145.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
145.e: First Mehla:

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਸਭਿ ਵਡਿਆਂਈਆ ਚੰਗੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
145.t: jaa too(n) vaddaa sabh vaddiaa(n)ieeaa cha(n)gai cha(n)gaa hoiee ||
145.e: You are so Great-all Greatness flows from You. You are So Good-Goodness radiates from You.

145.g: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਕੂੜਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
145.t: jaa too(n) sachaa taa sabh ko sachaa kooRaa koi na koiee ||
145.e: You are True-all that flows from You is True. Nothing at all is false.

145.g: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਚਲਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
145.t: aakhan vekhan bolan chalan jeevan maranaa dhaat ||
145.e: Talking, seeing, speaking, walking, living and dying-all these are transitory.

145.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ॥੨॥
145.t: hukam saaj hukamai vich rakhai naanak sachaa aap ||2||
145.e: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates, and in His Command, He keeps us. O Nanak, He Himself is True. ||2||

145.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
145.t: pauRee ||
145.e: Pauree:

145.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
145.t: satigur sev nisa(n)g bharam chukaieeaai ||
145.e: Serve the True Guru fearlessly, and your doubt shall be dispelled.

145.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੈ ਕਾਰ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
145.t: satigur aakhai kaar su kaar kamaieeaai ||
145.e: Do that work which the True Guru asks you to do.

145.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
145.t: satigur hoi dhiaal ta naam dhiaaieeaai ||
145.e: When the True Guru becomes merciful, we meditate on the Naam.

145.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
145.t: laahaa bhagat su saar gurmukh paieeaai ||
145.e: The profit of devotional worship is excellent. It is obtained by the Gurmukh.

145.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
145.t: manmukh kooR gubaar kooR kamaieeaai ||
145.e: The self-willed manmukhs are trapped in the darkness of falsehood; they practice nothing but falsehood.

145.g: ਸਚੇ ਦੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਚਵਾਂਈਐ ॥
145.t: sache dhai dhar jai sach chavaa(n)ieeaai ||
145.e: Go to the Gate of Truth, and speak the Truth.

145.g: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
145.t: sachai a(n)dhar mahal sach bulaieeaai ||
145.e: The True Lord calls the true ones to the Mansion of His Presence.

145.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧੫॥
145.t: naanak sach sadhaa sachiaar sach samaieeaai ||15||
145.e: O Nanak, the true ones are forever true; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||15||

145.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
145.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
145.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

145.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਾਤੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਕਾਸਾਈ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੰਖ ਕਰਿ ਉਡਰਿਆ ॥
145.t: kal kaatee raaje kaasaiee dharam pa(n)kh kar uddariaa ||
145.e: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the knife, and the kings are butchers; righteousness has sprouted wings and flown away.

145.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਅਮਾਵਸ ਸਚੁ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹ ਚੜਿਆ ॥
145.t: kooR amaavas sach cha(n)dhramaa dheesai naahee keh chaRiaa ||
145.e: In this dark night of falsehood, the moon of Truth is not visible anywhere.

145.g: ਹਉ ਭਾਲਿ ਵਿਕੁੰਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਆਧੇਰੈ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
145.t: hau bhaal viku(n)nee hoiee || aadherai raahu na koiee ||
145.e: I have searched in vain, and I am so confused; in this darkness, I cannot find the path.

145.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਈ ॥
145.t: vich haumai kar dhukh roiee ||
145.e: In egotism, they cry out in pain.

145.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
145.t: kahu naanak kin bidh gat hoiee ||1||
145.e: Says Nanak, how will they be saved? ||1||

145.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
145.e: Third Mehla:

145.g: ਕਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
145.t: kal keerat paragaT chaanan sa(n)saar ||
145.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has appeared as a Light in the world.

145.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
145.t: gurmukh koiee utarai paar ||
145.e: How rare are those few Gurmukhs who swim across to the other side!

145.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
145.t: jis no nadhar kare tis dhevai ||
145.e: The Lord bestows His Glance of Grace;

145.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ॥੨॥
145.t: naanak gurmukh ratan so levai ||2||
145.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh receives the jewel. ||2||

145.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
145.t: pauRee ||
145.e: Pauree:

145.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਤੈ ਸੈਸਾਰੀਆ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
145.t: bhagataa tai saisaareeaa joR kadhe na aaiaa ||
145.e: Between the Lord's devotees and the people of the world, there can never be any true alliance.

145.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
145.t: karataa aap abhul hai na bhulai kisai dhaa bhulaiaa ||
145.e: The Creator Himself is infallible. He cannot be fooled; no one can fool Him.

145.g: ਭਗਤ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
145.t: bhagat aape melian jinee sacho sach kamaiaa ||
145.e: He blends His devotees with Himself; they practice Truth, and only Truth.

145.g: ਸੈਸਾਰੀ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
145.t: saisaaree aap khuaaian jinee kooR bol bol bikh khaiaa ||
145.e: The Lord Himself leads the people of the world astray; they tell lies, and by telling lies, they eat poison.

145.g: ਚਲਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
145.t: chalan saar na jaananee kaam karodh vis vadhaiaa ||
145.e: They do not recognize the ultimate reality, that we all must go; they continue to cultivate the poisons of sexual desire and anger.

145.g: ਭਗਤ ਕਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
145.t: bhagat karan har chaakaree jinee anadhin naam dhiaaiaa ||
145.e: The devotees serve the Lord; night and day, they meditate on the Naam.

145.g: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
145.t: dhaasan dhaas hoi kai jinee vichahu aap gavaiaa ||
145.e: Becoming the slaves of the Lord's slaves, they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

145.g: ਓਨਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
145.t: onaa khasamai kai dhar mukh ujale sachai sabadh suhaiaa ||16||
145.e: In the Court of their Lord and Master, their faces are radiant; they are embellished and exalted with the True Word of the Shabad. ||16||

145.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
145.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
145.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

145.g: ਸਬਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ॥
145.t: sabaahee saalaeh jinee dhiaaiaa ik man ||
145.e: Those who praise the Lord in the early hours of the morning and meditate on Him single-mindedly,

145.g: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਖਤੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਮੁਏ ॥
145.t: seiee poore saeh vakhatai upar laR mue ||
145.e: are the perfect kings; at the right time, they die fighting.

145.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਰਾਹ ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਮਤੀ ਖਿੰਡੀਆ ॥
145.t: dhoojai bahute raeh man keeaa matee khi(n)ddeeaa ||
145.e: In the second watch, the focus of the mind is scattered in all sorts of ways.

145.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਏ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ॥
145.t: bahut pe asagaeh gote khaeh na nikaleh ||
145.e: So many fall into the bottomless pit; they are dragged under, and they cannot get out again.

146.g: ਤੀਜੈ ਮੁਹੀ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਖਾ ਦੁਇ ਭਉਕੀਆ ॥
146.t: teejai muhee giraeh bhukh tikhaa dhui bhaukeeaa ||
146.e: In the third watch, both hunger and thirst bark for attention, and food is put into the mouth.

146.g: ਖਾਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਹ ਭੀ ਖਾਣੇ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ॥
146.t: khaadhaa hoi suaaeh bhee khaane siau dhosatee ||
146.e: That which is eaten becomes dust, but they are still attached to eating.

146.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਆਈ ਊਂਘ ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਿ ਪਵਾਰਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
146.t: chauthai aaiee uoo(n)gh akhee meeT pavaar giaa ||
146.e: In the fourth watch, they become drowsy. They close their eyes and begin to dream.

146.g: ਭੀ ਉਠਿ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਵਾਦੁ ਸੈ ਵਰਿੑਆ ਕੀ ਪਿੜ ਬਧੀ ॥
146.t: bhee uTh rachion vaadh sai vari(h)aa kee piR badhee ||
146.e: Rising up again, they engage in conflicts; they set the stage as if they will live for 100 years.

146.g: ਸਭੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੇ ਅਠੀ ਭਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
146.t: sabhe velaa vakhat sabh je aThee bhau hoi ||
146.e: If at all times, at each and every moment, they live in the fear of God

146.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
146.t: naanak saahib man vasai sachaa naavan hoi ||1||
146.e: -O Nanak, the Lord dwells within their minds, and their cleansing bath is true. ||1||

146.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
146.e: Second Mehla:

146.g: ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹ ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
