146.t: seiee poore saeh jinee pooraa paiaa ||
146.e: They are the perfect kings, who have found the Perfect Lord.

146.g: ਅਠੀ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ਰਹਨਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
146.t: aThee veparavaeh rahan ikatai ra(n)g ||
146.e: Twenty-four hours a day, they remain unconcerned, imbued with the Love of the One Lord.

146.g: ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਥਾਹ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
146.t: dharasan roop athaeh virale paie'eeh ||
146.e: Only a few obtain the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the Unimaginably Beauteous Lord.

146.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
146.t: karam poorai pooraa guroo pooraa jaa kaa bol ||
146.e: Through the perfect karma of good deeds, one meets the Perfect Guru, whose speech is perfect.

146.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
146.t: naanak pooraa je kare ghaTai naahee tol ||2||
146.e: O Nanak, when the Guru makes one perfect, one's weight does not decrease. ||2||

146.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
146.t: pauRee ||
146.e: Pauree:

146.g: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
146.t: jaa too(n) taa kiaa hor mai sach sunaieeaai ||
146.e: When You are with me, what more could I want? I speak only the Truth.

146.g: ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਚੋਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
146.t: muThee dha(n)dhai chor mahal na paieeaai ||
146.e: Plundered by the thieves of worldly affairs, she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence.

146.g: ਏਨੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
146.t: enai chit kaThor sev gavaieeaai ||
146.e: Being so stone-hearted, she has lost her chance to serve the Lord.

146.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਸੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
146.t: jit ghaT sach na pai su bha(n)n ghaRaieeaai ||
146.e: That heart, in which the True Lord is not found, should be torn down and re-built.

146.g: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਟਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
146.t: kiau kar poorai vaT tol tulaieeaai ||
146.e: How can she be weighed accurately, upon the scale of perfection?

146.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਘਟਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
146.t: koi na aakhai ghaT haumai jaieeaai ||
146.e: No one will say that her weight has been shorted, if she rids herself of egotism.

146.g: ਲਈਅਨਿ ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥
146.t: lieean khare parakh dhar beenaieeaai ||
146.e: The genuine are assayed, and accepted in the Court of the All-knowing Lord.

146.g: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੭॥
146.t: saudhaa ikat haT poorai gur paieeaai ||17||
146.e: The genuine merchandise is found only in one shop-it is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||17||

146.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
146.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
146.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

146.g: ਅਠੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਅਠ ਖੰਡ ਨਾਵਾ ਖੰਡੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
146.t: aThee paharee aTh kha(n)dd naavaa kha(n)dd sareer ||
146.e: Twenty-four hours a day, destroy the eight things, and in the ninth place, conquer the body.

146.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
146.t: tis vich nau nidh naam ek bhaaleh gunee gaheer ||
146.e: Within the body are the nine treasures of the Name of the Lord-seek the depths of these virtues.

146.g: ਕਰਮਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
146.t: karamava(n)tee saalaahiaa naanak kar gur peer ||
146.e: Those blessed with the karma of good actions praise the Lord. O Nanak, they make the Guru their spiritual teacher.

146.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰਿ ਸਬਾਹ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਤਿਆ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
146.t: chauthai pahar sabaeh kai suratiaa upajai chaau ||
146.e: In the fourth watch of the early morning hours, a longing arises in their higher consciousness.

146.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਦਰੀਆਵਾ ਸਿਉ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
146.t: tinaa dhareeaavaa siau dhosatee man mukh sachaa naau ||
146.e: They are attuned to the river of life; the True Name is in their minds and on their lips.

146.g: ਓਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
146.t: othai a(n)mrit va(n)ddeeaai karamee hoi pasaau ||
146.e: The Ambrosial Nectar is distributed, and those with good karma receive this gift.

146.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਸੀਐ ਵੰਨੀ ਚੜੈ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
146.t: ka(n)chan kaiaa kaseeaai va(n)nee chaRai chaRaau ||
146.e: Their bodies become golden, and take on the color of spirituality.

146.g: ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਤਾਉ ॥
146.t: je hovai nadhar saraaf kee bahuR na paiee taau ||
146.e: If the Jeweller casts His Glance of Grace, they are not placed in the fire again.

146.g: ਸਤੀ ਪਹਰੀ ਸਤੁ ਭਲਾ ਬਹੀਐ ਪੜਿਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
146.t: satee paharee sat bhalaa baheeaai paRiaa paas ||
146.e: Throughout the other seven watches of the day, it is good to speak the Truth, and sit with the spiritually wise.

146.g: ਓਥੈ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਘਟੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
146.t: othai paap pu(n)n beechaareeaai kooRai ghaTai raas ||
146.e: There, vice and virtue are distinguished, and the capital of falsehood is decreased.

146.g: ਓਥੈ ਖੋਟੇ ਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਖਰੇ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
146.t: othai khoTe saTe'eeh khare keecheh saabaas ||
146.e: There, the counterfeit are cast aside, and the genuine are cheered.

146.g: ਬੋਲਣੁ ਫਾਦਲੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
146.t: bolan faadhal naanakaa dhukh sukh khasamai paas ||1||
146.e: Speech is vain and useless. O Nanak, pain and pleasure are in the power of our Lord and Master. ||1||

146.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
146.e: Second Mehla:

146.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
146.t: paun guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
146.e: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

146.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
146.t: dhinas raat dhui dhaiee dhaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
146.e: Day and night are the two nurses, in whose lap all the world is at play.

146.g: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਵਾਚੇ ਧਰਮੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
146.t: cha(n)giaaieeaa buriaaieeaa vaache dharam hadhoor ||
146.e: Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

146.g: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
146.t: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke dhoor ||
146.e: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

146.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
146.t: jinee naam dhiaaiaa ge masakat ghaal ||
146.e: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brow

146.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
146.t: naanak te mukh ujale hor ketee chhuTee naal ||2||
146.e: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many others are saved along with them! ||2||

146.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
146.t: pauRee ||
146.e: Pauree:

146.g: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
146.t: sachaa bhojan bhaau satigur dhasiaa ||
146.e: The True Food is the Love of the Lord; the True Guru has spoken.

146.g: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
146.t: sache hee pateeaai sach vigasiaa ||
146.e: With this True Food, I am satisfied, and with the Truth, I am delighted.

146.g: ਸਚੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਰਾਂਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
146.t: sachai koT giraa(n)i nij ghar vasiaa ||
146.e: True are the cities and the villages, where one abides in the True Home of the self.

146.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
146.t: satigur tuThai naau prem rahasiaa ||
146.e: When the True Guru is pleased, one receives the Lord's Name, and blossoms forth in His Love.

146.g: ਸਚੈ ਦੈ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
146.t: sachai dhai dheebaan kooR na jaieeaai ||
146.e: No one enters the Court of the True Lord through falsehood.

146.g: ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
146.t: jhooTho jhooTh vakhaan su mahal khuaaieeaai ||
146.e: By uttering falsehood and only falsehood, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

147.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: sachai sabadh neesaan Thaak na paieeaai ||
147.e: No one blocks the way of those who are blessed with the Banner of the True Word of the Shabad.

147.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥੧੮॥
147.t: sach sun bujh vakhaan mahal bulaieeaai ||18||
147.e: Hearing, understanding and speaking Truth, one is called to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||18||

147.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
147.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
147.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

147.g: ਪਹਿਰਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
147.t: pahiraa agan hivai ghar baadhaa bhojan saar karaiee ||
147.e: If I dressed myself in fire, and built my house of snow, and made iron my food;

147.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਾਕ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
147.t: sagale dhookh paanee kar peevaa dharatee haak chalaiee ||
147.e: and if I were to drink in all pain like water, and drive the entire earth before me;

147.g: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਈ ॥
147.t: dhar taaraajee a(n)bar tolee pichhai Ta(n)k chaRaiee ||
147.e: and if I were to place the earth upon a scale and balance it with a single copper coin;

147.g: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਧਾ ਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਨਥਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
147.t: evadd vadhaa maavaa naahee sabhasai nath chalaiee ||
147.e: and if I were to become so great that I could not be contained, and if I were to control and lead all;

147.g: ਏਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
147.t: etaa taan hovai man a(n)dhar karee bh aakh karaiee ||
147.e: and if I were to possess so much power within my mind that I could cause others to do my bidding-so what?

147.g: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤੇਵਡ ਦਾਤੀ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
147.t: jevadd saahib tevadd dhaatee dhe dhe kare rajaiee ||
147.e: As Great as our Lord and Master is, so great are His gifts. He bestows them according to His Will.

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
147.t: naanak nadhar kare jis upar sach naam vaddiaaiee ||1||
147.e: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

147.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
147.e: Second Mehla:

147.g: ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਜਿਆ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਰਜੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
147.t: aakhan aakh na rajiaa sunan na raje ka(n)n ||
147.e: The mouth is not satisfied by speaking, and the ears are not satisfied by hearing.

147.g: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕ ਇਕ ਵੰਨ ॥
147.t: akhee dhekh na rajeeaa gun gaahak ik va(n)n ||
147.e: The eyes are not satisfied by seeing-each organ seeks out one sensory quality.

147.g: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਲੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
147.t: bhukhiaa bhukh na utarai galee bhukh na jai ||
147.e: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased; by mere words, hunger is not relieved.

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਾ ਰਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
147.t: naanak bhukhaa taa rajai jaa gun keh gunee samai ||2||
147.e: O Nanak, hunger is relieved only when one utters the Glorious Praises of the Praiseworthy Lord. ||2||

147.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
147.t: pauRee ||
147.e: Pauree:

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: vin sache sabh kooR kooR kamaieeaai ||
147.e: Without the True One, all are false, and all practice falsehood.

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਬੰਨਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: vin sache kooRiaar ba(n)n chalaieeaai ||
147.e: Without the True One, the false ones are bound and gagged and driven off.

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਰਲਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: vin sache tan chhaar chhaar ralaieeaai ||
147.e: Without the True One, the body is just ashes, and it mingles again with ashes.

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਿ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: vin sache sabh bhukh j paijhai khaieeaai ||
147.e: Without the True Ome, all food and clothes are unsatisfying.

147.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: vin sache dharabaar kooR na paieeaai ||
147.e: Without the True One, the false ones do not attain the Lord's Court.

147.g: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
147.t: kooRai laalach lag mahal khuaaieeaai ||
147.e: Attached to false attachments, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

147.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਓ ਠਗਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: sabh jag Thagio Thag aaieeaai jaieeaai ||
147.e: The whole world is deceived by deception, coming and going in reincarnation.

147.g: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
147.t: tan meh tirasanaa ag sabadh bujhaieeaai ||19||
147.e: Within the body is the fire of desire; through the Word of the Shabad, it is quenched. ||19||

147.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
147.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
147.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
147.t: naanak gur sa(n)tokh rukh dharam ful fal giaan ||
147.e: O Nanak, the Guru is the tree of contentment, with flowers of faith, and fruits of spiritual wisdom.

147.g: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਪਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
147.t: ras rasiaa hariaa sadhaa pakai karam dhiaan ||
147.e: Watered with the Lord's Love, it remains forever green; through the karma of good deeds and meditation, it ripens.

147.g: ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਖਾਦਾ ਲਹੈ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
147.t: pat ke saadh khaadhaa lahai dhaanaa kai sir dhaan ||1||
147.e: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1||

147.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
147.e: First Mehla:

147.g: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪਤ ਪਰਵਾਲਾ ਫੁਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
147.t: suine kaa birakh pat paravaalaa ful javehar laal ||
147.e: The Guru is the tree of gold, with leaves of coral, and blossoms of jewels and rubies.

147.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਫਲ ਰਤਨ ਲਗਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਖਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
147.t: tit fal ratan lageh mukh bhaakhit hiradhai ridhai nihaal ||
147.e: The Words from His Mouth are fruits of jewels. Within His Heart, He beholds the Lord.

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
147.t: naanak karam hovai mukh masatak likhiaa hovai lekh ||
147.e: O Nanak, He is obtained by those, upon whose faces and foreheads such pre-recorded destiny is written.

147.g: ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
147.t: aThisaTh teerath gur kee charanee poojai sadhaa visekh ||
147.e: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are contained in the constant worship of the feet of the Exalted Guru.

147.g: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕੋਪੁ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਦੀਆ ਅਗਿ ॥
147.t: ha(n)s het lobh kop chaare nadheeaa ag ||
147.e: Cruelty, material attachment, greed and anger are the four rivers of fire.

147.g: ਪਵਹਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਲਗਿ ॥੨॥
147.t: paveh dhajheh naanakaa tareeaai karamee lag ||2||
147.e: Falling into them, one is burned, O Nanak! One is saved only by holding tight to good deeds. ||2||

147.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
147.t: pauRee ||
147.e: Pauree:

147.g: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: jeevadhiaa mar maar na pachhotaieeaai ||
147.e: While you are alive, conquer death, and you shall have no regrets in the end.

147.g: ਝੂਠਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: jhooThaa ih sa(n)saar kin samajhaieeaai ||
147.e: This world is false, but only a few understand this.

147.g: ਸਚਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: sach na dhare piaar dha(n)dhai dhaieeaai ||
147.e: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.

147.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆਈਐ ॥
147.t: kaal buraa khai kaal sir dhuneeaaieeaai ||
147.e: The terrible time of death and annihilation hovers over the heads of the world.

147.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਦਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: hukamee sir ja(n)dhaar maare dhaieeaai ||
147.e: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the Messenger of Death smashes his club over their heads.

147.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: aape dhei piaar ma(n)n vasaieeaai ||
147.e: The Lord Himself gives His Love, and enshrines it within their minds.

147.g: ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਲੰਮੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
147.t: muhat na chasaa vila(n)m bhareeaai paieeaai ||
147.e: Not a moment or an instant's delay is permitted, when one's measure of life is full.

147.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੦॥
147.t: gur parasaadhee bujh sach samaieeaai ||20||
147.e: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the True One, and is absorbed into Him. ||20||

147.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
147.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
147.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

147.g: ਤੁਮੀ ਤੁਮਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਨਿਮੁ ਫਲੁ ॥
147.t: tumee tumaa vis ak dhatooraa nim fal ||
147.e: Bitter melon, swallow-wort, thorn-apple and nim fruit

147.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
147.t: man mukh vaseh tis jis too(n) chit na aavahee ||
147.e: these bitter poisons lodge in the minds and mouths of those who do not remember You

147.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੰਢਨਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
147.t: naanak kaheeaai kis ha(n)ddan karamaa baahare ||1||
147.e: O Nanak, how shall I tell them this? Without the karma of good deeds, they are only destroying themselves. ||1||

147.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
147.e: First Mehla:

147.g: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚ ॥
147.t: mat pa(n)kheroo kirat saath kab utam kab neech ||
147.e: The intellect is a bird; on account of its actions, it is sometimes high, and sometimes low.

148.g: ਕਬ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਕਬ ਅਕਿ ਡਾਲਿ ਕਬ ਉਚੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
148.t: kab cha(n)dhan kab ak ddaal kab uchee pareet ||
148.e: Sometimes it is perched on the sandalwood tree, and sometimes it is on the branch of the poisonous swallow-wort. Sometimes, it soars through the heavens.

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲਗੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
148.t: naanak hukam chalaieeaai saahib lagee reet ||2||
148.e: O Nanak, our Lord and Master leads us on, according to the Hukam of His Command; such is His Way. ||2||

148.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
148.t: pauRee ||
148.e: Pauree:

148.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਾਣ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.t: kete kaheh vakhaan keh keh jaavanaa ||
148.e: Some speak and expound, and while speaking and lecturing, they pass away.

148.g: ਵੇਦ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਖਿਆਣ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.t: vedh kaheh vakhiaan a(n)t na paavanaa ||
148.e: The Vedas speak and expound on the Lord, but they do not know His limits.

148.g: ਪੜਿਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਬੁਝਿਐ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.t: paRiaai naahee bhedh bujhiaai paavanaa ||
148.e: Not by studying, but through understanding, is the Lord's Mystery revealed.

148.g: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਭੇਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.t: khaT dharasan kai bhekh kisai sach samaavanaa ||
148.e: There are six pathways in the Shaastras, but how rare are those who merge in the True Lord through them.

148.g: ਸਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.t: sachaa purakh alakh sabadh suhaavanaa ||
148.e: The True Lord is Unknowable; through the Word of His Shabad, we are embellished.

148.g: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਸੰਖ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.t: ma(n)ne naau bisa(n)kh dharageh paavanaa ||
148.e: One who believes in the Name of the Infinite Lord, attains the Court of the Lord.

148.g: ਖਾਲਕ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਢਾਢੀ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
148.t: khaalak kau aadhes ddaaddee gaavanaa ||
148.e: I humbly bow to the Creator Lord; I am a minstrel singing His Praises.

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੧॥
148.t: naanak jug jug ek ma(n)n vasaavanaa ||21||
148.e: Nanak enshrines the Lord within his mind. He is the One, throughout the ages. ||21||

148.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
148.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
148.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

148.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਠੂਹਿਆ ਨਾਗੀ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀ ਆਪਣੈ ਦੇ ਕੂਚਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
148.t: ma(n)tree hoi aThoohiaa naagee lagai jai || aapan hathee aapanai dhe koochaa aape lai ||
148.e: Those who charm scorpions and handle snakes only brand themselves with their own hands.

148.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਅਤੀ ਹੂ ਧਕਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
148.t: hukam piaa dhur khasam kaa atee hoo dhakaa khai ||
148.e: By the pre-ordained Order of our Lord and Master, they are beaten badly, and struck down.

148.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੜੈ ਡੁਬੈ ਹਕਿ ਨਿਆਇ ॥
148.t: gurmukh siau manmukh aRai ddubai hak niaai ||
148.e: If the self-willed manmukhs fight with the Gurmukh, they are condemned by the Lord, the True Judge.

148.g: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
148.t: dhuhaa siriaa aape khasam vekhai kar viaupai ||
148.e: He Himself is the Lord and Master of both worlds. He beholds all and makes the exact determination.

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
148.t: naanak evai jaaneeaai sabh kichh tiseh rajai ||1||
148.e: O Nanak, know this well: everything is in accordance with His Will. ||1||

148.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
148.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
148.e: Second Mehla:

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਤਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
148.t: naanak parakhe aap kau taa paarakh jaan ||
148.e: O Nanak, if someone judges himself, only then is he known as a real judge.

148.g: ਰੋਗੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਦੋਵੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਤਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
148.t: rog dhaaroo dhovai bujhai taa vaidh sujaan ||
148.e: If someone understands both the disease and the medicine, only then is he a wise physician.

148.g: ਵਾਟ ਨ ਕਰਈ ਮਾਮਲਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
148.t: vaaT na kariee maamalaa jaanai mihamaan ||
148.e: Do not involve yourself in idle business on the way; remember that you are only a guest here.

148.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਾਣਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਾਣੁ ॥
148.t: mool jaan galaa kare haan laae haan ||
148.e: Speak with those who know the Primal Lord, and renounce your evil ways.

148.g: ਲਬਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸੋ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
148.t: lab na chaliee sach rahai so visaT paravaan ||
148.e: That virtuous person who does not walk in the way of greed, and who abides in Truth, is accepted and famous.

148.g: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੇ ਆਗਾਸ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬਾਣੁ ॥
148.t: sar sa(n)dhe aagaas kau kiau pahuchai baan ||
148.e: If an arrow is shot at the sky, how can it reach there?

148.g: ਅਗੈ ਓਹੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹੇਦੜੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
148.t: agai oh aga(n)m hai vaahedhaR jaan ||2||
148.e: The sky above is unreachable-know this well, O archer! ||2||

148.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
148.t: pauRee ||
148.e: Pauree:

148.g: ਨਾਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
148.t: naaree purakh piaar prem seegaareeaa ||
148.e: The soul-bride loves her Husband Lord; she is embellished with His Love.

148.g: ਕਰਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਰਹਨੀ ਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
148.t: karan bhagat dhin raat na rahanee vaareeaa ||
148.e: She worships Him day and night; she cannot be restrained from doing so.

148.g: ਮਹਲਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
148.t: mahalaa ma(n)jh nivaas sabadh savaareeaa ||
148.e: In the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, she has made her home; she is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

148.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਹਨਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
148.t: sach kahan aradhaas se vechaareeaa ||
148.e: She is humble, and she offers her true and sincere prayer.

148.g: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
148.t: sohan khasamai paas hukam sidhaareeaa ||
148.e: She is beautiful in the Company of her Lord and Master; she walks in the Way of His Will.

148.g: ਸਖੀ ਕਹਨਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
148.t: sakhee kahan aradhaas manahu piaareeaa ||
148.e: With her dear friends, she offers her heart-felt prayers to her Beloved.

148.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
148.t: bin naavai dhirag vaas fiTu su jeeviaa ||
148.e: Cursed is that home, and shameful is that life, which is without the Name of the Lord.

148.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਿਆ ॥੨੨॥
148.t: sabadh savaareeaas a(n)mrit peeviaa ||22||
148.e: But she who is adorned with the Word of His Shabad, drinks in the Amrit of His Nectar. ||22||

148.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
148.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
148.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

148.g: ਮਾਰੂ ਮੀਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਅਗੀ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਭੁਖ ॥
148.t: maaroo meeh na tirapatiaa agee lahai na bhukh ||
148.e: The desert is not satisfied by rain, and the fire is not quenched by desire.

148.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਸਾਇਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਿਸੁਕ ॥
148.t: raajaa raaj na tirapatiaa sair bhare kisuk ||
148.e: The king is not satisfied with his kingdom, and the oceans are full, but still they thirst for more.

148.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਕੇਤੀ ਪੁਛਾ ਪੁਛ ॥੧॥
148.t: naanak sache naam kee ketee puchhaa puchh ||1||
148.e: O Nanak, how many times must I seek and ask for the True Name? ||1||

148.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
148.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
148.e: Second Mehla:

148.g: ਨਿਹਫਲੰ ਤਸਿ ਜਨਮਸਿ ਜਾਵਤੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨ ਬਿੰਦਤੇ ॥
148.t: nihafala(n) tas janamas jaavat braham na bi(n)dhate ||
148.e: Life is useless, as long as one does not know the Lord God.

148.g: ਸਾਗਰੰ ਸੰਸਾਰਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰਹਿ ਕੇ ॥
148.t: saagara(n) sa(n)saaras gur parasaadhee tareh ke ||
148.e: Only a few cross over the world-ocean, by Guru's Grace.

148.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
148.t: karan kaaran samarath hai kahu naanak beechaar ||
148.e: The Lord is the All-powerful Cause of causes, says Nanak after deep deliberation.

148.g: ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਖੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
148.t: kaaran karate vas hai jin kal rakhee dhaar ||2||
148.e: The creation is subject to the Creator, who sustains it by His Almighty Power. ||2||

148.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
148.t: pauRee ||
148.e: Pauree:

148.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ਢਾਢੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
148.t: khasamai kai dharabaar ddaaddee vasiaa ||
148.e: In the Court of the Lord and Master, His minstrels dwell.

148.g: ਸਚਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਲਾਣਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ॥
148.t: sachaa khasam kalaan kamal vigasiaa ||
148.e: Singing the Praises of their True Lord and Master, the lotuses of their hearts have blossomed forth.

148.g: ਖਸਮਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇ ਮਨਹੁ ਰਹਸਿਆ ॥
148.t: khasamahu pooraa pai manahu rahasiaa ||
148.e: Obtaining their Perfect Lord and Master, their minds are transfixed with ecstasy.

148.g: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਕਢੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਸਰਸਿਆ ॥
148.t: dhusaman kadde maar sajan sarasiaa ||
148.e: Their enemies have been driven out and subdued, and their friends are very pleased.

148.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ॥
148.t: sachaa satigur sevan sachaa maarag dhasiaa ||
148.e: Those who serve the Truthful True Guru are shown the True Path.

149.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਧਉਸਿਆ ॥
149.t: sachaa sabadh beechaar kaal vidhausiaa ||
149.e: Reflecting on the True Word of the Shabad, death is overcome.

149.g: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
149.t: ddaaddee kathe akath sabadh savaariaa ||
149.e: Speaking the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, one is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
149.t: naanak gun geh raas har jeeau mile piaariaa ||23||
149.e: Nanak holds tight to the Treasure of Virtue, and meets with the Dear, Beloved Lord. ||23||

149.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
149.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
149.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

149.g: ਖਤਿਅਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਤ ਖਤਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
149.t: khatiahu ja(n)me khate karan ta khatiaa vich paeh ||
149.e: Born because of the karma of their past mistakes, they make more mistakes, and fall into mistakes.

149.g: ਧੋਤੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
149.t: dhote mool na utareh je sau dhovan paeh ||
149.e: By washing, their pollution is not removed, even though they may wash hundreds of times.

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
149.t: naanak bakhase bakhase'eeh naeh ta paahee paeh ||1||
149.e: O Nanak, if God forgives, they are forgiven; otherwise, they are kicked and beaten. ||1||

149.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
149.e: First Mehla:

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਛਡਿ ਮੰਗੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
149.t: naanak bolan jhakhanaa dhukh chhadd ma(n)ge'eeh sukh ||
149.e: O Nanak, it is absurd to ask to be spared from pain by begging for comfort.

149.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਿ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨੁਖ ॥
149.t: sukh dhukh dhui dhar kapaRe pahireh jai manukh ||
149.e: Pleasure and pain are the two garments given, to be worn in the Court of the Lord.

149.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਚੰਗੀ ਚੁਪ ॥੨॥
149.t: jithai bolan haareeaai tithai cha(n)gee chup ||2||
149.e: Where you are bound to lose by speaking, there, you ought to remain silent. ||2||

149.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
149.t: pauRee ||
149.e: Pauree:

149.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.t: chaare ku(n)ddaa dhekh a(n)dhar bhaaliaa ||
149.e: After looking around in the four directions, I looked within my own self.

149.g: ਸਚੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਅਲਖਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.t: sachai purakh alakh siraj nihaaliaa ||
149.e: There, I saw the True, Invisible Lord Creator.

149.g: ਉਝੜਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਰਾਹ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.t: aujhaR bhule raeh gur vekhaaliaa ||
149.e: I was wandering in the wilderness, but now the Guru has shown me the Way.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.t: satigur sache vaahu sach samaaliaa ||
149.e: Hail to the True, True Guru, through whom we merge in the Truth.

149.g: ਪਾਇਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਾਹੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.t: paiaa ratan gharaahu dheevaa baaliaa ||
149.e: I have found the jewel within the home of my own self; the lamp within has been lit.

149.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.t: sachai sabadh salaeh sukhe'ee sach vaaliaa ||
149.e: Those who praise the True Word of the Shabad, abide in the peace of Truth.

149.g: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਲਗਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਸਿ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
149.t: niddariaa ddar lag garab s gaaliaa ||
149.e: But those who do not have the Fear of God, are overtaken by fear. They are destroyed by their own pride.

149.g: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
149.t: naavahu bhulaa jag firai betaaliaa ||24||
149.e: Having forgotten the Name, the world is roaming around like a wild demon. ||24||

149.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
149.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
149.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

149.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਭੈ ਮਰੈ ਭੀ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
149.t: bhai vich ja(n)mai bhai marai bhee bhau man meh hoi ||
149.e: In fear we are born, and in fear we die. Fear is always present in the mind.

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
149.t: naanak bhai vich je marai sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
149.e: O Nanak, if one dies in the fear of God, his coming into the world is blessed and approved. ||1||

149.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
149.e: Third Mehla:

149.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
149.t: bhai vin jeevai bahut bahut khuseeaa khusee kamai ||
149.e: Without the fear of God, you may live very, very long, and savor the most enjoyable pleasures.

149.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
149.t: naanak bhai vin je marai muh kaalai uTh jai ||2||
149.e: O Nanak, if you die without the fear of God, you will arise and depart with a blackened face. ||2||

149.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
149.t: pauRee ||
149.e: Pauree:

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
149.t: satigur hoi dhiaal ta saradhaa pooreeaai ||
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, then your desires will be fulfilled.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
149.t: satigur hoi dhiaal na kabahoo(n) jhooreeaai ||
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, you will never grieve.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
149.t: satigur hoi dhiaal taa dhukh na jaaneeaai ||
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, you will know no pain.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
149.t: satigur hoi dhiaal taa har ra(n)g maaneeaai ||
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, you will enjoy the Lord's Love.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
149.t: satigur hoi dhiaal taa jam kaa ddar kehaa ||
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, then why should you fear death?

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
149.t: satigur hoi dhiaal taa sadh hee sukh dhehaa ||
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, the body is always at peace.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
149.t: satigur hoi dhiaal taa nav nidh paieeaai ||
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, the nine treasures are obtained.

149.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੫॥
149.t: satigur hoi dhiaal ta sach samaieeaai ||25||
149.e: When the True Guru is merciful, you shall be absorbed in the True Lord. ||25||

149.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
149.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
149.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

149.g: ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਪੀਅਹਿ ਮਲਵਾਣੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
149.t: sir khohai pe'eeh malavaanee jooThaa ma(n)g ma(n)g khaahee ||
149.e: They pluck the hair out of their heads, and drink in filthy water; they beg endlessly and eat the garbage which others have thrown away.

149.g: ਫੋਲਿ ਫਦੀਹਤਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਭੜਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਾਹੀ ॥
149.t: fol fadheehat muh lain bhaRaasaa paanee dhekh sagaahee ||
149.e: They spread manure, they suck in rotting smells, and they are afraid of clean water.

149.g: ਭੇਡਾ ਵਾਗੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇਨਿ ਭਰੀਅਨਿ ਹਥ ਸੁਆਹੀ ॥
149.t: bheddaa vaagee sir khohain bhareean hath suaahee ||
149.e: Their hands are smeared with ashes, and the hair on their heads is plucked out-they are like sheep!

149.g: ਮਾਊ ਪੀਊ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਨਿ ਟਬਰ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
149.t: maauoo peeuoo kirat gavain Tabar rovan dhaahee ||
149.e: They have renounced the lifestyle of their mothers and fathers, and their families and relatives cry out in distress.

149.g: ਓਨਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਨ ਦੀਵਾ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
149.t: onaa pi(n)dd na patal kiriaa na dheevaa mue kithaauoo paahee ||
149.e: No one offers the rice dishes at their last rites, and no one lights the lamps for them. After their death, where will they be sent?

149.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਨਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
149.t: aThasaTh teerath dhen na ddoiee brahaman a(n)n na khaahee ||
149.e: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage give them no place of protection, and no Brahmin will eat their food.

149.g: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
149.t: sadhaa kucheel raheh dhin raatee mathai Tike naahee ||
149.e: They remain polluted forever, day and night; they do not apply the ceremonial tilak mark to their foreheads.

149.g: ਝੁੰਡੀ ਪਾਇ ਬਹਨਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਮਰਣੈ ਦੜਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
149.t: jhu(n)ddee pai bahan nit maranai dhaR dheebaan na jaahee ||
149.e: They sit together in silence, as if in mourning; they do not go to the Lord's Court.

149.g: ਲਕੀ ਕਾਸੇ ਹਥੀ ਫੁੰਮਣ ਅਗੋ ਪਿਛੀ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
149.t: lakee kaase hathee fu(n)man ago pichhee jaahee ||
149.e: With their begging bowls hanging from their waists, and their fly-brushes in their hands, they walk along in single file.

149.g: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੰਗਮ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁੰਲਾ ॥
149.t: naa oi jogee naa oi ja(n)gam naa oi kaajee mu(n)laa ||
149.e: They are not Yogis, and they are not Jangams, followers of Shiva. They are not Qazis or Mullahs.

150.g: ਦਯਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਫਿਟਾ ਵਤੈ ਗਲਾ ॥
150.t: dhay vigoe fireh vigute fiTaa vatai galaa ||
150.e: Ruined by the Merciful Lord, they wander around in disgrace, and their entire troop is contaminated.

150.g: ਜੀਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਖੈ ॥
150.t: jeeaa maar jeevaale soiee avar na koiee rakhai ||
150.e: The Lord alone kills and restores to life; no one else can protect anyone from Him.

150.g: ਦਾਨਹੁ ਤੈ ਇਸਨਾਨਹੁ ਵੰਜੇ ਭਸੁ ਪਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਖੁਥੈ ॥
150.t: dhaanahu tai isanaanahu va(n)je bhas piee sir khuthai ||
150.e: They go without giving alms or any cleansing baths; their shaven heads become covered with dust.

150.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਰਤਨ ਉਪੰਨੇ ਮੇਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਮਾਧਾਣੀ ॥
150.t: paanee vichahu ratan upa(n)ne mer keeaa maadhaanee ||
150.e: The jewel emerged from the water, when the mountain of gold was used to churn it.

150.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਪੁਰਬੀ ਲਗੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
150.t: aThasaTh teerath dhevee thaape purabee lagai baanee ||
150.e: The gods established the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the festivals are celebrated and hymns are chanted.

150.g: ਨਾਇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਨਾਤੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
150.t: nai nivaajaa naatai poojaa naavan sadhaa sujaanee ||
150.e: After bathing, the Muslims recite their prayers, and after bathing, the Hindus perform their worship services. The wise always take cleansing baths.

150.g: ਮੁਇਆ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
150.t: muiaa jeevadhiaa gat hovai jaa(n) sir paieeaai paanee ||
150.e: At the time of death, and at the time of birth, they are purified, when water is poured on their heads.

150.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਸੈਤਾਨੀ ਏਨਾ ਗਲ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
150.t: naanak sirakhuthe saitaanee enaa gal na bhaanee ||
150.e: O Nanak, the shaven-headed ones are devils. They are not pleased to hear these words.

150.g: ਵੁਠੈ ਹੋਇਐ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
150.t: vuThai hoiaai hoi bilaaval jeeaa jugat samaanee ||
150.e: When it rains, there is happiness. Water is the key to all life.

150.g: ਵੁਠੈ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਕਪਾਹਾ ਸਭਸੈ ਪੜਦਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
150.t: vuThai a(n)n kamaadh kapaahaa sabhasai paRadhaa hovai ||
150.e: When it rains, the corn grows, and the sugar cane, and the cotton, which provides clothing for all.

150.g: ਵੁਠੈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਹੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਵੈ ॥
150.t: vuThai ghaahu chareh nit surahee saa dhan dhahee vilovai ||
150.e: When it rains, the cows always have grass to graze upon, and housewives can churn the milk into butter.

150.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਿਇ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਸਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਇਐ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
150.t: tit ghi hom jag sadh poojaa piaai kaaraj sohai ||
150.e: With that ghee, sacred feasts and worship services are performed; all these efforts are blessed.

150.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਨਦੀ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖੀ ਨਾਤੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
150.t: guroo samu(n)dh nadhee sabh sikhee naatai jit vaddiaaiee ||
150.e: The Guru is the ocean, and all His Teachings are the river. Bathing within it, glorious greatness is obtained.

150.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਸਿਰਖੁਥੇ ਨਾਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਸਤ ਚਟੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ॥੧॥
150.t: naanak je sirakhuthe naavan naahee taa sat chaTe sir chhaiee ||1||
150.e: O Nanak, if the shaven-headed ones do not bathe, then seven handfuls of ashes are upon their heads. ||1||

150.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
150.e: Second Mehla:

150.g: ਅਗੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੇਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
150.t: agee paalaa k kare sooraj kehee raat ||
150.e: What can the cold do to the fire? How can the night affect the sun?

150.g: ਚੰਦ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
150.t: cha(n)dh aneraa k kare paun paanee kiaa jaat ||
150.e: What can the darkness do to the moon? What can social status do to air and water?

150.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਚੀਜੀ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
150.t: dharatee cheejee k kare jis vich sabh kichh hoi ||
150.e: What are personal possessions to the earth, from which all things are produced?

150.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
150.t: naanak taa pat jaaneeaai jaa pat rakhai soi ||2||
150.e: O Nanak, he alone is known as honorable, whose honor the Lord preserves. ||2||

150.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
150.t: pauRee ||
150.e: Pauree:

150.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਚੇ ਸੁਬਹਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਲਾਣਿਆ ॥
150.t: tudh sache subahaan sadhaa kalaaniaa ||
150.e: It is of You, O my True and Wondrous Lord, that I sing forever.

150.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
150.t: too(n) sachaa dheebaan hor aavan jaaniaa ||
150.e: Yours is the True Court. All others are subject to coming and going.

150.g: ਸਚੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥
150.t: sach j ma(n)geh dhaan s tudhai jehiaa ||
150.e: Those who ask for the gift of the True Name are like You.

150.g: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਿਆ ॥
150.t: sach teraa furamaan sabadhe sohiaa ||
150.e: Your Command is True; we are adorned with the Word of Your Shabad.

150.g: ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੁਧੈ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: ma(n)niaai giaan dhiaan tudhai te paiaa ||
150.e: Through faith and trust, we receive spiritual wisdom and meditation from You.

150.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: karam pavai neesaan na chalai chalaiaa ||
150.e: By Your Grace, the banner of honor is obtained. It cannot be taken away or lost.

150.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: too(n) sachaa dhaataar nit dheveh chaReh savaiaa ||
150.e: You are the True Giver; You give continually. Your Gifts continue to increase.

150.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
150.t: naanak ma(n)gai dhaan jo tudh bhaiaa ||26||
150.e: Nanak begs for that gift which is pleasing to You. ||26||

150.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
150.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
150.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

150.g: ਦੀਖਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥
150.t: dheekhiaa aakh bujhaiaa sifatee sach sameau ||
150.e: Those who have accepted the Guru's Teachings, and who have found the path, remain absorbed in the Praises of the True Lord.

150.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਦੇਸੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ ॥੧॥
150.t: tin kau kiaa upadheseeaai jin gur naanak dheau ||1||
150.e: What teachings can be imparted to those who have the Divine Guru Nanak as their Guru? ||1||

150.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
150.e: First Mehla:

150.g: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
150.t: aap bujhaae soiee boojhai ||
150.e: We understand the Lord only when He Himself inspires us to understand Him.

150.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
150.t: jis aap sujhaae tis sabh kichh soojhai ||
150.e: He alone knows everything, unto whom the Lord Himself gives knowledge.

150.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
150.t: keh keh kathanaa maiaa loojhai ||
150.e: One may talk and preach and give sermons but still yearn after Maya.

150.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਗਲ ਕਰੇ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
150.t: hukamee sagal kare aakaar ||
150.e: The Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, has created the entire creation.

150.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
150.t: aape jaanai sarab veechaar ||
150.e: He Himself knows the inner nature of all.

150.g: ਅਖਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਖਿਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
150.t: akhar naanak akhio aap ||
150.e: O Nanak, He Himself uttered the Word.

150.g: ਲਹੈ ਭਰਾਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
150.t: lahai bharaat hovai jis dhaat ||2||
150.e: Doubt departs from one who receives this gift. ||2||

150.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
150.t: pauRee ||
150.e: Pauree:

150.g: ਹਉ ਢਾਢੀ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: hau ddaaddee vekaar kaarai laiaa ||
150.e: I was a minstrel, out of work, when the Lord took me into His service.

150.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਕੈ ਵਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: raat dhihai kai vaar dhurahu furamaiaa ||
150.e: To sing His Praises day and night, He gave me His Order, right from the start.

150.g: ਢਾਢੀ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਸਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: ddaaddee sachai mahal khasam bulaiaa ||
150.e: My Lord and Master has summoned me, His minstrel, to the True Mansion of His Presence.

150.g: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਕਪੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: sachee sifat saalaeh kapaRaa paiaa ||
150.e: He has dressed me in the robes of His True Praise and Glory.

150.g: ਸਚਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
150.t: sachaa a(n)mirat naam bhojan aaiaa ||
150.e: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name has become my food.

150.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਖਾਧਾ ਰਜਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: gurmatee khaadhaa raj tin sukh paiaa ||
150.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings, who eat this food and are satisfied, find peace.

150.g: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
150.t: ddaaddee kare pasaau sabadh vajaiaa ||
150.e: His minstrel spreads His Glory, singing and vibrating the Word of His Shabad.

150.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੭॥ ਸੁਧੁ
150.t: naanak sach saalaeh pooraa paiaa ||27|| sudhu
150.e: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, I have obtained His Perfection. ||27||Sudh||

151.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ
151.t: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe dhupadhe
151.e: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay & Dho-Padhay:

151.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
151.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
151.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
The Fear of God is overpowering, and so very heavy,
while the intellect is lightweight, as is the speech one speaks.
So place the Fear of God upon your head, and bear that weight;
by the Grace of the Merciful Lord, contemplate the Guru. ||1||

151.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲੰਘਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
151.t: bhai bin koi na la(n)ghas paar ||
151.e: Without the Fear of God, no one crosses over the world-ocean.

151.g: ਭੈ ਭਉ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
151.t: bhai bhau raakhiaa bhai savaar ||1|| rahaau ||
151.e: This Fear of God adorns the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

151.g: ਭੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
151.t: bhai tan agan bhakhai bhai naal ||
151.e: The fire of fear within the body is burnt away by the Fear of God.
Through this Fear of God, we are adorned with the Word of the Shabad.
Without the Fear of God, all that is fashioned is false.
Useless is the mold, and useless are the hammer-strokes on the mold. ||2||
The desire for the worldly drama arises in the intellect,
but even with thousands of clever mental tricks, the heat of the Fear of God does not come into play.
O Nanak, the speech of the self-willed manmukh is just wind.
His words are worthless and empty, like the wind. ||3||1||
Gauree, First Mehla:

151.g: ਡਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
151.t: ddar ghar ghar ddar ddar ddar jai ||
151.e: Place the Fear of God within the home of your heart; with this Fear of God in your heart, all other fears shall be frightened away.

151.g: ਸੋ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਡਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
151.t: so ddar kehaa jit ddar ddar pai ||
151.e: What sort of fear is that, which frightens other fears?
Without You, I have other place of rest at all.

151.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
151.t: jo kichh varatai sabh teree rajai ||1||
151.e: Whatever happens is all according to Your Will. ||1||
Be afraid, if you have any fear, other than the Fear of God.

151.g: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਡਰਣਾ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
151.t: ddar ddar ddaranaa man kaa sor ||1|| rahaau ||
151.e: Afraid of fear, and living in fear, the mind is held in tumult. ||1||Pause||

151.g: ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਡੂਬੈ ਤਰੈ ॥
151.t: naa jeeau marai na ddoobai tarai ||
151.e: The soul does not die; it does not drown, and it does not swim across.

151.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
151.t: jin kichh keeaa so kichh karai ||
151.e: The One who created everything does everything.
By the Hukam of His Command we come, and by the Hukam of His Command we go.
Before and after, His Command is pervading. ||2||
Cruelty, attachment, desire and egotism

151.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਭੂਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨੈ ਸਾਨੁ ॥
151.t: tis vich bhookh bahut nai saan ||
151.e: there is great hunger in these, like the raging torrent of a wild stream.
Let the Fear of God be your food, drink and support.
Without doing this, the fools simply die. ||3||

151.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਕੋਇ ॥
151.t: jis kaa koi koiee koi koi ||
151.e: If anyone really has anyone else - how rare is that person!

151.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
151.t: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhanaa kaa soi ||
151.e: All are Yours - You are the Lord of all.

151.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
151.t: jaa ke jeea ja(n)t dhan maal ||
151.e: All beings and creatures, wealth and property belong to Him.
O Nanak, it is so difficult to describe and contemplate Him. ||4||2||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Let wisdom be your mother, and contentment your father.
Let Truth be your brother - these are your best relatives. ||1||

151.g: ਕਹਣਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
151.t: kahanaa hai kichh kahan na jai ||
151.e: He has been described, but He cannot be described at all.

151.g: ਤਉ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
151.t: tau kudharat keemat nahee pai ||1|| rahaau ||
151.e: Your All-pervading creative nature cannot be estimated. ||1||Pause||

152.e: Modesty, humility and intuitive understanding are my mother-in-law and father-in-law;
I have made good deeds my spouse. ||2||
Union with the Holy is my wedding date, and separation from the world is my marriage.
Says Nanak, Truth is the child born of this Union. ||3||3||
Gauree, First Mehla:
The union of air, water and fire
the body is the play-thing of the fickle and unsteady intellect.
It has nine doors, and then there is the Tenth Gate.
Reflect upon this and understand it, O wise one. ||1||
The Lord is the One who speaks, teaches and listens.

152.g: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
152.t: aap beechaare su giaanee hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
152.e: One who contemplates his own self is truly wise. ||1||Pause||
The body is dust; the wind speaks through it.

152.g: ਬੁਝੁ ਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੂਆ ਹੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
152.t: bujh re giaanee mooaa hai kaun ||
152.e: Understand, O wise one, who has died.
Awareness, conflict and ego have died,
but the One who sees does not die. ||2||
For the sake of it, you journey to sacred shrines and holy rivers;
but this priceless jewel is within your own heart.
The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read endlessly; they stir up arguments and controversies,
but they do not know the secret deep within. ||3||

152.g: ਹਉ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੁਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
152.t: hau na mooaa meree muiee balai ||
152.e: I have not died - that evil nature within me has died.

152.g: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਮੂਆ ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
152.t: oh na mooaa jo rahiaa samai ||
152.e: The One who is pervading everywhere does not die.
Says Nanak, the Guru has revealed God to me,
and now I see that there is no such thing as birth or death. ||4||4||
Gauree, First Mehla, Dakhanee:

152.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
152.t: sun sun boojhai maanai naau || taa kai sadh balihaarai jaau ||
152.e: I am forever a sacrifice to the one who listens and hears, who understands and believes in the Name.
When the Lord Himself leads us astray, there is no other place of rest for us to find.
You impart understanding, and You unite us in Your Union. ||1||
I obtain the Naam, which shall go along with me in the end.

152.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਸਭ ਕਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
152.t: bin naavai baadhee sabh kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
152.e: Without the Name, all are held in the grip of Death. ||1||Pause||
My farming and my trading are by the Support of the Name.
The seeds of sin and virtue are bound together.
Sexual desire and anger are the wounds of the soul.
The evil-minded ones forget the Naam, and then depart. ||2||
True are the Teachings of the True Guru.
The body and mind are cooled and soothed, by the touchstone of Truth.
This is the true mark of wisdom: that one remains detached, like the water-lily, or the lotus upon the water.
Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, one becomes sweet, like the juice of the sugar cane. ||3||
By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the castle of the body has ten gates.
The five passions dwell there, together with the Divine Light of the Infinite.
The Lord Himself is the merchandise, and He Himself is the trader.
O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are adorned and rejuvenated. ||4||5||
Gauree, First Mehla:
How can we know where we came from?
Where did we originate, and where will we go and merge?
How are we bound, and how do we obtain liberation?
How do we merge with intuitive ease into the Eternal, Imperishable Lord? ||1||
With the Naam in the heart and the Ambrosial Naam on our lips,
through the Name of the Lord, we rise above desire, like the Lord. ||1||Pause||
With intuitive ease we come, and with intuitive ease we depart.

152.g: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
152.t: man te upajai man maeh samai ||
152.e: From the mind we originate, and into the mind we are absorbed.
As Gurmukh, we are liberated, and are not bound.
Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, we are emancipated through the Name of the Lord. ||2||
At night, lots of birds settle on the tree.
Some are happy, and some are sad. Caught in the desires of the mind, they perish.
And when the life-night comes to its end, then they look to the sky.
They fly away in all ten directions, according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||3||

153.e: Those who are committed to the Naam, see the world as merely a temporary pasture.
Sexual desire and anger are broken, like a jar of poison.
Without the merchandise of the Name, the house of the body and the store of the mind are empty.
Meeting the Guru, the hard and heavy doors are opened. ||4||
One meets the Holy Saint only through perfect destiny.
The Lord's perfect people rejoice in the Truth.

153.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇ ਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
153.t: man tan dhe lai sahaj subhai ||
153.e: Surrendering their minds and bodies, they find the Lord with intuitive ease.
Nanak falls at their feet. ||5||6||
Gauree, First Mehla:
The conscious mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya.
The conscious mind is awake only to falsehood, corruption and attachment.
It gathers in the assets of sin and greed.
So swim across the river of life, O my mind, with the Sacred Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

153.g: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
153.t: vaahu vaahu saache mai teree Tek ||
153.e: Waaho! Waaho! - Great! Great is my True Lord! I seek Your All-powerful Support.

153.g: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
153.t: hau paapee too(n) niramal ek ||1|| rahaau ||
153.e: I am a sinner - You alone are pure. ||1||Pause||
Fire and water join together, and the breath roars in its fury!
The tongue and the sex organs each seek to taste.
The eyes which look upon corruption do not know the Love and the Fear of God.
Conquering self-conceit, one obtains the Name. ||2||

153.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
153.t: sabadh marai fir maran na hoi ||
153.e: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, shall never again have to die.
Without such a death, how can one attain perfection?
The mind is engrossed in deception, treachery and duality.
Whatever the Immortal Lord does, comes to pass. ||3||
So get aboard that boat when your turn comes.
Those who fail to embark upon that boat shall be beaten in the Court of the Lord.
Blessed is that Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, where the Praises of the True Lord are sung.
O Nanak, the One Creator Lord is pervading hearth and home. ||4||7||
Gauree, First Mehla:
The inverted heart-lotus has been turned upright, through reflective meditation on God.
From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.
The Lord Himself is pervading the three worlds. ||1||

153.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
153.t: re man mere bharam na keejai ||
153.e: O my mind, do not give in to doubt.

153.g: ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
153.t: man maaniaai a(n)mirat ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
153.e: When the mind surrenders to the Name, it drinks in the essence of Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
So win the game of life; let your mind surrender and accept death.

153.g: ਆਪਿ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
153.t: aap mooaa man man te jaaniaa ||
153.e: When the self dies, the individual mind comes to know the Supreme Mind.

153.g: ਨਜਰਿ ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
153.t: najar bhiee ghar ghar te jaaniaa ||2||
153.e: As the inner vision is awakened, one comes to know one's own home, deep within the self. ||2||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is austerity, chastity and cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
What good are ostentatious displays?
The All-pervading Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

153.g: ਆਨ ਮਨਉ ਤਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਉ ॥
153.t: aan manau tau par ghar jaau ||
153.e: If I had faith in someone else, then I would go to that one's house.
But where should I go, to beg? There is no other place for me.
O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||4||8||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Meeting the True Guru, we are shown the way to die.
Remaining alive in this death brings joy deep within.
Overcoming egotistical pride, the Tenth Gate is found. ||1||
Death is pre-ordained - no one who comes can remain here.

153.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
153.t: har jap jaap rahan har saranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
153.e: So chant and meditate on the Lord, and remain in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Meeting the True Guru, duality is dispelled.

153.g: ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
153.t: kamal bigaas man har prabh laagai ||
153.e: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mind is attached to the Lord God.
One who remains dead while yet alive obtains the greatest happiness hereafter. ||2||
Meeting the True Guru, one becomes truthful, chaste and pure.
Climbing up the steps of the Guru's Path, one becomes the highest of the high.

153.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੩॥
153.t: karam milai jam kaa bhau moochaa ||3||
153.e: When the Lord grants His Mercy, the fear of death is conquered. ||3||
Uniting in Guru's Union, we are absorbed in His Loving Embrace.
Granting His Grace, He reveals the Mansion of His Presence, within the home of the self.
O Nanak, conquering egotism, we are absorbed into the Lord. ||4||9||

154.e: Gauree, First Mehla:
Past actions cannot be erased.
What do we know of what will happen hereafter?
Whatever pleases Him shall come to pass.
There is no other Doer except Him. ||1||

154.g: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਰਮ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
154.t: naa jaanaa karam kevadd teree dhaat ||
154.e: I do not know about karma, or how great Your gifts are.

154.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
154.t: karam dharam tere naam kee jaat ||1|| rahaau ||
154.e: The karma of actions, the Dharma of righteousness, social class and status, are contained within Your Name. ||1||Pause||
You are So Great, O Giver, O Great Giver!
The treasure of Your devotional worship is never exhausted.
One who takes pride in himself shall never be right.
The soul and body are all at Your disposal. ||2||
You kill and rejuvenate. You forgive and merge us into Yourself.
As it pleases You, You inspire us to chant Your Name.

154.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
154.t: too(n) dhaanaa beenaa saachaa sir merai ||
154.e: You are All-knowing, All-seeing and True, O my Supreme Lord.
Please, bless me with the Guru's Teachings; my faith is in You alone. ||3||

154.g: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
154.t: tan meh mail naahee man raataa ||
154.e: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord, has no pollution in his body.
Through the Guru's Word, the True Shabad is realized.
All Power is Yours, through the greatness of Your Name.
Nanak abides in the Sanctuary of Your devotees. ||4||10||
Gauree, First Mehla:
Those who speak the Unspoken, drink in the Nectar.
Other fears are forgotten, and they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Why should we fear, when fear is dispelled by the Fear of God?

154.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
154.t: poore gur kai sabadh pachhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
154.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru, I recognize God. ||1||Pause||

154.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
154.t: jis nar raam ridhai har raas || sahaj subhai mile saabaas ||2||
154.e: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's essence are blessed and acclaimed, and intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||2||
Those whom the Lord puts to sleep, evening and morning
- those self-willed manmukhs are bound and gagged by Death, here and hereafter. ||3||
Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, day and night, are perfect.
O Nanak, they merge into the Lord, and their doubts are cast away. ||4||11||
Gauree, First Mehla:
One who loves the three qualities is subject to birth and death.
The four Vedas speak only of the visible forms.
They describe and explain the three states of mind,
but the fourth state, union with the Lord, is known only through the True Guru. ||1||
Through devotional worship of the Lord, and service to the Guru, one swims across.

154.g: ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
154.t: baahuR janam na hoi hai maranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
154.e: Then, one is not born again, and is not subject to death. ||1||Pause||
Everyone speaks of the four great blessings;
the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Pandits speak of them as well.

154.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਰਥੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
154.t: bin gur arath beechaar na paiaa ||
154.e: But without the Guru, they do not understand their true significance.
The treasure of liberation is obtained through devotional worship of the Lord. ||2||

154.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
154.t: jaa kai hiradhai vasiaa har soiee ||
154.e: Those, within whose hearts the Lord dwells,
become Gurmukh; they receive the blessings of devotional worship.
Through devotional worship of the Lord, liberation and bliss are obtained.
Through the Guru's Teachings, supreme ecstasy is obtained. ||3||
One who meets the Guru, beholds Him, and inspires others to behold Him as well.
In the midst of hope, the Guru teaches us to live above hope and desire.
He is the Master of the meek, the Giver of peace to all.
Nanak's mind is imbued with the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||
Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

154.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਬਾਜੀ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
154.t: a(n)mirat kaiaa rahai sukhaalee baajee ih sa(n)saaro ||
154.e: With your nectar-like body, you live in comfort, but this world is just a passing drama.

154.g: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
154.t: lab lobh much kooR kamaaveh bahut uThaaveh bhaaro ||
154.e: You practice greed, avarice and great falsehood, and you carry such a heavy burden.

154.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਰੁਲਦੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਜਿਉ ਧਰ ਉਪਰਿ ਛਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
154.t: too(n) kaiaa mai ruladhee dhekhee jiau dhar upar chhaaro ||1||
154.e: O body, I have seen you blowing away like dust on the earth. ||1||
Listen - listen to my advice!

154.g: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਰਹਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
154.t: sukirat keetaa rahasee mere jeeaRe bahuR na aavai vaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
154.e: Only the good deeds which you have done shall remain with you, O my soul. This opportunity shall not come again! ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
155.t: hau tudh aakhaa meree kaiaa too(n) sun sikh hamaaree ||
155.e: I say to you, O my body: listen to my advice!

155.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਚਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਝੂਠੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੀ ॥
155.t: ni(n)dhaa chi(n)dhaa kareh paraiee jhooThee laitabaaree ||
155.e: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip.

155.g: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਜੋਹਹਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
155.t: vel paraiee joheh jeeaRe kareh choree buriaaree ||
155.e: You gaze upon the wives of others, O my soul; you steal and commit evil deeds.

155.g: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਹੀਏਹਿ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਹੋਈਅਹਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
155.t: ha(n)s chaliaa too(n) pichhai rahe'eeh chhuTaR hoie'eeh naaree ||2||
155.e: But when the swan departs, you shall remain behind, like an abandoned woman. ||2||

155.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਹੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
155.t: too(n) kaiaa rahe'eeh supana(n)tar tudh kiaa karam kamaiaa ||
155.e: O body, you are living in a dream! What good deeds have you done?

155.g: ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਮੈ ਜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਆ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
155.t: kar choree mai jaa kichh leeaa taa man bhalaa bhaiaa ||
155.e: When I stole something by deception, then my mind was pleased.

155.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਲਤਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
155.t: halat na sobhaa palat na ddoiee ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||3||
155.e: I have no honor in this world, and I shall find no shelter in the world hereafter. My life has been lost, wasted in vain! ||3||

155.g: ਹਉ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਬਾਬਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
155.t: hau kharee dhuhelee hoiee baabaa naanak meree baat na puchhai koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
155.e: I am totally miserable! O Baba Nanak, no one cares for me at all! ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਤਾਜੀ ਤੁਰਕੀ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਰੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
155.t: taajee turakee suinaa rupaa kapaR kere bhaaraa ||
155.e: Turkish horses, gold, silver and loads of gorgeous clothes

155.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਝੜਿ ਝੜਿ ਪਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
155.t: kis hee naal na chale naanak jhaR jhaR pe gavaaraa ||
155.e: - none of these shall go with you, O Nanak. They are lost and left behind, you fool!

155.g: ਕੂਜਾ ਮੇਵਾ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
155.t: koojaa mevaa mai sabh kichh chaakhiaa ik a(n)mrit naam tumaaraa ||4||
155.e: I have tasted all the sugar candy and sweets, but Your Name alone is Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||

155.g: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਨੀਵ ਦਿਵਾਲ ਉਸਾਰੀ ਭਸਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
155.t: dhe dhe neev dhivaal usaaree bhasama(n)dhar kee dderee ||
155.e: Digging deep foundations, the walls are constructed, but in the end, the buildings return to heaps of dust.

155.g: ਸੰਚੇ ਸੰਚਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
155.t: sa(n)che sa(n)ch na dheiee kis hee a(n)dh jaanai sabh meree ||
155.e: People gather and hoard their possessions, and give nothing to anyone else - the poor fools think that everything is theirs.

155.g: ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਸੋਇਨ ਮਾੜੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੫॥
155.t: soin la(n)kaa soin maaRee sa(n)pai kisai na keree ||5||
155.e: Riches do not remain with anyone - not even the golden palaces of Sri Lanka. ||5||

155.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੰਨ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥
155.t: sun moorakh ma(n)n ajaanaa ||
155.e: Listen, you foolish and ignorant mind

155.g: ਹੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
155.t: hog tisai kaa bhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
155.e: - only His Will prevails. ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
155.t: saahu hamaaraa Thaakur bhaaraa ham tis ke vanajaare ||
155.e: My Banker is the Great Lord and Master. I am only His petty merchant.

155.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਰਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੩॥
155.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh raas tisai kee maar aape jeevaale ||6||1||13||
155.e: This soul and body all are His. He Himself kills, and brings back to life. ||6||1||13||

155.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
155.t: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
155.e: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

155.g: ਅਵਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਹਮ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਖਉ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
155.t: avar pa(n)ch ham ek janaa kiau raakhau ghar baar manaa ||
155.e: There are five of them, but I am all alone. How can I protect my hearth and home, O my mind?

155.g: ਮਾਰਹਿ ਲੂਟਹਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
155.t: maareh looTeh neet neet kis aagai karee pukaar janaa ||1||
155.e: They are beating and plundering me over and over again; unto whom can I complain? ||1||

155.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਚਰੁ ਮਨਾ ॥
155.t: sree raam naamaa uchar manaa ||
155.e: Chant the Name of the Supreme Lord, O my mind.

155.g: ਆਗੈ ਜਮ ਦਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
155.t: aagai jam dhal bikham ghanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
155.e: Otherwise, in the world hereafter, you will have to face the awesome and cruel army of Death. ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਉਸਾਰਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਸਾ ਧਨਾ ॥
155.t: ausaar maRolee raakhai dhuaaraa bheetar baiThee saa dhanaa ||
155.e: God has erected the temple of the body; He has placed the nine doors, and the soul-bride sits within.

155.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਲੁਟੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੨॥
155.t: a(n)mirat kel kare nit kaaman avar luTen su pa(n)ch janaa ||2||
155.e: She enjoys the sweet play again and again, while the five demons are plundering her. ||2||

155.g: ਢਾਹਿ ਮੜੋਲੀ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਪਕੜੀ ਏਕ ਜਨਾ ॥
155.t: ddaeh maRolee looTiaa dhehuraa saa dhan pakaRee ek janaa ||
155.e: In this way, the temple is being demolished; the body is being plundered, and the soul-bride, left all alone, is captured.

155.g: ਜਮ ਡੰਡਾ ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਪੜਿਆ ਭਾਗਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
155.t: jam dda(n)ddaa gal sa(n)gal paRiaa bhaag ge se pa(n)ch janaa ||3||
155.e: Death strikes her down with his rod, the shackles are placed around her neck, and now the five have left. ||3||

155.g: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲੋੜੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਲੁੜੇਨਿ ਸੁ ਖਾਧਾਤਾ ॥
155.t: kaaman loRai suinaa rupaa mitr luRen su khaadhaataa ||
155.e: The wife yearns for gold and silver, and her friends, the senses, yearn for good food.

155.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
155.t: naanak paap kare tin kaaran jaasee jamapur baadhaataa ||4||2||14||
155.e: O Nanak, she commits sins for their sake; she shall go, bound and gagged, to the City of Death. ||4||2||14||

155.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
155.t: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
155.e: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

155.g: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਤੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਖਿੰਥਾਤਾ ॥
155.t: mu(n)dhraa te ghaT bheetar mu(n)dhraa kaa(n)iaa keejai khi(n)thaataa ||
155.e: Let your ear-rings be those ear-rings which pierce deep within your heart. Let your body be your patched coat.

155.g: ਪੰਚ ਚੇਲੇ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਜਹਿ ਰਾਵਲ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਡੰਡਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
155.t: pa(n)ch chele vas keejeh raaval ih man keejai dda(n)ddaataa ||1||
155.e: Let the five passions be disciples under your control, O begging Yogi, and make this mind your walking stick. ||1||

155.g: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
155.t: jog jugat iv paavasitaa ||
155.e: Thus you shall find the Way of Yoga.

155.g: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
155.t: ek sabadh dhoojaa hor naasat ka(n)dh mool man laavasitaa ||1|| rahaau ||
155.e: There is only the One Word of the Shabad; everything else shall pass away. Let this be the fruits and roots of your mind's diet. ||1||Pause||

155.g: ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁੰਡਾਇਐ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੰਗਾਤਾ ॥
155.t: moo(n)dd mu(n)ddaiaai je gur paieeaai ham gur keenee ga(n)gaataa ||
155.e: Some try to find the Guru by shaving their heads at the Ganges, but I have made the Guru my Ganges.

155.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਅੰਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
155.t: tirabhavan taaranahaar suaamee ek na chetas a(n)dhaataa ||2||
155.e: The Saving Grace of the three worlds is the One Lord and Master, but those in darkness do not remember Him. ||2||

155.g: ਕਰਿ ਪਟੰਬੁ ਗਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਸਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥
155.t: kar paTa(n)b galee man laavas sa(n)saa mool na jaavasitaa ||
155.e: Practicing hypocrisy and attaching your mind to worldly objects, your doubt shall never depart.

156.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਕੀ ਧਾਵਸਿਤਾ ॥੩॥
156.t: ekas charanee je chit laaveh lab lobh kee dhaavasitaa ||3||
156.e: If you focus your consciousness on the Feet of the One Lord, what reason would you have to chase after greed? ||3||

156.g: ਜਪਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਰਚਸਿ ਮਨਾ ॥
156.t: japas nira(n)jan rachas manaa ||
156.e: Meditate on the Immaculate Lord, and saturate your mind with Him.

156.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਘਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
156.t: kaahe boleh jogee kapaT ghanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
156.e: Why, O Yogi, do you make so many false and deceptive claims? ||1||Pause||

156.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਮਲੀ ਹੰਸੁ ਇਆਣਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਣੀਤਾ ॥
156.t: kaiaa kamalee ha(n)s iaanaa meree meree karat bihaaneetaa ||
156.e: The body is wild, and the mind is foolish. Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, your life is passing away.

156.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਗੀ ਦਾਝੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
156.t: pranavat naanak naagee dhaajhai fir paachhai pachhutaaneetaa ||4||3||15||
156.e: Prays Nanak, when the naked body is cremated, then you will come to regret and repent. ||4||3||15||

156.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
156.t: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
156.e: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

156.g: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥
156.t: aaukhadh ma(n)tr mool man ekai je kar dhiraR chit keejai re ||
156.e: O mind, there is only the One medicine, mantra and healing herb - center your consciousness firmly on the One Lord.

156.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰਾ ਲੀਜੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
156.t: janam janam ke paap karam ke kaaTanahaaraa leejai re ||1||
156.e: Take to the Lord, the Destroyer of the sins and karma of past incarnations. ||1||

156.g: ਮਨ ਏਕੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
156.t: man eko saahib bhaiee re ||
156.e: The One Lord and Master is pleasing to my mind.

156.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
156.t: tere teen gunaa sa(n)saar samaaveh alakh na lakhanaa jaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||
156.e: In Your three qualities, the world is engrossed; the Unknowable cannot be known. ||1||Pause||

156.g: ਸਕਰ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਹਮ ਤਉ ਪੰਡ ਉਚਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
156.t: sakar kha(n)dd maiaa tan meeThee ham tau pa(n)dd uchaiee re ||
156.e: Maya is so sweet to the body, like sugar or molasses. We all carry loads of it.

156.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਜੁ ਟੂਕਸਿ ਮੂਸਾ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
156.t: raat aneree soojhas naahee laj Tookas moosaa bhaiee re ||2||
156.e: In the dark of the night, nothing can be seen. The mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life, O Siblings of Destiny! ||2||

156.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
156.t: manmukh kareh tetaa dhukh laagai gurmukh milai vaddaiee re ||
156.e: As the self-willed manmukhs act, they suffer in pain. The Gurmukh obtains honor and greatness.

156.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
156.t: jo tin keeaa soiee hoaa kirat na meTiaa jaiee re ||3||
156.e: Whatever He does, that alone happens; past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

156.g: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਊਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
156.t: subhar bhare na hoveh uoone jo raate ra(n)g laiee re ||
156.e: Those who are imbued with, and committed to the Lord's Love, are filled to overflowing; they never lack anything.

156.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਉ ਮੂੜਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬॥
156.t: tin kee pa(n)k hovai je naanak tau mooRaa kichh paiee re ||4||4||16||
156.e: If Nanak could be the dust of their feet, then he, the ignorant one, might also obtain some. ||4||4||16||

156.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
156.t: gauRee chetee mahalaa pehilaa ||
156.e: Gauree Chaytee, First Mehla:

156.g: ਕਤ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ਕਤ ਕੇਰਾ ਕਿਦੂ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਆਏ ॥
156.t: kat kee maiee baap kat keraa kidhoo thaavahu ham aae ||
156.e: Who is our mother, and who is our father? Where did we come from?

156.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਜਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨਿਪਜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੰਮਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
156.t: agan bi(n)b jal bheetar nipaje kaahe ka(n)m upaae ||1||
156.e: We are formed from the fire of the womb within, and the bubble of water of the sperm. For what purpose are we created? ||1||

156.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
156.t: mere saahibaa kaun jaanai gun tere ||
156.e: O my Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

156.g: ਕਹੇ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
156.t: kahe na jaanee aaugan mere ||1|| rahaau ||
156.e: My own demerits cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||

156.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਰੁਖ ਬਿਰਖ ਹਮ ਚੀਨੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
156.t: kete rukh birakh ham cheene kete pasoo upaae ||
156.e: I took the form of so many plants and trees, and so many animals.

156.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਗ ਕੁਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਕੇਤੇ ਪੰਖ ਉਡਾਏ ॥੨॥
156.t: kete naag kulee meh aae kete pa(n)kh uddaae ||2||
156.e: Many times I entered the families of snakes and flying birds. ||2||

156.g: ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਿਜ ਮੰਦਰ ਭੰਨੈ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
156.t: haT paTan bij ma(n)dhar bha(n)nai kar choree ghar aavai ||
156.e: I broke into the shops of the city and well-guarded palaces; stealing from them, I snuck home again.

156.g: ਅਗਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
156.t: agahu dhekhai pichhahu dhekhai tujh te kahaa chhapaavai ||3||
156.e: I looked in front of me, and I looked behind me, but where could I hide from You? ||3||

156.g: ਤਟ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਮ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
156.t: taT teerath ham nav kha(n)dd dhekhe haT paTan baajaaraa ||
156.e: I saw the banks of sacred rivers, the nine continents, the shops and bazaars of the cities.

156.g: ਲੈ ਕੈ ਤਕੜੀ ਤੋਲਣਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
156.t: lai kai takaRee tolan laagaa ghaT hee meh vanajaaraa ||4||
156.e: Taking the scale, the merchant begins to weigh his actions within his own heart. ||4||

156.g: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਤੇਤੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
156.t: jetaa samu(n)dh saagar neer bhariaa tete aaugan hamaare ||
156.e: As the seas and the oceans are overflowing with water, so vast are my own sins.

156.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਹਰ ਉਪਾਵਹੁ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਥਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
156.t: dhiaa karahu kichh mihar upaavahu ddubadhe pathar taare ||5||
156.e: Please, shower me with Your Mercy, and take pity upon me. I am a sinking stone - please carry me across! ||5||

156.g: ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਤਪੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਗੈ ਕਾਤੀ ॥
156.t: jeeaRaa agan baraabar tapai bheetar vagai kaatee ||
156.e: My soul is burning like fire, and the knife is cutting deep.

156.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੬॥੫॥੧੭॥
156.t: pranavat naanak hukam pachhaanai sukh hovai dhin raatee ||6||5||17||
156.e: Prays Nanak, recognizing the Lord's Command, I am at peace, day and night. ||6||5||17||

156.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
156.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa pehilaa ||
156.e: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehla:

156.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ਕੈ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
156.t: rain gavaiee soi kai dhivas gavaiaa khai ||
156.e: The nights are wasted sleeping, and the days are wasted eating.

156.g: ਹੀਰੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
156.t: heere jaisaa janam hai kauddee badhale jai ||1||
156.e: Human life is such a precious jewel, but it is being lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||1||

156.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਕਾ ॥
156.t: naam na jaaniaa raam kaa ||
156.e: You do not know the Name of the Lord.

156.g: ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
156.t: mooRe fir paachhai pachhutaeh re ||1|| rahaau ||
156.e: You fool - you shall regret and repent in the end! ||1||Pause||

156.g: ਅਨਤਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀ ਧਰੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਚਾਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
156.t: anataa dhan dharanee dhare anat na chaahiaa jai ||
156.e: You bury your temporary wealth in the ground, but how can you love that which is temporary?

156.g: ਅਨਤ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਨ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਆਏ ਅਨਤ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
156.t: anat kau chaahan jo ge se aae anat gavai ||2||
156.e: Those who have departed, after craving for temporary wealth, have returned home without this temporary wealth. ||2||

156.g: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
156.t: aapan leeaa je milai taa sabh ko bhaagaTh hoi ||
156.e: If people could gather it in by their own efforts, then everyone would be so lucky.

157.g: ਕਰਮਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
157.t: karamaa upar nibaRai je lochai sabh koi ||3||
157.e: According to the karma of past actions, one's destiny unfolds, even though everyone wants to be so lucky. ||3||

157.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
157.t: naanak karanaa jin keeaa soiee saar karei ||
157.e: O Nanak, the One who created the creation - He alone takes care of it.

157.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥
157.t: hukam na jaapee khasam kaa kisai vaddaiee dhei ||4||1||18||
157.e: The Hukam of our Lord and Master's Command cannot be known; He Himself blesses us with greatness. ||4||1||18||

157.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
157.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa pehilaa ||
157.e: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehla:

157.g: ਹਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਬਨਿ ਬਸਾ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲ ਚੁਣਿ ਖਾਉ ॥
157.t: haranee hovaa ban basaa ka(n)dh mool chun khaau ||
157.e: What if I were to become a deer, and live in the forest, picking and eating fruits and roots

157.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਹਉ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
157.t: gur parasaadhee meraa sahu milai vaar vaar hau jaau jeeau ||1||
157.e: - by Guru's Grace, I am a sacrifice to my Master. Again and again, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice. ||1||

157.g: ਮੈ ਬਨਜਾਰਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ॥
157.t: mai banajaaran raam kee ||
157.e: I am the shop-keeper of the Lord.

157.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
157.t: teraa naam vakhar vaapaar jee ||1|| rahaau ||
157.e: Your Name is my merchandise and trade. ||1||Pause||

157.g: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਹੋਵਾ ਅੰਬਿ ਬਸਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
157.t: kokil hovaa a(n)b basaa sahaj sabadh beechaar ||
157.e: If I were to become a cuckoo, living in a mango tree, I would still contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

157.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
157.t: sahaj subhai meraa sahu milai dharasan roop apaar ||2||
157.e: I would still meet my Lord and Master, with intuitive ease; the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of His Form, is incomparably beautiful. ||2||

157.g: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਸਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
157.t: machhulee hovaa jal basaa jeea ja(n)t sabh saar ||
157.e: If I were to become a fish, living in the water, I would still remember the Lord, who watches over all beings and creatures.

157.g: ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਮਿਲਉਗੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
157.t: auravaar paar meraa sahu vasai hau milaugee baeh pasaar ||3||
157.e: My Husband Lord dwells on this shore, and on the shore beyond; I would still meet Him, and hug Him close in my embrace. ||3||

157.g: ਨਾਗਨਿ ਹੋਵਾ ਧਰ ਵਸਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
157.t: naagan hovaa dhar vasaa sabadh vasai bhau jai ||
157.e: If I were to become a snake, living in the ground, the Shabad would still dwell in my mind, and my fears would be dispelled.

157.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੯॥
157.t: naanak sadhaa sohaaganee jin jotee jot samai ||4||2||19||
157.e: O Nanak, they are forever the happy soul-brides, whose light merges into His Light. ||4||2||19||

157.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧
157.t: gauRee poorabee dheepakee mahalaa pehilaa
157.e: Gauree Poorbee Deepkee, First Mehla:

157.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
157.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
157.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

157.g: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
157.t: jai ghar keerat aakheeaai karate kaa hoi beechaaro ||
157.e: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted

157.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
157.t: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarahu sirajanahaaro ||1||
157.e: - in that house, sing the Songs of Praise, and meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord. ||1||

157.g: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
157.t: tum gaavahu mere nirabhau kaa sohilaa ||
157.e: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

157.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
157.t: hau vaaree jaau jit sohilai sadhaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
157.e: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

157.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
157.t: nit nit jeeaRe samaaleean dhekhaigaa dhevanahaar ||
157.e: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

157.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
157.t: tere dhaanai keemat naa pavai tis dhaate kavan sumaar ||2||
157.e: Your gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

157.g: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
157.t: sa(n)bat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel ||
157.e: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come - let's gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

157.g: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਆਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
157.t: dheh sajan aaseesaReeaa jiau hovai saahib siau mel ||3||
157.e: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

157.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
157.t: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadhaRe nit pava(n)n ||
157.e: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

157.g: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੨੦॥
157.t: sadhanahaaraa simareeaai naanak se dheh aava(n)n ||4||1||20||
157.e: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||20||

157.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
157.t: raag gauRee guaareree ||
157.e: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree:

157.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
157.t: mahalaa teejaa chaupadhe ||
157.e: Third Mehla, Chau-Padhay:

157.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
157.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
157.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

157.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
157.t: gur miliaai har melaa hoiee ||
157.e: Meeting the Guru, we meet the Lord.

157.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
157.t: aape mel milaavai soiee ||
157.e: He Himself unites us in His Union.

157.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
157.t: meraa prabh sabh bidh aape jaanai ||
157.e: My God knows all His Own Ways.

157.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
157.t: hukame mele sabadh pachhaanai ||1||
157.e: By the Hukam of His Command, He unites those who recognize the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

157.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
157.t: satigur kai bhi bhram bhau jai ||
157.e: By the Fear of the True Guru, doubt and fear are dispelled.

157.g: ਭੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
157.t: bhai raachai sach ra(n)g samai ||1|| rahaau ||
157.e: Imbued with His Fear, we are absorbed in the Love of the True One. ||1||Pause||

157.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
157.t: gur miliaai har man vasai subhai ||
157.e: Meeting the Guru, the Lord naturally dwells within the mind.

157.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
157.t: meraa prabh bhaaraa keemat nahee pai ||
157.e: My God is Great and Almighty; His value cannot be estimated.

157.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
157.t: sabadh saalaahai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
157.e: Through the Shabad, I praise Him; He has no end or limitations.

157.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
157.t: meraa prabh bakhase bakhasanahaar ||2||
