157.e: My God is the Forgiver. I pray that He may forgive me. ||2||

157.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
157.t: gur miliaai sabh mat budh hoi ||
157.e: Meeting the Guru, all wisdom and understanding are obtained.

158.e: The mind becomes pure, when the True Lord dwells within.
When one dwells in Truth, all actions become true.
The ultimate action is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||3||
Through the Guru, true service is performed.
How rare is that Gurmukh who recognizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Giver, the Great Giver, lives forever.
Nanak enshrines love for the Name of the Lord. ||4||1||21||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

158.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
158.t: gur te giaan paae jan koi ||
158.e: Those who obtain spiritual wisdom from the Guru are very rare.
Those who obtain this understanding from the Guru become acceptable.
Through the Guru, we intuitively contemplate the True One.
Through the Guru, the Gate of Liberation is found. ||1||
Through perfect good destiny, we come to meet the Guru.
The true ones are intuitively absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
Meeting the Guru, the fire of desire is quenched.

158.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
158.t: gur te saa(n)t vasai man aae ||
158.e: Through the Guru, peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind.

158.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
158.t: gur te pavit paavan such hoi ||
158.e: Through the Guru, we become pure, holy and true.
Through the Guru, we are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
Without the Guru, everyone wanders in doubt.
Without the Name, they suffer in terrible pain.
Those who meditate on the Naam become Gurmukh.
True honor is obtained through the Darshan, the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||3||

158.g: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
158.t: kis no kaheeaai dhaataa ik soiee ||
158.e: Why speak of any other? He alone is the Giver.
When He grants His Grace, union with the Shabad is obtained.
Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
O Nanak, becoming true, I am absorbed in the True One. ||4||2||22||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

158.g: ਸੁ ਥਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
158.t: s thaau sach man niramal hoi ||
158.e: True is that place, where the mind becomes pure.
True is the one who abides in Truth.
The True Bani of the Word is known throughout the four ages.
The True One Himself is everything. ||1||
Through the karma of good actions, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

158.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁ ਥਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
158.t: har gun gaavai bais su thaae ||1|| rahaau ||
158.e: Sing the Glories of the Lord, sitting in that place. ||1||Pause||
Burn this tongue, which loves duality,

158.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਇ ॥
158.t: har ras na chaakhai feekaa aalai ||
158.e: which does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and which utters insipid words.

158.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
158.t: bin boojhe tan man feekaa hoi ||
158.e: Without understanding, the body and mind become tasteless and insipid.
Without the Name, the miserable ones depart crying out in pain. ||2||

158.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
158.t: rasanaa har ras chaakhiaa sahaj subhai || gur kirapaa te sach samai ||
158.e: One whose tongue naturally and intuitively tastes the Lord's sublime essence, by Guru's Grace, is absorbed in the True Lord.
Imbued with Truth, one contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad,
and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, from the immaculate stream within. ||3||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is collected in the vessel of the mind.
Nothing is collected if the vessel is upside-down.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Naam abides within the mind.

158.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੩॥
158.t: naanak sach bhaa(n)ddaa jis sabadh piaas ||4||3||23||
158.e: O Nanak, True is that vessel of the mind, which thirsts for the Shabad. ||4||3||23||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

158.g: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
158.t: eik gaavat rahe man saadh na pai ||
158.e: Some sing on and on, but their minds do not find happiness.
In egotism, they sing, but it is wasted uselessly.
Those who love the Naam, sing the song.
They contemplate the True Bani of the Word, and the Shabad. ||1||
They sing on and on, if it pleases the True Guru.

158.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
158.t: man tan raataa naam suhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
158.e: Their minds and bodies are embellished and adorned, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Some sing, and some perform devotional worship.
Without heart-felt love, the Naam is not obtained.
True devotional worship consists of love for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

158.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
158.t: apanaa pir raakhiaa sadhaa ur dhaar ||2||
158.e: The devotee keeps his Beloved clasped tightly to his heart. ||2||

159.e: The fools perform devotional worship by showing off;

159.g: ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਟਪਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
159.t: nach nach Tapeh bahut dhukh paaveh ||
159.e: they dance and dance and jump all around, but they only suffer in terrible pain.
By dancing and jumping, devotional worship is not performed.

159.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
159.t: sabadh marai bhagat paae jan soi ||3||
159.e: But one who dies in the Word of the Shabad, obtains devotional worship. ||3||
The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He inspires them to perform devotional worship.
True devotional worship consists of eliminating selfishness and conceit from within.

159.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
159.t: meraa prabh saachaa sabh bidh jaanai ||
159.e: My True God knows all ways and means.
O Nanak, He forgives those who recognize the Naam. ||4||4||24||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:
When someone kills and subdues his own mind, his wandering nature is also subdued.
Without such a death, how can one find the Lord?
Only a few know the medicine to kill the mind.

159.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
159.t: man sabadh marai boojhai jan soi ||1||
159.e: One whose mind dies in the Word of the Shabad, understands Him. ||1||
He grants greatness to those whom He forgives.

159.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
159.t: gur parasaadh har vasai man aaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
159.e: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh practices doing good deeds;

159.g: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
159.t: taa is man kee sojhee paavai ||
159.e: thus he comes to understand this mind.
The mind is like an elephant, drunk with wine.
The Guru is the rod which controls it, and shows it the way. ||2||
The mind is uncontrollable; how rare are those who subdue it.
Those who move the immovable become pure.
The Gurmukhs embellish and beautify this mind.
They eradicate egotism and corruption from within. ||3||
Those who, by pre-ordained destiny, are united in the Lord's Union,
are never separated from Him again; they are absorbed in the Shabad.
He Himself knows His Own Almighty Power.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||5||25||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:
The entire world has gone insane in egotism.
In the love of duality, it wanders deluded by doubt.

159.g: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
159.t: bahu chi(n)taa chitavai aap na pachhaanaa ||
159.e: The mind is distracted by great anxiety; no one recognizes one's own self.
Occupied with their own affairs, their nights and days are passing away. ||1||
Meditate on the Lord in your hearts, O my Siblings of Destiny.

159.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
159.t: gurmukh rasanaa har rasan rasaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
159.e: The Gurmukh's tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukhs recognize the Lord in their own hearts;
they serve the Lord, the Life of the World. They are famous throughout the four ages.
They subdue egotism, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
God, the Architect of Destiny, showers His Mercy upon them. ||2||

159.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
159.t: se jan sache jo gur sabadh milaae ||
159.e: True are those who merge into the Word of the Guru's Shabad;
they restrain their wandering mind and keep it steady.

159.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
159.t: naam nav nidh gur te paae ||
159.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the nine treasures. It is obtained from the Guru.

159.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
159.t: har kirapaa te har vasai man aae ||3||
159.e: By the Lord's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||3||

159.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
159.t: raam raam karatiaa sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
159.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, the body becomes peaceful and tranquil.

159.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਪੀਰ ॥
159.t: a(n)tar vasai na laagai jam peer ||
159.e: He dwells deep within - the pain of death does not touch Him.
He Himself is our Lord and Master; He is His Own Advisor.

159.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੬॥
159.t: naanak sev sadhaa har gunee gaheer ||4||6||26||
159.e: O Nanak, serve the Lord forever; He is the treasure of glorious virtue. ||4||6||26||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

159.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
159.t: so kiau visarai jis ke jeea paraanaa ||
159.e: Why forget Him, unto whom the soul and the breath of life belong?

159.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
159.t: so kiau visarai sabh maeh samaanaa ||
159.e: Why forget Him, who is all-pervading?
Serving Him, one is honored and accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

159.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
159.t: har ke naam viTahu bal jaau ||
159.e: I am a sacrifice to the Name of the Lord.

159.g: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਦਿ ਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
159.t: too(n) visareh tadh hee mar jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
159.e: If I were to forget You, at that very instant, I would die. ||1||Pause||

159.g: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
159.t: tin too(n) visareh j tudh aap bhulaae ||
159.e: Those whom You Yourself have led astray, forget You.

160.g: ਤਿਨ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
160.t: tin too(n) visareh j dhoojai bhaae ||
160.e: Thse who are in love with duality forget You.

160.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
160.t: manmukh agiaanee jonee paae ||2||
160.e: The ignorant, self-willed manmukhs are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

160.g: ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥ ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
160.t: jin ik man tuThaa se satigur sevaa laae || jin ik man tuThaa tin har ma(n)n vasaae ||
160.e: Those who are pleasing to the One Lord are assigned to His service and enshrine Him within their minds.

160.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
160.t: gurmatee har naam samaae ||3||
160.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||

160.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
160.t: jinaa potai pu(n)n se giaan beechaaree ||
160.e: Those who have virtue as their treasure, contemplate spiritual wisdom.

160.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
160.t: jinaa potai pu(n)n tin haumai maaree ||
160.e: Those who have virtue as their treasure, subdue egotism.

160.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੭॥
160.t: naanak jo naam rate tin kau balihaaree ||4||7||27||
160.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7||27||

160.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
160.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
160.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

160.g: ਤੂੰ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਥਿਆ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
160.t: too(n) akath kiau kathiaa jaeh ||
160.e: You are Indescribable; how can I describe You?

160.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
160.t: gur sabadh maaran man maeh samaeh ||
160.e: Those who subdue their minds, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are absorbed in You.

160.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
160.t: tere gun anek keemat neh paeh ||1||
160.e: Your Glorious Virtues are countless; their value cannot be estimated. ||1||

160.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
160.t: jis kee baanee tis maeh samaanee ||
160.e: The Word of His Bani belongs to Him; in Him, it is diffused.

160.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
160.t: teree akath kathaa gur sabadh vakhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
160.e: Your Speech cannot be spoken; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is chanted. ||1||Pause||

160.g: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਹ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
160.t: jeh satigur teh satasa(n)gat banaiee ||
160.e: Where the True Guru is - there is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

160.g: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
160.t: jeh satigur sahaje har gun gaiee ||
160.e: Where the True Guru is - there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are intuitively sung.

160.g: ਜਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਹਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
160.t: jeh satigur tahaa haumai sabadh jalaiee ||2||
160.e: Where the True Guru is - there egotism is burnt away, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

160.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਥਾਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
160.t: gurmukh sevaa mahalee thaau paae ||
160.e: The Gurmukhs serve Him; they obtain a place in the Mansion of His Presence.

160.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
160.t: gurmukh a(n)tar har naam vasaae ||
160.e: The Gurmukhs enshrine the Naam within the mind.

160.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
160.t: gurmukh bhagat har naam samaae ||3||
160.e: The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

160.g: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
160.t: aape dhaat kare dhaataar ||
160.e: The Giver Himself gives His Gifts,

160.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
160.t: poore satigur siau lagai piaar ||
160.e: as we enshrine love for the True Guru.

160.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੮॥
160.t: naanak naam rate tin kau jaikaar ||4||8||28||
160.e: Nanak celebrates those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||28||

160.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
160.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
160.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

160.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
160.t: ekas te sabh roop heh ra(n)gaa ||
160.e: All forms and colors come from the One Lord.

160.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਹਲੰਗਾ ॥
160.t: paun paanee baisa(n)tar sabh sahala(n)gaa ||
160.e: Air, water and fire are all kept together.

160.g: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
160.t: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n vekhai har prabh ra(n)gaa ||1||
160.e: The Lord God beholds the many and various colors. ||1||

160.g: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
160.t: ek acharaj eko hai soiee ||
160.e: The One Lord is wondrous and amazing! He is the One, the One and Only.

160.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
160.t: gurmukh veechaare viralaa koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
160.e: How rare is that Gurmukh who meditates on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

160.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਭਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
160.t: sahaj bhavai prabh sabhanee thaiee ||
160.e: God is naturally pervading all places.

160.g: ਕਹਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
160.t: kahaa gupat pragaT prabh banat banaiee ||
160.e: Sometimes He is hidden, and sometimes He is revealed; thus God has made the world of His making.

160.g: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਈ ॥੨॥
160.t: aape sutiaa dhei jagaiee ||2||
160.e: He Himself wakes us from sleep. ||2||

160.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
160.t: tis kee keemat kinai na hoiee ||
160.e: No one can estimate His value,

160.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਥਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
160.t: keh keh kathan kahai sabh koiee ||
160.e: although everyone has tried, over and over again, to describe Him.

160.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
160.t: gur sabadh samaavai boojhai har soiee ||3||
160.e: Those who merge in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, come to understand the Lord. ||3||

160.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
160.t: sun sun vekhai sabadh milaae ||
160.e: They listen to the Shabad continually; beholding Him, they merge into Him.

160.g: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
160.t: vaddee vaddiaaiee gur sevaa te paae ||
160.e: They obtain glorious greatness by serving the Guru.

160.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੯॥
160.t: naanak naam rate har naam samaae ||4||9||29||
160.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||9||29||

160.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
160.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
160.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

160.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
160.t: manmukh sootaa maiaa moh piaar ||
160.e: The self-willed manmukhs are asleep, in love and attachment to Maya.

160.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
160.t: gurmukh jaage gun giaan beechaar ||
160.e: The Gurmukhs are awake, contemplating spiritual wisdom and the Glory of God.

160.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
160.t: se jan jaage jin naam piaar ||1||
160.e: Those humble beings who love the Naam, are awake and aware. ||1||

160.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
160.t: sahaje jaagai savai na koi ||
160.e: One who is awake to this intuitive wisdom does not fall asleep.

160.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
160.t: poore gur te boojhai jan koi ||1|| rahaau ||
160.e: How rare are those humble beings who understand this through the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

160.g: ਅਸੰਤੁ ਅਨਾੜੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
160.t: asa(n)t anaaRee kadhe na boojhai ||
160.e: The unsaintly blockhead shall never understand.

160.g: ਕਥਨੀ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
160.t: kathanee kare tai maiaa naal loojhai ||
160.e: He babbles on and on, but he is infatuated with Maya.

160.g: ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੨॥
160.t: a(n)dh agiaanee kadhe na seejhai ||2||
160.e: Blind and ignorant, he shall never be reformed. ||2||

160.g: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
160.t: eis jug meh raam naam nisataaraa ||
160.e: In this age, salvation comes only from the Lord's Name.

160.g: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
160.t: viralaa ko paae gur sabadh veechaaraa ||
160.e: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

160.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
160.t: aap tarai sagale kul udhaaraa ||3||
160.e: They save themselves, and save all their family and ancestors as well. ||3||

161.g: ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
161.t: eis kalijug meh karam dharam na koiee ||
161.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, no one is interested in good karma, or Dharmic faith.

161.g: ਕਲੀ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
161.t: kalee kaa janam cha(n)ddaal kai ghar hoiee ||
161.e: This Dark Age was born in the house of evil.

161.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੩੦॥
161.t: naanak naam binaa ko mukat na hoiee ||4||10||30||
161.e: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is liberated. ||4||10||30||
Gauree, Third Mehla, Gwaarayree:
True is the Lord King, True is His Royal Command.

161.g: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
161.t: man saachai raate har veparavaahu || sachai mahal sach naam samaahu ||1||
161.e: Those whose minds are attuned to the True, Carefree Lord enter the True Mansion of His Presence, and merge in the True Name. ||1||
Listen, O my mind: contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

161.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
161.t: raam japahu bhavajal utarahu paar ||1|| rahaau ||
161.e: Chant the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
In doubt he comes, and in doubt he goes.
This world is born out of the love of duality.
The self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord; he continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||

161.g: ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
161.t: aap bhulaa k prabh aap bhulaiaa ||
161.e: Does he himself go astray, or does God lead him astray?
This soul is enjoined to the service of someone else.

161.g: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
161.t: mahaa dhukh khaTe birathaa janam gavaiaa ||3||
161.e: It earns only terrible pain, and this life is lost in vain. ||3||
Granting His Grace, He leads us to meet the True Guru.

161.g: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
161.t: eko naam chete vichahu bharam chukaae ||
161.e: Remembering the One Name, doubt is cast out from within.

161.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੩੧॥
161.t: naanak naam jape naau nau nidh paae ||4||11||31||
161.e: O Nanak, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the nine treasures of the Name are obtained. ||4||11||31||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

161.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
161.t: jinaa gurmukh dhiaaiaa tin poochhau jai ||
161.e: Go and ask the Gurmukhs, who meditate on the Lord.
Serving the Guru, the mind is satisfied.
Those who earn the Lord's Name are wealthy.
Through the Perfect Guru, understanding is obtained. ||1||

161.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
161.t: har har naam japahu mere bhaiee ||
161.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Siblings of Destiny.

161.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਲ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
161.t: gurmukh sevaa har ghaal thai paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
161.e: The Gurmukhs serve the Lord, and so they are accepted. ||1||Pause||
Those who recognize the self - their minds become pure.
They become Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive, and they find the Lord.

161.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
161.t: har gun gaavai mat uootam hoi ||
161.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the intellect becomes pure and sublime,
and they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||2||
In the love of duality, no one can serve the Lord.
In egotism and Maya, they are eating toxic poison.
They are emotionally attached to their children, family and home.
The blind, self-willed manmukhs come and go in reincarnation. ||3||

161.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
161.t: har har naam dhevai jan soi || anadhin bhagat gur sabadhee hoi ||
161.e: Those, unto whom the Lord bestows His Name, worship Him night and day, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
How rare are those who understand the Guru's Teachings!
O Nanak, they are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||32||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:
The Guru's service has been performed throughout the four ages.
Very few are those perfect ones who do this good deed.

161.g: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
161.t: akhuT naam dhan har toT na hoiee ||
161.e: The wealth of the Lord's Name is inexhaustible; it shall never be exhausted.

161.g: ਐਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
161.t: aaithai sadhaa sukh dhar sobhaa hoiee ||1||
161.e: In this world, it brings a constant peace, and at the Lord's Gate, it brings honor. ||1||

161.g: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
161.t: e man mere bharam na keejai ||
161.e: O my mind, have no doubt about this.

161.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
161.t: gurmukh sevaa a(n)mirat ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
161.e: Those Gurmukhs who serve, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
Those who serve the True Guru are the greatest people of the world.
They save themselves, and they redeem all their generations as well.

161.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
161.t: har kaa naam rakheh ur dhaare ||
161.e: They keep the Name of the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts.
Attuned to the Naam, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes humble forever.
Egotism is subdued, and the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
The Unstruck Melody vibrates, as they dwell within the home of the self.
Attuned to the Naam, they remain detached within their own home. ||3||

161.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
161.t: satigur seveh tin kee sachee baanee ||
161.e: Serving the True Guru, their words are true.
Throughout the ages, the devotees chant and repeat these words.
Night and day, they meditate on the Lord, the Sustainer of the Earth.

162.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੩੩॥
162.t: naanak naam rate nihakeval nirabaanee ||4||13||33||
162.e: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are detached, in the perfect balance of Nirvaanaa. ||4||13||33||

162.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
162.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa teejaa ||
162.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehla:

162.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
162.t: satigur milai vaddabhaag sa(n)jog ||
162.e: Through great good fortune and high destiny, one meets the True Guru.

162.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
162.t: hiradhai naam nit har ras bhog ||1||
162.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is constantly within the heart, and one enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

162.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
162.t: gurmukh praanee naam har dhiaai ||
162.e: O mortal, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

162.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
162.t: janam jeet laahaa naam pai ||1|| rahaau ||
162.e: Be victorious in the game of life, and earn the profit of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

162.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
162.t: giaan dhiaan gur sabadh hai meeThaa ||
162.e: Spiritual wisdom and meditation come to those unto whom the Word of the Guru's Shabad is sweet.

162.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
162.t: gur kirapaa te kinai viralai chakh ddeeThaa ||2||
162.e: By Guru's Grace, a few have tasted, and seen it. ||2||

162.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਚਾਰ ॥
162.t: karam kaa(n)dd bahu kareh achaar ||
162.e: They may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions,

162.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
162.t: bin naavai dhirag dhirag aha(n)kaar ||3||
162.e: but without the Name, the egotistical ones are cursed and doomed. ||3||

162.g: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ॥
162.t: ba(n)dhan baadhio maiaa faas ||
162.e: They are bound and gagged, and hung by Maya's noose;

162.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੩੪॥
162.t: jan naanak chhooTai gur paragaas ||4||14||34||
162.e: O servant Nanak, they shall be released only by Guru's Grace. ||4||14||34||

162.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ॥
162.t: mahalaa teejaa gauRee bairaagan ||
162.e: Third Mehla, Gauree Bairaagan:

162.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਊਪਰਿਮੇਘੁਲਾ ਬਰਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
162.t: jaisee dharatee uooparimeghulaa barasat hai kiaa dharatee madhe paanee naahee ||
162.e: The clouds pour their rain down upon the earth, but isn't there water within the earth as well?

162.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗਾ ਵਰਸਤ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
162.t: jaise dharatee madhe paanee paragaasiaa bin pagaa varasat firaahee ||1||
162.e: Water is contained within the earth; without feet, the clouds run around and let down their rain. ||1||

162.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਤੂੰ ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਹੀ ॥
162.t: baabaa too(n) aaise bharam chukaahee ||
162.e: O Baba, get rid of your doubts like this.

162.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
162.t: jo kichh karat hai soiee koiee hai re taise jai samaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
162.e: As you act, so shall you become, and so you shall go and mingle. ||1||Pause||

162.g: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਆ ਓਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
162.t: eisataree purakh hoi kai kiaa oi karam kamaahee ||
162.e: As woman or man, what can anyone do?

162.g: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਹਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
162.t: naanaa roop sadhaa heh tere tujh hee maeh samaahee ||2||
162.e: The many and various forms are always Yours, O Lord; they shall merge again into You. ||2||

162.g: ਇਤਨੇ ਜਨਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
162.t: eitane janam bhool pare se jaa paiaa taa bhoole naahee ||
162.e: In countless incarnations, I went astray. Now that I have found You, I shall no longer wander.

162.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
162.t: jaa kaa kaaraj soiee par jaanai je gur kai sabadh samaahee ||3||
162.e: It is His work; those who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad come to know it well. ||3||

162.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਹੀ ॥
162.t: teraa sabadh too(n)hai heh aape bharam kahaahee ||
162.e: The Shabad is Yours; You are Yourself. Where is there any doubt?

162.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੩੫॥
162.t: naanak tat tat siau miliaa punarap janam na aahee ||4||1||15||35||
162.e: O Nanak, one whose essence is merged with the Lord's essence does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again. ||4||1||15||35||

162.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
162.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa teejaa ||
162.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehla:

162.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
162.t: sabh jag kaalai vas hai baadhaa dhoojai bhai ||
162.e: The whole world is under the power of Death, bound by the love of duality.

162.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
162.t: haumai karam kamaavadhe manmukh milai sajai ||1||
162.e: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego; they receive their just rewards. ||1||

162.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
162.t: mere man gur charanee chit lai ||
162.e: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

162.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
162.t: gurmukh naam nidhaan lai dharageh le chhaddai ||1|| rahaau ||
162.e: As Gurmukh, you shall be awarded the treasure of the Naam. In the Court of the Lord, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

162.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
162.t: lakh chauraaseeh bharamadhe manahaTh aavai jai ||
162.e: Through 8.4 million incarnations, people wander lost; in stubborn-mindedness, they come and go.

162.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
162.t: gur kaa sabadh na cheenio fir fir jonee pai ||2||
162.e: They do not realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad; they are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

162.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
162.t: gurmukh aap pachhaaniaa har naam vasiaa man aai ||
162.e: The Gurmukh understands his own self. The Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

162.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
162.t: anadhin bhagatee ratiaa har naame sukh samai ||3||
162.e: Imbued with devotion to the Lord's Name, night and day, he merges in peace. ||3||

162.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
162.t: man sabadh marai parateet hoi haumai taje vikaar ||
162.e: When one's mind dies in the Shabad, one radiates faith and confidence, shedding egotism and corruption.

162.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੩੬॥
162.t: jan naanak karamee paieean har naamaa bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||4||2||16||36||
162.e: O servant Nanak, through the karma of good actions, the treasure of devotional worship and the Name of the Lord are attained. ||4||2||16||36||

162.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
162.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa teejaa ||
162.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehla:

162.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
162.t: peieeaRai dhin chaar hai har har likh paiaa ||
162.e: The Lord, Har, Har, has ordained that the soul is to stay in her parents' home for only a few short days.

162.g: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
162.t: sobhaava(n)tee naar hai gurmukh gun gaiaa ||
162.e: Glorious is that soul-bride, who as Gurmukh, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

162.g: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਮਲੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
162.t: pevakaRai gun sa(n)malai saahurai vaas paiaa ||
162.e: She who cultivates virtue in her parents' home, shall obtain a home at her in-laws.

162.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
162.t: gurmukh sahaj samaaneeaa har har man bhaiaa ||1||
162.e: The Gurmukhs are intuitively absorbed into the Lord. The Lord is pleasing to their minds. ||1||

162.g: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
162.t: sasurai peieeaai pir vasai kahu kit bidh paieeaai ||
162.e: Our Husband Lord dwells in this world, and in the world beyond. Tell me, how can He be found?

162.g: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
162.t: aap nira(n)jan alakh hai aape melaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
162.e: The Immaculate Lord Himself is unseen. He unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||

163.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
163.t: aape hee prabh dheh mat har naam dhiaaieeaai ||
163.e: God Himself bestows wisdom; meditate on the Name of the Lord.

163.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
163.t: vaddabhaagee satigur milai mukh a(n)mrit paieeaai ||
163.e: By great good fortune, one meets the True Guru, who places the Ambrosial Nectar in the mouth.

163.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
163.t: haumai dhubidhaa binas jai sahaje sukh samaieeaai ||
163.e: When egotism and duality are eradicated, one intuitively merges in peace.

163.g: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
163.t: sabh aape aap varatadhaa aape nai laieeaai ||2||
163.e: He Himself is All-pervading; He Himself links us to His Name. ||2||

163.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
163.t: manmukh garab na paio agiaan iaane ||
163.e: The self-willed manmukhs, in their arrogant pride, do not find God; they are so ignorant and foolish!

163.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ॥
163.t: satigur sevaa naa kareh fir fir pachhutaane ||
163.e: They do not serve the True Guru, and in the end, they regret and repent, over and over again.

163.g: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਗਰਭੇ ਗਲਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
163.t: garabh jonee vaas paidhe garabhe gal jaane ||
163.e: They are cast into the womb to be reincarnated, and within the womb, they rot.

163.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
163.t: mere karate evai bhaavadhaa manmukh bharamaane ||3||
163.e: As it pleases my Creator Lord, the self-willed manmukhs wander around lost. ||3||

163.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
163.t: merai har prabh lekh likhaiaa dhur masatak pooraa ||
163.e: My Lord God inscribed the full pre-ordained destiny upon the forehead.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
163.t: har har naam dhiaaiaa bheTiaa gur sooraa ||
163.e: When one meets the Great and Courageous Guru, one meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

163.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਬੀਰਾ ॥
163.t: meraa pitaa maataa har naam hai har ba(n)dhap beeraa ||
163.e: The Lord's Name is my mother and father; the Lord is my relative and brother.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੩੭॥
163.t: har har bakhas milai prabh jan naanak keeraa ||4||3||17||37||
163.e: O Lord, Har, Har, please forgive me and unite me with Yourself. Servant Nanak is a lowly worm. ||4||3||17||37||

163.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
163.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa teejaa ||
163.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehla:

163.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
163.t: satigur te giaan paiaa har tat beechaaraa ||
163.e: From the True Guru, I obtained spiritual wisdom; I contemplate the Lord's essence.

163.g: ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ ॥
163.t: mat maleen paragaT bhiee jap naam muraaraa ||
163.e: My polluted intellect was enlightened by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

163.g: ਸਿਵਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਮਿਟਾਈਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
163.t: siv sakat miTaieeaa chookaa a(n)dhiaaraa ||
163.e: The distinction between Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter - has been destroyed, and the darkness has been dispelled.

163.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥
163.t: dhur masatak jin kau likhiaa tin har naam piaaraa ||1||
163.e: The Lord's Name is loved by those, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny was written. ||1||

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
163.t: har kit bidh paieeaai sa(n)t janahu jis dhekh hau jeevaa ||
163.e: How can the Lord be obtained, O Saints? Seeing Him, my life is sustained.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
163.t: har bin chasaa na jeevatee gur melih har ras peevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
163.e: Without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant. Unite me with the Guru, so that I may drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

163.g: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
163.t: hau har gun gaavaa nit har sunee har har gat keenee ||
163.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and I listen to them daily; the Lord, Har, Har, has emancipated me.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
163.t: har ras gur te paiaa meraa man tan leenee ||
163.e: I have obtained the Lord's essence from the Guru; my mind and body are drenched with it.

163.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
163.t: dhan dhan gur sat purakh hai jin bhagat har dheenee ||
163.e: Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the True Being, who has blessed me with devotional worship of the Lord.

163.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੨॥
163.t: jis gur te har paiaa so gur ham keenee ||2||
163.e: From the Guru, I have obtained the Lord; I have made Him my Guru. ||2||

163.g: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
163.t: gunadhaataa har rai hai ham avaganiaare ||
163.e: The Sovereign Lord is the Giver of virtue. I am worthless and without virtue.

163.g: ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਡੂਬਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
163.t: paapee paathar ddoobadhe gurmat har taare ||
163.e: The sinners sink like stones; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord carries us across.

163.g: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
163.t: too(n) gunadhaataa niramalaa ham avaganiaare ||
163.e: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord; I am worthless and without virtue.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
163.t: har saranaagat raakh leh mooR mugadh nisataare ||3||
163.e: I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord; please save me, as You have saved the idiots and fools. ||3||

163.g: ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
163.t: sahaj ana(n)dh sadhaa gurmatee har har man dhiaaiaa ||
163.e: Eternal celestial bliss comes through the Guru's Teachings, by meditating continually on the Lord, Har, Har.

163.g: ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
163.t: sajan har prabh paiaa ghar sohilaa gaiaa ||
163.e: I have obtained the Lord God as my Best Friend, within the home of my own self. I sing the Songs of Joy.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ ॥
163.t: har dhiaa dhaar prabh benatee har har chetaiaa ||
163.e: Please shower me with Your Mercy, O Lord God, that I may meditate on Your Name, Har, Har.

163.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੩੮॥
163.t: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhooR tin jin satigur paiaa ||4||4||18||38||
163.e: Servant Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of those who have found the True Guru. ||4||4||18||38||

163.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਚਉਥਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ
163.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa chauthhaa chauthaa chaupadhe
163.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehla, Chau-Padhay:

163.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
163.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
163.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

163.g: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥
163.t: pa(n)ddit saasat simirat paRiaa ||
163.e: The Pandit - the religious scholar - recites the Shaastras and the Simritees;

163.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
163.t: jogee gorakh gorakh kariaa ||
163.e: the Yogi cries out, ""Gorakh, Gorakh"".

163.g: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਪੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
163.t: mai moorakh har har jap paRiaa ||1||
163.e: But I am just a fool - I just chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

163.g: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
163.t: naa jaanaa kiaa gat raam hamaaree ||
163.e: I do not know what my condition shall be, Lord.

163.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤੂ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
163.t: har bhaj man mere tar bhaujal too taaree ||1|| rahaau ||
163.e: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Name of the Lord. You shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

164.e: The Sannyaasee smears his body with ashes;
renouncing other men's women, he practices celibacy.
I am just a fool, Lord; I place my hopes in You! ||2||
The Kh'shaatriya acts bravely, and is recognized as a warrior.
The Shoodra and the Vaisha work and slave for others;
I am just a fool - I am saved by the Lord's Name. ||3||

164.g: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
164.t: sabh teree sirasaT too(n) aap rahiaa samaiee ||
164.e: The entire Universe is Yours; You Yourself permeate and pervade it.
O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with glorious greatness.
I am blind - I have taken the Lord as my Support. ||4||1||39||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehla:

164.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ॥
164.t: niragun kathaa kathaa hai har kee ||
164.e: The Speech of the Lord is the most sublime speech, free of any attributes.

164.g: ਭਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
164.t: bhaj mil saadhoo sa(n)gat jan kee ||
164.e: Vibrate on it, meditate on it, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

164.g: ਤਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ॥੧॥
164.t: tar bhaujal akath kathaa sun har kee ||1||
164.e: Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, listening to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||1||
O Lord of the Universe, unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

164.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
164.t: har ras rasanaa raam gun gai ||1|| rahaau ||
164.e: My tongue savors the sublime essence of the Lord, singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||

164.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
164.t: jo jan dhiaaveh har har naamaa ||
164.e: Those humble beings who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

164.g: ਤਿਨ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
164.t: tin dhaasan dhaas karahu ham raamaa ||
164.e: please make me the slave of their slaves, Lord.
Serving Your slaves is the ultimate good deed. ||2||

164.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
164.t: jo har kee har kathaa sunaavai ||
164.e: One who chants the Speech of the Lord

164.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
164.t: so jan hamarai man chit bhaavai ||
164.e: that humble servant is pleasing to my conscious mind.
Those who are blessed with great good fortune obtain the dust of the feet of the humble. ||3||

164.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
164.t: sa(n)t janaa siau preet ban aaiee || jin kau likhat likhiaa dhur paiee ||
164.e: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny are in love with the humble Saints.
Those humble beings, O Nanak, are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||40||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehla:
The mother loves to see her son eat.
The fish loves to bathe in the water.
The True Guru loves to place food in the mouth of His GurSikh. ||1||

164.g: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
164.t: te har jan har melahu ham piaare ||
164.e: If only I could meet those humble servants of the Lord, O my Beloved.

164.g: ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
164.t: jin miliaa dhukh jaeh hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
164.e: Meeting with them, my sorrows depart. ||1||Pause||

164.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਛਰੇ ਗਊ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
164.t: jiau mil bachhare guoo preet lagaavai ||
164.e: As the cow shows her love to her strayed calf when she finds it,

164.g: ਕਾਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
164.t: kaaman preet jaa pir ghar aavai ||
164.e: and as the bride shows her love for her husband when he returns home,

164.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
164.t: har jan preet jaa har jas gaavai ||2||
164.e: so does the Lord's humble servant love to sing the Praises of the Lord. ||2||
The rainbird loves the rainwater, falling in torrents;
the king loves to see his wealth on display.
The humble servant of the Lord loves to meditate on the Formless Lord. ||3||

164.g: ਨਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੇ ॥
164.t: nar praanee preet maiaa dhan khaaTe ||
164.e: The mortal man loves to accumulate wealth and property.
The GurSikh loves to meet and embrace the Guru.

164.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਚਾਟੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੧॥
164.t: jan naanak preet saadh pag chaaTe ||4||3||41||
164.e: Servant Nanak loves to kiss the feet of the Holy. ||4||3||41||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehla:
The beggar loves to receive charity from the wealthy landlord.
The hungry person loves to eat food.
The GurSikh loves to find satisfaction by meeting the Guru. ||1||

164.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
164.t: har dharasan dheh har aas tumaaree ||
164.e: O Lord, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; I place my hopes in You, Lord.

164.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
164.t: kar kirapaa loch poor hamaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
164.e: Shower me with Your Mercy, and fulfill my longing. ||1||Pause||
The song-bird loves the sun shining in her face.
Meeting her Beloved, all her pains are left behind.
The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||2||
The calf loves to suck its mother's milk;
its heart blossoms forth upon seeing its mother.
The GurSikh loves to gaze upon the Face of the Guru. ||3||

164.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥
164.t: hor sabh preet maiaa moh kaachaa ||
164.e: All other loves and emotional attachment to Maya are false.
They shall pass away, like false and transitory decorations.

164.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੨॥
164.t: jan naanak preet tirapat gur saachaa ||4||4||42||
164.e: Servant Nanak is fulfilled, through the Love of the True Guru. ||4||4||42||

165.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
165.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
165.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehla:

165.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਬਣੀ ॥
165.t: satigur sevaa safal hai banee ||
165.e: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding;

165.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
165.t: jit mil har naam dhiaaiaa har dhanee ||
165.e: meeting Him, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Lord Master.

165.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੂਟੀ ਘਣੀ ॥੧॥
165.t: jin har japiaa tin peechhai chhooTee ghanee ||1||
165.e: So many are emancipated along with those who meditate on the Lord. ||1||

165.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
165.t: gursikh har bolahu mere bhaiee ||
165.e: O GurSikhs, chant the Name of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਸਭ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
165.t: har bolat sabh paap leh jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
165.e: Chanting the Lord's Name, all sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

165.g: ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
165.t: jab gur miliaa tab man vas aaiaa ||
165.e: When one meets the Guru, then the mind becomes centered.

165.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਪੰਚ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
165.t: dhaavat pa(n)ch rahe har dhiaaiaa ||
165.e: The five passions, running wild, are brought to rest by meditating on the Lord.

165.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਗਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
165.t: anadhin nagaree har gun gaiaa ||2||
165.e: Night and day, within the body-village, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung. ||2||

165.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
165.t: satigur pag dhoor jinaa mukh laiee ||
165.e: Those who apply the dust of the Feet of the True Guru to their faces,

165.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੂੜ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
165.t: tin kooR tiaage har liv laiee ||
165.e: renounce falsehood and enshrine love for the Lord.

165.g: ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
165.t: te har dharageh mukh uoojal bhaiee ||3||
165.e: Their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||3||

165.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
165.t: gur sevaa aap har bhaavai ||
165.e: Service to the Guru is pleasing to the Lord Himself.

165.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਲਭਦ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
165.t: kirasan balabhadhr gur pag lag dhiaavai ||
165.e: Even Krishna and Balbhadar meditated on the Lord, falling at the Guru's Feet.

165.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੩॥
165.t: naanak gurmukh har aap taraavai ||4||5||43||
165.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself saves the Gurmukhs. ||4||5||43||

165.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
165.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
165.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourth Mehla:

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਡੰਡਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
165.t: har aape jogee dda(n)ddaadhaaree ||
165.e: The Lord Himself is the Yogi, who wields the staff of authority.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਲਾਇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
165.t: har aape rav rahiaa banavaaree || har aape tap taapai lai taaree ||1||
165.e: The Lord Himself practices tapa - intense self-disciplined meditation; He is deeply absorbed in His primal trance. ||1||

165.g: ਐਸਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
165.t: aaisaa meraa raam rahiaa bharapoor ||
165.e: Such is my Lord, who is all-pervading everywhere.

165.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
165.t: nikaT vasai naahee har dhoor ||1|| rahaau ||
165.e: He dwells near at hand - the Lord is not far away. ||1||Pause||

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
165.t: har aape sabadh surat dhun aape ||
165.e: The Lord Himself is the Word of the Shabad. He Himself is the awareness, attuned to its music.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
165.t: har aape vekhai vigasai aape ||
165.e: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself blossoms forth.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
165.t: har aap japai aape har jaape ||2||
165.e: The Lord Himself chants, and the Lord Himself inspires others to chant. ||2||

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਧਾਰਾ ॥
165.t: har aape saari(n)g a(n)mritadhaaraa ||
165.e: He Himself is the rainbird, and the Ambrosial Nectar raining down.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
165.t: har a(n)mrit aap peeaavanahaaraa ||
165.e: The Lord is the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
165.t: har aap kare aape nisataaraa ||3||
165.e: The Lord Himself is the Doer; He Himself is our Saving Grace. ||3||

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੇੜੀ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਤਾਰਾ ॥
165.t: har aape beRee tulahaa taaraa ||
165.e: The Lord Himself is the Boat, the Raft and the Boatman.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
165.t: har aape gurmatee nisataaraa ||
165.e: The Lord Himself, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੪॥
165.t: har aape naanak paavai paaraa ||4||6||44||
165.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself carries us across to the other side. ||4||6||44||

165.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
165.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
165.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehla:

165.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਹਮ ਲੇਹਿ ॥
165.t: saahu hamaaraa too(n) dhanee jaisee too(n) raas dheh taisee ham leh ||
165.e: O Master, You are my Banker. I receive only that capital which You give me.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
165.t: har naam vana(n)jeh ra(n)g siau je aap dhiaal hoi dheh ||1||
165.e: I would purchase the Lord's Name with love, if You Yourself, in Your Mercy, would sell it to me. ||1||

165.g: ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ॥
165.t: ham vanajaare raam ke ||
165.e: I am the merchant, the peddler of the Lord.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਦੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
165.t: har vanaj karaavai dhe raas re ||1|| rahaau ||
165.e: I trade in the merchandise and capital of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

165.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
165.t: laahaa har bhagat dhan khaTiaa har sache saeh man bhaiaa ||
165.e: I have earned the profit, the wealth of devotional worship of the Lord. I have become pleasing to the Mind of the Lord, the True Banker.

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
165.t: har jap har vakhar ladhiaa jam jaagaatee neR na aaiaa ||2||
165.e: I chant and meditate on the Lord, loading the merchandise of the Lord's Name. The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even approach me. ||2||

165.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
165.t: hor vanaj kareh vaapaare'e ana(n)t tara(n)gee dhukh maiaa ||
165.e: Those traders who trade in other merchandise, are caught up in the endless waves of the pain of Maya.

165.g: ਓਇ ਜੇਹੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਫਲੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
165.t: oi jehai vanaj har laiaa fal tehaa tin paiaa ||3||
165.e: According to the business in which the Lord has placed them, so are the rewards they obtain. ||3||

165.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਈ ॥
165.t: har har vanaj so jan kare jis kirapaal hoi prabh dheiee ||
165.e: People trade in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, when the God shows His Mercy and bestows it.

165.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੪੫॥
165.t: jan naanak saahu har seviaa fir lekhaa mool na leiee ||4||1||7||45||
165.e: Servant Nanak serves the Lord, the Banker; he shall never again be called to render his account. ||4||1||7||45||

165.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
165.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
165.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehla:

165.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਗਰਭੁ ਪਾਲਤੀ ਸੁਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
165.t: jiau jananee garabh paalatee sut kee kar aasaa ||
165.e: The mother nourishes the fetus in the womb, hoping for a son,

165.g: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ਦੇਇ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
165.t: vaddaa hoi dhan khaaT dhei kar bhog bilaasaa ||
165.e: who will grow and earn and give her money to enjoy herself.

165.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਦਾ ਦੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਥਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
165.t: tiau har jan preet har raakhadhaa dhe aap hathaasaa ||1||
165.e: In just the same way, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Lord, who extends His Helping Hand to us. ||1||

166.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
166.t: mere raam mai moorakh har raakh mere gusieeaa ||
166.e: O my Lord, I am so foolish; save me, O my Lord God!

166.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਵਡਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
166.t: jan kee upamaa tujheh vaddieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
166.e: Your servant's praise is Your Own Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

166.g: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
166.t: ma(n)dhar ghar aana(n)dh har har jas man bhaavai ||
166.e: Those whose minds are pleased by the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, are joyful in the palaces of their own homes.

166.g: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
166.t: sabh ras meeThe mukh lageh jaa har gun gaavai ||
166.e: Their mouths savor all the sweet delicacies when they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

166.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
166.t: har jan paravaar sadhaar hai ikeeh kulee sabh jagat chhaddaavai ||2||
166.e: The Lord's humble servants are the saviors of their families; they save their families for twenty-one generations - they save the entire world! ||2||

166.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
166.t: jo kichh keeaa so har keeaa har kee vaddiaaiee ||
166.e: Whatever has been done, has been done by the Lord; it is the Glorious Greatness of the Lord.

166.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
166.t: har jeea tere too(n) varatadhaa har pooj karaiee ||
166.e: O Lord, in Your creatures, You are pervading; You inspire them to worship You.

166.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
166.t: har bhagat bha(n)ddaar lahaidhaa aape varataiee ||3||
166.e: The Lord leads us to the treasure of devotional worship; He Himself bestows it. ||3||

166.g: ਲਾਲਾ ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
166.t: laalaa haaT vihaajhiaa kiaa tis chaturaiee ||
166.e: I am a slave, purchased in Your market; what clever tricks do I have?

166.g: ਜੇ ਰਾਜਿ ਬਹਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਾਸੀ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
166.t: je raaj bahaale taa har gulaam ghaasee kau har naam kaddaiee ||
166.e: If the Lord were to set me upon a throne, I would still be His slave. If I were a grass-cutter, I would still chant the Lord's Name.

166.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥੪੬॥
166.t: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai har kee vaddiaaiee ||4||2||8||46||
166.e: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; contemplate the Glorious Greatness of the Lord||4||2||8||46||

166.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
166.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
166.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehla:

166.g: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ॥
166.t: kirasaanee kirasaan kare lochai jeeau lai ||
166.e: The farmers love to work their farms;

166.g: ਹਲੁ ਜੋਤੈ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਧੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
166.t: hal jotai udham kare meraa put dhee khai ||
166.e: they plow and work the fields, so that their sons and daughters may eat.

166.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
166.t: tiau har jan har har jap kare har a(n)t chhaddai ||1||
166.e: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and in the end, the Lord shall save them. ||1||

166.g: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
166.t: mai moorakh kee gat keejai mere raam ||
166.e: I am foolish - save me, O my Lord!

166.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਹਮ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
166.t: gur satigur sevaa har lai ham kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
166.e: O Lord, enjoin me to work and serve the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

166.g: ਲੈ ਤੁਰੇ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
166.t: lai ture saudhaagaree saudhaagar dhaavai ||
166.e: The traders buy horses, planning to trade them.

166.g: ਧਨੁ ਖਟੈ ਆਸਾ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
166.t: dhan khaTai aasaa karai maiaa moh vadhaavai ||
166.e: They hope to earn wealth; their attachment to Maya increases.

166.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
166.t: tiau har jan har har bolataa har bol sukh paavai ||2||
166.e: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; chanting the Lord's Name, they find peace. ||2||

166.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਹਟਵਾਣੀਆ ਬਹਿ ਹਾਟਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
166.t: bikh sa(n)chai haTavaaneeaa beh haaT kamai ||
166.e: The shop-keepers collect poison, sitting in their shops, carrying on their business.

166.g: ਮੋਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਝੂਠ ਕਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
166.t: moh jhooTh pasaaraa jhooTh kaa jhooThe lapaTai ||
166.e: Their love is false, their displays are false, and they are engrossed in falsehood.

166.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
166.t: tiau har jan har dhan sa(n)chiaa har kharach lai jai ||3||
166.e: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; they take the Lord's Name as their supplies. ||3||

166.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਫਾਸ ॥
166.t: eih maiaa moh kuTa(n)b hai bhai dhoojai faas ||
166.e: This emotional attachment to Maya and family, and the love of duality, is a noose around the neck.

166.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
166.t: gurmatee so jan tarai jo dhaasan dhaas ||
166.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, the humble servants are carried across; they become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

166.g: ਜਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥੪੭॥
166.t: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gurmukh paragaas ||4||3||9||47||
166.e: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam; the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||4||3||9||47||

166.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
166.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
166.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehla:

166.g: ਨਿਤ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਭਰਮੈ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
166.t: nit dhinas raat laalach kare bharamai bharamaiaa ||
166.e: Continuously, day and night, they are gripped by greed and deluded by doubt.

166.g: ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਵੇਗਾਰੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ॥
166.t: vegaar firai vegaareeaa sir bhaar uThaiaa ||
166.e: The slaves labor in slavery, carrying the loads upon their heads.

166.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
166.t: jo gur kee jan sevaa kare so ghar kai ka(n)m har laiaa ||1||
166.e: That humble being who serves the Guru is put to work by the Lord in His Home. ||1||

166.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
166.t: mere raam toR ba(n)dhan maiaa ghar kai ka(n)m lai ||
166.e: O my Lord, please break these bonds of Maya, and put me to work in Your Home.

166.g: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
166.t: nit har gun gaaveh har naam samai ||1|| rahaau ||
166.e: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

166.g: ਨਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
166.t: nar praanee chaakaree kare narapat raaje arath sabh maiaa ||
166.e: Mortal men work for kings, all for the sake of wealth and Maya.

166.g: ਕੈ ਬੰਧੈ ਕੈ ਡਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ ਕੈ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
166.t: kai ba(n)dhai kai ddaan lei kai narapat mar jaiaa ||
166.e: But the king either imprisons them, or fines them, or else dies himself.

166.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
166.t: dha(n)n dhan sevaa safal satiguroo kee jit har har naam jap har sukh paiaa ||2||
166.e: Blessed, rewarding and fruitful is the service of the True Guru; through it, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I have found peace. ||2||

166.g: ਨਿਤ ਸਉਦਾ ਸੂਦੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
166.t: nit saudhaa soodh keechai bahu bhaat kar maiaa kai taiee ||
166.e: Everyday, people carry on their business, with all sorts of devices to earn interest, for the sake of Maya.

166.g: ਜਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਦੇਇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੇ ਤੋਟੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
166.t: jaa laahaa dhei taa sukh mane toTai mar jaiee ||
166.e: If they earn a profit, they are pleased, but their hearts are broken by losses.

166.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
166.t: jo gun saajhee gur siau kare nit nit sukh paiee ||3||
166.e: One who is worthy, becomes a partner with the Guru, and finds a lasting peace forever. ||3||

167.g: ਜਿਤਨੀ ਭੂਖ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਹੈ ਤਿਤਨੀ ਭੂਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
167.t: jitanee bhookh an ras saadh hai titanee bhookh fir laagai ||
167.e: The more one feels hunger for other tastes and pleasures, the more this hunger persists.

167.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਚੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ॥
167.t: jis har aap kirapaa kare so veche sir gur aagai ||
167.e: Those unto whom the Lord Himself shows mercy, sell their head to the Guru.

167.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੮॥
167.t: jan naanak har ras tirapatiaa fir bhookh na laagai ||4||4||10||48||
167.e: Servant Nanak is satisfied by the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. He shall never feel hungry again. ||4||4||10||48||

167.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
167.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
167.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehla:

167.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਤ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
167.t: hamarai man chit har aas nit kiau dhekhaa har dharas tumaaraa ||
167.e: Within my conscious mind is the constant longing for the Lord. How can I behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Lord?

167.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਤਾ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
167.t: jin preet laiee so jaanataa hamarai man chit har bahut piaaraa ||
167.e: One who loves the Lord knows this; the Lord is very dear to my conscious mind.

167.g: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
167.t: hau kurabaanee gur aapane jin vichhuRiaa meliaa meraa sirajanahaaraa ||1||
167.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has re-united me with my Creator Lord; I was separated from Him for such a long time! ||1||

167.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
167.t: mere raam ham paapee saran pare har dhuaar ||
167.e: O my Lord, I am a sinner; I have come to Your Sanctuary, and fallen at Your Door, Lord.

167.g: ਮਤੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
167.t: mat niragun ham melai kabahoo(n) apunee kirapaa dhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
167.e: My intellect is worthless; I am filthy and polluted. Please shower me with Your Mercy sometime. ||1||Pause||

167.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
167.t: hamare avagun bahut bahut hai bahu baar baar har ganat na aavai ||
167.e: My demerits are so many and numerous. I have sinned so many times, over and over again. O Lord, they cannot be counted.

167.g: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
167.t: too(n) gunava(n)taa har har dhiaal har aape bakhas laih har bhaavai ||
167.e: You, Lord, are the Merciful Treasure of Virtue. When it pleases You, Lord, You forgive me.

167.g: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
167.t: ham aparaadhee raakhe gur sa(n)gatee upadhes dheeo har naam chhaddaavai ||2||
167.e: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. He has bestowed the Teachings of the Lord's Name, which saves me. ||2||

167.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਜਬ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹ ਤਬ ਬਿਸਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
167.t: tumare gun kiaa kahaa mere satiguraa jab gur boleh tab bisam hoi jai ||
167.e: What Glorious Virtues of Yours can I describe, O my True Guru? When the Guru speaks, I am transfixed with wonder.

167.g: ਹਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
167.t: ham jaise aparaadhee avar koiee raakhai jaise ham satigur raakh le'ee chhaddai ||
167.e: Can anyone else save a sinner like me? The True Guru has protected and saved me.

167.g: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੰਧਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
167.t: too(n) gur pitaa too(n)hai gur maataa too(n) gur ba(n)dhap meraa sakhaa sakhai ||3||
167.e: O Guru, You are my father. O Guru, You are my mother. O Guru, You are my relative, companion and friend. ||3||

167.g: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਪੇ ॥
167.t: jo hamaree bidh hotee mere satiguraa saa bidh tum har jaanahu aape ||
167.e: My condition, O my True Guru - that condition, O Lord, is known only to You.

167.g: ਹਮ ਰੁਲਤੇ ਫਿਰਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੂਛਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
167.t: ham rulate firate koiee baat na poochhataa gur satigur sa(n)g keere ham thaape ||
167.e: I was rolling around in the dirt, and no one cared for me at all. In the Company of the Guru, the True Guru, I, the worm, have been raised up and exalted.

167.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥੪੯॥
167.t: dha(n)n dha(n)n guroo naanak jan keraa jit miliaai chooke sabh sog sa(n)taape ||4||5||11||49||
167.e: Blessed, blessed is the Guru of servant Nanak; meeting Him, all my sorrows and troubles have come to an end. ||4||5||11||49||

167.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
167.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
167.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehla:

167.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਲੁਭਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
167.t: ka(n)chan naaree meh jeeau lubhat hai moh meeThaa maiaa ||
167.e: The soul of the man is lured by gold and women; emotional attachment to Maya is so sweet to him.

167.g: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਘੋੜੇ ਖੁਸੀ ਮਨੁ ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
167.t: ghar ma(n)dhar ghoRe khusee man an ras laiaa ||
167.e: The mind has become attached to the pleasures of houses, palaces, horses and other enjoyments.

167.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
167.t: har prabh chit na aaviee kiau chhooTaa mere har raiaa ||1||
167.e: The Lord God does not even enter his thoughts; how can he be saved, O my Lord King? ||1||

167.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਇਹ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
167.t: mere raam ieh neech karam har mere ||
167.e: O my Lord, these are my lowly actions, O my Lord.

167.g: ਗੁਣਵੰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
167.t: gunava(n)taa har har dhiaal kar kirapaa bakhas avagan sabh mere ||1|| rahaau ||
167.e: O Lord, Har, Har, Treasure of Virtue, Merciful Lord: please bless me with Your Grace and forgive me for all my mistakes. ||1||Pause||

167.g: ਕਿਛੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
167.t: kichh roop nahee kichh jaat naahee kichh dda(n)g na meraa ||
167.e: I have no beauty, no social status, no manners.

167.g: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਬੋਲਹ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਨ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
167.t: kiaa muh lai boleh gun bihoon naam japiaa na teraa ||
167.e: With what face am I to speak? I have no virtue at all; I have not chanted Your Name.

167.g: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਬਰੇ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
167.t: ham paapee sa(n)g gur ubare pu(n)n satigur keraa ||2||
167.e: I am a sinner, saved only by the Company of the Guru. This is the generous blessing of the True Guru. ||2||

167.g: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਕੁ ਦੀਆ ਵਰਤਣ ਕਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
167.t: sabh jeeau pi(n)dd mukh nak dheeaa varatan kau paanee ||
167.e: He gave all beings souls, bodies, mouths, noses and water to drink.

167.g: ਅੰਨੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਦੀਆ ਰਸ ਅਨਿ ਭੋਗਾਣੀ ॥
167.t: a(n)n khaanaa kapaR painan dheeaa ras an bhogaanee ||
167.e: He gave them corn to eat, clothes to wear, and other pleasures to enjoy.

167.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਸੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਪਸੂ ਹਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
167.t: jin dhe'ee su chit na aaviee pasoo hau kar jaanee ||3||
167.e: But they do not remember the One who gave them all this. The animals think that they made themselves! ||3||

167.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
167.t: sabh keetaa teraa varatadhaa too(n) a(n)tarajaamee ||
167.e: You made them all; You are all-pervading. You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

167.g: ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
167.t: ham ja(n)t vichaare kiaa kareh sabh khel tum suaamee ||
167.e: What can these wretched creatures do? This whole drama is Yours, O Lord and Master.

167.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਮ ਗੁਲਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨॥੫੦॥
167.t: jan naanak haaT vihaajhiaa har gulam gulaamee ||4||6||12||50||
167.e: Servant Nanak was purchased in the slave-market. He is the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||4||6||12||50||

168.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
168.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
168.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehla:

168.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਜਣਿ ਪਾਲਤੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
168.t: jiau jananee sut jan paalatee raakhai nadhar majhaar ||
168.e: Just as the mother, having given birth to a son, feeds him and keeps him in her vision

168.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪੋਚਾਰਿ ॥
168.t: a(n)tar baahar mukh dhe giraas khin khin pochaar ||
168.e: - indoors and outdoors, she puts food in his mouth; each and every moment, she caresses him.

168.g: ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
168.t: tiau satigur gursikh raakhataa har preet piaar ||1||
168.e: In just the same way, the True Guru protects His GurSikhs, who love their Beloved Lord. ||1||

168.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਹੈ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
168.t: mere raam ham baarik har prabh ke hai iaane ||
168.e: O my Lord, we are just the ignorant children of our Lord God.

168.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਧਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ ਕੀਏ ਸਿਆਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
168.t: dha(n)n dha(n)n guroo gur satigur paadhaa jin har upadhes dhe ke'ee siaane ||1|| rahaau ||
168.e: Hail, hail, to the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Teacher who has made me wise through the Lord's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

168.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਗਗਨਿ ਫਿਰੰਤੀ ਊਡਤੀ ਕਪਰੇ ਬਾਗੇ ਵਾਲੀ ॥
168.t: jaisee gagan fira(n)tee uooddatee kapare baage vaalee ||
168.e: The white flamingo circles through the sky,

168.g: ਓਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਚੀਤੁ ਪੀਛੈ ਬਿਚਿ ਬਚਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥
168.t: oh raakhai cheet peechhai bich bachare nit hiradhai saar samaalee ||
168.e: but she keeps her young ones in her mind; she has left them behind, but she constantly remembers them in her heart.

168.g: ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਰਖੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
168.t: tiau satigur sikh preet har har kee gur sikh rakhai jeea naalee ||2||
168.e: In just the same way, the True Guru loves His Sikhs. The Lord cherishes His GurSikhs, and keeps them clasped to His Heart. ||2||

168.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਤੀ ਤੀਸ ਬਤੀਸ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਮਾਸ ਰਤੁ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
168.t: jaise kaatee tees batees hai vich raakhai rasanaa maas rat keree ||
168.e: Just as the tongue, made of flesh and blood, is protected within the scissors of the thirty-two teeth

168.g: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮਾਸ ਕਾਤੀ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
168.t: koiee jaanahu maas kaatee kai kichh haath hai sabh vasagat hai har keree ||
168.e: who thinks that the power lies in the flesh or the scissors? Everything is in the Power of the Lord.

168.g: ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
168.t: tiau sa(n)t janaa kee nar ni(n)dhaa kareh har raakhai paij jan keree ||3||
168.e: In just the same way, when someone slanders the Saint, the Lord preserves the honor of His servant. ||3||

168.g: ਭਾਈ ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
168.t: bhaiee mat koiee jaanahu kisee kai kichh haath hai sabh kare karaiaa ||
168.e: O Siblings of Destiny, let none think that they have any power. All act as the Lord causes them to act.

168.g: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸਿਰਤਿ ਸਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
168.t: jaraa maraa taap sirat saap sabh har kai vas hai koiee laag na sakai bin har kaa laiaa ||
168.e: Old age, death, fever, poisons and snakes - everything is in the Hands of the Lord. Nothing can touch anyone without the Lord's Order.

168.g: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥੫੧॥
168.t: aaisaa har naam man chit nit dhiaavahu jan naanak jo a(n)tee aausar le chhaddaiaa ||4||7||13||51||
168.e: Within your conscious mind, O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Name of the Lord, who shall deliver you in the end. ||4||7||13||51||

168.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
168.t: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
168.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehla:

168.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
168.t: jis miliaai man hoi ana(n)dh so satigur kaheeaai ||
168.e: Meeting Him, the mind is filled with bliss. He is called the True Guru.

168.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
168.t: man kee dhubidhaa binas jai har param padh laheeaai ||1||
168.e: Double-mindedness departs, and the supreme status of the Lord is obtained. ||1||

168.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
168.t: meraa satigur piaaraa kit bidh milai ||
168.e: How can I meet my Beloved True Guru?

168.g: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
168.t: hau khin khin karee namasakaar meraa gur pooraa kiau milai ||1|| rahaau ||
168.e: Each and every moment, I humbly bow to Him. How will I meet my Perfect Guru? ||1||Pause||

168.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
168.t: kar kirapaa har meliaa meraa satigur pooraa ||
168.e: Granting His Grace, the Lord has led me to meet my Perfect True Guru.

168.g: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀਆ ਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
168.t: eichh pu(n)nee jan kereeaa le satigur dhooraa ||2||
168.e: The desire of His humble servant has been fulfilled. I have received the dust of the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

168.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ॥
168.t: har bhagat dhiraRaavai har bhagat sunai tis satigur mileeaai ||
168.e: Those who meet the True Guru implant devotional worship to the Lord, and listen to this devotional worship of the Lord.

168.g: ਤੋਟਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਐ ॥੩॥
168.t: toTaa mool na aaviee har laabh nit dhiraReeaai ||3||
168.e: They never suffer any loss; they continually earn the profit of the Lord. ||3||

168.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
168.t: jis kau ridhai vigaas hai bhaau dhoojaa naahee ||
168.e: One whose heart blossoms forth, is not in love with duality.

168.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੪॥੫੨॥
168.t: naanak tis gur mil udharai har gun gaavaahee ||4||8||14||52||
168.e: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, one is saved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||8||14||52||

168.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ॥
168.t: mahalaa chauthhaa gauRee poorabee ||
168.e: Fourth Mehla, Gauree Poorbee:

168.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ॥
168.t: har dhiaal dhiaa prabh keenee merai man tan mukh har bolee ||
168.e: The Merciful Lord God showered me with His Mercy; with mind and body and mouth, I chant the Lord's Name.

168.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥੧॥
168.t: gurmukh ra(n)g bhiaa at gooRaa har ra(n)g bheenee meree cholee ||1||
168.e: As Gurmukh, I have been dyed in the deep and lasting color of the Lord's Love. The robe of my body is drenched with His Love. ||1||

168.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਗੋਲੀ ॥
168.t: apune har prabh kee hau golee ||
168.e: I am the maid-servant of my Lord God.

168.g: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੋਲ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
168.t: jab ham har setee man maaniaa kar dheeno jagat sabh gol amolee ||1|| rahaau ||
168.e: When my mind surrendered to the Lord, He made all the world my slave. ||1||Pause||

168.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਖੋਜਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਢੰਢੋਲੀ ॥
168.t: karahu bibek sa(n)t jan bhaiee khoj hiradhai dhekh dda(n)ddolee ||
168.e: Consider this well, O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny - search your own hearts, seek and find Him there.

168.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋਲੀ ॥੨॥
168.t: har har roop sabh jot sabaiee har nikaT vasai har kolee ||2||
168.e: The Beauty and the Light of the Lord, Har, Har, is present in all. In all places, the Lord dwells near by, close at hand. ||2||

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੋਲੀ ॥
169.t: har har nikaT vasai sabh jag kai apara(n)par purakh atolee ||
169.e: The Lord, Har, Har, dwells close by, all over the world. He is Infinite, All-powerful and Immeasurable.

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਕੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੋਲੀ ॥੩॥
169.t: har har pragaT keeo gur poorai sir vechio gur peh molee ||3||
169.e: The Perfect Guru has revealed the Lord, Har, Har, to me. I have sold my head to the Guru. ||3||

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੋਲੀ ॥
169.t: har jee a(n)tar baahar tum saranaagat tum vadd purakh vaddolee ||
169.e: O Dear Lord, inside and outside, I am in the protection of Your Sanctuary; You are the Greatest of the Great, All-powerful Lord.

169.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਵੇਚੋਲੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੫੩॥
169.t: jan naanak anadhin har gun gaavai mil satigur gur vecholee ||4||1||15||53||
169.e: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, meeting the Guru, the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary. ||4||1||15||53||

169.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
169.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
169.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

169.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
169.t: jagajeevan apara(n)par suaamee jagadheesur purakh bidhaate ||
169.e: Life of the World, Infinite Lord and Master, Master of the Universe, All-powerful Architect of Destiny.

169.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
169.t: jit maarag tum prerahu suaamee tit maarag ham jaate ||1||
169.e: Whichever way You turn me, O my Lord and Master, that is the way I shall go. ||1||

169.g: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
169.t: raam meraa man har setee raate ||
169.e: O Lord, my mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

169.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
169.t: satasa(n)gat mil raam ras paiaa har raamai naam samaate ||1|| rahaau ||
169.e: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
169.t: har har naam har har jag avakhadh har har naam har saate ||
169.e: The Lord, Har, Har, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the panacea, the medicine for the world. The Lord, and the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, bring peace and tranquility.

169.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
169.t: tin ke paap dhokh sabh binase jo gurmat raam ras khaate ||2||
169.e: Those who partake of the Lord's sublime essence, through the Guru's Teachings - their sins and sufferings are all eliminated. ||2||

169.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਤੇ ॥
169.t: jin kau likhat likhe dhur masatak te gur sa(n)tokh sar naate ||
169.e: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads, bathe in the pool of contentment of the Guru.

169.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
169.t: dhuramat mail giee sabh tin kee jo raam naam ra(n)g raate ||3||
169.e: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away, from those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord's Name. ||3||

169.g: ਰਾਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮ ਜੇਵਡ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
169.t: raam tum aape aap aap prabh Thaakur tum jevadd avar na dhaate ||
169.e: O Lord, You Yourself are Your Own Master, O God. There is no other Giver as Great as You.

169.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੫੪॥
169.t: jan naanak naam le taa(n) jeevai har japeeaai har kirapaa te ||4||2||16||54||
169.e: Servant Nanak lives by the Naam, the Name of the Lord; by the Lord's Mercy, he chants the Lord's Name. ||4||2||16||54||

169.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
169.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
169.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

169.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
169.t: karahu kirapaa jagajeevan dhaate meraa man har setee raache ||
169.e: Show Mercy to me, O Life of the World, O Great Giver, so that my mind may merge with the Lord.

169.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬਚਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਚੇ ॥੧॥
169.t: satigur bachan dheeo at niramal jap har har har man maache ||1||
169.e: The True Guru has bestowed His most pure and sacred Teachings. Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, my mind is transfixed and enraptured. ||1||

169.g: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੇਧਿ ਲੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
169.t: raam meraa man tan bedh leeo har saache ||
169.e: O Lord, my mind and body have been pierced through by the True Lord.

169.g: ਜਿਹ ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਚੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
169.t: jeh kaal kai mukh jagat sabh grasiaa gur satigur kai bachan har ham baache ||1|| rahaau ||
169.e: The whole world is caught and held in the mouth of Death. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I am saved. ||1||Pause||

169.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਰ ਕਾਚੇ ॥
169.t: jin kau preet naahee har setee te saakat mooR nar kaache ||
169.e: Those who are not in love with the Lord are foolish and false - they are faithless cynics.

169.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਪਾਚੇ ॥੨॥
169.t: tin kau janam maran at bhaaree vich visaTaa mar mar paache ||2||
169.e: They suffer the most extreme agonies of birth and death; they die over and over again, and they rot away in manure. ||2||

169.g: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਚੇ ॥
169.t: tum dhiaal saran pratipaalak mo kau dheejai dhaan har ham jaache ||
169.e: You are the Merciful Cherisher of those who seek Your Sanctuary. I beg of You: please grant me Your gift, Lord.

169.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
169.t: har ke dhaas dhaas ham keejai man nirat kare kar naache ||3||
169.e: Make me the slave of the Lord's slaves, so that my mind might dance in Your Love. ||3||

169.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਹਹਿ ਤਾ ਚੇ ॥
169.t: aape saeh vadde prabh suaamee ham vanajaare heh taa che ||
169.e: He Himself is the Great Banker; God is our Lord and Master. I am His petty merchant.

169.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭॥੫੫॥
169.t: meraa man tan jeeau raas sabh teree jan naanak ke saeh prabh saache ||4||3||17||55||
169.e: My mind, body and soul are all Your capital assets. You, O God, are the True Banker of servant Nanak. ||4||3||17||55||

169.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
169.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
169.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

169.g: ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਾਨੇ ॥
169.t: tum dhiaal sarab dhukh bha(n)jan ik binau sunahu dhe kaane ||
169.e: You are Merciful, the Destroyer of all pain. Please give me Your Ear and listen to my prayer.

169.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
169.t: jis te tum har jaane suaamee so satigur mel meraa praane ||1||
