169.e: Please unite me with the True Guru, my breath of life; through Him, O my Lord and Master, You are known. ||1||

169.g: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
169.t: raam ham satigur paarabraham kar maane ||
169.e: O Lord, I acknowledge the True Guru as the Supreme Lord God.

169.g: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਸੁਧ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
169.t: ham mooR mugadh asudh mat hote gur satigur kai bachan har ham jaane ||1|| rahaau ||
169.e: I am foolish and ignorant, and my intellect is impure. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord, I come to know You. ||1||Pause||

169.g: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਹਮ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਭ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਫੀਕ ਫੀਕਾਨੇ ॥
169.t: jitane ras an ras ham dhekhe sabh titane feek feekaane ||
169.e: All the pleasures and enjoyments which I have seen - I have found them all to be bland and insipid.

170.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੀਠ ਰਸ ਗਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
170.t: har kaa naam a(n)mirat ras chaakhiaa mil satigur meeTh ras gaane ||2||
170.e: I have tasted the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by meeting the True Guru. It is sweet, like the juice of the sugarcane. ||2||

170.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
170.t: jin kau gur satigur nahee bheTiaa te saakat mooR dhivaane ||
170.e: Those who have not met the Guru, the True Guru, are foolish and insane - they are faithless cynics.

170.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਚਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
170.t: tin ke karamaheen dhur paae dhekh dheepak moh pachaane ||3||
170.e: Those who were pre-ordained to have no good karma at all - gazing into the lamp of emotional attachment, they are burnt, like moths in a flame. ||3||

170.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਨੇ ॥
170.t: jin kau tum dhiaa kar melahu te har har sev lagaane ||
170.e: Those whom You, in Your Mercy, have met, Lord, are committed to Your Service.

170.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੬॥
170.t: jan naanak har har har jap pragaTe mat gurmat naam samaane ||4||4||18||56||
170.e: Servant Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. He is famous, and through the Guru's Teachings, He merges in the Name. ||4||4||18||56||

170.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
170.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
170.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਹੁ ਨਸੀਐ ॥
170.t: mere man so prabh sadhaa naal hai suaamee kahu kithai har pahu naseeaai ||
170.e: O my mind, God is always with you; He is your Lord and Master. Tell me, where could you run to get away from the Lord?

170.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥
170.t: har aape bakhas le prabh saachaa har aap chhaddaae chhuTeeaai ||1||
170.e: The True Lord God Himself grants forgiveness; we are emancipated only when the Lord Himself emancipates us. ||1||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ॥
170.t: mere man jap har har har man japeeaai ||
170.e: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har - chant it in your mind.

170.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੀਛੈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
170.t: satigur kee saranaiee bhaj pau mere manaa gur satigur peechhai chhuTeeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
170.e: Quickly now, run to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, O my mind; following the Guru, the True Guru, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੀਐ ॥
170.t: mere man sevahu so prabh srab sukhadhaataa jit seviaai nij ghar vaseeaai ||
170.e: O my mind, serve God, the Giver of all peace; serving Him, you shall come to dwell in your own home deep within.

170.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਘਸੀਐ ॥੨॥
170.t: gurmukh jai lahahu ghar apanaa ghas cha(n)dhan har jas ghaseeaai ||2||
170.e: As Gurmukh, go and enter your own home; anoint yourself with the sandalwood oil of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਸੀਐ ॥
170.t: mere man har har har har har jas uootam lai laahaa har man haseeaai ||
170.e: O my mind, the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are exalted and sublime. Earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and let your mind be happy.

170.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖੀਐ ॥੩॥
170.t: har har aap dhiaa kar dhevai taa a(n)mrit har ras chakheeaai ||3||
170.e: If the Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy, bestows it, then we partake of the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Name. ||3||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਜਮਿ ਘੁਟੀਐ ॥
170.t: mere man naam binaa jo dhoojai laage te saakat nar jam ghuTeeaai ||
170.e: O my mind, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and attached to duality, those faithless cynics are strangled by the Messenger of Death.

170.g: ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਚੋਰ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਭਿਟੀਐ ॥੪॥
170.t: te saakat chor jinaa naam visaariaa man tin kai nikaT na bhiTeeaai ||4||
170.e: Such faithless cynics, who have forgotten the Naam, are thieves. O my mind, do not even go near them. ||4||

170.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਲੇਖਾ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥
170.t: mere man sevahu alakh nira(n)jan narahar jit seviaai lekhaa chhuTeeaai ||
170.e: O my mind, serve the Unknowable and Immaculate Lord, the Man-lion; serving Him, your account will be cleared.

170.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਘਟੀਐ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੯॥੫੭॥
170.t: jan naanak har prabh poore ke'ee khin maasaa tol na ghaTeeaai ||5||5||19||57||
170.e: The Lord God has made servant Nanak perfect; he is not diminished by even the tiniest particle. ||5||5||19||57||

170.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
170.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
170.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

170.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
170.t: hamare praan vasagat prabh tumarai meraa jeeau pi(n)dd sabh teree ||
170.e: My breath of life is in Your Power, God; my soul and body are totally Yours.

170.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਘਣੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
170.t: dhiaa karahu har dharas dhikhaavahu merai man tan loch ghaneree ||1||
170.e: Be merciful to me, and show me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. There is such a great longing within my mind and body! ||1||

170.g: ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਚ ਮਿਲਣ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
170.t: raam merai man tan loch milan har keree ||
170.e: O my Lord, there is such a great longing within my mind and body to meet the Lord.

170.g: ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
170.t: gur kirapaal kirapaa ki(n)chat gur keenee har miliaa aai prabh meree ||1|| rahaau ||
170.e: When the Guru, the Merciful Guru, showed just a little mercy to me, my Lord God came and met me. ||1||Pause||

170.g: ਜੋ ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
170.t: jo hamarai man chit hai suaamee saa bidh tum har jaanahu meree ||
170.e: Whatever is in my conscious mind, O Lord and Master - that condition of mine is known only to You, Lord.

170.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਵਾ ਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
170.t: anadhin naam japee sukh paiee nit jeevaa aas har teree ||2||
170.e: Night and day, I chant Your Name, and I find peace. I live by placing my hopes in You, Lord. ||2||

170.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
170.t: gur satigur dhaatai pa(n)th bataiaa har miliaa aai prabh meree ||
170.e: The Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, has shown me the Way; my Lord God came and met me.

170.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਭ ਆਸ ਪੁਜੀ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
170.t: anadhin anadh bhiaa vaddabhaagee sabh aas pujee jan keree ||3||
170.e: Night and day, I am filled with bliss; by great good fortune, all of the hopes of His humble servant have been fulfilled. ||3||

170.g: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
170.t: jaga(n)naath jagadheesur karate sabh vasagat hai har keree ||
170.e: O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe, everything is under Your control.

170.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਜਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੦॥੫੮॥
170.t: jan naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu paij jan keree ||4||6||20||58||
170.e: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, Lord; please, preserve the honor of Your humble servant. ||4||6||20||58||

170.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
170.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
170.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

170.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਹਾਢੇ ॥
170.t: eih manooaa khin na Tikai bahu ra(n)gee dheh dheh dhis chal chal haadde ||
170.e: This mind does not hold still, even for an instant. Distracted by all sorts of distractions, it wanders around aimlessly in the ten directions.

171.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
171.t: gur pooraa paiaa vaddabhaagee har ma(n)tr dheeaa man Thaadde ||1||
171.e: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||

171.g: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
171.t: raam ham satigur laale kaa(n)dde ||1|| rahaau ||
171.e: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

171.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
171.t: hamarai masatak dhaag dhagaanaa ham karaj guroo bahu saadde ||
171.e: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.

171.g: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
171.t: paraupakaar pu(n)n bahu keeaa bhau dhutar taar paraadde ||2||
171.e: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

171.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
171.t: jin kau preet ridhai har naahee tin koore gaaddan gaadde ||
171.e: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only false intentions and goals.

171.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
171.t: jiau paanee kaagadh binas jaat hai tiau manmukh garabh galaadde ||3||
171.e: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||

171.g: ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
171.t: ham jaaniaa kachhoo na jaaneh aagai jiau har raakhai tiau Thaadde ||
171.e: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.

171.g: ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
171.t: ham bhool chook gur kirapaa dhaarahu jan naanak kutare kaadde ||4||7||21||59||
171.e: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace; servant Nanak is Your obedient dog. ||4||7||21||59||

171.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
171.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
171.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

171.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.t: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo kha(n)ddal kha(n)ddaa he ||
171.e: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

171.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
171.t: poorab likhat likhe gur paiaa man har liv ma(n)ddal ma(n)ddaa he ||1||
171.e: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

171.g: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.t: kar saadhoo a(n)julee pu(n)n vaddaa he ||
171.e: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

171.g: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
171.t: kar dda(n)ddaut pun vaddaa he ||1|| rahaau ||
171.e: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

171.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.t: saakat har ras saadh na jaaniaa tin a(n)tar haumai ka(n)ddaa he ||
171.e: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

171.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
171.t: jiau jiau chaleh chubhai dhukh paaveh jamakaal saheh sir dda(n)ddaa he ||2||
171.e: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

171.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.t: har jan har har naam samaane dhukh janam maran bhav kha(n)ddaa he ||
171.e: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

171.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
171.t: abinaasee purakh paiaa paramesar bahu sobh kha(n)dd brahama(n)ddaa he ||3||
171.e: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

171.g: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
171.t: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vadd vaddaa he ||
171.e: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

171.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
171.t: jan naanak naam adhaar Tek hai har naame hee sukh ma(n)ddaa he ||4||8||22||60||
171.e: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60||

171.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
171.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
171.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

171.g: ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਧੀਠਾ ॥
171.t: eis gaR meh har raam rai hai kichh saadh na paavai dheeThaa ||
171.e: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn ones do not find the taste.

171.g: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
171.t: har dheen dhiaal anugrahu keeaa har gur sabadhee chakh ddeeThaa ||1||
171.e: When the Lord, Merciful to the meek, showed His Mercy, I found and tasted it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

171.g: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
171.t: raam har keeratan gur liv meeThaa ||1|| rahaau ||
171.e: Lovingly focused upon the Guru, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has become sweet to me. ||1||Pause||

171.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
171.t: har agam agochar paarabraham hai mil satigur laag baseeThaa ||
171.e: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.

171.g: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
171.t: jin gur bachan sukhaane heearai tin aagai aan pareeThaa ||2||
171.e: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence is revealed to them. ||2||

171.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ ॥
171.t: manmukh heearaa at kaThor hai tin a(n)tar kaar kareeThaa ||
171.e: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings are dark.

171.g: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਫੋਲਿ ਫੁਲੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
171.t: biseear kau bahu dhoodh peeaaieeaai bikh nikasai fol fuleeThaa ||3||
171.e: Even if the poisonous snake is fed large amounts of milk, it will still yield only poison. ||3||

171.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਘਸਿ ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਠਾ ॥
171.t: har prabh aan milaavahu gur saadhoo ghas garuR sabadh mukh leeThaa ||
171.e: O Lord God, please unite me with the Holy Guru, so that I might joyfully grind and eat the Shabad.

171.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੂਆ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੩॥੬੧॥
171.t: jan naanak gur ke laale gole lag sa(n)gat karooaa meeThaa ||4||9||23||61||
171.e: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Guru; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet. ||4||9||23||61||

171.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
171.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
171.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

171.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੇ ॥
171.t: har har arath sareer ham bechiaa poore gur kai aage ||
171.e: For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.

171.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
171.t: satigur dhaatai naam dhiRaiaa mukh masatak bhaag sabhaage ||1||
171.e: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. A very blessed and fortunate destiny is recorded upon my forehead. ||1||

171.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
171.t: raam gurmat har liv laage ||1|| rahaau ||
171.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I am lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

172.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
172.t: ghaT ghaT ramieeaa ramat raam rai gur sabadh guroo liv laage ||
172.e: The All-pervading Sovereign Lord King is contained in each and every heart. Through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am lovingly centered on the Lord.

172.g: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
172.t: hau man tan dhevau kaaT guroo kau meraa bhram bhau gur bachanee bhaage ||2||
172.e: Cutting my mind and body into pieces, I offer them to my Guru. The Guru's Teachings have dispelled my doubt and fear. ||2||

172.g: ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਆਨਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
172.t: a(n)dhiaarai dheepak aan jalaae gur giaan guroo liv laage ||
172.e: In the darkness, the Guru has lit the lamp of the Guru's wisdom; I am lovingly focused on the Lord.

172.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੀ ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
172.t: agiaan a(n)dheraa binas binaasio ghar vasat lahee man jaage ||3||
172.e: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, and my mind has been awakened; within the home of my inner being, I have found the genuine article. ||3||

172.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
172.t: saakat badhik maiaadhaaree tin jam johan laage ||
172.e: The vicious hunters, the faithless cynics, are hunted down by the Messenger of Death.

172.g: ਉਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥
172.t: aun satigur aagai sees na bechiaa oi aaveh jaeh abhaage ||4||
172.e: They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those wretched, unfortunate ones continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||4||

172.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗੇ ॥
172.t: hamaraa binau sunahu prabh Thaakur ham saran prabhoo har maage ||
172.e: Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I beg for the Sanctuary of the Lord God.

172.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲਜ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਬੇਚਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
172.t: jan naanak kee laj paat guroo hai sir bechio satigur aage ||5||10||24||62||
172.e: Servant Nanak's honor and respect is the Guru; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ||5||10||24||62||

172.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
172.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
172.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

172.g: ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
172.t: ham aha(n)kaaree aha(n)kaar agiaan mat gur miliaai aap gavaiaa ||
172.e: I am egotistical and conceited, and my intellect is ignorant. Meeting the Guru, my selfishness and conceit have been abolished.

172.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
172.t: haumai rog giaa sukh paiaa dhan dha(n)n guroo har raiaa ||1||
172.e: The illness of egotism is gone, and I have found peace. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

172.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
172.t: raam gur kai bachan har paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
172.e: I have found the Lord, through the Teachings of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

172.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
172.t: merai heearai preet raam rai kee gur maarag pa(n)th bataiaa ||
172.e: My heart is filled with love for the Sovereign Lord King; the Guru has shown me the path and the way to find Him.

172.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
172.t: meraa jeeau pi(n)dd sabh satigur aagai jin vichhuRiaa har gal laiaa ||2||
172.e: My soul and body all belong to the Guru; I was separated, and He has led me into the Lord's Embrace. ||2||

172.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
172.t: merai a(n)tar preet lagee dhekhan kau gur hiradhe naal dhikhaiaa ||
172.e: Deep within myself, I would love to see the Lord; the Guru has inspired me to see Him within my heart.

172.g: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
172.t: sahaj ana(n)dh bhiaa man morai gur aagai aap vechaiaa ||3||
172.e: Within my mind, intuitive peace and bliss have arisen; I have sold myself to the Guru. ||3||

172.g: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
172.t: ham aparaadh paap bahu keene kar dhusaTee chor churaiaa ||
172.e: I am a sinner - I have committed so many sins; I am a villainous, thieving thief.

172.g: ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
172.t: ab naanak saranaagat aae har raakhahu laaj har bhaiaa ||4||11||25||63||
172.e: Now, Nanak has come to the Lord's Sanctuary; preserve my honor, Lord, as it pleases Your Will. ||4||11||25||63||

172.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
172.t: gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
172.e: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

172.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
172.t: gurmat baajai sabadh anaahadh gurmat manooaa gaavai ||
172.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the unstruck music resounds; through the Guru's Teachings, the mind sings.

172.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
172.t: vaddabhaagee gur dharasan paiaa dhan dha(n)n guroo liv laavai ||1||
172.e: By great good fortune, I received the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has led me to love the Lord. ||1||

172.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
172.t: gurmukh har liv laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
172.e: The Gurmukh is lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

172.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
172.t: hamaraa Thaakur satigur pooraa man gur kee kaar kamaavai ||
172.e: My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru. My mind works to serve the Guru.

172.g: ਹਮ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
172.t: ham mal mal dhoveh paav guroo ke jo har har kathaa sunaavai ||2||
172.e: I massage and wash the Feet of the Guru, who recites the Sermon of the Lord. ||2||

172.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
172.t: hiradhai gurmat raam rasain jihavaa har gun gaavai ||
172.e: The Teachings of the Guru are in my heart; the Lord is the Source of nectar. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

172.g: ਮਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
172.t: man rasak rasak har ras aaghaane fir bahur na bhookh lagaavai ||3||
172.e: My mind is immersed in, and drenched with the Lord's essence. Fulfilled with the Lord's Love, I shall never feel hunger again. ||3||

172.g: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਵ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
172.t: koiee karai upaav anek bahutere bin kirapaa naam na paavai ||
172.e: People try all sorts of things, but without the Lord's Mercy, His Name is not obtained.

172.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
172.t: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree mat gurmat naam dhiraRaavai ||4||12||26||64||
172.e: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, he has enshrined the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||12||26||64||

172.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
172.t: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
172.e: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

172.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
172.t: gurmukh ji(n)dhoo jap naam kara(n)maa ||
172.e: O my soul, as Gurmukh, do this deed: chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

172.g: ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
172.t: mat maataa mat jeeau naam mukh raamaa ||
172.e: Make that teaching your mother, that it may teach you to keep the Lord's Name in your mouth.

172.g: ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
172.t: sa(n)tokh pitaa kar gur purakh ajanamaa ||
172.e: Let contentment be your father; the Guru is the Primal Being, beyond birth or incarnation.

173.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
173.t: vaddabhaagee mil raamaa ||1||
173.e: By great good fortune, you shall meet with the Lord. ||1||

173.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: gur jogee purakh miliaa ra(n)g maanee jeeau ||
173.e: I have met the Guru, the Yogi, the Primal Being; I am delighted with His Love.

173.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: gur har ra(n)g rataRaa sadhaa nirabaanee jeeau ||
173.e: The Guru is imbued with the Love of the Lord; He dwells forever in Nirvaanaa.

173.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: vaddabhaagee mil sughaR sujaanee jeeau ||
173.e: By great good fortune, I met the most accomplished and all-knowing Lord.

173.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥੨॥
173.t: meraa man tan har ra(n)g bhi(n)naa ||2||
173.e: My mind and body are drenched in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

173.g: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਹਾ ॥
173.t: aavahu sa(n)tahu mil naam japaahaa ||
173.e: Come, O Saints - let's meet together and chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

173.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: vich sa(n)gat naam sadhaa lai laahaa jeeau ||
173.e: In the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, let's earn the lasting profit of the Naam.

173.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: kar sevaa sa(n)taa a(n)mrit mukh paahaa jeeau ||
173.e: Let's serve the Saints, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

173.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਅੜੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
173.t: mil poorab likhiaRe dhur karamaa ||3||
173.e: By one's karma and pre-ordained destiny, they are met. ||3||

173.g: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: saavan varas a(n)mirat jag chhaiaa jeeau ||
173.e: In the month of Saawan, the clouds of Ambrosial Nectar hang over the world.

173.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰੁ ਕੁਹੁਕਿਅੜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
173.t: man mor kuhukiaRaa sabadh mukh paiaa ||
173.e: The peacock of the mind chirps, and receives the Word of the Shabad, in its mouth;

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: har a(n)mrit vuThaRaa miliaa har raiaa jeeau ||
173.e: the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord rains down, and the Sovereign Lord King is met.

173.t: jan naanak prem rata(n)naa ||4||1||27||65||
173.e: Servant Nanak is imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||1||27||65||

173.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
173.t: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
173.e: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

173.g: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰੀਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: aau sakhee gun kaaman kareehaa jeeau ||
173.e: Come, O sisters - let's make virtue our charms.

173.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਹ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: mil sa(n)t janaa ra(n)g maaneh raleeaa jeeau ||
173.e: Let's join the Saints, and enjoy the pleasure of the Lord's Love.

173.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: gur dheepak giaan sadhaa man baleeaa jeeau ||
173.e: The lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom burns steadily in my mind.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਢੁਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
173.t: har tuThai ddul ddul mileeaa jeeau ||1||
173.e: The Lord, being pleased and moved by pity, has led me to meet Him. ||1||

173.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: merai man tan prem lagaa har ddole jeeau ||
173.e: My mind and body are filled with love for my Darling Lord.

173.g: ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਚੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: mai mele mitr satigur vechole jeeau ||
173.e: The True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, has united me with my Friend.

173.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਸੰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: man dhevaa(n) sa(n)taa meraa prabh mele jeeau ||
173.e: I offer my mind to the Guru, who has led me to meet my God.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਘੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
173.t: har viTaRiahu sadhaa ghole jeeau ||2||
173.e: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||

173.g: ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: vas mere piaariaa vas mere govidhaa har kar kirapaa man vas jeeau ||
173.e: Dwell, O my Beloved, dwell, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, show mercy to me and come to dwell within my mind.

173.g: ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: man chi(n)dhiaRaa fal paiaa mere govi(n)dhaa gur pooraa vekh vigas jeeau ||
173.e: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, O my Lord of the Universe; I am transfixed with ecstasy, gazing upon the Perfect Guru.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: har naam miliaa sohaaganee mere govi(n)dhaa man anadhin anadh rahas jeeau ||
173.e: The happy soul-brides receive the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; night and day, their minds are blissful and happy.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਨਿਤ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਨਿ ਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
173.t: har paiaRaa vaddabhaageeiee mere govi(n)dhaa nit lai laahaa man has jeeau ||3||
173.e: By great good fortune, the Lord is found, O my Lord of the Universe; earning profit continually, the mind laughs with joy. ||3||

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: har aap upaae har aape vekhai har aape kaarai laiaa jeeau ||
173.e: The Lord Himself creates, and the Lord Himself beholds; the Lord Himself assigns all to their tasks.

173.g: ਇਕਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਖਸ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਫਕਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: eik khaaveh bakhas toT na aavai ikanaa fakaa paiaa jeeau ||
173.e: Some partake of the bounty of the Lord's favor, which never runs out, while others receive only a handful.

173.g: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਇਕਨਾ ਭਿਖ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: eik raaje takhat baheh nit sukhe'ee ikanaa bhikh ma(n)gaiaa jeeau ||
173.e: Some sit upon thrones as kings, and enjoy constant pleasures, while others must beg for charity.

173.g: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥੬੬॥
173.t: sabh iko sabadh varatadhaa mere govidhaa jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa jeeau ||4||2||28||66||
173.e: The Word of the Shabad is pervading in everyone, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak meditates on the Naam. ||4||2||28||66||

173.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
173.t: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
173.e: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

173.g: ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: man maahee man maahee mere govi(n)dhaa har ra(n)g rataa man maahee jeeau ||
173.e: From within my mind, from within my mind, O my Lord of the Universe, I am imbued with the Love of the Lord, from within my mind.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: har ra(n)g naal na lakheeaai mere govidhaa gur pooraa alakh lakhaahee jeeau ||
173.e: The Lord's Love is with me, but it cannot be seen, O my Lord of the Universe; the Perfect Guru has led me to see the unseen.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਭ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: har har naam paragaasiaa mere govi(n)dhaa sabh dhaaladh dhukh leh jaahee jeeau ||
173.e: He has revealed the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my Lord of the Universe; all poverty and pain have departed.

173.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
173.t: har padh uootam paiaa mere govi(n)dhaa vaddabhaagee naam samaahee jeeau ||1||
173.e: I have obtained the supreme status of the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; by great good fortune, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||1||

173.g: ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠੜਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: nainee mere piaariaa nainee mere govidhaa kinai har prabh ddiThaRaa nainee jeeau ||
173.e: With his eyes, O my Beloved, with his eyes, O my Lord of the Universe - has anyone ever seen the Lord God with his eyes?

173.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
173.t: meraa man tan bahut bairaagiaa mere govi(n)dhaa har baajhahu dhan kumalainee jeeau ||
173.e: My mind and body are sad and depressed, O my Lord of the Universe; without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is withering away.

174.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: sa(n)t janaa mil paiaa mere govidhaa meraa har prabh sajan sainee jeeau ||
174.e: Meeting the Saints, O my Lord of the Universe, I have found my Lord God, my Companion, my Best Friend.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਰੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
174.t: har aai miliaa jagajeevan mere govi(n)dhaa mai sukh vihaanee rainee jeeau ||2||
174.e: The Lord, the Life of the World, has come to meet me, O my Lord of the Universe. The night of my life now passes in peace. ||2||

174.g: ਮੈ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: mai melahu sa(n)t meraa har prabh sajan mai man tan bhukh lagaieeaa jeeau ||
174.e: O Saints, unite me with my Lord God, my Best Friend; my mind and body are hungry for Him.

174.g: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: hau reh na sakau bin dhekhe mere preetam mai a(n)tar birahu har laieeaa jeeau ||
174.e: I cannot survive without seeing my Beloved; deep within, I feel the pain of separation from the Lord.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: har raiaa meraa sajan piaaraa gur mele meraa man jeevaieeaa jeeau ||
174.e: The Sovereign Lord King is my Beloved, my Best Friend. Through the Guru, I have met Him, and my mind has been rejuvenated.

174.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
174.t: merai man tan aasaa pooreeaa mere govi(n)dhaa har miliaa man vaadhaieeaa jeeau ||3||
174.e: The hopes of my mind and body have been fulfilled, O my Lord of the Universe; meeting the Lord, my mind vibrates with joy. ||3||

174.g: ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: vaaree mere govi(n)dhaa vaaree mere piaariaa hau tudh viTaRiahu sadh vaaree jeeau ||
174.e: A sacrifice, O my Lord of the Universe, a sacrifice, O my Beloved; I am forever a sacrifice to You.

174.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: merai man tan prem pira(n)m kaa mere govidhaa har poo(n)jee raakh hamaaree jeeau ||
174.e: My mind and body are filled with love for my Husband Lord; O my Lord of the Universe, please preserve my assets.

174.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: satigur visaT mel mere govi(n)dhaa har mele kar raibaaree jeeau ||
174.e: Unite me with the True Guru, Your Advisor, O my Lord of the Universe; through His guidance, He shall lead me to the Lord.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੭॥
174.t: har naam dhiaa kar paiaa mere govi(n)dhaa jan naanak saran tumaaree jeeau ||4||3||29||67||
174.e: I have obtained the Lord's Name, by Your Mercy, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||29||67||

174.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
174.t: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
174.e: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

174.g: ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: chojee mere govi(n)dhaa chojee mere piaariaa har prabh meraa chojee jeeau ||
174.e: Playful is my Lord of the Universe; playful is my Beloved. My Lord God is wondrous and playful.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਖੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: har aape kaan(h) upaidhaa mere govidhaa har aape gopee khojee jeeau ||
174.e: The Lord Himself created Krishna, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is the milkmaids who seek Him.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: har aape sabh ghaT bhogadhaa mere govi(n)dhaa aape raseeaa bhogee jeeau ||
174.e: The Lord Himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is the Ravisher and the Enjoyer.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
174.t: har sujaan na bhuliee mere govi(n)dhaa aape satigur jogee jeeau ||1||
174.e: The Lord is All-knowing - He cannot be fooled, O my Lord of the Universe. He is the True Guru, the Yogi. ||1||

174.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: aape jagat upaidhaa mere govidhaa har aap khelai bahu ra(n)gee jeeau ||
174.e: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself plays in so many ways!

174.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨੰਗ ਨੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: eikanaa bhog bhogaidhaa mere govi(n)dhaa ik nagan fireh na(n)g na(n)gee jeeau ||
174.e: Some enjoy enjoyments, O my Lord of the Universe, while others wander around naked, the poorest of the poor.

174.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: aape jagat upaidhaa mere govidhaa har dhaan dhevai sabh ma(n)gee jeeau ||
174.e: He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord gives His gifts to all who beg for them.

174.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
174.t: bhagataa naam aadhaar hai mere govi(n)dhaa har kathaa ma(n)geh har cha(n)gee jeeau ||2||
174.e: His devotees have the Support of the Naam, O my Lord of the Universe; they beg for the sublime sermon of the Lord. ||2||

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੋਚ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: har aape bhagat karaidhaa mere govi(n)dhaa har bhagataa loch man pooree jeeau ||
174.e: The Lord Himself inspires His devotees to worship Him, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord fulfills the desires of the minds of His devotees.

174.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: aape jal thal varatadhaa mere govidhaa rav rahiaa nahee dhooree jeeau ||
174.e: He Himself is permeating and pervading the waters and the lands, O my Lord of the Universe; He is All-pervading - He is not far away.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: har a(n)tar baahar aap hai mere govidhaa har aap rahiaa bharapooree jeeau ||
174.e: The Lord Himself is within the self, and outside as well, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is fully pervading everywhere.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
174.t: har aatam raam pasaariaa mere govi(n)dhaa har vekhai aap hadhooree jeeau ||3||
174.e: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is diffused everywhere, O my Lord of the Universe. The Lord Himself beholds all; His Immanent Presence is pervading everywhere. ||3||

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: har a(n)tar vaajaa paun hai mere govi(n)dhaa har aap vajaae tiau vaajai jeeau ||
174.e: O Lord, the music of the praanic wind is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; as the Lord Himself plays this music, so does it vibrate and resound.

174.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: har a(n)tar naam nidhaan hai mere govi(n)dhaa gur sabadhee har prabh gaajai jeeau ||
174.e: O Lord, the treasure of the Naam is deep within, O my Lord of the Universe; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord God is revealed.

174.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
174.t: aape saran pavaidhaa mere govi(n)dhaa har bhagat janaa raakh laajai jeeau ||
174.e: He Himself leads us to enter His Sanctuary, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord preserves the honor of His devotees.

175.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
175.t: vaddabhaagee mil sa(n)gatee mere govi(n)dhaa jan naanak naam sidh kaajai jeeau ||4||4||30||68||
175.e: By great good fortune, one joins the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, O my Lord of the Universe; O servant Nanak, through the Naam, one's affairs are resolved. ||4||4||30||68||

175.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
175.t: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
175.e: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

175.g: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: mai har naamai har birahu lagaiee jeeau ||
175.e: The Lord has implanted a longing for the Lord's Name within me.

175.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: meraa har prabh mit milai sukh paiee jeeau ||
175.e: I have met the Lord God, my Best Friend, and I have found peace.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: har prabh dhekh jeevaa meree maiee jeeau ||
175.e: Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.

175.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
175.t: meraa naam sakhaa har bhaiee jeeau ||1||
175.e: The Lord's Name is my Friend and Brother. ||1||

175.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: gun gaavahu sa(n)t jeeau mere har prabh kere jeeau ||
175.e: O Dear Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord God.

175.g: ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: jap gurmukh naam jeeau bhaag vaddere jeeau ||
175.e: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O very fortunate ones.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: har har naam jeeau praan har mere jeeau ||
175.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.

175.g: ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
175.t: fir bahuR na bhavajal fere jeeau ||2||
175.e: I shall never again have to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

175.g: ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਖਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: kiau har prabh vekhaa merai man tan chaau jeeau ||
175.e: How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body yearn for Him.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: har melahu sa(n)t jeeau man lagaa bhaau jeeau ||
175.e: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints; my mind is in love with Him.

175.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: gur sabadhee paieeaai har preetam raau jeeau ||
175.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the Sovereign Lord, my Beloved.

175.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
175.t: vaddabhaagee jap naau jeeau ||3||
175.e: O very fortunate ones, chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||

175.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: merai man tan vaddaRee govi(n)dh prabh aasaa jeeau ||
175.e: Within my mind and body, there is such a great longing for God, the Lord of the Universe.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: har melahu sa(n)t jeeau govidh prabh paasaa jeeau ||
175.e: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints. God, the Lord of the Universe, is so close to me.

175.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: satigur mat naam sadhaa paragaasaa jeeau ||
175.e: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Naam is always revealed;

175.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਿਅੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
175.t: jan naanak pooriaRee man aasaa jeeau ||4||5||31||69||
175.e: the desires of servant Nanak's mind have been fulfilled. ||4||5||31||69||

175.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
175.t: gauRee maajh mahalaa chauthhaa ||
175.e: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehla:

175.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: meraa birahee naam milai taa jeevaa jeeau ||
175.e: If I receive my Love, the Naam, then I live.

175.g: ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: man a(n)dhar a(n)mrit gurmat har leevaa jeeau ||
175.e: In the temple of the mind, is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, we drink it in.

175.g: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: man har ra(n)g rataRaa har ras sadhaa peevaa jeeau ||
175.e: My mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. I continually drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
175.t: har paiaRaa man jeevaa jeeau ||1||
175.e: I have found the Lord within my mind, and so I live. ||1||

175.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: merai man tan prem lagaa har baan jeeau ||
175.e: The arrow of the Lord's Love has pierced by mind and body.

175.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: meraa preetam mitr har purakh sujaan jeeau ||
175.e: The Lord, the Primal Being, is All-knowing; He is my Beloved and my Best Friend.

175.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: gur mele sa(n)t har sughaR sujaan jeeau ||
175.e: The Saintly Guru has united me with the All-knowing and All-seeing Lord.

175.g: ਹਉ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
175.t: hau naam viTahu kurabaan jeeau ||2||
175.e: I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

175.g: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: hau har har sajan har meet dhasaiee jeeau ||
175.e: I seek my Lord, Har, Har, my Intimate, my Best Friend.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਸਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: har dhasahu sa(n)tahu jee har khoj pavaiee jeeau ||
175.e: Show me the way to the Lord, Dear Saints; I am searching all over for Him.

175.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: satigur tuThaRaa dhase har paiee jeeau ||
175.e: The Kind and Compassionate True Guru has shown me the Way, and I have found the Lord.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
175.t: har naame naam samaiee jeeau ||3||
175.e: Through the Name of the Lord, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

175.g: ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: mai vedhan prem har birahu lagaiee jeeau ||
175.e: I am consumed with the pain of separation from the Love of the Lord.

175.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: gur saradhaa poor a(n)mrit mukh paiee jeeau ||
175.e: The Guru has fulfilled my desire, and I have received the Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

175.g: ਹਰਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
175.t: har hoh dhiaal har naam dhiaaiee jeeau ||
175.e: The Lord has become merciful, and now I meditate on the Name of the Lord.

175.t: jan naanak har ras paiee jeeau ||4||6||20||18||32||70||
175.e: Servant Nanak has obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||6||20||18||32||70||

175.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਚਉਪਦੇ
175.t: mahalaa panjavaa raag gauRee guaareree chaupadhe
175.e: Fifth Mehla, Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Chau-Padhay:

175.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
175.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
175.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

175.g: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
175.t: kin bidh kusal hot mere bhaiee ||
175.e: How can happiness be found, O my Siblings of Destiny?

175.g: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
175.t: kiau paieeaai har raam sahaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
175.e: How can the Lord, our Help and Support, be found? ||1||Pause||

175.g: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
175.t: kusal na gireh meree sabh maiaa ||
175.e: There is no happiness in owning one's own home, in all of Maya,

175.g: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
175.t: uooche ma(n)dhar su(n)dhar chhaiaa ||
175.e: or in lofty mansions casting beautiful shadows.

175.g: ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
175.t: jhooThe laalach janam gavaiaa ||1||
175.e: In fraud and greed, this human life is being wasted. ||1||

176.e: He is pleased at the sight of his elephants and horses
and his armies assembled, his servants and his soldiers.
But the noose of egotism is tightening around his neck. ||2||
His rule may extend in all ten directions;
he may revel in pleasures, and enjoy many women
- but he is just a beggar, who in his dream, is a king. ||3||

176.g: ਏਕੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
176.t: ek kusal mo kau satiguroo bataiaa ||
176.e: The True Guru has shown me that there is only one pleasure.

176.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
176.t: har jo kichh kare su har kiaa bhagataa bhaiaa ||
176.e: Whatever the Lord does, is pleasing to the Lord's devotee.
Servant Nanak has abolished his ego, and he is absorbed in the Lord. ||4||

176.g: ਇਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
176.t: ein bidh kusal hot mere bhaiee ||
176.e: This is the way to find happiness, O my Siblings of Destiny.

176.g: ਇਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
176.t: eiau paieeaai har raam sahaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||
176.e: This is the way to find the Lord, our Help and Support. ||1||Second Pause||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

176.g: ਕਿਉ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
176.t: kiau bhrameeaai bhram kis kaa hoiee ||
176.e: Why do you doubt? What do you doubt?

176.g: ਜਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
176.t: jaa jal thal maheeal raviaa soiee ||
176.e: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky.
The Gurmukhs are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor. ||1||
One who is protected by the Merciful Lord

176.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
176.t: tis nahee dhoojaa ko pahuchanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
176.e: - no one else can rival him. ||1||Pause||
The Infinite One is pervading among all.

176.g: ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਉ ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
176.t: taa too(n) sukh soau hoi achi(n)taa ||
176.e: So sleep in peace, and don't worry.

176.g: ਓਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
176.t: oh sabh kichh jaanai jo varata(n)taa ||2||
176.e: He knows everything which happens. ||2||
The self-willed manmukhs are dying in the thirst of duality.

176.g: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਹਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
176.t: bahu jonee bhaveh dhur kirat likhiaasaa ||
176.e: They wander lost through countless incarnations; this is their pre-ordained destiny.
As they plant, so shall they harvest. ||3||
Beholding the Blessed Vision, my mind has blossomed forth.
And now everywhere I look, God is revealed to me.

176.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੧॥
176.t: jan naanak kee har pooran aasaa ||4||2||71||
176.e: Servant Nanak's hopes have been fulfilled by the Lord. ||4||2||71||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
In so many incarnations, you were a worm and a moth;
in so many incarnations, you were an elephant, a fish and a deer.
In so many incarnations, you were a bird and a snake.
In so many incarnations, you were yoked as an ox and a horse. ||1||
Meet the Lord of the Universe - now is the time to meet Him.
After so very long, this human body was fashioned for you. ||1||Pause||
In so many incarnations, you were rocks and mountains;
in so many incarnations, you were aborted in the womb;
in so many incarnations, you developed branches and leaves;
you wandered through 8.4 million incarnations. ||2||
Through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you obtained this human life.

176.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
176.t: kar sevaa bhaj har har gurmat ||
176.e: Do seva - selfless service; follow the Guru's Teachings, and vibrate the Lord's Name, Har, Har.
Abandon pride, falsehood and arrogance.
Remain dead while yet alive, and you shall be welcomed in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

176.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
176.t: jo kichh hoaa su tujh te hog ||
176.e: Whatever has been, and whatever shall be, comes from You, Lord.
No one else can do anything at all.
We are united with You, when You unite us with Yourself.

176.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੨॥
176.t: kahu naanak har har gun gai ||4||3||72||
176.e: Says Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||72||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
In the field of karma, plant the seed of the Naam.
Your works shall be brought to fruition.
You shall obtain these fruits, and the fear of death shall be dispelled.

176.g: ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
176.t: nit gaaveh har har gun jaas ||1||
176.e: Sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

176.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
176.t: har har naam a(n)tar ur dhaar ||
176.e: Keep the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, enshrined in your heart,
and your affairs shall be quickly resolved. ||1||Pause||
Be always attentive to your God;
thus you shall be honored in His Court.

177.g: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
177.t: aukat siaanap sagalee tiaag ||
177.e: Give up all your clever tricks and devices,

177.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
177.t: sa(n)t janaa kee charanee laag ||2||
177.e: and hold tight to the Feet of the Saints. ||2||

177.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਹਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
177.t: sarab jeea heh jaa kai haath ||
177.e: The One, who holds all creatures in His Hands,

177.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
177.t: kadhe na vichhuRai sabh kai saath ||
177.e: is never separated from them; He is with them all.

177.g: ਉਪਾਵ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
177.t: aupaav chhodd gahu tis kee oT ||
177.e: Abandon your clever devices, and grasp hold of His Support.

177.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥੩॥
177.t: nimakh maeh hovai teree chhoT ||3||
177.e: In an instant, you shall be saved. ||3||

177.g: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
177.t: sadhaa nikaT kar tis no jaan ||
177.e: Know that He is always near at hand.

177.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
177.t: prabh kee aagiaa sat kar maan ||
177.e: Accept the Order of God as True.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
177.t: gur kai bachan miTaavahu aap ||
177.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, eradicate selfishness and conceit.

177.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
177.t: har har naam naanak jap jaap ||4||4||73||
177.e: O Nanak, chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||4||73||

177.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
177.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
177.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
177.t: gur kaa bachan sadhaa abinaasee ||
177.e: The Guru's Word is eternal and everlasting.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
177.t: gur kai bachan kaTee jam faasee ||
177.e: The Guru's Word cuts away the noose of Death.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
177.t: gur kaa bachan jeea kai sa(n)g ||
177.e: The Guru's Word is always with the soul.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
177.t: gur kai bachan rachai raam kai ra(n)g ||1||
177.e: Through the Guru's Word, one is immersed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

177.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
177.t: jo gur dheeaa su man kai kaam ||
177.e: Whatever the Guru gives, is useful to the mind.

177.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
177.t: sa(n)t kaa keeaa sat kar maan ||1|| rahaau ||
177.e: Whatever the Saint does - accept that as True. ||1||Pause||

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਟਲ ਅਛੇਦ ॥
177.t: gur kaa bachan aTal achhedh ||
177.e: The Guru's Word is infallible and unchanging.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
177.t: gur kai bachan kaTe bhram bhedh ||
177.e: Through the Guru's Word, doubt and prejudice are dispelled.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
177.t: gur kaa bachan katahu na jai ||
177.e: The Guru's Word never goes away;

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
177.t: gur kai bachan har ke gun gai ||2||
177.e: through the Guru's Word, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
177.t: gur kaa bachan jeea kai saath ||
177.e: The Guru's Word accompanies the soul.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
177.t: gur kaa bachan anaath ko naath ||
177.e: The Guru's Word is the Master of the masterless.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
177.t: gur kai bachan narak na pavai ||
177.e: The Guru's Word saves one from falling into hell.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
177.t: gur kai bachan rasanaa a(n)mrit ravai ||3||
177.e: Through the Guru's Word, the tongue savors the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
177.t: gur kaa bachan paragaT sa(n)saar ||
177.e: The Guru's Word is revealed in the world.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
177.t: gur kai bachan na aavai haar ||
177.e: Through the Guru's Word, no one suffers defeat.

177.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੪॥
177.t: jis jan hoe aap kirapaal || naanak satigur sadhaa dhiaal ||4||5||74||
177.e: O Nanak, the True Guru is always kind and compassionate, unto those whom the Lord Himself has blessed with His Mercy. ||4||5||74||

177.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
177.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
177.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

177.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
177.t: jin keetaa maaTee te ratan ||
177.e: He makes jewels out of the dust,

177.g: ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
177.t: garabh meh raakhiaa jin kar jatan ||
177.e: and He managed to preserve you in the womb.

177.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
177.t: jin dheenee sobhaa vaddiaaiee ||
177.e: He has given you fame and greatness;

177.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
177.t: tis prabh kau aaTh pahar dhiaaiee ||1||
177.e: meditate on that God, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

177.g: ਰਮਈਆ ਰੇਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
177.t: ramieeaa ren saadh jan paavau ||
177.e: O Lord, I seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
177.t: gur mil apunaa khasam dhiaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
177.e: Meeting the Guru, I meditate on my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

177.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਮੂੜ ਤੇ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
177.t: jin keetaa mooR te bakataa ||
177.e: He transformed me, the fool, into a fine speaker,

177.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਬੇਸੁਰਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ॥
177.t: jin keetaa besurat te surataa ||
177.e: and He made the unconscious become conscious;

177.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
177.t: jis parasaadh navai nidh paiee ||
177.e: by His Grace, I have obtained the nine treasures.

177.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
177.t: so prabh man te bisarat naahee ||2||
177.e: May I never forget that God from my mind. ||2||

177.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
177.t: jin dheeaa nithaave kau thaan ||
177.e: He has given a home to the homeless;

177.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਿਮਾਨੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
177.t: jin dheeaa nimaane kau maan ||
177.e: He has given honor to the dishonored.

177.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
177.t: jin keenee sabh pooran aasaa ||
177.e: He has fulfilled all desires;

177.g: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
177.t: simarau dhin rain saas giraasaa ||3||
177.e: remember Him in meditation, day and night, with every breath and every morsel of food. ||3||

177.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਿਲਕ ਕਾਟੀ ॥
177.t: jis prasaadh maiaa silak kaaTee ||
177.e: By His Grace, the bonds of Maya are cut away.

177.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਟੀ ॥
177.t: gur prasaadh a(n)mrit bikh khaaTee ||
177.e: By Guru's Grace, the bitter poison has become Ambrosial Nectar.

177.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
177.t: kahu naanak is te kichh naahee ||
177.e: Says Nanak, I cannot do anything;

177.g: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੫॥
177.t: raakhanahaare kau saalaahee ||4||6||75||
177.e: I praise the Lord, the Protector. ||4||6||75||

177.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
177.t: gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa ||
177.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

177.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
177.t: tis kee saran naahee bhau sog ||
177.e: In His Sanctuary, there is no fear or sorrow.

177.g: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
177.t: aus te baahar kachhoo na hog ||
177.e: Without Him, nothing at all can be done.

177.g: ਤਜੀ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਬਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
177.t: tajee siaanap bal budh bikaar ||
177.e: I have renounced clever tricks, power and intellectual corruption.

177.g: ਦਾਸ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
177.t: dhaas apane kee raakhanahaar ||1||
177.e: God is the Protector of His servant. ||1||

177.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
177.t: jap man mere raam raam ra(n)g ||
177.e: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, Raam, Raam, with love.

177.g: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
177.t: ghar baahar terai sadh sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
177.e: Within your home, and beyond it, He is always with you. ||1||Pause||

177.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
177.t: tis kee Tek manai meh raakh ||
177.e: Keep His Support in your mind.

178.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
178.t: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mirat ras chaakh ||
178.e: Taste the ambrosial essence, the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Of what use are other efforts?
Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself protects our honor. ||2||
What is the human? What power does he have?
All the tumult of Maya is false.
Our Lord and Master is the One who acts, and causes others to act.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||
Of all comforts, this is the true comfort.
Keep the Guru's Teachings in your mind.

178.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
178.t: jaa kau raam naam liv laagee ||
178.e: Those who bear love for the Name of the Lord
- says Nanak, they are blessed, and very fortunate. ||4||7||76||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
Listening to the Lord's sermon, my pollution has been washed away.
I have become totally pure, and I now walk in peace.
By great good fortune, I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
I have fallen in love with the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

178.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਜਨੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
178.t: har har naam japat jan taario ||
178.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His servant has been carried across.

178.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
178.t: agan saagar gur paar utaario ||1|| rahaau ||
178.e: The Guru has lifted me up and carried me across the ocean of fire. ||1||Pause||
Singing the Kirtan of His Praises, my mind has become peaceful;
the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away.
I have seen all the treasures within my own mind;
why should I now go out searching for them? ||2||
When God Himself becomes merciful,
the work of His servant becomes perfect.
He has cut away my bonds, and made me His slave.
Remember, remember, remember Him in meditation; He is the treasure of excellence. ||3||
He alone is in the mind; He alone is everywhere.
The Perfect Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere.
The Perfect Guru has dispelled all doubts.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak has found peace. ||4||8||77||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
Those who have died have been forgotten.

178.g: ਜੋ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਕੁ ਖਰੇ ॥
178.t: jo ubare se ba(n)dh lak khare ||
178.e: Those who survive have fastened their belts.
They are busily occupied in their affairs;

178.g: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣ ਦਿੜੀ ਉਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
178.t: aun te dhugun dhiRee un maae ||1||
178.e: they cling twice as hard to Maya. ||1||

178.g: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਛੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
178.t: oh belaa kachh cheet na aavai ||
178.e: No one thinks of the time of death;
people grasp to hold that which shall pass away. ||1||Pause||
The fools - their bodies are bound down by desires.
They are mired in sexual desire, anger and attachment;
the Righteous Judge of Dharma stands over their heads.
Believing it to be sweet, the fools eat poison. ||2||

178.g: ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ ਹਉ ਸਾਧਉ ਬੈਰੁ ॥ ਹਮਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਘਾਲੈ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
178.t: hau ba(n)dhau hau saadhau bair || hamaree bhoom kaun ghaalai pair ||
178.e: They say, ""I shall tie up my enemy, and I shall cut him down. Who dares to set foot upon my land?
I am learned, I am clever and wise.""
The ignorant ones do not recognize their Creator. ||3||
The Lord Himself knows His Own state and condition.

178.g: ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
178.t: kiaa ko kahai kiaa aakh vakhaanai ||
178.e: What can anyone say? How can anyone describe Him?

178.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
178.t: jit jit laaveh tit tit laganaa ||
178.e: Whatever He attaches us to - to that we are attached.
Everyone begs for their own good. ||4||
Everything is Yours; You are the Creator Lord.
You have no end or limitation.
Please give this gift to Your servant,
that Nanak might never forget the Naam. ||5||9||78||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
By all sorts of efforts, people do not find salvation.
Through clever tricks, the weight is only piled on more and more.
Serving the Lord with a pure heart,
you shall be received with honor at God's Court. ||1||

179.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਓਲਾ ॥
179.t: man mere gahu har naam kaa olaa ||
179.e: O my mind, hold tight to the Support of the Lord's Name.

179.g: ਤੁਝੈ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾਤਾ ਝੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
179.t: tujhai na laagai taataa jholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
179.e: The hot winds shall never even touch you. ||1||Pause||
Like a boat in the ocean of fear;
like a lamp which illumines the darkness;
like fire which takes away the pain of cold
- just so, chanting the Name, the mind becomes peaceful. ||2||

179.g: ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
179.t: autar jai tere man kee piaas ||
179.e: The thirst of your mind shall be quenched,
and all hopes shall be fulfilled.
Your consciousness shall not waver.
Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam as Gurmukh, O my friend. ||3||
He alone receives the panacea, the medicine of the Naam,
unto whom the Lord, in His Grace, bestows it.

179.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥
179.t: har har naam jaa kai hiradhai vasai ||
179.e: One whose heart is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har
- O Nanak, his pains and sorrows are eliminated. ||4||10||79||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

179.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
179.t: bahut dharab kar man na aghaanaa ||
179.e: Even with vast sums of wealth, the mind is not satisfied.
Gazing upon countless beauties, the man is not satisfied.
He is so involved with his wife and sons - he believes that they belong to him.
That wealth shall pass away, and those relatives shall be reduced to ashes. ||1||
Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, they are crying out in pain.

179.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
179.t: dhirag tan dhirag dhan maiaa sa(n)g raate ||1|| rahaau ||
179.e: Their bodies are cursed, and their wealth is cursed - they are imbued with Maya. ||1||Pause||

179.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
179.t: jiau bigaaree kai sir dheejeh dhaam ||
179.e: The servant carries the bags of money on his head,

179.g: ਓਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਉਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ ॥
179.t: oi khasamai kai gireh un dhookh sahaam ||
179.e: but it goes to his master's house, and he receives only pain.
The man sits as a king in his dreams,
but when he opens his eyes, he sees that it was all in vain. ||2||
The watchman oversees the field of another,

179.g: ਖੇਤੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
179.t: khet khasam kaa raakhaa uTh jaae ||
179.e: but the field belongs to his master, while he must get up and depart.
He works so hard, and suffers for that field,

179.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪੜੈ ॥੩॥
179.t: tis kai paalai kachhoo na paRai ||3||
179.e: but still, nothing comes into his hands. ||3||

179.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
179.t: jis kaa raaj tisai kaa supanaa ||
179.e: The dream is His, and the kingdom is His;

179.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
179.t: jin maiaa dheenee tin laiee tirasanaa ||
179.e: He who has given the wealth of Maya, has infused the desire for it.
He Himself annihilates, and He Himself restores.
Nanak offers this prayer to God. ||4||11||80||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

179.g: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖੀ ॥
179.t: bahu ra(n)g maiaa bahu bidh pekhee ||
179.e: I have gazed upon the many forms of Maya, in so many ways.
With pen and paper, I have written clever things.
I have seen what it is to be a chief, a king, and an emperor,
but they do not satisfy the mind. ||1||

179.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
179.t: so sukh mo kau sa(n)t bataavahu ||
179.e: Show me that peace, O Saints,
which will quench my thirst and satisfy my mind. ||1||Pause||
You may have horses as fast as the wind, elephants to ride on,
sandalwood oil, and beautiful women in bed,
actors in dramas, singing in theaters

179.g: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
179.t: taa meh man sa(n)tokh na paiaa ||2||
179.e: - but even with them, the mind does not find contentment. ||2||
You may have a throne at the royal court, with beautiful decorations and soft carpets,
all sorts of luscious fruits and beautiful gardens,
the excitement of the chase and princely pleasures
- but still, the mind is not made happy by such illusory diversions. ||3||
In their kindness, the Saints have told me of the True One,
and so I have obtained all comforts and joy.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
Says Nanak, through great good fortune, I have found this. ||4||

179.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
179.t: jaa kai har dhan soiee suhelaa ||
179.e: One who obtains the wealth of the Lord becomes happy.

179.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥੮੧॥
179.t: prabh kirapaa te saadhasa(n)g melaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||12||81||
179.e: By God's Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat. ||1||Second Pause||12||81||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

180.e: The mortal claims this body as his own.
Again and again, he clings to it.
He is entangled with his children, his wife and household affairs.

180.g: ਹੋਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
180.t: hon na paieeaai raam ke dhaasaa ||1||
180.e: He cannot be the slave of the Lord. ||1||

180.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
180.t: kavan su bidh jit raam gun gai ||
180.e: What is that way, by which the Lord's Praises might be sung?

180.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
180.t: kavan su mat jit tarai ieh mai ||1|| rahaau ||
180.e: What is that intellect, by which this person might swim across, O mother? ||1||Pause||
That which is for his own good, he thinks is evil.
If someone tells him the truth, he looks upon that as poison.
He cannot tell victory from defeat.
This is the way of life in the world of the faithless cynic. ||2||
The demented fool drinks in the deadly poison,
while he believes the Ambrosial Naam to be bitter.
He does not even approach the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;
he wanders lost through 8.4 million incarnations. ||3||
The birds are caught in the net of Maya;

180.g: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
180.t: ras ras bhog kareh bahu ra(n)gee ||
180.e: immersed in the pleasures of love, they frolic in so many ways.

180.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੮੨॥
180.t: kahu naanak jis bhe kirapaal || gur poorai taa ke kaaTe jaal ||4||13||82||
180.e: Says Nanak, the Perfect Guru has cut away the noose from those, unto whom the Lord has shown His Mercy. ||4||13||82||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
By Your Grace, we find the Way.
By God's Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By God's Grace, we are released from our bondage.
By Your Grace, egotism is eradicated. ||1||
As You assign me, so I take to Your service.

180.g: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
180.t: ham te kachhoo na hovai dhev ||1|| rahaau ||
180.e: By myself, I cannot do anything at all, O Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||
If it pleases You, then I sing the Word of Your Bani.
If it pleases You, then I speak the Truth.
If it pleases You, then the True Guru showers His Mercy upon me.
All peace comes by Your Kindness, God. ||2||

180.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
180.t: jo tudh bhaavai so niramal karamaa ||
180.e: Whatever pleases You is a pure action of karma.

180.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
180.t: jo tudh bhaavai so sach dharamaa ||
180.e: Whatever pleases You is the true faith of Dharma.

180.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
180.t: sarab nidhaan gun tum hee paas ||
180.e: The treasure of all excellence is with You.
Your servant prays to You, O Lord and Master. ||3||

180.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
180.t: man tan niramal hoi har ra(n)g ||
180.e: The mind and body become immaculate through the Lord's Love.
All peace is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
My mind remains attuned to Your Name;
Nanak affirms this as his greatest pleasure. ||4||14||83||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
You may taste the other flavors,
but your thirst shall not depart, even for an instant.

180.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
180.t: har ras kaa too(n) chaakheh saadh ||
180.e: If you taste the sweet flavor of the Lord's sublime essence
- upon tasting it, you shall be wonder-struck and amazed. ||1||
O dear beloved tongue, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

180.g: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
180.t: eeh ras raatee hoi tirapataaree ||1|| rahaau ||
180.e: Imbued with this sublime essence, you shall be satisfied. ||1||Pause||

180.g: ਹੇ ਜਿਹਵੇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
180.t: he jihave too(n) raam gun gaau ||
180.e: O tongue, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

180.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
180.t: nimakh nimakh har har har dhiaau ||
180.e: Each and every moment, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
Do not listen to any other, and do not go anywhere else.
By great good fortune, you shall find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

180.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਹਵੇ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਗਾਧਿ ॥
180.t: aaTh pahar jihave aaraadh || paarabraham Thaakur aagaadh ||
180.e: Twenty-four hours a day, O tongue, dwell upon God, the Unfathomable, Supreme Lord and Master.
Here and hereafter, you shall be happy forever.
Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O tongue, you shall become priceless. ||3||
All the vegetation will blossom forth for you, flowering in fruition;

180.g: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੇ ॥
180.t: eeh ras raatee bahur na chhodde ||
180.e: imbued with this sublime essence, you shall never leave it again.

180.g: ਆਨ ਨ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
180.t: aan na ras kas lavai na laiee ||
180.e: No other sweet and tasty flavors can compare to it.

180.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੪॥
180.t: kahu naanak gur bhe hai sahaiee ||4||15||84||
180.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has become my Support. ||4||15||84||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
The mind is the temple, and the body is the fence built around it.

181.e: The infinite substance is within it.
Within it, the great merchant is said to dwell.

181.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਬਾਪਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਊਹਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
181.t: kavan baapaaree jaa kaa uoohaa visaahu ||1||
181.e: Who is the trader who deals there? ||1||
How rare is that trader who deals in the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He takes the Ambrosial Nectar as his food. ||1||Pause||
He dedicates his mind and body to serving the Lord.

181.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
181.t: kavan su jugat jit kar bheejai ||
181.e: How can we please the Lord?
I fall at His Feet, and I renounce all sense of 'mine and yours'.

181.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
181.t: kavanu su jan jo saudhaa jorai ||2||
181.e: Who can settle this bargain? ||2||

181.g: ਮਹਲੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
181.t: mahal saeh kaa kin bidh paavai ||
181.e: How can I attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence?

181.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
181.t: kavan su bidh jit bheetar bulaavai ||
181.e: How can I get Him to call me inside?

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
181.t: too(n) vadd saahu jaa ke koT vanajaare ||
181.e: You are the Great Merchant; You have millions of traders.
Who is the benefactor? Who can take me to Him? ||3||
Seeking and searching, I have found my own home, deep within my own being.
The True Lord has shown me the priceless jewel.
When the Great Merchant shows His Mercy, He blends us into Himself.
Says Nanak, place your faith in the Guru. ||4||16||85||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla, Gwaarayree:
Night and day, they remain in the Love of the One.

181.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
181.t: prabh kau jaanai sadh hee sa(n)gaa ||
181.e: They know that God is always with them.
They make the Name of their Lord and Master their way of life;
they are satisfied and fulfilled with the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

181.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
181.t: har sa(n)g raate man tan hare ||
181.e: Imbued with the Love of the Lord, their minds and bodies are rejuvenated,

181.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
181.t: gur poore kee saranee pare ||1|| rahaau ||
181.e: entering the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||
The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of the soul.
They see only the One, and obey His Order.
There is only one trade, and one occupation.
They know no other than the Formless Lord. ||2||
They are free of both pleasure and pain.
They remain unattached, joined to the Lord's Way.

181.g: ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
181.t: dheeseh sabh meh sabh te rahate ||
181.e: They are seen among all, and yet they are distinct from all.
They focus their meditation on the Supreme Lord God. ||3||
How can I describe the Glories of the Saints?

181.g: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
181.t: agaadh bodh kichh mit nahee jaanau ||
181.e: Their knowledge is unfathomable; their limits cannot be known.
O Supreme Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon me.
Bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||17||86||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
181.t: too(n) meraa sakhaa too(n)hee meraa meet ||
181.e: You are my Companion; You are my Best Friend.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀਤੁ ॥
181.t: too(n) meraa preetam tum sa(n)g heet ||
181.e: You are my Beloved; I am in love with You.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
181.t: too(n) meree pat toohai meraa gahanaa ||
181.e: You are my honor; You are my decoration.

181.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਮਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
181.t: tujh bin nimakh na jaiee rahanaa ||1||
181.e: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||1||

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
181.t: too(n) mere laalan too(n) mere praan ||
181.e: You are my Intimate Beloved, You are my breath of life.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
181.t: too(n) mere saahib too(n) mere khaan ||1|| rahaau ||
181.e: You are my Lord and Master; You are my Leader. ||1||Pause||

181.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
181.t: jiau tum raakhahu tiv hee rahanaa ||
181.e: As You keep me, so do I survive.

181.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
181.t: jo tum kahahu soiee moh karanaa ||
181.e: Whatever You say, that is what I do.
Wherever I look, there I see You dwelling.
O my Fearless Lord, with my tongue, I chant Your Name. ||2||

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੂੰ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
181.t: too(n) meree nav nidh too(n) bha(n)ddaar ||
181.e: You are my nine treasures, You are my storehouse.
I am imbued with Your Love; You are the Support of my mind.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੀਆ ॥
181.t: too(n) meree sobhaa tum sa(n)g racheeaa ||
181.e: You are my Glory; I am blended with You.

181.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
181.t: too(n) meree oT too(n) hai meraa takeeaa ||3||
181.e: You are my Shelter; You are my Anchoring Support. ||3||
Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.
I have obtained Your secret from the Guru.
Through the True Guru, the One and only Lord was implanted within me;

181.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੭॥
181.t: naanak dhaas har har har Tekai ||4||18||87||
181.e: servant Nanak has taken to the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||18||87||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

182.e: It torments us with the expression of pleasure and pain.
It torments us through incarnations in heaven and hell.
It is seen to afflict the rich, the poor and the glorious.
The source of this illness which torments us is greed. ||1||
Maya torments us in so many ways.

182.g: ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
182.t: sa(n)t jeeveh prabh oT tumaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
182.e: But the Saints live under Your Protection, God. ||1||Pause||
It torments us through intoxication with intellectual pride.
It torments us through the love of children and spouse.
It torments us through elephants, horses and beautiful clothes.
It torments us through the intoxication of wine and the beauty of youth. ||2||
It torments landlords, paupers and lovers of pleasure.
It torments us through the sweet sounds of music and parties.
It torments us through beautiful beds, palaces and decorations.
It torments us through the darkness of the five evil passions. ||3||
It torments those who act, entangled in ego.
It torments us through household affairs, and it torments us in renunciation.
It torments us through character, lifestyle and social status.

182.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥
182.t: sabh kichh biaapat bin har ra(n)g raat ||4||
182.e: It torments us through everything, except for those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||

182.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
182.t: sa(n)tan ke ba(n)dhan kaaTe har rai ||
182.e: The Sovereign Lord King has cut away the bonds of His Saints.
How can Maya torment them?

182.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੯॥੮੮॥
182.t: kahu naanak jin dhoor sa(n)t paiee || taa kai nikaT na aavai maiee ||5||19||88||
182.e: Says Nanak, Maya does not draw near those who have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||5||19||88||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
The eyes are asleep in corruption, gazing upon the beauty of another.
The ears are asleep, listening to slanderous stories.
The tongue is asleep, in its desire for sweet flavors.
The mind is asleep, fascinated by Maya. ||1||

182.g: ਇਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
182.t: eis gireh meh koiee jaagat rahai ||
182.e: Those who remain awake in this house are very rare;

182.g: ਸਾਬਤੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
182.t: saabat vasat oh apanee lahai ||1|| rahaau ||
182.e: by doing so, they receive the whole thing. ||1||Pause||
All of my companions are intoxicated with their sensory pleasures;

182.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
182.t: gireh apune kee khabar na jaatee ||
182.e: they do not know how to guard their own home.
The five thieves have plundered them;
the thugs descend upon the unguarded village. ||2||

182.g: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
182.t: aun te raakhai baap na maiee ||
182.e: Our mothers and fathers cannot save us from them;

182.g: ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
182.t: aun te raakhai meet na bhaiee ||
182.e: friends and brothers cannot protect us from them
they cannot be restrained by wealth or cleverness.
Only through the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, can those villains be brought under control. ||3||
Have Mercy upon me, O Lord, Sustainer of the world.
The dust of the feet of the Saints is all the treasure I need.
In the Company of the True Guru, one's investment remains intact.
Nanak is awake to the Love of the Supreme Lord. ||4||
He alone is awake, unto whom God shows His Mercy.

182.g: ਇਹ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੦॥੮੯॥
182.t: eeh poo(n)jee saabat dhan maal ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||20||89||
182.e: This investment, wealth and property shall remain intact. ||1||Second Pause||20||89||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
Kings and emperors are under His Power.

182.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
182.t: jaa kai vas hai sagal jahaan ||
182.e: The whole world is under His Power.

182.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
182.t: jaa kaa keeaa sabh kichh hoi ||
182.e: Everything is done by His doing;
other than Him, there is nothing at all. ||1||
Offer your prayers to your True Guru;
He will resolve your affairs. ||1||Pause||

182.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
182.t: sabh te uooch jaa kaa dharabaar ||
182.e: The Darbaar of His Court is the most exalted of all.

182.g: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
182.t: sagal bhagat jaa kaa naam adhaar ||
182.e: His Name is the Support of all His devotees.
The Perfect Master is pervading everywhere.

182.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਨੀ ॥੨॥
182.t: jaa kee sobhaa ghaT ghaT banee ||2||
