182.e: His Glory is manifest in each and every heart. ||2||
Remembering Him in meditation, the home of sorrow is abolished.

182.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
182.t: jis simarat jam kichhoo na kahai ||
182.e: Remembering Him in meditation, the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.
Remembering Him in meditation, the dry branches become green again.

183.e: Remembering Him in meditation, sinking stones are made to float. ||3||
I salute and applaud the Society of the Saints.

183.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
183.t: har har naam jan praan adhaar ||
183.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Support of the breath of life of His servant.
Says Nanak, the Lord has heard my prayer;

183.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੦॥
183.t: sa(n)t prasaadh mo kau naam nivaas ||4||21||90||
183.e: by the Grace of the Saints, I dwell in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||21||90||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
By the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, the fire of desire is quenched.
Meeting the True Guru, egotism is subdued.
In the Company of the True Guru, the mind does not waver.
The Gurmukh speaks the Ambrosial Word of Gurbani. ||1||

183.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਾ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
183.t: sabh jag saachaa jaa sach meh raate ||
183.e: He sees the True One pervading the whole world; he is imbued with the True One.

183.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
183.t: seetal saat gur te prabh jaate ||1|| rahaau ||
183.e: I have become cool and tranquil, knowing God, through the Guru. ||1||Pause||
By the Grace of the Saints, one chants the Lord's Name.
By the Grace of the Saints, one sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
By the Grace of the Saints, all pains are erased.
By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from bondage. ||2||

183.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ॥
183.t: sa(n)t kirapaa te miTe moh bharam ||
183.e: By the kind Mercy of the Saints, emotional attachment and doubt are removed.
Taking a bath in the dust of the feet of the Holy - this is true Dharmic faith.
By the kindness of the Holy, the Lord of the Universe becomes merciful.
The life of my soul is with the Holy. ||3||

183.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਬੈਠਣੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
183.t: kirapaa nidh kirapaal dhiaavau || saadhasa(n)g taa baiThan paavau ||
183.e: Meditating on the Merciful Lord, the Treasure of Mercy, I have obtained a seat in the Saadh Sangat.

183.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
183.t: moh niragun kau prabh keenee dhiaa ||
183.e: I am worthless, but God has been kind to me.
In the Saadh Sangat, Nanak has taken to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||22||91||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord God.
The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Shedding my ego, I have become free of hate.
Twenty-four hours a day, I worship the Guru's Feet. ||1||
Now, my evil sense of alienation is eliminated,

183.g: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
183.t: jab te suniaa har jas kaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
183.e: since I have heard the Praises of the Lord with my ears. ||1||Pause||
The Savior Lord is the treasure of intuitive peace, poise and bliss.
He shall save me in the end.
My pains, sufferings, fears and doubts have been erased.
He has mercifully saved me from coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
He Himself beholds, speaks and hears all.

183.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
183.t: sadhaa sa(n)g taa kau man jaap ||
183.e: O my mind, meditate on the One who is always with you.
By the Grace of the Saints, the Light has dawned.
The One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence, is perfectly pervading everywhere. ||3||

183.g: ਕਹਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਣਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
183.t: kahat pavitr sunat puneet || gun govi(n)dh gaaveh nit neet ||
183.e: Pure are those who speak, and sanctified are those who hear and sing, forever and ever, the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

183.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
183.t: kahu naanak jaa kau hoh kirapaal ||
183.e: Says Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Mercy,

183.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੨॥
183.t: tis jan kee sabh pooran ghaal ||4||23||92||
183.e: all one's efforts are fulfilled. ||4||23||92||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
He breaks our bonds, and inspires us to chant the Lord's Name.

183.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
183.t: man meh laagai saach dhiaan || miTeh kales sukhee hoi raheeaai ||
183.e: With the mind centered in meditation on the True Lord, anguish is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace.
Such is the True Guru, the Great Giver. ||1||
He alone is the Giver of peace, who inspires us to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

183.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
183.t: kar kirapaa tis sa(n)g milaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
183.e: By His Grace, He leads us to merge with Him. ||1||Pause||

183.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
183.t: jis hoi dhiaal tis aap milaavai ||
183.e: He unites with Himself those unto whom He has shown His Mercy.
All treasures are received from the Guru.
Renouncing selfishness and conceit, coming and going come to an end.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Supreme Lord God is recognized. ||2||
God has become merciful to His humble servant.

184.e: The One Lord of the Universe is the Support of His humble servants.
They love the One Lord; their minds are filled with love for the Lord.

184.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
184.t: sarab nidhaan jan kai har naau ||3||
184.e: The Name of the Lord is all treasures for them. ||3||
They are in love with the Supreme Lord God;
their actions are pure, and their lifestyle is true.
The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness.
Nanak's God is Incomparable and Infinite. ||4||24||93||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

184.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
184.t: jis man vasai tarai jan soi ||
184.e: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord, swim across.
Those who have the blessing of good karma, meet with the Lord.

184.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
184.t: dhookh rog kachh bhau na biaapai ||
184.e: Pain, disease and fear do not affect them at all.
They meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within their hearts. ||1||
Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord.

184.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
184.t: gur poore te ieh mat paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
184.e: From the Perfect Guru, this understanding is obtained. ||1||Pause||
The Merciful Lord is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.
He is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible, Eternal and Infinite.
Meditate on Him, O my mind, through the Teachings of the Perfect Guru. ||2||
Serving Him, all treasures are obtained.
Worshipping God, honor is obtained.

184.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
184.t: jaa kee Tahal na birathee jai ||
184.e: Working for Him is never in vain;

184.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
184.t: sadhaa sadhaa har ke gun gai ||3||
184.e: forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
Show Mercy to me, O God, O Searcher of hearts.
The Unseen Lord and Master is the Treasure of Peace.
All beings and creatures seek Your Sanctuary;
Nanak is blessed to receive the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||25||94||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:

184.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
184.t: jeea jugat jaa kai hai haath ||
184.e: Our way of life is in His Hands;
remember Him, the Master of the masterless.

184.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
184.t: prabh chit aae sabh dhukh jai ||
184.e: When God comes to mind, all pains depart.

184.g: ਭੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
184.t: bhai sabh binaseh har kai nai ||1||
184.e: All fears are dispelled through the Name of the Lord. ||1||

184.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਾ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
184.t: bin har bhau kaahe kaa maaneh ||
184.e: Why do you fear any other than the Lord?

184.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
184.t: har bisarat kaahe sukh jaaneh ||1|| rahaau ||
184.e: Forgetting the Lord, why do you pretend to be at peace? ||1||Pause||
He established the many worlds and skies.
The soul is illumined with His Light;

184.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
184.t: jaa kee bakhas na meTai koi ||
184.e: no one can revoke His Blessing.
Meditate, meditate in remembrance on God, and become fearless. ||2||
Twenty-four hours a day, meditate in remembrance on God's Name.
In it are the many sacred shrines of pilgrimage and cleansing baths.
Seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God.

184.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੰਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
184.t: koT kala(n)k khin meh miT jaeh ||3||
184.e: Millions of mistakes shall be erased in an instant. ||3||
The Perfect King is self-sufficient.
God's servant has true faith in Him.
Giving him His Hand, the Perfect Guru protects him.
O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God is All-powerful. ||4||26||95||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
By Guru's Grace, my mind is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Asleep for so many incarnations, it is now awakened.
I chant the Ambrosial Bani, the Glorious Praises of God.
The Pure Teachings of the Perfect Guru have been revealed to me. ||1||
Meditating in remembrance on God, I have found total peace.

184.g: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
184.t: ghar baahar sukh sahaj sabaae ||1|| rahaau ||
184.e: Within my home, and outside as well, there is peace and poise all around. ||1||Pause||
I have recognized the One who created me.
Showing His Mercy, God has blended me with Himself.
Taking me by the arm, He has made me His Own.

184.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
184.t: har har kathaa sadhaa jap japanaa ||2||
184.e: I continually chant and meditate on the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||
Mantras, tantras, all-curing medicines and acts of atonement,

185.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
185.t: har har naam jeea praan adhaar ||
185.e: are all in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Support of the soul and the breath of life.
I have obtained the true wealth of the Lord's Love.
I have crossed over the treacherous world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||
Sit in peace, O Saints, with the family of friends.

185.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਓ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
185.t: har dhan khaTio jaa kaa naeh sumaar ||
185.e: Earn the wealth of the Lord, which is beyond estimation.
He alone obtains it, unto whom the Guru has bestowed it.
O Nanak, no one shall go away empty-handed. ||4||27||96||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
The hands are sanctified instantly,
and the entanglements of Maya are dispelled.
Repeat constantly with your tongue the Glorious Praises of the Lord,
and you shall find peace, O my friends, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
With pen and ink, write upon your paper

185.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
185.t: raam naam har a(n)mirat baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
185.e: the Name of the Lord, the Ambrosial Word of the Lord's Bani. ||1||Pause||
By this act, your sins shall be washed away.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death.

185.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
185.t: dharam rai ke dhoot na johai ||
185.e: The couriers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall not touch you.
The intoxication of Maya shall not entice you at all. ||2||
You shall be redeemed, and through you, the whole world shall be saved,
if you chant the Name of the One and Only Lord.
Practice this yourself, and teach others;
instill the Lord's Name in your heart. ||3||
That person, who has this treasure upon his forehead
that person meditates on God.

185.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
185.t: aaTh pahar har har gun gaau ||
185.e: Twenty-four hours a day, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

185.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੭॥
185.t: kahu naanak hau tis bal jaau ||4||28||97||
185.e: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||4||28||97||

185.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ
185.t: raag gauRee guaareree mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe dhupadhe
185.e: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
That which belongs to another - he claims as his own.

185.g: ਜੋ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
185.t: jo taj chhoddan tis siau man rachanaa ||1||
185.e: That which he must abandon - to that, his mind is attracted. ||1||
Tell me, how can he meet the Lord of the World?

185.g: ਜੋ ਬਿਬਰਜਤ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
185.t: jo bibarajat tis siau neh ||1|| rahaau ||
185.e: That which is forbidden - with that, he is in love. ||1||Pause||

185.g: ਝੂਠੁ ਬਾਤ ਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
185.t: jhooTh baat saa sach kar jaatee ||
185.e: That which is false - he deems as true.

185.g: ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
185.t: sat hovan man lagai na raatee ||2||
185.e: That which is true - his mind is not attached to that at all. ||2||
He takes the crooked path of the unrighteous way;
leaving the straight and narrow path, he weaves his way backwards. ||3||

185.g: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
185.t: dhuhaa siriaa kaa khasam prabh soiee ||
185.e: God is the Lord and Master of both worlds.

185.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੮॥
185.t: jis mele naanak so mukataa hoiee ||4||29||98||
185.e: He, whom the Lord unites with Himself, O Nanak, is liberated. ||4||29||98||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, they come together through destiny.
As long as the Lord commands, they enjoy their pleasures. ||1||
By burning oneself, the Beloved Lord is not obtained.

185.g: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਸਤੀ ਉਠਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
185.t: kirat sa(n)jog satee uTh hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
185.e: Only by the actions of destiny does she rise up and burn herself, as a 'satee'. ||1||Pause||
Imitating what she sees, with her stubborn mind-set, she goes into the fire.

185.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
185.t: pria sa(n)g na paavai bahu jon bhavaieeaai ||2||
185.e: She does not obtain the Company of her Beloved Lord, and she wanders through countless incarnations. ||2||
With pure conduct and self-restraint, she surrenders to her Husband Lord's Will;

185.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
185.t: tis naaree kau dhukh na jamaanai ||3||
185.e: that woman shall not suffer pain at the hands of the Messenger of Death. ||3||

185.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
185.t: kahu naanak jin priau paramesar kar jaaniaa ||
185.e: Says Nanak, she who looks upon the Transcendent Lord as her Husband,
is the blessed 'satee'; she is received with honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||30||99||
Gauree Gwaarayree, Fifth Mehla:
I am prosperous and fortunate, for I have received the True Name.

185.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
185.t: har gun gaaveh sahaj subhai ||1|| rahaau ||
185.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural, intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

186.g: ਪੀਊ ਦਾਦੇ ਕਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
186.t: peeuoo dhaadhe kaa khol ddiThaa khajaanaa ||
186.e: When I opened it up and gazed upon the treasures of my father and grandfather,
then my mind became very happy. ||1||

186.g: ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਮੋਲੁ ॥ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਖੂਟ ਅਤੋਲ ॥੨॥
186.t: ratan laal jaa kaa kachhoo na mol || bhare bha(n)ddaar akhooT atol ||2||
186.e: The storehouse is inexhaustible and immeasurable, overflowing with priceless jewels and rubies. ||2||
The Siblings of Destiny meet together, and eat and spend,
but these resources do not diminish; they continue to increase. ||3||

186.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
186.t: kahu naanak jis masatak lekh likhai ||
186.e: Says Nanak, one who has such destiny written on his forehead,
becomes a partner in these treasures. ||4||31||100||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

186.g: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਤੇ ਜਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
186.t: ddar ddar marate jab jaaneeaai dhoor ||
186.e: I was scared, scared to death, when I thought that He was far away.
But my fear was removed, when I saw that He is pervading everywhere. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

186.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
186.t: chhodd na jaiee sarapar taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
186.e: He shall not abandon me; He shall surely carry me across. ||1||Pause||

186.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਬ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
186.t: dhookh rog sog bisarai jab naam ||
186.e: Pain, disease and sorrow come when one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

186.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
186.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh jaa har gun gaam ||2||
186.e: Eternal bliss comes when one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
Do not say that anyone is good or bad.
Renounce your arrogant pride, and grasp the Feet of the Lord. ||3||
Says Nanak, remember the GurMantra;
you shall find peace at the True Court. ||4||32||101||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

186.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਮੀਆ ॥
186.t: jaa kaa meet saajan hai sameeaa ||
186.e: Those who have the Lord as their Friend and Companion

186.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਕਮੀਆ ॥੧॥
186.t: tis jan kau kahu kaa kee kameeaa ||1||
186.e: - tell me, what else do they need? ||1||

186.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
186.t: jaa kee preet gobi(n)dh siau laagee ||
186.e: Those who are in love with the Lord of the Universe

186.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
186.t: dhookh dharadh bhram taa kaa bhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
186.e: - pain, suffering and doubt run away from them. ||1||Pause||

186.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
186.t: jaa kau ras har ras hai aaio ||
186.e: Those who have enjoyed the flavor of the Lord's sublime essence
are not attracted to any other pleasures. ||2||
Those whose speech is accepted in the Court of the Lord

186.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵੈ ਤਲੈ ॥੩॥
186.t: so kis kau nadhar lai aavai talai ||3||
186.e: - what do they care about anything else? ||3||

186.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
186.t: jaa kaa sabh kichh taa kaa hoi ||
186.e: Those who belong to the One, unto whom all things belong

186.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੧੦੨॥
186.t: naanak taa kau sadhaa sukh hoi ||4||33||102||
186.e: - O Nanak, they find a lasting peace. ||4||33||102||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

186.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
186.t: jaa kai dhukh sukh sam kar jaapai ||
186.e: Those who look alike upon pleasure and pain
- how can anxiety touch them? ||1||
The Lord's Holy Saints abide in celestial bliss.
They remain obedient to the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King. ||1||Pause||

186.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
186.t: jaa kai achi(n)t vasai man aai ||
186.e: Those who have the Carefree Lord abiding in their minds
- no cares will ever bother them. ||2||

186.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
186.t: jaa kai binasio man te bharamaa ||
186.e: Those who have banished doubt from their minds

186.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਡਰੁ ਜਮਾ ॥੩॥
186.t: taa kai kachhoo naahee ddar jamaa ||3||
186.e: are not afraid of death at all. ||3||

186.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
186.t: jaa kai hiradhai dheeo gur naamaa ||
186.e: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord's Name by the Guru

186.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੧੦੩॥
186.t: kahu naanak taa kai sagal nidhaanaa ||4||34||103||
186.e: - says Nanak, all treasures come to them. ||4||34||103||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

186.g: ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
186.t: agam roop kaa man meh thaanaa ||
186.e: The Lord of Unfathomable Form has His Place in the mind.
By Guru's Grace, a rare few come to understand this. ||1||
The Ambrosial Pools of the celestial sermon

186.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਲੈ ਭੁੰਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
186.t: jiseh paraapat tis lai bhu(n)chaa ||1|| rahaau ||
186.e: - those who find them, drink them in. ||1||Pause||
The unstruck melody of the Guru's Bani vibrates in that most special place.
The Lord of the World is fascinated with this melody. ||2||
The numerous, countless places of celestial peace
- there, the Saints dwell, in the Company of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||
There is infinite joy, and no sorrow or duality.

186.g: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੧੦੪॥
186.t: so ghar gur naanak kau dheeaa ||4||35||104||
186.e: The Guru has blessed Nanak with this home. ||4||35||104||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
What form of Yours should I worship and adore?
What Yoga should I practice to control my body? ||1||

187.g: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਲੈ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
187.t: kavan gun jo tujh lai gaavau ||
187.e: What is that virtue, by which I may sing of You?
What is that speech, by which I may please the Supreme Lord God? ||1||Pause||
What worship service shall I perform for You?

187.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥
187.t: kavan su bidh jit bhavajal tarau ||2||
187.e: How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||2||
What is that penance, by which I may become a penitent?

187.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
187.t: kavanu su naam haumai mal khoi ||3||
187.e: What is that Name, by which the filth of egotism may be washed away? ||3||

187.g: ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਗਲ ਘਾਲ ॥
187.t: gun poojaa giaan dhiaan naanak sagal ghaal ||
187.e: Virtue, worship, spiritual wisdom, meditation and all service, O Nanak,

187.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥
187.t: jis kar kirapaa satigur milai dhiaal ||4||
187.e: are obtained from the True Guru, when, in His Mercy and Kindness, He meets us. ||4||

187.g: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਗੁਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
187.t: tis hee gun tin hee prabh jaataa ||
187.e: They alone receive this merit, and they alone know God,

187.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੩੬॥੧੦੫॥
187.t: jis kee maan lei sukhadhaataa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||36||105||
187.e: who are approved by the Giver of peace. ||1||Second Pause||36||105||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

187.g: ਆਪਨ ਤਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਗਰਬਾ ॥
187.t: aapan tan nahee jaa ko garabaa ||
187.e: The body which you are so proud of, does not belong to you.
Power, property and wealth are not yours. ||1||
They are not yours, so why do you cling to them?

187.g: ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
187.t: aapan naam satigur te paio ||1|| rahaau ||
187.e: Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is yours; it is received from the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
Children, spouse and siblings are not yours.

187.g: ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ ਆਪ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
187.t: eisaT meet aap baap na maiee ||2||
187.e: Dear friends, mother and father are not yours. ||2||
Gold, silver and money are not yours.
Fine horses and magnificent elephants are of no use to you. ||3||

187.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
187.t: kahu naanak jo gur bakhas milaiaa ||
187.e: Says Nanak, those whom the Guru forgives, meet with the Lord.

187.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੧੦੬॥
187.t: tis kaa sabh kichh jis kaa har raiaa ||4||37||106||
187.e: Everything belongs to those who have the Lord as their King. ||4||37||106||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

187.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
187.t: gur ke charan uoopar mere maathe ||
187.e: I place the Guru's Feet on my forehead,

187.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
187.t: taa te dhukh mere sagale laathe ||1||
187.e: and all my pains are gone. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

187.g: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ ਪਰਮ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
187.t: aatam cheen param ra(n)g maanee ||1|| rahaau ||
187.e: I have come to understand my soul, and I enjoy supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

187.g: ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
187.t: charan ren gur kee mukh laagee ||
187.e: I have applied the dust of the Guru's Feet to my face,
which has removed all my arrogant intellect. ||2||

187.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
187.t: gur kaa sabadh lago man meeThaa ||
187.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become sweet to my mind,
and I behold the Supreme Lord God. ||3||
The Guru is the Giver of peace; the Guru is the Creator.
O Nanak, the Guru is the Support of the breath of life and the soul. ||4||38||107||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

187.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਆਹਿ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਊਣਾ ਕਛਹੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
187.t: re man mere too(n) taa kau aaeh || jaa kai uoonaa kachhahoo naeh ||1||
187.e: O my mind, seek the One who lacks nothing. ||1||

187.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
187.t: har saa preetam kar man meet ||
187.e: Make the Beloved Lord your friend.

187.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਦ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
187.t: praan adhaar raakhahu sadh cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
187.e: Keep Him constantly in your mind; He is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

187.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਿ ॥
187.t: re man mere too(n) taa kau sev ||
187.e: O my mind, serve Him;
He is the Primal Being, the Infinite Divine Lord. ||2||

187.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨ ਕਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਸਾ ॥
187.t: tis uoopar man kar too(n) aasaa ||
187.e: Place your hopes in the One
who is the Support of all beings, from the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages. ||3||

187.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
187.t: jaa kee preet sadhaa sukh hoi ||
187.e: His Love brings eternal peace;
meeting the Guru, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||4||39||108||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Whatever my Friend does, I accept.
My Friend's actions are pleasing to me. ||1||
Within my conscious mind, the One Lord is my only Support.

187.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
187.t: jis kichh karanaa su hamaraa meet ||1|| rahaau ||
187.e: One who does this is my Friend. ||1||Pause||
My Friend is Carefree.
By Guru's Grace, I give my love to Him. ||2||
My Friend is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
He is the All-powerful Being, the Supreme Lord and Master. ||3||
I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master.

188.e: Nanak: my honor and glory are Yours, God. ||4||40||109||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

188.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਭਏ ਸਮਰਥ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
188.t: jaa kau tum bhe samarath a(n)gaa ||
188.e: Those who have You on their side, O All-powerful Lord
- no black stain can stick to them. ||1||

188.g: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
188.t: maadhau jaa kau hai aas tumaaree ||
188.e: O Lord of wealth, those who place their hopes in You

188.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
188.t: taa kau kachh naahee sa(n)saaree ||1|| rahaau ||
188.e: - nothing of the world can touch them at all. ||1||Pause||
Those whose hearts are filled with their Lord and Master
- no anxiety can affect them. ||2||

188.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੀਰ ॥
188.t: jaa kau tum dheenee prabh dheer ||
188.e: Those, unto whom You give Your consolation, God

188.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੩॥
188.t: taa kai nikaT na aavai peer ||3||
188.e: - pain does not even approach them. ||3||

188.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
188.t: kahu naanak mai so gur paiaa ||
188.e: Says Nanak, I have found that Guru,
who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God. ||4||41||110||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
This human body is so difficult to obtain; it is only obtained by great good fortune.

188.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
188.t: naam na japeh te aatam ghaatee ||1||
188.e: Those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are murderers of the soul. ||1||

188.g: ਮਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
188.t: mar na jaahee jinaa bisarat raam ||
188.e: Those who forget the Lord might just as well die.

188.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਉਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
188.t: naam bihoon jeevan kaun kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
188.e: Without the Naam, of what use are their lives? ||1||Pause||
Eating, drinking, playing, laughing and showing off
- what use are the ostentatious displays of the dead? ||2||
Those who do not listen to the Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss,

188.g: ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਤੇ ਮੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
188.t: pas pa(n)khee tiragadh jon te ma(n)dhaa ||3||
188.e: are worse off than beasts, birds or creeping creatures. ||3||
Says Nanak, the GurMantra has been implanted within me;
the Name alone is contained within my heart. ||4||42||111||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

188.g: ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਪ ॥
188.t: kaa kee maiee kaa ko baap ||
188.e: Whose mother is this? Whose father is this?
They are relatives in name only- they are all false. ||1||
Why are you screaming and shouting, you fool?

188.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
188.t: mil sa(n)jog hukam too(n) aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
188.e: By good destiny and the Lord's Order, you have come into the world. ||1||Pause||
There is the one dust, the one light,
the one praanic wind. Why are you crying? For whom do you cry? ||2||
People weep and cry out, ""Mine, mine!""
This soul is not perishable. ||3||
Says Nanak, the Guru has opened my shutters;
I am liberated, and my doubts have been dispelled. ||4||43||112||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Those who seem to be great and powerful,
are afflicted by the disease of anxiety. ||1||
Who is great by the greatness of Maya?

188.g: ਸੋ ਵਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
188.t: so vaddaa jin raam liv laiee ||1|| rahaau ||
188.e: They alone are great, who are lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The landlord fights over his land each day.
He shall have to leave it in the end, and yet his desire is still not satisfied. ||2||
Says Nanak, this is the essence of Truth:
without the Lord's meditation, there is no salvation. ||3||44||113||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Perfect is the path; perfect is the cleansing bath.
Everything is perfect, if the Naam is in the heart. ||1||
One's honor remains perfect, when the Perfect Lord preserves it.

188.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
188.t: paarabraham kee saran jan taakee ||1|| rahaau ||
188.e: His servant takes to the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||Pause||
Perfect is the peace; perfect is the contentment.
Perfect is the penance; perfect is the Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success. ||2||
On the Lord's Path, sinners are purified.
Perfect is their glory; perfect is their humanity. ||3||
They dwell forever in the Presence of the Creator Lord.
Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect. ||4||45||114||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

188.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਅਘ ਕੋਟ ॥
188.t: sa(n)t kee dhoor miTe agh koT ||
188.e: Millions of sins are wiped away by the dust of the feet of the Saints.

189.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥
189.t: sa(n)t prasaadh janam maran te chhoT ||1||
189.e: By the Grace of the Saints, one is released from birth and death. ||1||
The Blessed Vision of the Saints is the perfect cleansing bath.

189.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
189.t: sa(n)t kirapaa te japeeaai naam ||1|| rahaau ||
189.e: By the Grace of the Saints, one comes to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
In the Society of the Saints, egotism is shed,
and the One Lord is seen everywhere. ||2||
By the pleasure of the Saints, the five passions are overpowered,
and the heart is irrigated with the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

189.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
189.t: kahu naanak jaa kaa pooraa karam ||
189.e: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect,
touches the feet of the Holy. ||4||46||115||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating on the Glories of the Lord, the heart-lotus blossoms radiantly.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, all fears are dispelled. ||1||

189.g: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
189.t: saa mat pooree jit har gun gaavai ||
189.e: Perfect is that intellect, by which the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.

189.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
189.t: vaddai bhaag saadhoo sa(n)g paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
189.e: By great good fortune, one finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
In the Saadh Sangat, the treasure of the Name is obtained.
In the Saadh Sangat, all one's works are brought to fruition. ||2||
Through devotion to the Lord, one's life is approved.
By Guru's Grace, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
Says Nanak, that humble being is accepted,
within whose heart the Lord God abides. ||4||47||116||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

189.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
189.t: ekas siau jaa kaa man raataa ||
189.e: Those whose minds are imbued with the One Lord,
forget to feel jealous of others. ||1||
They see none other than the Lord of the Universe.
The Creator is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||1||Pause||

189.g: ਮਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
189.t: maneh kamaavai mukh har har bolai ||
189.e: Those who work willingly, and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har

189.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੨॥
189.t: so jan it ut kateh na ddolai ||2||
189.e: - they do not waver, here or hereafter. ||2||

189.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਚ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
189.t: jaa kai har dhan so sach saahu ||
189.e: Those who possess the wealth of the Lord are the true bankers.
The Perfect Guru has established their line of credit. ||3||
The Giver of life, the Sovereign Lord King meets them.
Says Nanak, they attain the supreme status. ||4||48||117||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the breath of life of His devotees.
The Naam is their wealth, the Naam is their occupation. ||1||
By the greatness of the Naam, His humble servants are blessed with glory.

189.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
189.t: kar kirapaa jis aap dhivaae ||1|| rahaau ||
189.e: The Lord Himself bestows it, in His Mercy. ||1||Pause||
The Naam is the home of peace of His devotees.
Attuned to the Naam, His devotees are approved. ||2||

189.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
189.t: har kaa naam jan kau dhaarai ||
189.e: The Name of the Lord is the support of His humble servants.
With each and every breath, they remember the Naam. ||3||
Says Nanak, those who have perfect destiny

189.t: naam sa(n)g taa kaa man laag ||4||49||118||
189.e: - their minds are attached to the Naam. ||4||49||118||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
By the Grace of the Saints, I meditated on the Name of the Lord.
Since then, my restless mind has been satisfied. ||1||
I have obtained the home of peace, singing His Glorious Praises.

189.g: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਤੀ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
189.t: sram miTiaa meree hatee balai ||1|| rahaau ||
189.e: My troubles have ended, and the demon has been destroyed. ||1||Pause||
Worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Lord God.

189.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
189.t: har simaran te miTee meree chi(n)taa ||2||
189.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, my anxiety has come to an end. ||2||

189.g: ਸਭ ਤਜਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਏਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
189.t: sabh taj anaath ek saran aaio ||
189.e: I have renounced all - I am an orphan. I have come to the Sanctuary of the One Lord.
Since then, I have found the highest celestial home. ||3||
My pains, troubles, doubts and fears are gone.
The Creator Lord abides in Nanak's mind. ||4||50||119||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

189.g: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਟਹਲ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
189.t: kar kar Tahal rasanaa gun gaavau ||
189.e: With my hands I do His work; with my tongue I sing His Glorious Praises.

190.e: With my feet, I walk on the Path of my Lord and Master. ||1||
It is a good time, when I remember Him in meditation.

190.g: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
190.t: simarat naam bhai paar utareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
190.e: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
With your eyes, behold the Blessed Vision of the Saints.
Record the Immortal Lord God within your mind. ||2||
Listen to the Kirtan of His Praises, at the Feet of the Holy.
Your fears of birth and death shall depart. ||3||
Enshrine the Lotus Feet of your Lord and Master within your heart.
Thus this human life, so difficult to obtain, shall be redeemed. ||4||51||120||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Those, upon whom the Lord Himself showers His Mercy,
chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with their tongues. ||1||
Forgetting the Lord, superstition and sorrow shall overtake you.

190.g: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
190.t: simarat naam bharam bhau bhaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
190.e: Meditating on the Naam, doubt and fear shall depart. ||1||Pause||

190.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
190.t: har keeratan sunai har keeratan gaavai ||
190.e: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and singing the Lord's Kirtan,

190.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
190.t: tis jan dhookh nikaT nahee aavai ||2||
190.e: misfortune shall not even come near you. ||2||

190.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰਤ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
190.t: har kee Tahal karat jan sohai ||
190.e: Working for the Lord, His humble servants look beautiful.

190.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
190.t: taa kau maiaa agan na pohai ||3||
190.e: The fire of Maya does not touch them. ||3||

190.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
190.t: man tan mukh har naam dhiaal ||
190.e: Within their minds, bodies and mouths, is the Name of the Merciful Lord.
Nanak has renounced other entanglements. ||4||52||121||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Renounce your cleverness, and your cunning tricks.
Seek the Support of the Perfect Guru. ||1||

190.g: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
190.t: dhukh binase sukh har gun gai ||
190.e: Your pain shall depart, and in peace, you shall sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

190.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
190.t: gur pooraa bheTiaa liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
190.e: Meeting the Perfect Guru, let yourself be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

190.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
190.t: har kaa naam dheeo gur ma(n)tr ||
190.e: The Guru has given me the Mantra of the Name of the Lord.
My worries are forgotten, and my anxiety is gone. ||2||
Meeting with the Merciful Guru, I am in ecstasy.
Showering His Mercy, He has cut away the noose of the Messenger of Death. ||3||
Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru;

190.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫੩॥੧੨੨॥
190.t: taa te bahur na biaapai maiaa ||4||53||122||
190.e: Maya shall no longer harass me. ||4||53||122||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The Perfect Guru Himself has saved me.
The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted with misfortune. ||1||
Chant and meditate on the Guru, the Guru, O my friend.
Your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Enshrine the Feet of the Guru within your heart;
your pains, enemies and bad luck shall be destroyed. ||2||

190.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
190.t: gur kaa sabadh terai sa(n)g sahaiee ||
190.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is your Companion and Helper.
O Siblings of Destiny, all beings shall be kind to you. ||3||
When the Perfect Guru granted His Grace,
says Nanak, I was totally, completely fulfilled. ||4||54||123||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Like beasts, they consume all sorts of tasty treats.
With the rope of emotional attachment, they are bound and gagged like thieves. ||1||
Their bodies are corpses, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

190.g: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
190.t: aavat jaat jonee dhukh kheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
190.e: They come and go in reincarnation, and are destroyed by pain. ||1||Pause||
They wear all sorts of beautiful robes,
but they are still just scarecrows in the field, frightening away the birds. ||2||
All bodies are of some use,
but those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are totally useless. ||3||

190.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
190.t: kahu naanak jaa kau bhe dhiaalaa ||
190.e: Says Nanak, those unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful,
join the Saadh Sangat, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||4||55||124||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

191.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad quiets worries and troubles.
Coming and going ceases, and all comforts are obtained. ||1||
Fear is dispelled, meditating on the Fearless Lord.

191.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
191.t: saadhasa(n)g har ke gun gaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
191.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of the Lord within my heart.
The Guru has carried me across the ocean of fire. ||2||
I was sinking down, and the Perfect Guru pulled me out.
I was cut off from the Lord for countless incarnations, and now the Guru united me with Him again. ||3||
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;
meeting Him, I have been saved. ||4||56||125||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, seek His Sanctuary.
Place your mind and body in offering before Him. ||1||
Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.

191.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਭ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
191.t: simar simar sabh tapat bujhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
191.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the fire of desire is totally quenched. ||1||Pause||
Renounce your arrogant pride, and end the cycle of birth and death.

191.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
191.t: har ke dhaas ke charan namasakaarahu ||2||
191.e: Bow in humility to the feet of the Lord's slave. ||2||
Remember God in your mind, with each and every breath.

191.g: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਜੋ ਚਾਲੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
191.t: so dhan sa(n)chahu jo chaalai naale ||3||
191.e: Gather only that wealth, which shall go with you. ||3||
He alone obtains it, upon whose forehead such destiny is written.

191.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥੫੭॥੧੨੬॥
191.t: kahu naanak taa kee charanee laag ||4||57||126||
191.e: Says Nanak, fall at the Feet of that Lord. ||4||57||126||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The dried branches are made green again in an instant.
His Ambrosial Glance irrigates and revives them. ||1||
The Perfect Divine Guru has removed my sorrow.

191.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੀ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
191.t: sevak kau dheenee apunee sev ||1|| rahaau ||
191.e: He blesses His servant with His service. ||1||Pause||

191.g: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤ ਪੁਨੀ ਮਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
191.t: miT giee chi(n)t punee man aasaa ||
191.e: Anxiety is removed, and the desires of the mind are fulfilled,
when the True Guru, the Treasure of Excellence, shows His Kindness. ||2||
Pain is driven far away, and peace comes in its place;

191.g: ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਰੀ ਜਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
191.t: ddeel na paree jaa gur furamaae ||3||
191.e: there is no delay, when the Guru gives the Order. ||3||
Desires are fulfilled, when one meets the True Guru;
O Nanak, His humble servant is fruitful and prosperous. ||4||58||127||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The fever has departed; God has showered us with peace and tranquility.
A cooling peace prevails; God has granted this gift. ||1||
By God's Grace, we have become comfortable.

191.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
191.t: janam janam ke bichhure mele ||1|| rahaau ||
191.e: Separated from Him for countless incarnations, we are now reunited with Him. ||1||Pause||
Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God's Name,
the dwelling of all disease is destroyed. ||2||
In intuitive peace and poise, chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.
Twenty-four hours a day, O mortal, meditate on God. ||3||

191.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
191.t: dhookh dharadh jam neR na aavai ||
191.e: Pain, suffering and the Messenger of Death do not even approach that one,

191.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫੯॥੧੨੮॥
191.t: kahu naanak jo har gun gaavai ||4||59||128||
191.e: says Nanak, who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||59||128||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Auspicious is the day, and auspicious is the chance,
which brought me to the Supreme Lord God, the Unjoined, Unlimited One. ||1||

191.g: ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
191.t: oh belaa kau hau bal jaau ||
191.e: I am a sacrifice to that time,

191.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
191.t: jit meraa man japai har naau ||1|| rahaau ||
191.e: when my mind chants the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Blessed is that moment, and blessed is that time,
when my tongue chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Haree. ||2||
Blessed is that forehead, which bows in humility to the Saints.
Sacred are those feet, which walk on the Lord's Path. ||3||
Says Nanak, auspicious is my karma,
which has led me to touch the Feet of the Holy. ||4||60||129||

192.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

192.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
192.t: gur kaa sabadh raakh man maeh ||
192.e: Keep the Word of the Guru's Shabad in your mind.
Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all anxiety is removed. ||1||
Without the Lord God, there is no one else at all.
He alone preserves and destroys. ||1||Pause||

192.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
192.t: gur ke charan ridhai ur dhaar ||
192.e: Enshrine the Guru's Feet in your heart.
Meditate on Him and cross over the ocean of fire. ||2||
Focus your meditation on the Guru's Sublime Form.
Here and hereafter, you shall be honored. ||3||
Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary.
My anxieties are over - O Nanak, I have found peace. ||4||61||130||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Remembering Him in meditation, all pains are gone.
The jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||

192.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
192.t: jap man mere govi(n)dh kee baanee ||
192.e: O my mind, chant the Bani, the Hymns of the Lord of the Universe.

192.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
192.t: saadhoo jan raam rasan vakhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
192.e: The Holy People chant the Lord's Name with their tongues. ||1||Pause||
Without the One Lord, there is no other at all.

192.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
192.t: jaa kee dhirasaT sadhaa sukh hoi ||2||
192.e: By His Glance of Grace, eternal peace is obtained. ||2||
Make the One Lord your friend, intimate and companion.

192.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
192.t: har har akhar man meh lekh ||3||
192.e: Write in your mind the Word of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
The Lord Master is totally pervading everywhere.
Nanak sings the Praises of the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||62||131||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The whole world is engrossed in fear.

192.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
192.t: tis bhau naahee jis naam adhaaraa ||1||
192.e: Those who have the Naam, the Name of the Lord, as their Support, feel no fear. ||1||
Fear does not affect those who take to Your Sanctuary.

192.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
192.t: jo tudh bhaavai soiee karanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
192.e: You do whatever You please. ||1||Pause||
In pleasure and in pain, the world is coming and going in reincarnation.

192.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
192.t: tin sukh paiaa jo prabh bhaanaa ||2||
192.e: Those who are pleasing to God, find peace. ||2||
Maya pervades the awesome ocean of fire.
Those who have found the True Guru are calm and cool. ||3||
Please preserve me, O God, O Great Preserver!
Says Nanak, what a helpless creature I am! ||4||63||132||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
By Your Grace, I chant Your Name.
By Your Grace, I obtain a seat in Your Court. ||1||
Without You, O Supreme Lord God, there is no one.

192.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
192.t: tumaree kirapaa te sadhaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
192.e: By Your Grace, everlasting peace is obtained. ||1||Pause||

192.g: ਤੁਮ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ਤਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
192.t: tum man vase tau dhookh na laagai ||
192.e: If You abide in the mind, we do not suffer in sorrow.

192.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
192.t: tumaree kirapaa te bhram bhau bhaagai ||2||
192.e: By Your Grace, doubt and fear run away. ||2||
O Supreme Lord God, Infinite Lord and Master,
You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||3||
I offer this prayer to the True Guru:
O Nanak, may I be blessed with the treasure of the True Name. ||4||64||133||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
As the husk is empty without the grain,
so is the mouth empty without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

192.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
192.t: har har naam japahu nit praanee ||
192.e: O mortal, chant continually the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

192.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਗਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
192.t: naam bihoon dhirag dheh bigaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
192.e: Without the Naam, cursed is the body, which shall be taken back by Death. ||1||Pause||
Without the Naam, no one's face shows good fortune.
Without the Husband, where is the marriage? ||2||
Forgetting the Naam, and attached to other tastes,

192.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੩॥
192.t: taa kee aas na poojai kai ||3||
192.e: no desires are fulfilled. ||3||
O God, grant Your Grace, and give me this gift.
Please, let Nanak chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||65||134||

193.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
You are All-powerful, You are my Lord and Master.

193.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
193.t: sabh kichh tum te too(n) a(n)tarajaamee ||1||
193.e: Everything comes from You; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||
The Perfect Supreme Lord God is the Support of His humble servant.

193.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੋਟਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
193.t: teree saran udhareh jan koT ||1|| rahaau ||
193.e: Millions are saved in Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||
As many creatures as there are - they are all Yours.
By Your Grace, all sorts of comforts are obtained. ||2||

193.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
193.t: jo kichh varatai sabh teraa bhaanaa ||
193.e: Whatever happens, is all according to Your Will.
One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||
Please grant Your Grace, God, and bestow this gift
upon Nanak, that he may meditate on the treasure of the Naam. ||4||66||135||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
By great good fortune, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is obtained,

193.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
193.t: jaa kee raam naam liv laagee ||1||
193.e: by those who are lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||

193.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
193.t: jaa kai har vasiaa man maahee ||
193.e: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord,

193.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
193.t: taa kau dhukh supanai bhee naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
193.e: do not suffer pain, even in dreams. ||1||Pause||
All treasures have been placed within the minds of His humble servants.

193.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
193.t: taa kai sa(n)g kilavikh dhukh jaeh ||2||
193.e: In their company, sinful mistakes and sorrows are taken away. ||2||

193.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
193.t: jan kee mahimaa kathee na jai ||
193.e: The Glories of the Lord's humble servants cannot be described.
The servants of the Supreme Lord God remain absorbed in Him. ||3||
Grant Your Grace, God, and hear my prayer:

193.g: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੬੭॥੧੩੬॥
193.t: dhaas kee dhoor naanak kau dheejai ||4||67||136||
193.e: please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your slave. ||4||67||136||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Remembering the Lord in meditation, your misfortune shall be taken away,
and all joy shall come to abide in your mind. ||1||
Meditate, O my mind, on the One Name.

193.g: ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
193.t: jeea tere kai aavai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
193.e: It alone shall be of use to your soul. ||1||Pause||
Night and day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord,
through the Pure Mantra of the Perfect Guru. ||2||
Give up other efforts, and place your faith in the Support of the One Lord.
Taste the Ambrosial Essence of this, the greatest treasure. ||3||
They alone cross over the treacherous world-ocean,
O Nanak, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||4||68||137||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
I have enshrined the Lotus Feet of God within my heart.
Meeting the Perfect True Guru, I am emancipated. ||1||
Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O my Siblings of Destiny.

193.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
193.t: mil saadhoo har naam dhiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
193.e: Joining the Holy Saints, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
This human body, so difficult to obtain, is redeemed
when one receives the banner of the Naam from the True Guru. ||2||
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the state of perfection is attained.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, fear and doubt depart. ||3||

193.g: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
193.t: jat kat dhekhau tat rahiaa samai ||
193.e: Wherever I look, there I see the Lord pervading.
Slave Nanak has entered the Lord's Sanctuary. ||4||69||138||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

193.g: ਗੁਰ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
193.t: gur jee ke dharasan kau bal jaau ||
193.e: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.
Chanting and meditating on the Name of the True Guru, I live. ||1||
O Supreme Lord God, O Perfect Divine Guru,

193.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲਾਗਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
193.t: kar kirapaa laagau teree sev ||1|| rahaau ||
193.e: show mercy to me, and commit me to Your service. ||1||Pause||
I enshrine His Lotus Feet within my heart.

193.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
193.t: man tan dhan gur praan adhaaree ||2||
193.e: I offer my mind, body and wealth to the Guru, the Support of the breath of life. ||2||
My life is prosperous, fruitful and approved;
I know that the Guru, the Supreme Lord God, is near me. ||3||
By great good fortune, I have obtained the dust of the feet of the Saints.

193.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੭੦॥੧੩੯॥
193.t: naanak gur bheTat har siau liv laagee ||4||70||139||
193.e: O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I have fallen in love with the Lord. ||4||70||139||

194.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
They do their evil deeds, and pretend otherwise;
but in the Court of the Lord, they shall be bound and gagged like thieves. ||1||
Those who remember the Lord belong to the Lord.

194.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
194.t: jal thal maheeal ek samaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
194.e: The One Lord is contained in the water, the land and the sky. ||1||Pause||
Their inner beings are filled with poison, and yet with their mouths, they preach words of Ambrosial Nectar.
Bound and gagged in the City of Death, they are punished and beaten. ||2||
Hiding behind many screens, they commit acts of corruption,
but in an instant, they are revealed to all the world. ||3||
Those whose inner beings are true, who are attuned to the ambrosial essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord
- O Nanak, the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is merciful to them. ||4||71||140||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

194.g: ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਉਤਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
194.t: raam ra(n)g kadhe utar na jai ||
194.e: The Lord's Love shall never leave or depart.
They alone understand, unto whom the Perfect Guru gives it. ||1||

194.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
194.t: har ra(n)g raataa so man saachaa ||
194.e: One whose mind is attuned to the Lord's Love is true.

194.g: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
194.t: laal ra(n)g pooran purakh bidhaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
194.e: The Love of the Beloved, the Architect of Destiny, is perfect. ||1||Pause||
Sitting in the Society of the Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

194.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
194.t: taa kaa ra(n)g na utarai jai ||2||
194.e: The color of His Love shall never fade away. ||2||

194.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
194.t: bin har simaran sukh nahee paiaa ||
194.e: Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, peace is not found.
All the other loves and tastes of Maya are bland and insipid. ||3||
Those who are imbued with love by the Guru become happy.

194.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥੭੨॥੧੪੧॥
194.t: kahu naanak gur bhe hai dhiaal ||4||72||141||
194.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has become merciful to them. ||4||72||141||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord Master, sinful mistakes are erased,
and one comes to abide in peace, celestial joy and bliss. ||1||
The Lord's humble servants place their faith in the Lord.

194.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
194.t: naam japat sabh miTio a(n)dhesaa ||1|| rahaau ||
194.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all anxieties are dispelled. ||1||Pause||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, there is no fear or doubt.
The Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung there, day and night. ||2||
Granting His Grace, God has released me from bondage.
He has given me the Support of His Lotus Feet. ||3||

194.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਸੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਜਨ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੭੩॥੧੪੨॥
194.t: kahu naanak man bhiee parateet || niramal jas peeveh jan neet ||4||73||142||
194.e: Says Nanak, faith comes into the mind of His servant, who continually drinks in the Immaculate Praises of the Lord. ||4||73||142||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

194.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
194.t: har charanee jaa kaa man laagaa ||
194.e: Those who keep their minds attached to the Lord's Feet

194.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
194.t: dhookh dharadh bhram taa kaa bhaagaa ||1||
194.e: - pain, suffering and doubt run away from them. ||1||
Those who deal in the Lord's wealth are perfect.

194.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
194.t: jiseh nivaaje so jan sooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
194.e: Those who are honored by the Lord are the true spiritual heroes. ||1||Pause||
Those humble beings, unto whom the Lord of the Universe shows mercy,

194.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
194.t: se jan laage gur kee paiee ||2||
194.e: fall at the Guru's Feet. ||2||
They are blessed with peace, celestial bliss, tranquility and ecstasy;
chanting and meditating, they live in supreme bliss. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, I have earned the wealth of the Naam.
Says Nanak, God has relieved my pain. ||4||74||143||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all suffering is eradicated.
The Lord's Lotus Feet are enshrined within my mind. ||1||
Chant the Lord's Name, hundreds of thousands of times, O my dear,

194.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
194.t: a(n)mirat ras peevahu prabh piaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
194.e: and drink deeply of the Ambrosial Essence of God. ||1||Pause||
Peace, celestial bliss, pleasures and the greatest ecstasy are obtained;
chanting and meditating, you shall live in supreme bliss. ||2||
Sexual desire, anger, greed and ego are eradicated;

194.g: ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਸਭ ਧੋਏ ॥੩॥
194.t: saadh kai sa(n)g kilabikh sabh dhoe ||3||
194.e: in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sinful mistakes are washed away. ||3||
Grant Your Grace, O God, O Merciful to the meek.
Please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||75||144||

195.e: Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
They wear and eat the gifts from the Lord;

195.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਬਨੈ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
195.t: tis siau aalas kiau banai mai ||1||
195.e: how can laziness help them, O mother? ||1||
Forgetting her Husband Lord, and attaching herself to other affairs,
the soul-bride throws away the precious jewel in exchange for a mere shell. ||1||Pause||
Forsaking God, she is attached to other desires.
But who has gained honor by saluting the slave? ||2||
They consume food and drink, delicious and sublime as ambrosial nectar.

195.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਸੁਆਨ ॥੩॥
195.t: jin dhe'ee tiseh na jaaneh suaan ||3||
195.e: But the dog does not know the One who has bestowed these. ||3||
Says Nanak, I have been unfaithful to my own nature.
Please forgive me, O God, O Searcher of hearts. ||4||76||145||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

195.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
195.t: prabh ke charan man maeh dhiaan ||
195.e: I meditate on the Feet of God within my mind.
This is my cleansing bath at all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

195.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
195.t: har dhin har simaran mere bhaiee ||
195.e: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord every day, O my Siblings of Destiny.

195.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
195.t: koT janam kee mal leh jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
195.e: Thus, the filth of millions of incarnations shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||

195.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਸਾਈ ॥
195.t: har kee kathaa ridh maeh basaiee ||
195.e: Enshrine the Lord's Sermon within your heart,
and you shall obtain all the desires of your mind. ||2||
Redeemed is the life, death and birth of those,
within whose hearts the Lord God abides. ||3||
Says Nanak, those humble beings are perfect,
who are blessed with the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||77||146||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
They eat and wear what they are given, but still, they deny the Lord.
The messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma shall hunt them down. ||1||

195.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਬੇਮੁਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
195.t: tis siau bemukh jin jeeau pi(n)dd dheenaa ||
195.e: They are unfaithful to the One, who has given them body and soul.

195.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੂਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
195.t: koT janam bharameh bahu joonaa ||1|| rahaau ||
195.e: Through millions of incarnations, for so many lifetimes, they wander lost. ||1||Pause||
Such is the lifestyle of the faithless cynics;
everything they do is evil. ||2||

195.g: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥ ਸੋਈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
195.t: jeeau praan jin man tan dhaariaa || soiee Thaakur manahu bisaariaa ||3||
195.e: Within their minds, they have forgotten that Lord and Master, who created the soul, breath of life, mind and body. ||3||
Their wickedness and corruption have increased - they are recorded in volumes of books.
O Nanak, they are saved only by the Mercy of God, the Ocean of peace. ||4||
O Supreme Lord God, I have come to Your Sanctuary.

195.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭੮॥੧੪੭॥
195.t: ba(n)dhan kaaT tarai har nai ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||78||147||
195.e: Break my bonds, and carry me across, with the Lord's Name. ||1||Second Pause||78||147||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
For their own advantage, they make God their friend.
He fulfills all their desires, and blesses them with the state of liberation. ||1||
Everyone should make Him such a friend.

195.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
195.t: jaa te birathaa koi na hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
195.e: No one goes away empty-handed from Him. ||1||Pause||
For their own purposes, they enshrine the Lord in the heart;
all pain, suffering and disease are taken away. ||2||
Their tongues learn the habit of chanting the Lord's Name,
and all their works are brought to perfection. ||3||
So many times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him;
fruitful is the Blessed Vision, the Darshan, of my Lord of the Universe. ||4||79||148||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Millions of obstacles are removed in an instant,
for those who listen to the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

195.g: ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
195.t: peevat raam ras a(n)mirat gun jaas ||
195.e: They drink in the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, the Ambrosial Elixir.

195.g: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਿਟੀ ਖੁਧਿ ਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
195.t: jap har charan miTee khudh taas ||1|| rahaau ||
195.e: Meditating on the Lord's Feet, hunger is taken away. ||1||Pause||
The treasure of all happiness, celestial peace and poise,
are obtained by those, whose hearts are filled with the Lord God. ||2||

196.e: All medicines and remedies, mantras and tantras are nothing more than ashes.
Enshrine the Creator Lord within your heart. ||3||
Renounce all your doubts, and vibrate upon the Supreme Lord God.
Says Nanak, this path of Dharma is eternal and unchanging. ||4||80||149||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord bestowed His Mercy, and led me to meet the Guru.

196.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਬਲਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
196.t: tit bal rog na biaapai koiee ||1||
196.e: By His power, no disease afflicts me. ||1||
Remembering the Lord, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

196.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਫਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਕਾਗਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
196.t: saran soor faare jam kaagar ||1|| rahaau ||
196.e: In the Sanctuary of the spiritual warrior, the account books of the Messenger of Death are torn up. ||1||Pause||
The True Guru has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name.
By this Support, my affairs have been resolved. ||2||

196.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪੂਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੩॥
196.t: jap tap sa(n)jam pooree vaddiaaiee || gur kirapaal har bhe sahaiee ||3||
196.e: Meditation, self-discipline, self-control and perfect greatness were obtained when the Merciful Lord, the Guru, became my Help and Support. ||3||
The Guru has dispelled pride, emotional attachment and superstition.
Nanak sees the Supreme Lord God pervading everywhere. ||4||81||150||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The blind beggar is better off than the vicious king.
Overcome by pain, the blind man invokes the Lord's Name. ||1||
You are the glorious greatness of Your slave.

196.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
196.t: maiaa magan narak lai jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
196.e: The intoxication of Maya leads the others to hell. ||1||Pause||
Gripped by disease, they invoke the Name.

196.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਕਾ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥੨॥
196.t: bikh maate kaa Thaur na Thaau ||2||
196.e: But those who are intoxicated with vice shall find no home, no place of rest. ||2||
One who is in love with the Lord's Lotus Feet,
does not think of any other comforts. ||3||
Forever and ever, meditate on God, your Lord and Master.
O Nanak, meet with the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||82||151||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Twenty-four hours a day, the highway robbers are my companions.
Granting His Grace, God has driven them away. ||1||

196.g: ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਮਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
196.t: aaisaa har ras ramahu sabh koi ||
196.e: Everyone should dwell on the Sweet Name of such a Lord.

196.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
196.t: sarab kalaa pooran prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
196.e: God is overflowing with all power. ||1||Pause||
The world-ocean is burning hot!
In an instant, God saves us, and carries us across. ||2||
There are so many bonds, they cannot be broken.
Remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the fruit of liberation is obtained. ||3||

196.g: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
196.t: aukat siaanap is te kachh naeh ||
196.e: By clever devices, nothing is accomplished.
Grant Your Grace to Nanak, that he may sing the Glories of God. ||4||83||152||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Those who obtain the wealth of the Lord's Name
move freely in the world; all their affairs are resolved. ||1||
By great good fortune, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.

196.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
196.t: paarabraham too(n) dheh ta paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
196.e: O Supreme Lord God, as You give, so do I receive. ||1||Pause||

196.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
196.t: har ke charan hiradhai ur dhaar ||
196.e: Enshrine the Lord's Feet within your heart.
Get aboard this boat, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
Everyone who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

196.g: ਸਦਾ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
196.t: sadhaa kaliaan fir dhookh na hoi ||3||
196.e: obtains eternal peace; pain does not afflict them any longer. ||3||
With loving devotional worship, meditate on the treasure of excellence.
O Nanak, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||84||153||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

196.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤ ॥
196.t: jal thal maheeal pooran har meet ||
196.e: The Lord, our Friend, is totally pervading the water, the land and the skies.
Doubts are dispelled by continually singing the Lord's Glorious Praises. ||1||
While rising up, and while lying down in sleep, the Lord is always with you, watching over you.

196.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਜਮ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
196.t: jaa kai simaran jam nahee ddarooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
196.e: Remembering Him in meditation, the fear of Death departs. ||1||Pause||
With God's Lotus Feet abiding in the heart,

197.e: all suffering comes to an end. ||2||
The One Lord is my hope, honor, power and wealth.

197.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਟੇਕ ॥੩॥
197.t: saache saeh kee man meh Tek ||3||
197.e: Within my mind is the Support of the True Banker. ||3||
I am the poorest and most helpless servant of the Holy.
O Nanak, giving me His Hand, God has protected me. ||4||85||154||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

197.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਚੇ ॥
197.t: har har naam majan kar sooche ||
197.e: Taking my cleansing bath in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been purified.

197.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਹਣ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਮੂਚੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
197.t: koT grahan pu(n)n fal mooche ||1|| rahaau ||
197.e: Its reward surpasses the giving of charity at millions of solar eclipses. ||1||Pause||

197.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੇ ॥
197.t: har ke charan ridhe meh base ||
197.e: With the Lord's Feet abiding in the heart,
the sinful mistakes of countless incarnations are removed. ||1||
I have obtained the reward of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

197.g: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
197.t: jam kaa maarag dhirasaT na aaiaa ||2||
197.e: I no longer have to gaze upon the way of death. ||2||
In thought, word and deed, seek the Support of the Lord of the Universe;
thus you shall be saved from the poisonous world-ocean. ||3||
Granting His Grace, God has made me His Own.
Nanak chants and meditates on the Chant of the Lord's Name. ||4||86||155||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Seek the Sanctuary of those who have come to know the Lord.

197.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
197.t: man tan seetal charan har raate ||1||
197.e: Your mind and body shall become cool and peaceful, imbued with the Feet of the Lord. ||1||

197.g: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
197.t: bhai bha(n)jan prabh man na basaahee ||
197.e: If God, the Destroyer of fear, does not dwell within your mind,

197.g: ਡਰਪਤ ਡਰਪਤ ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
197.t: ddarapat ddarapat janam bahut jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
197.e: you shall spend countless incarnations in fear and dread. ||1||Pause||

197.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
197.t: jaa kai ridhai basio har naam ||
197.e: Those who have the Lord's Name dwelling within their hearts

197.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
197.t: sagal manorath taa ke pooran kaam ||2||
197.e: have all their desires and tasks fulfilled. ||2||
Birth, old age and death are in His Power,
so remember that All-powerful Lord with each breath and morsel of food. ||3||
The One God is my Intimate, Best Friend and Companion.
The Naam, the Name of my Lord and Master, is Nanak's only Support. ||4||87||156||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
When they are out and about, they keep Him enshrined in their hearts;
returning home, the Lord of the Universe is still with them. ||1||

197.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
197.t: har har naam sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g ||
197.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Companion of His Saints.

197.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
197.t: man tan raataa raam kai ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
197.e: Their minds and bodies are imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's Grace, one crosses over the world-ocean;

197.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
197.t: janam janam ke kilavikh sabh hiriaa ||2||
197.e: the sinful mistakes of countless incarnations are all washed away. ||2||
Honor and intuitive awareness are acquired through the Name of the Lord God.
The Teachings of the Perfect Guru are immaculate and pure. ||3||
Within your heart, meditate on the His Lotus Feet.
Nanak lives by beholding the Lord's Expansive Power. ||4||88||157||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

197.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
197.t: dha(n)n ih thaan govi(n)dh gun gaae ||
197.e: Blessed is this place, where the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe are sung.

197.g: ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
197.t: kusal khem prabh aap basaae ||1|| rahaau ||
197.e: God Himself bestows peace and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

197.g: ਬਿਪਤਿ ਤਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
197.t: bipat tahaa jahaa har simaran naahee ||
197.e: Misfortune occurs where the Lord is not remembered in meditation.

197.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
197.t: koT ana(n)dh jeh har gun gaahee ||1||
197.e: There are millions of joys where the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung. ||1||
Forgetting the Lord, all sorts of pains and diseases come.

197.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੨॥
197.t: prabh sevaa jam lagai na nere ||2||
197.e: Serving God, the Messenger of Death will not even approach you. ||2||
Very blessed, stable and sublime is that place,
where the Name of God alone is chanted. ||3||

197.g: ਜਹ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
197.t: jeh jaieeaai teh naal meraa suaamee ||
197.e: Wherever I go, my Lord and Master is with me.
Nanak has met the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||89||158||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
That mortal who meditates on the Lord of the Universe,
whether educated or uneducated, obtains the state of supreme dignity. ||1||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Lord of the World.

197.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਝੂਠਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
197.t: bin naavai jhooThaa dhan maal ||1|| rahaau ||
197.e: Without the Name, wealth and property are false. ||1||Pause||

198.e: They alone are handsome, clever and wise,

198.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
198.t: jin jan maaniaa prabh kaa bhaanaa ||2||
198.e: who surrender to the Will of God. ||2||
Blessed is their coming into this world,
if they recognize their Lord and Master in each and every heart. ||3||

198.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਗ ॥
198.t: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran bhaag ||
198.e: Says Nanak, their good fortune is perfect,

198.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੯੦॥੧੫੯॥
198.t: har charanee taa kaa man laag ||4||90||159||
198.e: if they enshrine the Lord's Feet within their minds. ||4||90||159||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

198.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
198.t: har ke dhaas siau saakat nahee sa(n)g ||
198.e: The Lord's servant does not associate with the faithless cynic.

198.g: ਓਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ ਓਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
198.t: oh bikhiee os raam ko ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
198.e: One is in the clutches of vice, while the other is in love with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
It would be like an imaginary rider on a decorated horse,
or a eunuch caressing a woman. ||1||
It would be like tying up an ox and trying to milk it,
or riding a cow to chase a tiger. ||2||
It would be like taking a sheep and worshipping it as the Elysian cow,
the giver of all blessings; it would be like going out shopping without any money. ||3||
O Nanak, consciously meditate on the Lord's Name.
Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, your Best Friend. ||4||91||160||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Pure and steady is that intellect,
which drinks in the Lord's sublime essence. ||1||

198.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਰਿ ਓਟ ॥
198.t: har ke charan hiradhai kar oT ||
198.e: Keep the Support of the Lord's Feet in your heart,

198.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਹੋਵਤ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
198.t: janam maran te hovat chhoT ||1|| rahaau ||
198.e: and you shall be saved from the cycle of birth and death. ||1||Pause||

198.g: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਨ ਪਾਪੁ ॥
198.t: so tan niramal jit upajai na paap ||
198.e: Pure is that body, in which sin does not arise.
In the Love of the Lord is pure glory. ||2||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, corruption is eradicated.
This is the greatest blessing of all. ||3||
Imbued with loving devotional worship of the Sustainer of the Universe,
Nanak asks for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||92||161||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Such is my love for the Lord of the Universe;
through perfect good destiny, I have been united with Him. ||1||Pause||
As the wife is delighted upon beholding her husband,

198.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
198.t: tiau har jan jeevai naam chitaaree ||1||
198.e: so does the Lord's humble servant live by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
As the mother is rejuvenated upon seeing her son,

198.g: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
198.t: ot pot jan har siau raataa ||2||
198.e: so is the Lord's humble servant imbued with Him, through and through. ||2||
As the greedy man rejoices upon beholding his wealth,

198.g: ਜਨ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
198.t: jan charan kamal siau laago manaa ||3||
198.e: so is the mind of the Lord's humble servant attached to His Lotus Feet. ||3||
May I never forget You, for even an instant, O Great Giver!
Nanak's God is the Support of his breath of life. ||4||93||162||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Those humble beings who are accustomed to the Lord's sublime essence,

198.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤੀ ਬੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
198.t: charan kamal prem bhagatee beedhe ||1|| rahaau ||
198.e: are pierced through with loving devotional worship of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||
All other pleasures look like ashes;
without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the world is fruitless. ||1||
He Himself rescues us from the deep dark well.
Wondrous and Glorious are the Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
In the woods and meadows, and throughout the three worlds, the Sustainer of the Universe is pervading.
The Expansive Lord God is Merciful to all beings. ||3||
Says Nanak, that speech alone is excellent,
which is approved by the Creator Lord. ||4||94||163||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Every day, take your bath in the Sacred Pool of the Lord.

198.g: ਝੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
198.t: jhol mahaa ras har a(n)mrit peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
198.e: Mix and drink in the most delicious, sublime Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The water of the Name of the Lord of the Universe is immaculate and pure.
Take your cleansing bath in it, and all your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||

199.e: In the Society of the Saints, spiritual conversations take place.
The sinful mistakes of millions of incarnations are erased. ||2||
The Holy Saints meditate in remembrance, in ecstasy.
Their minds and bodies are immersed in supreme ecstasy. ||3||

199.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੪॥੯੫॥੧੬੪॥
199.t: jiseh paraapat har charan nidhaan || naanak dhaas tiseh kurabaan ||4||95||164||
199.e: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to those who have obtained the treasure of the Lord's Feet. ||4||95||164||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

199.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
199.t: so kichh kar jit mail na laagai ||
199.e: Do only that, by which no filth or pollution shall stick to you.

199.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
199.t: har keeratan meh eh man jaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
199.e: Let your mind remain awake and aware, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||
Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; do not be in love with duality.
In the Society of the Saints, chant only the Name. ||1||
The karma of good actions, the Dharma of righteous living, religious rituals, fasts and worship
- practice these, but do not know any other than the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

199.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
199.t: taa kee pooran hoiee ghaal || jaa kee preet apune prabh naal ||3||
199.e: Those who place their love in God - their works are brought to fruition. ||3||
Infinitely invaluable is that Vaishnaav, that worshipper of Vishnu,
says Nanak, who has renounced corruption. ||4||96||165||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
They desert you even when you are alive, O madman;
what good can they do when someone is dead? ||1||

199.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥
199.t: simar govi(n)dh man tan dhur likhiaa ||
199.e: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe in your mind and body - this is your pre-ordained destiny.

199.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
199.t: kaahoo kaaj na aavat bikhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
199.e: The poison of Maya is of no use at all. ||1||Pause||
Those who have eaten this poison of deception

199.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
199.t: taa kee tirasanaa kabahoo(n) na jaiee ||2||
199.e: - their thirst shall never depart. ||2||
The treacherous world-ocean is filled with terrible pain.

199.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
199.t: raam naam bin kaise utaras paar ||3||
199.e: Without the Lord's Name, how can anyone cross over? ||3||
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be saved here and hereafter.
O Nanak, worship and adore the Name of the Lord. ||4||97||166||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The bearded emperor who struck down the poor,
has been burnt in the fire by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
The Creator administers true justice.
He is the Saving Grace of His slaves. ||1||Pause||
In the beginning, and throughout the ages, His glory is manifest.
The slanderer died after contracting the deadly fever. ||2||

199.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਿ ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
199.t: tin maariaa j rakhai na koi ||
199.e: He is killed, and no one can save him.
Here and hereafter, his reputation is evil. ||3||
The Lord hugs His slaves close in His Embrace.
Nanak seeks the Lord's Sanctuary, and meditates on the Naam. ||4||98||167||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The memorandum was proven to be false by the Lord Himself.
The sinner is now suffering in despair. ||1||
Those who have my Lord of the Universe as their support

199.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
199.t: tis kau jam nahee aavai neraa ||1|| rahaau ||
199.e: - death does not even approach them. ||1||Pause||
In the True Court, they lie;
the blind fools strike their own heads with their own hands. ||2||
Sickness afflicts those who commit sins;
God Himself sits as the Judge. ||3||
By their own actions, they are bound and gagged.

199.g: ਦਰਬੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੈ ॥੪॥
199.t: dharab giaa sabh jeea kai saathai ||4||
199.e: All their wealth is gone, along with their lives. ||4||
Nanak has taken to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Court;
my Creator has preserved my honor. ||5||99||168||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

199.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੀਠ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥
199.t: jan kee dhoor man meeTh khaTaanee ||
199.e: The dust of the feet of the humble beings is so sweet to my mind.

199.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
199.t: poorab karam likhiaa dhur praanee ||1|| rahaau ||
199.e: Perfect karma is the mortal's pre-ordained destiny. ||1||Pause||

200.e: The mind is overflowing with the greasy dirt of egotistical pride.
With the dust of the feet of the Holy, it is scrubbed clean. ||1||
The body may be washed with loads of water,

200.g: ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਤੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
200.t: mail na utarai sudh na tehee ||2||
200.e: and yet its filth is not removed, and it does not become clean. ||2||
I have met the True Guru, who is merciful forever.

200.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਭਉ ਕਾਲ ॥੩॥
200.t: har simar simar kaaTiaa bhau kaal ||3||
200.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am rid of the fear of death. ||3||
Liberation, pleasures and worldly success are all in the Lord's Name.
With loving devotional worship, O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||4||100||169||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord's slaves attain the highest status of life.
Meeting them, the soul is enlightened. ||1||

200.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
200.t: har kaa simaran sun man kaanee ||
200.e: Those who listen with their mind and ears to the Lord's meditative remembrance,

200.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
200.t: sukh paaveh har dhuaar paraanee ||1|| rahaau ||
200.e: are blessed with peace at the Lord's Gate, O mortal. ||1||Pause||
Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Sustainer of the World.
O Nanak, gazing on the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am enraptured. ||2||101||170||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
Peace and tranquility have come; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, has brought it.

200.g: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
200.t: taap paap binase mere bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
200.e: The burning sins have departed, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
With your tongue, continually chant the Lord's Name.
Disease shall depart, and you shall be saved. ||1||
Contemplate the Glorious Virtues of the Unfathomable Supreme Lord God.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be emancipated. ||2||
Sing the Glories of God each and every day;
your afflictions shall be dispelled, and you shall be saved, my humble friend. ||3||

200.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
200.t: man bach karam prabh apanaa dhiaaiee ||
200.e: In thought, word and deed, I meditate on my God.
Slave Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||102||171||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
The Divine Guru has opened his eyes.

200.g: ਭਰਮ ਗਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
200.t: bharam ge pooran bhiee sev ||1|| rahaau ||
200.e: Doubt has been dispelled; my service has been successful. ||1||Pause||
The Giver of joy has saved him from smallpox.
The Supreme Lord God has granted His Grace. ||1||
O Nanak, he alone lives, who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, drink deeply of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||103||172||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:

200.g: ਧਨੁ ਓਹੁ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨੇਤ ॥
200.t: dhan oh masatak dhan tere net ||
200.e: Blessed is that forehead, and blessed are those eyes;

200.g: ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤ ॥੧॥
200.t: dhan oi bhagat jin tum sa(n)g het ||1||
200.e: blessed are those devotees who are in love with You. ||1||
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how anyone find peace?

200.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
200.t: rasanaa raam naam jas kaheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
200.e: With your tongue, chant the Praises of the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Nanak is a sacrifice to those
who meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||2||104||173||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
You are my Advisor; You are always with me.
You preserve, protect and care for me. ||1||
Such is the Lord, our Help and Support in this world and the next.

200.g: ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
200.t: dhaas kee paij rakhai mere bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
200.e: He protects the honor of His slave, O my Sibling of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

200.g: ਆਗੈ ਆਪਿ ਇਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
200.t: aagai aap ih thaan vas jaa kai ||
200.e: He alone exists hereafter; this place is in His Power.

200.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੨॥
200.t: aaTh pahar man har kau jaapai ||2||
200.e: Twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, chant and meditate on the Lord. ||2||
His honor is acknowledged, and he bears the True Insignia;
the Lord Himself issues His Royal Command. ||3||
He Himself is the Giver; He Himself is the Cherisher.

200.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦੫॥੧੭੪॥
200.t: nit nit naanak raam naam samaal ||4||105||174||
200.e: Continually, continuously, O Nanak, dwell upon the Name of the Lord. ||4||105||174||
Gauree, Fifth Mehla:
When the Perfect True Guru becomes merciful,
the Lord of the World abides in the heart forever. ||1||

200.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
200.t: raam ravat sadh hee sukh paiaa ||
200.e: Meditating on the Lord, I have found eternal peace.
